# Пул нод из админки (подпроект 2) — Implementation Plan

> **For agentic workers:** REQUIRED SUB-SKILL: Use superpowers:subagent-driven-development (recommended) or superpowers:executing-plans to implement this plan task-by-task. Steps use checkbox (`- [ ]`) syntax for tracking.

**Goal:** владелец сам добавляет, проверяет и выводит exit-ноды за рубежом и резервные входы в РФ, управляет доменами и видит/настраивает весь сервис из админки — без CLI и SSH; падение любой одной ноды не роняет сервис.

**Architecture:** единое ядро провижининга `internal/provision` на Hub (SSH, идемпотентные шаги apply/verify/rollback, задачи в БД) для админки и CLI; роли нод `exit|relay`; два туннеля на каждый exit (Hysteria + TCP Reality) с однозначными тегами; ретранслятор в РФ = nftables DNAT+SNAT на Hub; реестр доменов; админка перестраивается вокруг владельца (раздел 7 спецификации).

**Tech Stack:** Go 1.24 (module `github.com/heyearth/backend`, raw SQL lib/pq, PostgreSQL, golang-migrate), Xray-core 26.3.27, Hysteria 2.13.0, nginx 1.24 (stream + http), nftables/iptables-nft, React 19 + Vite + Tailwind v4 (`admin_web`), Beads.

**Spec:** `docs/superpowers/specs/2026-10-12-node-pool-design.md` (approved). Research: `docs/research/2026-10-12-node-pool-map.md`, `docs/research/2026-10-12-admin-panel-audit.md`.

## Global Constraints

- Ветка: `vpn/node-pool` от `main`. Коммиты — только явные пути (`git add <files>`, никогда `-A`), без amend, без `.build/*`; сообщение заканчивается строкой `Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>`.
- Проверка каждой задачи: `cd server/backend && gofmt -l <изменённые .go> && go build ./... && go vet ./... && go test ./<пакеты> -count=1`; для `admin_web` — `cd admin_web && npm test && npm run build` (`npm test` = `node --test` из Task 1.9; фаза 5 его не сужает, только добавляет скрипты). Вставлять реальный вывод.
- Деплой на прод и проверки на проде делает **только контроллер** (не исполнитель): API — `REF=<sha> deploy_api.sh` из чистого worktree; админка — `go run ./cmd/deploy --admin-web`.
- **Пока на проде включён PROXY-режим, никогда не деплоить API без зеркала `vless-reality-pp`** (все сборки этой ветки его содержат).
- Миграции (golang-migrate, файл = один Exec, без транзакции): фаза 1 — `000059_payments_refund_permission`; фаза 2 — `000060_node_roles_and_jobs`; фаза 3 — `000061_entries_failover`; фаза 4 — `000062_domains`; фаза 5 — `000063_admin_settings_whitelist` (только если нужна). Каждая — `up` + `down`, идемпотентно (`IF NOT EXISTS`, `ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING`).
- Xray: теги выходов `exit-<id>.hy` (Hysteria SOCKS `127.0.0.1:1088+id`) и `exit-<id>.vr` (VLESS Reality TCP прямо на exit); селектор exit для балансеров — `exit-<id>.`; общий балансер — селектор `exit-`; observatory `subjectSelector: ["exit-"]`. Дублирование тегов по `load_weight` запрещено; вес — через стратегию балансера `leastLoad` + `costs`.
- Порты: Hysteria-клиент exit N на Hub — `127.0.0.1:(1088+N)` (N ≤ 511); никакого :1091/«dedicated».
- Секреты (`ssh_password*`, приватные ключи, `tunnel_uuid`, `tunnel_ss_password`, `tunnel_private_key`, `yookassa_secret_key`, `smtp_password`, `hysteria2_obfs_password`, `hysteria2_stats_secret`, `hub_tunnel_password`, `awg_server_private_key`, `alert_telegram_bot_token`, `vless_uuid` — мастер-UUID Hub тоже учётка) **никогда** не возвращаются API админки; в UI — только на запись (образец: токен бота в `AlertsPage.jsx`). Единый список ключей `app_settings` — `secretSettingKeys` в `internal/admin/settings_handlers.go` (Task 1.7; фаза 5 только дописывает).
- Права: каждое новое право (`payments.refund`, `nodes.provision`, `domains.manage`) — и в миграции, и в `permissionCatalog` (`internal/admin/auth.go`): `ensureSuperAdminRole` при каждом входе пересобирает `super_admin` из каталога. Разделы «Ноды», «Входы», «Домены» видны с `servers.read`; изменения в них — `nodes.provision` («Ноды», «Входы») и `domains.manage` («Домены»).
- Метки UI: `load_weight` везде называется «Приоритет» (1–10) с пояснением «трафик идёт на живой выход с более высоким приоритетом (с учётом задержки), остальные — резерв» — фаза 1 делает его предпочтением `leastLoad` + `costs`, а не долей трафика; слова «вес/доля» в UI не используются.
- SSH к нодам: только с подтверждённым владельцем отпечатком ключа хоста (`servers.ssh_host_key_fp`); `ssh.InsecureIgnoreHostKey` в коде нод запрещён.
- API никогда не перезапускает сам себя (`systemctl restart heyearth-api` из кода API запрещён); после изменений — `RequestXraySync()` / синк hysteria-клиентов.
- Шаблоны конфигов нод — только из `internal/config` (одни для админки и CLI). Тюнинг Hysteria на exit: окна `26843545/67108864`, `bandwidth up/down 100 mbps`, ACL `config.ExitHysteriaACL(exitIP, mtprotoPort)`.
- UI: русский язык, понятные названия («Берёза» = VLESS Reality, «Дуб» = XHTTP, «Бамбук» = Hysteria2, «Пальма» = AmneziaWG, «выход за рубежом» = exit, «резервный вход» = relay). Admin theme lock (repo `CLAUDE.md`): только токены `admin_web/src/styles/theme.css`, Geist/Geist Mono, без `slate-/gray-/zinc-`, без `shadow-*`, `rounded`/`rounded-md`, строки 36px, числа — mono tabular-nums; primitives из `components/ui/*`; `Dialog` вместо `confirm/prompt`; `apiFetch` вместо сырого `fetch`; мобильная вёрстка по `admin_web/CLAUDE.md`.
- Тесты: Go unit/table tests; shell-шаблоны — на настоящем bash с заглушками (как `cmd/deploy/*_test.go`); генераторы — golden-тесты (`testdata/*.golden`, эталоны генерировать старым кодом там, где поведение должно сохраниться); мутационная проверка ключевой логики в каждой задаче (сломать → тест падает → вернуть).

## Review Focus

1. **Второй exit на живом сервисе** (id 2 уже есть, новый может получить id 3 или ≥ 10): Бамбук продолжает работать, тарифы не перемешиваются (`exit-2.` не ловит `exit-20.`), Xray перезапускается ровно один раз при добавлении.
2. **Обрыв посреди провижининга** (SSH-обрыв, рестарт API, падение шага): задача становится `interrupted/failed`, повтор доводит до конца без дублей (nft, ufw, юниты), нода не попадает в маршрутизацию, пока не `online`.
3. **UDP «Россия→заграница» задушен** (Hysteria exit мёртв, TCP жив): трафик exit идёт по `exit-N.vr`, exit не помечается мёртвым, алерт про путь.
4. **Ложная автоподмена входа** (моргание пробы, сбой самой пробы, недоступность exit, через который пробуем): подмена только по 3 подряд реальным провалам при здоровом резерве; возврат с гистерезисом; сбой пробы ≠ блокировка.
5. **Секреты и права**: ни один ответ API админки не содержит секретов из списка Global Constraints; возврат денег без права `payments.refund` → 403; 403 в UI не разлогинивает.

Каждая строка закрыта тестом в задаче-владельце (см. «Review Focus →» в задачах фаз 1–3, 5).

## Общие интерфейсы между фазами (имена фиксированы)

- **Фаза 1 → все:** теги/селекторы выше; в `cmd/api/xray_exits.go` — `exitOutboundTags(id int) (hy, vr string)`, `exitSelector`, `exitSocksPort`, `exitProbePort`/`exitProbeTag` (`probe-vr-<id>`, 12000+id), `exitHasHyPath`/`exitHasVRPath` (фаза 2 добавляет в `exitHasVRPath` выключатель `FallbackEnabled`), `buildExitConfig`; `biz.ExitNodeTunnel` читается через `exitNodeColumns` + `scanExitNode` (`internal/biz/server.go`; новые колонки дописываются туда). Монитор путей: `biz.GetExitPaths(id) (biz.ExitPaths, bool)` (`internal/biz/exit_paths.go`; `Hy`/`VR` ∈ `healthy|unhealthy|unknown|absent`, `CheckedAt`), `exitPathProber`/`pathProbe{present, ok, rttMs, err}`; ключи алертов `exit-down-<id>` (`exitDownAlertKey`) и `exit-path-down-<id>-hy|vr` (`exitPathAlertKey`). Контракт активации: exit входит в маршрутизацию только при `lifecycle_state='online'` **и** `tunnel_status='healthy'`, мастер фазы 2 ставит оба одной записью (`Hooks.Activate`) после своей проверки обоих путей. Бамбук: `biz.ExpressExit() (biz.ExpressChoice, error)`, `biz.ExpressCurrent() (biz.ExpressChoice, bool)` (EWMA α=0.3, переключение ≥10 мин и ≥20 %; `app_settings` `hysteria2_bound_exit_id/_since`). Админка: `admin.redactServer()`, `removedServerActions` + `goneHandler` (410), `POST /servers/{id}/check-tunnel`; permission `payments.refund`; `GET /settings` → `{settings, secrets_set}` (`redactSettings`, `loadAllSettings`). UI: `ApiError` (403 не разлогинивает), `auth/access.js` (`PAGE_PERMS`/`TENANT_HIDDEN` — новые страницы фаз 2–4 регистрируются здесь до фазы 5), `utils/serverState.js`, `components/servers/TunnelCheckDialog.jsx`, `components/payments/RefundDialog.jsx`, `components/settings/SecretSettingField.jsx`, `components/protocols/BambooCard.jsx`; `npm test` = `node --test` (находит `src/**/*.test.js` и `scripts/test/*.test.mjs`). SS+WS: Hub после фазы 1 его не использует нигде (генератор, монитор, действия, `PATCH tunnel_protocol` ∈ {hysteria2, vless}); `tunnel_ss_password` — пароль Hysteria, остаётся.
- **Фаза 2 → 3, 4, 5:** миграция `000060`: `servers.role TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'exit' CHECK (role IN ('exit','relay'))`, `servers.ssh_host_key_fp TEXT`, `servers.ssh_host_key_confirmed_at TIMESTAMPTZ`, `servers.tunnel_fallback_enabled BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT true`, `lifecycle_state` DEFAULT `'pending'` для новых строк; таблицы `provision_jobs(id BIGSERIAL, server_id INT REFERENCES servers(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, kind TEXT, status TEXT, error TEXT, created_at, started_at, finished_at)` и `provision_steps(id BIGSERIAL, job_id BIGINT REFERENCES provision_jobs(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, idx INT, name TEXT, status TEXT, output_tail TEXT, started_at, finished_at)`. Пакет `internal/provision`: `type Remote interface { Run(ctx context.Context, script string) (string, error); PutFile(ctx context.Context, path string, data []byte, mode uint32) (changed bool, err error) }`, `type Step struct { Name string; Apply func(context.Context, Remote, *State) error; Verify func(context.Context, Remote, *State) error; Rollback func(context.Context, Remote, *State) error }`, `type Recipe []Step`, `ExitRecipe(ExitOptions) Recipe`, `RelayRecipe(RelayOptions) Recipe` (фаза 3), `DeprovisionRecipe(role string) Recipe` (`internal/provision/deprovision.go`: `exclude` → шаги роли → `finalize`, итог `offline`), `type Runner struct{ Store; Dial func(Node) (Remote, error); Recipe func(ctx, Node, kind) (Recipe, *State, error); Go; Logf }` с `Start(ctx, serverID int, kind string) (jobID int64, err error)`, `Resume(ctx, jobID int64) error`; виды `KindProvision|KindReprovision|KindDeprovision|KindVerify`. ## Фаза 1 — Разминирование, маршрутизация нескольких exit, безопасность админки

**Spec:** §3 «Маршрутизация при нескольких exit и разминирование», §7 «Фаза 1». **Beads:** эпик `heyearthproject-cudk`; `07f7` (селекторы), `s6yc` (Бамбук), `7yrs` (выбор exit Бамбука), `smqe` (опасные кнопки).

Что меняется для пользователей: ничего, кроме **одного** перезапуска Xray при выкатке API (новые теги exit, проверочные входы, стратегия `leastLoad`). `hysteria2-server` при выкатке **не** перезапускается (Бамбук остаётся на exit #2, порт 1090 — байты `server.yaml` не меняются).

В репозитории уже есть файлы не по `gofmt` (например `internal/admin/types.go`, `cmd/api/b2b_handlers.go`), поэтому `gofmt -l` в шагах проверяет только изменённые файлы; Task 1.5 переформатирует `types.go` целиком — это ожидаемо.

Код задач 1.1–1.12 прогнан на копии репозитория: `go build`, `go vet`, `go test ./cmd/api ./internal/...` зелёные, тесты `node --test` (17 новых) зелёные, изменённые страницы собираются esbuild.

Порядок задач и зависимости: 1.1 → 1.2 → 1.3 (сеть); 1.4 независима; 1.5 → 1.6 (админка, бэкенд; 1.5 берёт реестр путей из 1.2); 1.7 независима; 1.8 после 1.3; UI: 1.9 → 1.10 (после 1.5–1.6), 1.11 (после 1.7), 1.12 (после 1.7–1.8).

Контракт для фазы 2 (не реализуется здесь, но Фаза 1 на него рассчитана): exit попадает в маршрутизацию, только когда `lifecycle_state='online'` **и** `tunnel_status='healthy'`; проверочная пара `probe-vr-<id>` появляется при `online`. Чтобы добавление exit стоило ровно одного рестарта Xray (Review Focus 1), мастер фазы 2 переводит exit в `online` **и** `healthy` одной записью — после собственной проверки обоих путей (Hysteria — через `127.0.0.1:1088+id`, TCP — разовым стендом Xray), а не ждёт монитора.

JSON балансера (вход Xray 26.3.27): `{"tag":"plan-3-balancer","selector":["exit-2."],"strategy":{"type":"leastLoad","settings":{"costs":[{"regexp":true,"match":"^exit-2\\.hy$","value":10},{"regexp":true,"match":"^exit-2\\.vr$","value":1000}]}},"fallbackTag":"exit-2.hy"}`. Семантика Xray (docs `routing.md`, проверено через Context7 `/xtls/xray-docs-next`): `leastLoad` работает только с observatory, мёртвые узлы исключает, «чем больше `value`, тем реже выбирается» (RTT × √cost); `match` без `regexp` — подстрока, поэтому используем якорные регулярки.

```go
package main

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	"reflect"
	"regexp"

	"github.com/heyearth/backend/internal/biz"

)

// exitFixture is an exit as cmd/deploy --setup-exit-node writes it: Hysteria on 50443 plus the
// exit's VLESS Reality credentials (SNI microsoft.com); withVR=false is an older row without them.
func exitFixture(id, weight int, status string, withVR bool) biz.ExitNodeTunnel {

	n.TunnelPort, n.TunnelSNI, n.LoadWeight, n.TunnelStatus, n.LifecycleState = 50443, "microsoft.com", weight, status, "online"
	if !withVR {
		n.TunnelUUID, n.TunnelPubKey, n.TunnelShortID = "", "", ""
	}
	return n
}

// exitsInputs: plan 3 → exit 2, plan 4 → exit 20, plan 6 → exits 2, 3, 20, plan 7 → exit 7.
func exitsInputs(exits ...biz.ExitNodeTunnel) xrayInputs {
	in := baseInputs()
	in.exitNodes = exits
	in.planServers = map[int][]int{3: {2}, 4: {20}, 6: {2, 3, 20}, 7: {7}}
	return in
}

// multiExits: ids 2 and 20 (prefix trap), weights 1/5/10, exit 7 online but unhealthy.
func multiExits() []biz.ExitNodeTunnel {

		exitFixture(2, 1, "healthy", true),
		exitFixture(3, 5, "healthy", true),
		exitFixture(7, 1, "unhealthy", true),

	}
}

type xrayCost struct {
	Regexp bool    `json:"regexp"`
	Match  string  `json:"match"`
	Value  float64 `json:"value"`
}

type xrayView struct {
	Inbounds  []map[string]any `json:"inbounds"`
	Outbounds []map[string]any `json:"outbounds"`
	Routing   struct {
		Rules     []map[string]any `json:"rules"`
		Balancers []struct {
			Tag         string   `json:"tag"`
			Selector    []string `json:"selector"`
			FallbackTag string   `json:"fallbackTag"`
			Strategy    struct {
				Type     string `json:"type"`
				Settings struct {
					Costs []xrayCost `json:"costs"`
				} `json:"settings"`
			} `json:"strategy"`
		} `json:"balancers"`
	} `json:"routing"`
	Observatory struct {
		SubjectSelector []string `json:"subjectSelector"`
	} `json:"observatory"`
}

func viewOf(t *testing.T, cfg []byte) xrayView {
	t.Helper()
	var v xrayView
	if err := json.Unmarshal(cfg, &v); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	return v
}

func (v xrayView) outboundTags() []string {
	tags := make([]string, 0, len(v.Outbounds))
	for _, o := range v.Outbounds {
		tag, _ := o["tag"].(string)
		tags = append(tags, tag)
	}
	return tags
}

func byTag(items []map[string]any, tag string) map[string]any {
	for _, it := range items {
		if it["tag"] == tag {
			return it
		}
	}
	return nil
}

func asJSON(x any) string { b, _ := json.Marshal(x); return string(b) }

// xraySelect mirrors Xray-core 26.3.27 app/proxyman/outbound Manager.Select: an outbound is
// selected when one of the selectors is a PREFIX of its tag (there is no exact or regexp form).
func xraySelect(tags, selectors []string) []string {
	var out []string
	for _, tag := range tags {
		for _, s := range selectors {
			if strings.HasPrefix(tag, s) {
				out = append(out, tag)
				break
			}
		}
	}
	sort.Strings(out)
	return out
}

// Review Focus 1 → with exits 2, 3 and 20 a plan bound to exit 2 never selects exit-20.*; the
// catch-all balancer and the observatory take every exit path and nothing else (no probe-vr-*).
func TestXrayExitSelectorsAreExact(t *testing.T) {
	cfg, b := genConfig(t, exitsInputs(multiExits()...), quotaCutoff{})
	v := viewOf(t, cfg)
	tags := v.outboundTags()
	all := []string{"exit-2.hy", "exit-2.vr", "exit-20.hy", "exit-20.vr", "exit-3.hy", "exit-3.vr"}
	want := map[string][]string{
		"exit-balancer":   all,
		"plan-3-balancer": {"exit-2.hy", "exit-2.vr"},
		"plan-4-balancer": {"exit-20.hy", "exit-20.vr"},
		"plan-6-balancer": all,
	}
	got := map[string][]string{}
	for _, bal := range v.Routing.Balancers {
		sel := xraySelect(tags, bal.Selector)
		got[bal.Tag] = sel
		if !slices.Contains(sel, bal.FallbackTag) {
			t.Errorf("%s: fallbackTag %q is not one of its own exit paths %v", bal.Tag, bal.FallbackTag, sel)
		}
		if bal.Strategy.Type != "leastLoad" {
			t.Errorf("%s: strategy %q, want leastLoad (the Hysteria-first order and weights live in its costs)", bal.Tag, bal.Strategy.Type)
		}
	}
	if !reflect.DeepEqual(got, want) {
		t.Fatalf("balancer selections:\n got %v\nwant %v", got, want)
	}
	if obs := xraySelect(tags, v.Observatory.SubjectSelector); !reflect.DeepEqual(obs, all) {
		t.Errorf("observatory probes %v, want exactly the exit paths %v", obs, all)
	}
	if b.exits != 3 {
		t.Errorf("routed exits = %d, want 3 (exit 7 is unhealthy)", b.exits)
	}
	// The pre-phase-1 form is exactly the bug: selector "exit-2" also takes exit-20.
	if old := xraySelect([]string{"exit-2", "exit-20"}, []string{"exit-2"}); len(old) != 2 {
		t.Fatal("xraySelect must model prefix selection")
	}
}

// Weights and the Hysteria-first order come from leastLoad costs, never from duplicated tags.
func TestXrayExitCostsAndNoDuplicateTags(t *testing.T) {
	cfg, _ := genConfig(t, exitsInputs(multiExits()...), quotaCutoff{})
	v := viewOf(t, cfg)
	seen := map[string]bool{}
	for _, tag := range v.outboundTags() {
		if seen[tag] {
			t.Errorf("outbound tag %q is duplicated (load_weight must not duplicate tags)", tag)
		}
		seen[tag] = true
	}
	// weight 1 → 10, weight 5 → 6, weight 10 → 1; the TCP path of a Hysteria exit costs ×100.
	want := map[string]float64{"exit-2.hy": 10, "exit-2.vr": 1000, "exit-3.hy": 6, "exit-3.vr": 600, "exit-20.hy": 1, "exit-20.vr": 100}
	for _, bal := range v.Routing.Balancers {
		if bal.Tag != "plan-6-balancer" {
			continue
		}
		got := map[string]float64{}
		for _, c := range bal.Strategy.Settings.Costs {
			if !c.Regexp || !strings.HasPrefix(c.Match, "^") || !strings.HasSuffix(c.Match, "$") {
				t.Errorf("cost %q must be an anchored regexp (a plain match is a substring match)", c.Match)
			}
			re := regexp.MustCompile(c.Match)
			var hit []string
			for tag := range want {
				if re.MatchString(tag) {
					hit = append(hit, tag)
				}
			}
			if len(hit) != 1 {
				t.Errorf("cost %q matches %v, want exactly one tag", c.Match, hit)
				continue
			}
			got[hit[0]] = c.Value
		}
		if !reflect.DeepEqual(got, want) {
			t.Fatalf("plan-6 costs = %v, want %v", got, want)
		}
		return
	}
	t.Fatal("plan-6-balancer not generated")
}

func TestXrayExitPathOutbounds(t *testing.T) {
	legacy := testExit(5, "vless") // a primary VLESS exit from the old admin form
	legacy.TunnelPort = 8443
	in := exitsInputs(exitFixture(2, 1, "healthy", true), exitFixture(20, 1, "healthy", true), legacy)
	cfg, _ := genConfig(t, in, quotaCutoff{})
	v := viewOf(t, cfg)

	hy := byTag(v.Outbounds, "exit-20.hy")
	if hy == nil || hy["protocol"] != "socks" || !strings.Contains(asJSON(hy["settings"]), `"address":"127.0.0.1","port":1108`) {
		t.Errorf("exit-20.hy must be the SOCKS of hysteria2-client-20 (127.0.0.1:1108): %s", asJSON(hy))
	}
	vr := asJSON(byTag(v.Outbounds, "exit-2.vr"))
	for _, want := range []string{`"address":"203.0.113.2"`, `"port":10443`, `"flow":"xtls-rprx-vision"`,
		`"serverName":"microsoft.com"`, `"publicKey":"` + testExitPBK + `"`, `"shortId":"abcd"`, `"fingerprint":"chrome"`} {
		if !strings.Contains(vr, want) {
			t.Errorf("exit-2.vr lacks %s: %s", want, vr)
		}
	}
	if strings.Contains(vr, `"mux"`) {
		t.Errorf("Vision cannot run over mux: %s", vr)
	}
	old := asJSON(byTag(v.Outbounds, "exit-5.vr"))
	if !strings.Contains(old, `"port":8443`) || !strings.Contains(old, `"mux"`) || strings.Contains(old, `"flow"`) {
		t.Errorf("a legacy VLESS exit keeps its own port, mux and no flow: %s", old)
	}
	if byTag(v.Outbounds, "exit-5.hy") != nil {
		t.Error("a VLESS exit has no Hysteria path")
	}
}

// Every online exit with a TCP path gets a loopback probe pair, healthy or not, outside every
// selector; probe inbounds are not user inbounds (the no-exit block never covers them).
func TestXrayExitProbes(t *testing.T) {
	cfg, _ := genConfig(t, exitsInputs(multiExits()...), quotaCutoff{})
	v := viewOf(t, cfg)
	if byTag(v.Outbounds, "exit-7.hy") != nil || byTag(v.Outbounds, "exit-7.vr") != nil {
		t.Fatal("an unhealthy exit must stay out of the routing")
	}
	for _, id := range []int{2, 3, 7, 20} {
		tag := exitProbeTag(id)
		in := byTag(v.Inbounds, tag)
		if in == nil || in["listen"] != "127.0.0.1" || in["port"] != float64(12000+id) || in["protocol"] != "socks" {
			t.Errorf("%s: want a loopback SOCKS inbound on %d, got %v", tag, 12000+id, in)
		}
		if byTag(v.Outbounds, tag) == nil {
			t.Errorf("%s: no probe outbound", tag)
		}
		routed := false
		for _, r := range v.Routing.Rules {
			if r["outboundTag"] == tag {
				routed = reflect.DeepEqual(r["inboundTag"], []any{tag})
			}
		}
		if !routed {
			t.Errorf("%s: no rule routing exactly its own inbound to it", tag)
		}
	}

	down := multiExits()
	for i := range down {
		down[i].TunnelStatus = "unhealthy"
	}
	cfg, b := genConfig(t, exitsInputs(down...), quotaCutoff{}) // the leak guard runs inside
	if !b.noExit {
		t.Fatal("no healthy exit must be the no-exit mode")
	}
	v = viewOf(t, cfg)
	if byTag(v.Inbounds, "probe-vr-2") == nil {
		t.Fatal("probe pairs must survive the no-exit mode: a recovered TCP path must be noticed")
	}
	for _, r := range v.Routing.Rules {
		if r["outboundTag"] == "block" && strings.Contains(fmt.Sprint(r["inboundTag"]), "probe-vr") {
			t.Errorf("the no-exit block must not cover the probe inbounds: %v", r)
		}
	}
}

// Review Focus 1 → adding a second exit (id 20 next to 2) is one structural diff = one xray
// restart; the next sync with the same inputs restarts nothing.
func TestXrayExitAddedIsOneStructuralChange(t *testing.T) {
	one, _ := genConfig(t, exitsInputs(exitFixture(2, 1, "healthy", true)), quotaCutoff{})
	twoIn := exitsInputs(exitFixture(2, 1, "healthy", true), exitFixture(20, 1, "healthy", true))
	two, _ := genConfig(t, twoIn, quotaCutoff{})
	if d, err := xraydiff.Classify(one, two); err != nil || d.Kind != xraydiff.Structural {
		t.Fatalf("adding exit 20: kind %v (%v), want one structural restart", d.Kind, err)
	}
	again, _ := genConfig(t, twoIn, quotaCutoff{})
	if d, _ := xraydiff.Classify(two, again); d.Kind != xraydiff.None {
		t.Fatalf("the next sync must not restart again: %v (%s)", d.Kind, d.Reason)
	}
}

// The egress guard lets xray reach SOCKS 1088..1599 only: exits outside 1..511 are skipped.
func TestXrayExitIDRange(t *testing.T) {
	captureLog(t)
	cfg, b := genConfig(t, exitsInputs(exitFixture(2, 1, "healthy", true), exitFixture(512, 1, "healthy", true)), quotaCutoff{})
	if b.exits != 1 || strings.Contains(string(cfg), "exit-512.") || strings.Contains(string(cfg), "probe-vr-512") {
		t.Fatalf("exit 512 is outside the allowed SOCKS range: %d exits routed", b.exits)
	}
}

func TestXrayExitGoldens(t *testing.T) {
	for _, tc := range []struct {
		name  string
		exits []biz.ExitNodeTunnel
	}{
		{"xray_exits_legacy_single", []biz.ExitNodeTunnel{exitFixture(2, 1, "healthy", false)}},
		{"xray_exits_dual", []biz.ExitNodeTunnel{exitFixture(2, 1, "healthy", true)}},
		{"xray_exits_multi", multiExits()},
	} {
		t.Run(tc.name, func(t *testing.T) {
			cfg, _ := genConfig(t, exitsInputs(tc.exits...), quotaCutoff{})
			checkGolden(t, tc.name, exitProjection(t, cfg))
		})
	}
}

// exitProjection keeps what this task changes: exit and probe outbounds, probe inbounds, the rules
// that use a balancer or a probe outbound, the balancers and the observatory.
func exitProjection(t *testing.T, cfg []byte) []byte {
	t.Helper()
	var c struct {
		Inbounds    []map[string]any `json:"inbounds"`
		Outbounds   []map[string]any `json:"outbounds"`
		Routing     map[string]any   `json:"routing"`
		Observatory map[string]any   `json:"observatory"`
	}
	if err := json.Unmarshal(cfg, &c); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	tagged := func(items []map[string]any, prefixes ...string) []map[string]any {
		out := []map[string]any{}
		for _, it := range items {
			tag, _ := it["tag"].(string)
			for _, p := range prefixes {
				if strings.HasPrefix(tag, p) {
					out = append(out, it)
					break
				}
			}
		}
		return out
	}
	rules := []any{}
	raw, _ := c.Routing["rules"].([]any)
	for _, r := range raw {
		m, _ := r.(map[string]any)
		out, _ := m["outboundTag"].(string)
		if m["balancerTag"] != nil || strings.HasPrefix(out, exitProbeTagPrefix) {
			rules = append(rules, m)
		}
	}
	b, err := json.MarshalIndent(map[string]any{
		"inbounds":    tagged(c.Inbounds, exitProbeTagPrefix),
		"outbounds":   tagged(c.Outbounds, exitAllSelector, exitProbeTagPrefix),
		"rules":       rules,
		"balancers":   c.Routing["balancers"],
		"observatory": c.Observatory,
	}, "", "  ")
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	return append(b, '\n')
}
```

```go
// ExitNodeTunnel — конфигурация туннеля к exit-ноде.
// Hub подключается к каждой exit-ноде через зашифрованный канал.
type ExitNodeTunnel struct {
	ID             int
	Name           string
	IPAddress      string
	TunnelProtocol string // hysteria2 (+ VLESS Reality on :10443) or legacy vless
	TunnelPort     int
	TunnelUUID     string // VLESS UUID of the Hub on the exit's xray
	TunnelPubKey   string // Reality public key of the exit's xray
	TunnelShortID  string // Reality short ID
	TunnelSNI      string // SNI для Reality
	TunnelSSMethod string // legacy
	TunnelSSPass   string // Hysteria auth password (historical column name)
	TunnelStatus   string // healthy, unhealthy, unknown
	LoadWeight     int    // 1-10: preference of the exit in the leastLoad balancers
	LifecycleState string // pending, provisioning, online, failed, deprovisioning, offline
}

// exitNodeColumns is the select list scanExitNode reads.
const exitNodeColumns = `id, COALESCE(name, ''), ip_address,
	       COALESCE(tunnel_protocol, ''), COALESCE(tunnel_port, 0),
	       COALESCE(tunnel_uuid, ''), COALESCE(tunnel_public_key, ''),
	       COALESCE(tunnel_short_id, ''), COALESCE(tunnel_sni, ''),
	       COALESCE(tunnel_ss_method, ''), COALESCE(tunnel_ss_password, ''),
	       COALESCE(tunnel_status, 'unknown'), COALESCE(load_weight, 1), lifecycle_state`

func scanExitNode(row interface{ Scan(dest ...any) error }) (ExitNodeTunnel, error) {
	var n ExitNodeTunnel
	err := row.Scan(&n.ID, &n.Name, &n.IPAddress, &n.TunnelProtocol, &n.TunnelPort,
		&n.TunnelUUID, &n.TunnelPubKey, &n.TunnelShortID, &n.TunnelSNI,
		&n.TunnelSSMethod, &n.TunnelSSPass, &n.TunnelStatus, &n.LoadWeight, &n.LifecycleState)
	return n, err
}

// ListHealthyExitNodes возвращает все exit-ноды со статусом healthy.
func ListHealthyExitNodes() ([]ExitNodeTunnel, error) {
	return listExitNodesByStatus(context.Background(), "healthy")
}

// ListHealthyExitNodesContext is ListHealthyExitNodes bounded by ctx.
func ListHealthyExitNodesContext(ctx context.Context) ([]ExitNodeTunnel, error) {
	return listExitNodesByStatus(ctx, "healthy")
}

// ListOnlineExitNodesContext returns every online exit whatever its tunnel status: the xray
// generator routes the healthy ones and keeps a probe pair for each (cmd/api/xray_exits.go).
func ListOnlineExitNodesContext(ctx context.Context) ([]ExitNodeTunnel, error) {
	return listExitNodesByStatus(ctx, "")
}

// ListAllExitNodes возвращает все online exit-ноды (для health-check).
func ListAllExitNodes() ([]ExitNodeTunnel, error) {
	return listExitNodesByStatus(context.Background(), "")
}

// GetExitNodeTunnel reads one exit in any lifecycle state («Проверить туннель»). sql.ErrNoRows
// when the id is unknown or not an exit.
func GetExitNodeTunnel(ctx context.Context, id int) (ExitNodeTunnel, error) {
	return scanExitNode(db.DB.QueryRowContext(ctx,
		`SELECT `+exitNodeColumns+` FROM servers WHERE id = $1 AND is_exit_node = TRUE`, id))
}

func listExitNodesByStatus(ctx context.Context, statusFilter string) ([]ExitNodeTunnel, error) {
	// Defense-in-depth: only return servers whose lifecycle is 'online'.
	// tunnel_status alone is not enough — a server marked offline in the FSM
	// must never appear in xray routing (otherwise we get ghosts).
	query := `SELECT ` + exitNodeColumns + ` FROM servers WHERE is_exit_node = TRUE AND lifecycle_state = 'online'`
	var args []any
	if statusFilter != "" {
		query += ` AND tunnel_status = $1`
		args = append(args, statusFilter)
	}
	query += ` ORDER BY id`

	rows, err := db.DB.QueryContext(ctx, query, args...)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("list exit nodes: %w", err)
	}
	defer rows.Close()

	var nodes []ExitNodeTunnel
	for rows.Next() {
		n, err := scanExitNode(rows)
		if err != nil {
			log.Printf("scan exit node: %v", err)
			continue
		}
		nodes = append(nodes, n)
	}
	return nodes, rows.Err()
}
```

Create `server/backend/cmd/api/xray_exits.go`:

```go
package main

import (
	"fmt"
	"log"
	"regexp"
	"strconv"

	"github.com/heyearth/backend/internal/biz"
)

// ─────────────── Exit paths in the Hub's xray config (node pool, phase 1) ───────────────
//
// Every HEALTHY exit N (lifecycle online, tunnel_status healthy) gets up to two outbounds:
//
//	exit-N.hy  Hysteria: SOCKS 127.0.0.1:(1088+N), served by hysteria2-client-N (UDP to the exit)
//	exit-N.vr  TCP: VLESS Reality straight to the exit's xray on :10443 (flow xtls-rprx-vision)
//
// Balancers pick exits by the prefix "exit-N." (xray selectors are tag prefixes, so "exit-2."
// can never match exit-20.*; Beads 07f7) and the catch-all one by "exit-". The order inside an
// exit (Hysteria first, TCP while Hysteria is dead) and load_weight between exits come from the
// leastLoad strategy's costs (exitCosts); tags are never duplicated. An exit leaves the routing
// only when the tunnel monitor finds BOTH of its paths dead (tunnel_probe.go).
//
// Every ONLINE exit with a TCP path, healthy or not, also gets a probe pair outside every
// selector: the loopback SOCKS inbound probe-vr-N (127.0.0.1:12000+N) routed to the outbound
// probe-vr-N (the same VLESS Reality). The monitor fetches generate_204 through it to judge the
// TCP path, also while the exit is out of the routing, so its recovery is noticed. The pair
// depends only on the exit being online, never on its health: health flips restart xray exactly
// as before (an exit enters or leaves the balancers) and nothing more.
//
// Legacy rows: tunnel_protocol vless keeps its old single VLESS outbound (own port, mux, no flow)
// under exit-N.vr; shadowsocks/socks5/http are no longer generated (phase-1 pre-check: none online).

const (
	exitSocksPortBase  = 1088
	exitProbePortBase  = 12000
	exitMaxID          = 511 // the egress guard allows xray SOCKS 1088..1599 (cmd/deploy/ops_egress_guard.go)
	exitVRPort         = 10443
	exitVRFlow         = "xtls-rprx-vision"
	exitAllSelector    = "exit-"
	exitProbeTagPrefix = "probe-vr-"
	// leastLoad multiplies a node's observed RTT by sqrt(cost) and takes the cheapest live node:
	// hy cost = 11 - load_weight (weight 10 → 1 … weight 1 → 10); the TCP path of a Hysteria exit
	// costs ×100, i.e. it wins only while Hysteria is dead or ten times slower.
	exitHyCostBase   = 11
	exitVRCostFactor = 100
)

func exitOutboundTags(id int) (hy, vr string) {
	return fmt.Sprintf("exit-%d.hy", id), fmt.Sprintf("exit-%d.vr", id)
}

func exitSelector(id int) string  { return fmt.Sprintf("exit-%d.", id) }
func exitSocksPort(id int) int    { return exitSocksPortBase + id }
func exitProbePort(id int) int    { return exitProbePortBase + id }
func exitProbeTag(id int) string  { return exitProbeTagPrefix + strconv.Itoa(id) }
func exitIDValid(id int) bool     { return id >= 1 && id <= exitMaxID }

// exitHasHyPath: Hysteria exits are reached through their hysteria2-client SOCKS.
func exitHasHyPath(n biz.ExitNodeTunnel) bool {
	return exitIDValid(n.ID) && n.TunnelProtocol == "hysteria2"
}

// exitHasVRPath: a VLESS Reality path needs the Hub's UUID on the exit and, for a Hysteria exit
// (whose xray always runs Reality), the exit's public key.
func exitHasVRPath(n biz.ExitNodeTunnel) bool {
	if !exitIDValid(n.ID) || len(n.TunnelUUID) < 32 {
		return false
	}
	switch n.TunnelProtocol {
	case "hysteria2":
		return len(n.TunnelPubKey) >= 40
	case "vless":
		return n.TunnelPubKey == "" || len(n.TunnelPubKey) >= 40
	}
	return false
}

func exitHyOutbound(id int, tag string) map[string]interface{} {
	return map[string]interface{}{
		"tag": tag, "protocol": "socks",
		"settings": map[string]interface{}{
			"servers": []map[string]interface{}{{"address": "127.0.0.1", "port": exitSocksPort(id)}},
		},
	}
}

// exitVROutbound is VLESS Reality over TCP to the exit's xray. For a Hysteria exit it is the
// fallback path: the exit's xray serves the Hub's UUID with flow xtls-rprx-vision (cmd/deploy
// --setup-exit-node) and refuses requests without that flow and over mux.cool, so: Vision, no
// mux (UDP 443/QUIC is refused by Vision, clients fall back to TCP while on this path). A legacy
// primary VLESS exit keeps its old outbound: its own port, mux, no flow.
func exitVROutbound(n biz.ExitNodeTunnel, tag, fingerprint string, mux int) map[string]interface{} {
	sni := n.TunnelSNI
	if sni == "" {
		sni = n.IPAddress
	}
	reality := map[string]interface{}{"fingerprint": fingerprint, "serverName": sni}
	if n.TunnelPubKey != "" {
		reality["publicKey"] = n.TunnelPubKey
		if n.TunnelShortID != "" {
			reality["shortId"] = n.TunnelShortID // singular: the client side of Reality
		}
	}
	user := map[string]interface{}{"id": n.TunnelUUID, "encryption": "none"}
	out := map[string]interface{}{"tag": tag, "protocol": "vless"}
	port := exitVRPort
	if n.TunnelProtocol == "vless" {
		port = n.TunnelPort
		out["mux"] = map[string]interface{}{
			"enabled": true, "concurrency": mux, "xudpConcurrency": 16, "xudpProxyUDP443": "allow",
		}
	} else {
		user["flow"] = exitVRFlow
	}
	out["settings"] = map[string]interface{}{
		"vnext": []map[string]interface{}{{"address": n.IPAddress, "port": port, "users": []map[string]interface{}{user}}},
	}
	out["streamSettings"] = map[string]interface{}{
		"network": "tcp", "security": "reality", "realitySettings": reality,
		"sockopt": map[string]interface{}{"tcpFastOpen": true, "tcpNoDelay": true, "tcpKeepAliveInterval": 30},
	}
	return out
}

// exitProbeInbound: loopback SOCKS the tunnel monitor dials to test exit N's TCP path.
func exitProbeInbound(id int) map[string]interface{} {
	return map[string]interface{}{
		"tag": exitProbeTag(id), "listen": "127.0.0.1", "port": exitProbePort(id), "protocol": "socks",
		"settings": map[string]interface{}{"auth": "noauth", "udp": false},
	}
}

// exitRoute is one routed (healthy) exit as the balancers see it.
type exitRoute struct {
	id           int
	weight       int    // load_weight clamped to 1..10
	primary      string // the fallback tag: .hy when the exit has it, else .vr
	hasHy, hasVR bool
}

// exitConfig is the exit part of the xray config.
type exitConfig struct {
	routes         []exitRoute
	outbounds      []map[string]interface{} // exit-N.hy / exit-N.vr of the routed exits
	probeOutbounds []map[string]interface{}
	probeInbounds  []map[string]interface{}
	probeRules     []map[string]interface{}
}

// exitWeight clamps load_weight to 1..10 (migration 000022).
func exitWeight(w int) int {
	if w < 1 {
		return 1
	}
	if w > 10 {
		return 10
	}
	return w
}

// buildExitConfig builds the exit outbounds of the healthy exits and the probe pairs of every
// online exit with a TCP path, in node order (ORDER BY id).
func buildExitConfig(nodes []biz.ExitNodeTunnel, fingerprint string, mux int) exitConfig {
	var c exitConfig
	for _, n := range nodes {
		hy, vr := exitHasHyPath(n), exitHasVRPath(n)
		if !hy && !vr {
			log.Printf("[xray-sync] exit-нода %d (%s): пропущена — нет ни пути Hysteria, ни TCP-пути (протокол %q, id 1..%d)",
				n.ID, n.Name, n.TunnelProtocol, exitMaxID)
			continue
		}
		hyTag, vrTag := exitOutboundTags(n.ID)
		if n.TunnelStatus == "healthy" {
			r := exitRoute{id: n.ID, weight: exitWeight(n.LoadWeight), primary: vrTag, hasHy: hy, hasVR: vr}
			if hy {
				r.primary = hyTag
				c.outbounds = append(c.outbounds, exitHyOutbound(n.ID, hyTag))
			}
			if vr {
				c.outbounds = append(c.outbounds, exitVROutbound(n, vrTag, fingerprint, mux))
			}
			c.routes = append(c.routes, r)
		}
		if vr {
			tag := exitProbeTag(n.ID)
			c.probeOutbounds = append(c.probeOutbounds, exitVROutbound(n, tag, fingerprint, mux))
			c.probeInbounds = append(c.probeInbounds, exitProbeInbound(n.ID))
			c.probeRules = append(c.probeRules, map[string]interface{}{
				"type": xrayRuleTypeField, "inboundTag": []string{tag}, "outboundTag": tag,
			})
		}
	}
	return c
}

// exitCosts are the leastLoad costs of the given routed exits (see exitHyCostBase). Anchored
// regexps: xray's plain match is a SUBSTRING match.
func exitCosts(routes []exitRoute) []map[string]interface{} {
	costs := make([]map[string]interface{}, 0, 2*len(routes))
	for _, r := range routes {
		base := exitHyCostBase - r.weight
		hy, vr := exitOutboundTags(r.id)
		if r.hasHy {
			costs = append(costs, exitCost(hy, base))
		}
		if r.hasVR {
			v := base
			if r.hasHy {
				v = base * exitVRCostFactor
			}
			costs = append(costs, exitCost(vr, v))
		}
	}
	return costs
}

func exitCost(tag string, value int) map[string]interface{} {
	return map[string]interface{}{"regexp": true, "match": "^" + regexp.QuoteMeta(tag) + "$", "value": value}
}
```

```go
// newBalancer builds a leastLoad balancer whose fallback is never the default outbound: the
// primary path of its first exit (an exit our own monitor reports healthy) or block when it has
// none. leastLoad needs the observatory and drops nodes it sees dead; costs order the paths
// (exitCosts). The old balancer_strategy setting (random) is no longer used: random would split
// traffic between an exit's Hysteria and TCP paths instead of preferring Hysteria.
func newBalancer(tag string, selector []string, fallback string, costs []map[string]interface{}) map[string]interface{} {
	if fallback == "" {
		fallback = xrayBlockTag
	}
	if costs == nil {
		costs = []map[string]interface{}{}
	}
	return map[string]interface{}{
		"tag":      tag,
		"selector": selector,
		"strategy": map[string]interface{}{
			"type":     "leastLoad",
			"settings": map[string]interface{}{"costs": costs},
		},
		"fallbackTag": fallback,
	}
}
```

```go
					planRoutes = append(planRoutes, r)
				}

				continue
			}

			for _, r := range planRoutes {
				selector = append(selector, exitSelector(r.id))
			}
```

```go
// ─────────────── Two paths per exit (phase 1) ───────────────

// «Exit мёртв, только если мертвы оба пути» and Review Focus 3, tick by tick.
func TestExitHealthTwoPaths(t *testing.T) {
	ok := func(ms int) pathProbe { return pathProbe{present: true, ok: true, rttMs: ms} }
	hyFail := pathProbe{present: true, err: "hysteria2 exit #2 via 127.0.0.1:1090: timeout after 5s"}
	vrFail := pathProbe{present: true, err: "tcp-reality exit #2 via 127.0.0.1:12002: EOF"}
	absent := pathProbe{}
	R, S, N := exitAlertRaise, exitAlertResolve, exitAlertNone
	type tick struct {
		p                           exitPathProbe
		status                      string
		exitAlert, hyAlert, vrAlert exitAlertAction
		hyChanged                   bool
	}
	cases := []struct {
		name  string
		db    string
		ticks []tick
	}{
		{"Review Focus 3 → UDP Россия→заграница задушен, TCP жив: exit жив, тревога про путь Hysteria", "healthy", []tick{
			{exitPathProbe{hyFail, ok(90)}, "healthy", S, S, S, false},
			{exitPathProbe{hyFail, ok(90)}, "healthy", S, S, S, false},
			{exitPathProbe{hyFail, ok(90)}, "healthy", S, R, S, true},
			{exitPathProbe{hyFail, ok(90)}, "healthy", S, R, S, false},
			{exitPathProbe{ok(40), ok(90)}, "healthy", S, R, S, false}, // one success is not a recovery
			{exitPathProbe{ok(40), ok(90)}, "healthy", S, S, S, true},
		}},
		{"оба пути мертвы: exit мёртв, говорит только тревога exit; вернулся по TCP", "healthy", []tick{
			{exitPathProbe{hyFail, vrFail}, "healthy", S, S, S, false},
			{exitPathProbe{hyFail, vrFail}, "healthy", S, S, S, false},
			{exitPathProbe{hyFail, vrFail}, "unhealthy", R, N, N, true},
			{exitPathProbe{hyFail, ok(90)}, "unhealthy", R, N, N, false},
			{exitPathProbe{hyFail, ok(90)}, "healthy", S, R, S, false},
		}},
		{"старый exit только с Hysteria: смерть пути — смерть exit", "healthy", []tick{
			{exitPathProbe{hyFail, absent}, "healthy", S, S, S, false},
			{exitPathProbe{hyFail, absent}, "healthy", S, S, S, false},
			{exitPathProbe{hyFail, absent}, "unhealthy", R, N, S, true},
		}},
		{"новый exit (unknown): первый успех любого пути делает его живым", "unknown", []tick{
			{exitPathProbe{hyFail, ok(80)}, "healthy", S, N, S, false},
			{exitPathProbe{ok(30), ok(80)}, "healthy", S, S, S, true},
		}},
		{"у exit нет ни одного пути", "healthy", []tick{
			{exitPathProbe{absent, absent}, "unhealthy", R, S, S, false},
		}},
	}
	for _, tc := range cases {
		t.Run(tc.name, func(t *testing.T) {
			var h exitHealth
			db := tc.db
			for i, tk := range tc.ticks {
				v := h.tick(db, tk.p)
				if v.status != tk.status || v.exitAlert != tk.exitAlert || v.hyAlert != tk.hyAlert ||
					v.vrAlert != tk.vrAlert || v.hyChanged != tk.hyChanged {
					t.Fatalf("tick %d: got status=%s exit=%v hy=%v vr=%v hyChanged=%v, want %s %v %v %v %v",
						i+1, v.status, v.exitAlert, v.hyAlert, v.vrAlert, v.hyChanged,
						tk.status, tk.exitAlert, tk.hyAlert, tk.vrAlert, tk.hyChanged)
				}
				db = v.status // checkAllTunnels persists it; the next tick reads it back
			}
		})
	}
}

	var h exitHealth
```

```go
package biz

import (
	"sync"
	"time"
)

// Path states of an exit as the tunnel monitor (cmd/api) judges them.
const (
	PathHealthy   = "healthy"
	PathUnhealthy = "unhealthy"
	PathUnknown   = "unknown"
	PathAbsent    = "absent" // the exit has no such path (protocol / credentials)
)

// ExitPaths is the monitor's last view of one exit's two paths: Hysteria (hy, the exit's
// hysteria2-client SOCKS) and TCP (vr, VLESS Reality to the exit's xray). In memory only:
// empty after an API restart until the first monitor tick (~10 s). Errors name loopback
// addresses only, never credentials.
type ExitPaths struct {
	Hy        string    `json:"hy"`
	VR        string    `json:"vr"`
	HyRTTms   int       `json:"hy_rtt_ms,omitempty"`
	VRRTTms   int       `json:"vr_rtt_ms,omitempty"`
	HyError   string    `json:"hy_error,omitempty"`
	VRError   string    `json:"vr_error,omitempty"`
	CheckedAt time.Time `json:"checked_at"`
}

var exitPaths sync.Map // server id → ExitPaths

// SetExitPaths records the monitor's view of exit id.
func SetExitPaths(id int, p ExitPaths) { exitPaths.Store(id, p) }

// GetExitPaths returns the last view of exit id; false before the monitor has seen it.
func GetExitPaths(id int) (ExitPaths, bool) {
	v, ok := exitPaths.Load(id)
	if !ok {
		return ExitPaths{}, false
	}
	return v.(ExitPaths), true
}
```

```go
// ─────────────── Two paths per exit (node pool, phase 1) ───────────────

// pathProbe is one probe of one path of an exit on one monitor tick.
type pathProbe struct {
	present bool // the exit has this path (protocol / credentials)
	ok      bool
	rttMs   int
	err     string // one line; "" when ok
}

// exitPathProbe is one tick's probe of both paths.
type exitPathProbe struct{ hy, vr pathProbe }

// exitPathProber probes both paths of an exit; tests swap it.
var exitPathProber = probeExitPathsLive

// probeExitPathsLive fetches generate_204 through each path of the exit, both at once: Hysteria
// through hysteria2-client-N's SOCKS (127.0.0.1:1088+N), TCP through xray's loopback probe inbound
// probe-vr-N (127.0.0.1:12000+N → VLESS Reality to the exit's :10443). At most
// len(exitProbeTargets) × exitProbeTimeout (10 s) per exit.
func probeExitPathsLive(node biz.ExitNodeTunnel) exitPathProbe {
	var p exitPathProbe
	var wg sync.WaitGroup
	run := func(dst *pathProbe, present bool, port int, label string) {
		if !present {
			return
		}
		dst.present = true
		wg.Add(1)
		go func() {
			defer wg.Done()
			addr := fmt.Sprintf("127.0.0.1:%d", port)
			rtt, err := probeExitViaSOCKS5(addr, exitProbeTargets, exitProbeTimeout)
			if err != nil {
				dst.err = fmt.Sprintf("%s exit #%d via %s: %v", label, node.ID, addr, err)
				return
			}
			dst.ok, dst.rttMs = true, max(1, int(rtt.Milliseconds()))
		}()
	}
	run(&p.hy, exitHasHyPath(node), exitSocksPort(node.ID), "hysteria2")
	run(&p.vr, exitHasVRPath(node), exitProbePort(node.ID), "tcp-reality")
	wg.Wait()
	return p
}

// exitPathState is the hysteresis of one path with evalExitHealth's thresholds (3 failures →
// unhealthy, 2 successes → healthy; an unknown path is healthy on its first success).
type exitPathState struct {
	status string
	hc     nodeHealthCounter
}

// fold applies one probe; changed reports a status flip.
func (s *exitPathState) fold(p pathProbe) (status string, act exitAlertAction, changed bool) {
	if !p.present {
		changed = s.status != biz.PathAbsent
		*s = exitPathState{status: biz.PathAbsent}
		return biz.PathAbsent, exitAlertResolve, changed
	}
	if s.status == biz.PathAbsent || s.status == "" {
		s.status = biz.PathUnknown // the path appeared (credentials were added)
	}
	result := biz.PathUnhealthy
	if p.ok {
		result = biz.PathHealthy
	}
	newStatus, act := evalExitHealth(s.status, result, &s.hc)
	if changed = newStatus != s.status; changed {
		s.hc = nodeHealthCounter{}
	}
	s.status = newStatus
	return newStatus, act, changed
}

// exitHealth is the monitor's memory about one exit. Only the monitor goroutine uses it.
type exitHealth struct {
	seeded bool
	hy, vr exitPathState
}

// exitVerdict is what one monitor tick decided for one exit.
type exitVerdict struct {
	status                      string          // exit tunnel_status after this tick
	exitAlert, hyAlert, vrAlert exitAlertAction // exit-down-<id>, exit-path-down-<id>-hy|vr
	hyChanged                   bool            // the Hysteria path flipped: Bamboo re-decides
	latencyMs                   int             // latency_ms: the Hysteria RTT, else the TCP one
	errText                     string          // tunnel_error: this tick's failures
}

// tick folds one probe of both paths into the exit's state. dbStatus is the persisted
// tunnel_status: it seeds the paths after an API restart (a healthy exit stays healthy while its
// paths are re-judged) and stays when the paths do not decide (one unknown, none healthy).
func (h *exitHealth) tick(dbStatus string, p exitPathProbe) exitVerdict {
	if dbStatus == "" {
		dbStatus = biz.PathUnknown
	}
	if !h.seeded {
		seed := biz.PathUnknown
		if dbStatus == biz.PathHealthy || dbStatus == biz.PathUnhealthy {
			seed = dbStatus
		}
		h.hy.status, h.vr.status = biz.PathAbsent, biz.PathAbsent
		if p.hy.present {
			h.hy.status = seed
		}
		if p.vr.present {
			h.vr.status = seed
		}
		h.seeded = true
	}
	hySt, hyAct, hyChanged := h.hy.fold(p.hy)
	vrSt, vrAct, _ := h.vr.fold(p.vr)
	v := exitVerdict{status: combineExitStatus(dbStatus, hySt, vrSt), hyChanged: hyChanged}
	switch v.status {
	case biz.PathUnhealthy:
		v.exitAlert = exitAlertRaise
	case biz.PathHealthy:
		v.exitAlert = exitAlertResolve
	}
	v.hyAlert, v.vrAlert = pathAlert(hyAct, v.status), pathAlert(vrAct, v.status)
	switch {
	case p.hy.ok:
		v.latencyMs = p.hy.rttMs
	case p.vr.ok:
		v.latencyMs = p.vr.rttMs
	}
	var errs []string
	for _, pp := range []pathProbe{p.hy, p.vr} {
		if pp.present && !pp.ok {
			errs = append(errs, pp.err)
		}
	}
	if !p.hy.present && !p.vr.present {
		errs = append(errs, "у exit нет рабочего пути: нужен протокол hysteria2 или учётка VLESS Reality")
	}
	v.errText = strings.Join(errs, "; ")
	return v
}

// snapshot is the view biz.ExitPaths gets after a tick.
func (h *exitHealth) snapshot(p exitPathProbe, now time.Time) biz.ExitPaths {
	return biz.ExitPaths{Hy: h.hy.status, VR: h.vr.status, HyRTTms: p.hy.rttMs, VRRTTms: p.vr.rttMs,
		HyError: p.hy.err, VRError: p.vr.err, CheckedAt: now}
}

// combineExitStatus: an exit is healthy while any of its paths is, unhealthy only when every
// path it has is unhealthy (or it has none); otherwise (a path still unknown) prev stays.
func combineExitStatus(prev string, paths ...string) string {
	present, dead := 0, 0
	for _, s := range paths {
		switch s {
		case biz.PathAbsent:
			continue
		case biz.PathHealthy:
			return biz.PathHealthy
		case biz.PathUnhealthy:
			dead++
		}
		present++
	}
	if present == dead {
		return biz.PathUnhealthy
	}
	return prev
}

// pathAlert: a dead path is reported only while the exit still works through the other one
// (otherwise exit-down-<id> covers it); a healthy or absent path resolves its alert.
func pathAlert(act exitAlertAction, exitStatus string) exitAlertAction {
	if act == exitAlertRaise && exitStatus != biz.PathHealthy {
		return exitAlertNone
	}
	return act
}

func exitPathAlertKey(serverID int, path string) string {
	return fmt.Sprintf("exit-path-down-%d-%s", serverID, path)
}

func exitPathDownText(node biz.ExitNodeTunnel, path, probeErr string) (title, details string) {
	if probeErr == "" {
		probeErr = "последняя проверка прошла, ждём подтверждения восстановления"
	}
	if path == "hy" {
		return fmt.Sprintf("Exit-нода %s: путь Hysteria (UDP) недоступен", node.Name),
			fmt.Sprintf("%s (%s): трафик exit идёт по запасному TCP-пути (VLESS Reality :%d); Бамбук через этот exit не работает.\nОшибка: %s\nПроверьте UDP 50443 и hop-диапазон на exit и юнит hysteria2-client-%d на Hub.",
				node.Name, node.IPAddress, exitVRPort, probeErr, node.ID)
	}
	return fmt.Sprintf("Exit-нода %s: запасной TCP-путь недоступен", node.Name),
		fmt.Sprintf("%s (%s): exit работает через Hysteria, но без запаса — при блокировке UDP он отключится целиком.\nОшибка: %s\nПроверьте xray на exit (TCP %d) и фаервол.",
			node.Name, node.IPAddress, probeErr, exitVRPort)
}

func exitPathUpText(node biz.ExitNodeTunnel, path string) string {
	if path == "hy" {
		return fmt.Sprintf("Exit-нода %s (#%d): путь Hysteria снова работает", node.Name, node.ID)
	}
	return fmt.Sprintf("Exit-нода %s (#%d): запасной TCP-путь снова работает", node.Name, node.ID)
}

// applyExitAlerts sends the tick's alert calls (the alert manager dedups by key; resolving a key
// that was never raised is a no-op).
func applyExitAlerts(node biz.ExitNodeTunnel, v exitVerdict, p exitPathProbe) {
	switch v.exitAlert {
	case exitAlertRaise:
		RaiseAlert(exitDownAlertKey(node.ID), AlertWarn, fmt.Sprintf("Exit-нода %s недоступна", node.Name), exitDownDetails(node, v.errText))
	case exitAlertResolve:
		ResolveAlert(exitDownAlertKey(node.ID), exitUpMessage(node, v.latencyMs))
	}
	for _, x := range []struct {
		path string
		act  exitAlertAction
		err  string
	}{{"hy", v.hyAlert, p.hy.err}, {"vr", v.vrAlert, p.vr.err}} {
		switch x.act {
		case exitAlertRaise:
			title, details := exitPathDownText(node, x.path, x.err)
			RaiseAlert(exitPathAlertKey(node.ID, x.path), AlertWarn, title, details)
		case exitAlertResolve:
			ResolveAlert(exitPathAlertKey(node.ID, x.path), exitPathUpText(node, x.path))
		}
	}
}
```

```go
// exitHealthByID: the monitor's per-exit path memory (map[int]*exitHealth).
var exitHealthByID sync.Map

func exitHealthFor(id int) *exitHealth {
	v, _ := exitHealthByID.LoadOrStore(id, &exitHealth{})
	return v.(*exitHealth)
}

// checkAllTunnels проверяет оба пути каждой exit-ноды и обновляет статусы.
func checkAllTunnels() {
	nodes, err := biz.ListAllExitNodes()
	if err != nil {
		log.Printf("[tunnel-monitor] Ошибка загрузки exit-нод: %v", err)
		return
	}

	if len(nodes) == 0 {
		// No online exit at all: SyncXrayConfig blocks every user inbound.
		RaiseAlert("all-exits-down", AlertCritical, "Нет ни одной exit-ноды",
			"В servers нет online exit-нод — пользовательский трафик заблокирован (кроме RU-direct).")
		return
	}

	statusChanged, hyChanged := false, false
	healthyCount := 0
	for _, node := range nodes {
		probe := exitPathProber(node)
		h := exitHealthFor(node.ID)
		v := h.tick(node.TunnelStatus, probe)

		// Bamboo (biz.ExpressExit) ranks exits by the RTT of their Hysteria path only.
		if probe.hy.ok {
			if rttErr := biz.UpdateExitRTT(node.ID, probe.hy.rttMs); rttErr != nil {
				log.Printf("[tunnel-monitor] UpdateExitRTT(%d) failed: %v", node.ID, rttErr)
			}
		}
		biz.SetExitPaths(node.ID, h.snapshot(probe, time.Now()))
		applyExitAlerts(node, v, probe)
		if v.hyChanged {
			hyChanged = true
		}
		if v.status == biz.PathHealthy {
			healthyCount++
		}

		oldStatus := node.TunnelStatus
		// last_tunnel_check / latency / tunnel_error on every tick, the status when it flipped.
		if err := biz.UpdateTunnelStatusWithError(node.ID, v.status, v.latencyMs, v.errText); err != nil {
			log.Printf("[tunnel-monitor] Ошибка обновления статуса ноды %d: %v", node.ID, err)
			continue
		}
		if v.status == oldStatus {
			continue
		}
		statusChanged = true
		switch {
		case v.status == biz.PathUnhealthy:
			log.Printf("[tunnel-monitor] ALERT: Exit-нода %d (%s, %s) — оба пути НЕДОСТУПНЫ: %s",
				node.ID, node.Name, node.IPAddress, v.errText)
			biz.RecordFailedConnection(node.ID)
		case v.status == biz.PathHealthy && oldStatus == biz.PathUnhealthy:
			log.Printf("[tunnel-monitor] OK: Exit-нода %d (%s, %s) — туннель ВОССТАНОВЛЕН", node.ID, node.Name, node.IPAddress)
			biz.RecordSuccessfulConnection(node.ID)
		default:
			log.Printf("[tunnel-monitor] Exit-нода %d (%s): %s -> %s", node.ID, node.Name, oldStatus, v.status)
		}
	}

	// Evaluated every cycle (RaiseAlert dedups by key with a 30-min cooldown),
	// so an outage that began before an API restart still alerts.
	if healthyCount == 0 {
		RaiseAlert("all-exits-down", AlertCritical, "Все exit-ноды недоступны",
			fmt.Sprintf("0 из %d exit-нод healthy — пользовательский трафик заблокирован (кроме RU-direct).", len(nodes)))
	} else {
		ResolveAlert("all-exits-down",
			fmt.Sprintf("Exit-ноды снова доступны: %d из %d healthy", healthyCount, len(nodes)))
	}

	if statusChanged {
		log.Printf("[tunnel-monitor] Статус exit-нод изменился, запрос на пересинхронизацию Xray...")
		RequestXraySync()
	}
	// Bamboo re-decides its exit when an exit or its Hysteria path flips; the 5-minute periodic
	// Hysteria2 sync covers the rest (the hysteresis lives in biz.ExpressSelector).
	if statusChanged || hyChanged {
		RequestHysteria2Sync()
	}

	// ── MTProto :mtproto_port TCP probe ──
	checkMTProtoHealth()
}
```

```go
package biz

import (
	"strings"
	"testing"
	"time"
)

var expressT0 = time.Date(2026, 10, 12, 12, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC)

// cands builds candidates from id, rtt pairs.
func cands(pairs ...int) []ExpressCandidate {
	var out []ExpressCandidate
	for i := 0; i+1 < len(pairs); i += 2 {
		out = append(out, ExpressCandidate{ID: pairs[i], RTTms: pairs[i+1]})
	}
	return out
}

func TestExpressEWMA(t *testing.T) {
	s := NewExpressSelector(0, time.Time{})
	s.Observe(2, 100)
	s.Observe(2, 200)
	if c := s.Choose(expressT0, cands(2, 0)); c.ExitID != 2 || c.RTTms != 130 {
		t.Fatalf("EWMA α=0.3 of 100 then 200 must be 130: %+v", c)
	}
	s.Observe(2, 0)
	s.Observe(0, 50)
	if c := s.Choose(expressT0, cands(2, 0)); c.RTTms != 130 {
		t.Fatalf("a zero RTT or id must be ignored: %+v", c)
	}
}

// Review Focus 1 → with a second exit Bamboo moves to exit #3's OWN tunnel port 1091 (1088+3),
// never to a "dedicated" client.
func TestExpressFirstChoiceAndPort(t *testing.T) {
	c := NewExpressSelector(0, time.Time{}).Choose(expressT0, cands(2, 120, 3, 80))
	if !c.Switched || c.ExitID != 3 || c.SocksPort != 1091 || !c.Since.Equal(expressT0) || c.Reason != "первый выбор" {
		t.Fatalf("first choice must take the fastest exit on its own 1088+id port: %+v", c)
	}
	if c := NewExpressSelector(0, time.Time{}).Choose(expressT0, nil); c.ExitID != 0 || c.SocksPort != ExpressFallbackPort || c.Switched {
		t.Fatalf("no exit at all: legacy port, no switch: %+v", c)
	}
}

func TestExpressHysteresis(t *testing.T) {
	s := NewExpressSelector(2, expressT0)
	if c := s.Choose(expressT0.Add(9*time.Minute), cands(2, 100, 3, 70)); c.Switched || c.ExitID != 2 {
		t.Fatalf("switch inside the 10-minute hold: %+v", c)
	}
	if c := NewExpressSelector(2, expressT0).Choose(expressT0.Add(time.Hour), cands(2, 100, 3, 85)); c.Switched {
		t.Fatalf("switch for a 15%% gain: %+v", c)
	}
	c := s.Choose(expressT0.Add(10*time.Minute), cands(2, 100, 3, 70))
	if !c.Switched || c.ExitID != 3 || !strings.Contains(c.Reason, "быстрее на 30%") || c.SocksPort != 1091 {
		t.Fatalf("want one switch to exit #3 (30%% faster): %+v", c)
	}
}

func TestExpressFailoverIsImmediate(t *testing.T) {
	s := NewExpressSelector(2, expressT0)
	c := s.Choose(expressT0.Add(time.Minute), cands(3, 200)) // exit 2 lost its Hysteria path
	if !c.Switched || c.ExitID != 3 || !strings.Contains(c.Reason, "нет живого пути Hysteria") {
		t.Fatalf("a dead current exit must be left at once, hold or not: %+v", c)
	}
	if c := s.Choose(expressT0.Add(2*time.Minute), nil); c.Switched || c.ExitID != 3 || c.SocksPort != 1091 {
		t.Fatalf("with nothing alive the choice stays (no rewrite, no restart): %+v", c)
	}
}

// Flapping health must not flap Bamboo.
func TestExpressFlappingHealth(t *testing.T) {
	s := NewExpressSelector(2, expressT0)
	s.Observe(2, 100)
	s.Observe(3, 100)
	switches := 0
	for i := 1; i <= 120; i++ { // an hour of 30-second ticks; exit 2 is dead every other tick
		cs := cands(3, 100)
		if i%2 == 0 {
			cs = cands(2, 100, 3, 100)
		}
		s.Observe(3, 95+i%10) // jitter well under 20 %
		if c := s.Choose(expressT0.Add(time.Duration(i)*30*time.Second), cs); c.Switched {
			switches++
		}
	}
	if switches != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("switches = %d, want 1 (the failover to #3, then stay)", switches)
	}

	s = NewExpressSelector(2, expressT0)
	switches = 0
	for i := 1; i <= 120; i++ { // a flapping candidate only 10 % faster never takes over
		cs := cands(2, 100)
		if i%2 == 0 {
			cs = cands(2, 100, 3, 90)
		}
		if c := s.Choose(expressT0.Add(time.Duration(i)*30*time.Second), cs); c.Switched {
			switches++
		}
	}
	if switches != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("switches = %d, want 0", switches)
	}
}

func TestExpressCandidatesNeedALiveHysteriaPath(t *testing.T) {
	paths := map[int]ExitPaths{2: {Hy: PathUnhealthy, VR: PathHealthy}, 3: {Hy: PathHealthy}}
	got := filterExpressCandidates(cands(2, 50, 3, 90, 5, 70), func(id int) (ExitPaths, bool) {
		p, ok := paths[id]
		return p, ok
	})
	if len(got) != 2 || got[0].ID != 3 || got[1].ID != 5 {
		t.Fatalf("exit 2 (Hysteria dead) must be dropped, exit 5 (not probed yet) kept: %+v", got)
	}
	q := strings.Join(strings.Fields(expressCandidatesQuery), " ")
	for _, want := range []string{"tunnel_status = 'healthy'", "tunnel_protocol = 'hysteria2'", "lifecycle_state = 'online'"} {
		if !strings.Contains(q, want) {
			t.Errorf("candidates query lacks %q: %s", want, q)
		}
	}
}
```

```go
package main

import (
	"strings"
	"testing"
	"time"

	"github.com/heyearth/backend/internal/biz"
)

// hysteria2-server restarts only when server.yaml's bytes change (SyncHysteria2Config compares
// them first): two hours of RTT jitter and a flapping second exit must not change them; a real
// failover changes them once, onto the new exit's own port.
func TestBambooRestartsOnlyWhenTheExitChanges(t *testing.T) {
	t0 := time.Date(2026, 10, 12, 12, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC)
	sel := biz.NewExpressSelector(2, t0)
	render := func(c biz.ExpressChoice) string {
		return renderHysteria2Config(100, 100, "obfs", "stats", c.SocksPort, []string{"138.16.181.225"})
	}
	last := render(sel.Current())
	if !strings.Contains(last, "addr: 127.0.0.1:1090") {
		t.Fatalf("exit #2 must keep Bamboo on 127.0.0.1:1090 (no restart at deploy):\n%s", last)
	}
	restarts := 0
	for i := 1; i <= 240; i++ {
		rtt2, rtt3 := 100+i%15, 95+(i*7)%15
		sel.Observe(2, rtt2)
		sel.Observe(3, rtt3)
		cs := []biz.ExpressCandidate{{ID: 2, RTTms: rtt2}, {ID: 3, RTTms: rtt3}}
		if i%3 == 0 {
			cs = cs[:1] // exit 3 flaps out every third tick
		}
		if y := render(sel.Choose(t0.Add(time.Duration(i)*30*time.Second), cs)); y != last {
			restarts++
			last = y
		}
	}
	if restarts != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("hysteria2-server restarted %d times without a real exit change", restarts)
	}
	y := render(sel.Choose(t0.Add(3*time.Hour), []biz.ExpressCandidate{{ID: 3, RTTms: 100}}))
	if y == last || !strings.Contains(y, "addr: 127.0.0.1:1091") {
		t.Fatalf("failover must move via_exit to exit #3's own 127.0.0.1:1091:\n%s", y)
	}
}
```

```go
// s6yc: the dedicated Express client is gone (its :1091 is exit #3's own SOCKS port); setup
// removes a leftover unit instead of installing one.
func TestHysteria2HubScriptRemovesDedicatedExpressClient(t *testing.T) {

	if strings.Contains(s, "cat > /etc/systemd/system/hysteria2-client-express.service") {

	for _, want := range []string{
```

- [ ] **Step 3: `biz.ExpressExit`**

Replace `server/backend/internal/biz/express_tunnel.go` целиком:

```go
// Package biz — Бамбук (Hysteria2 на Hub): через какой exit он выходит.
//
// hysteria2-server on the Hub sends Bamboo users' traffic into the SOCKS of ONE exit:
// hysteria2-client-<id> on 127.0.0.1:(1088+id), the same client that serves the exit-<id>.hy path
// in xray. There is no "dedicated" client any more (s6yc): its :1091 was exit #3's own port and
// its separate auth password was never set.
//
// Choice (7yrs): a smoothed RTT of each exit's Hysteria path (EWMA, α = 0.3, fed by every
// successful monitor probe through UpdateExitRTT) with hysteresis — an optimisation switch at
// most once per 10 minutes and only to an exit at least 20 % faster. When the current exit loses
// its Hysteria path the switch is immediate (that is a failover, not an optimisation). With no
// live exit the choice stays: server.yaml is not rewritten and hysteria2-server is not restarted
// (traffic cannot pass anyway, and a restart drops every Bamboo session).
package biz

import (
	"context"
	"database/sql"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"log"
	"strconv"
	"strings"
	"sync"
	"time"

	"github.com/heyearth/backend/internal/db"
)

const (
	ExpressEWMAAlpha  = 0.3
	ExpressMinHold    = 10 * time.Minute
	ExpressMinGainPct = 20
	// ExpressFallbackPort is used while no exit was ever chosen (exit #2's port, as before).
	ExpressFallbackPort = 1090
	expressUnmeasured   = 9999.0 // an exit without any RTT sorts last
)

// ExpressCandidate is a healthy exit whose Hysteria path is alive.
type ExpressCandidate struct {
	ID    int
	RTTms int // servers.last_rtt_ms (last Hysteria RTT); 0 = unknown
}

// ExpressChoice is the exit Bamboo leaves through.
type ExpressChoice struct {
	ExitID    int       // 0: no exit chosen yet
	SocksPort int       // 1088+ExitID; ExpressFallbackPort while ExitID is 0
	RTTms     int       // smoothed RTT of the chosen exit, 0 = unknown
	Since     time.Time // when this exit was chosen
	Switched  bool      // this Choose changed the exit
	Reason    string    // why it changed (for the log)
}

func expressSocksPort(id int) int {
	if id <= 0 {
		return ExpressFallbackPort
	}
	return 1088 + id
}

// ExpressSelector keeps the smoothed RTTs and the current choice.
type ExpressSelector struct {
	mu      sync.Mutex
	ewma    map[int]float64
	current int
	since   time.Time
}

func NewExpressSelector(current int, since time.Time) *ExpressSelector {
	return &ExpressSelector{ewma: map[int]float64{}, current: current, since: since}
}

// Observe folds one successful RTT measurement of exit id into its EWMA.
func (s *ExpressSelector) Observe(id, rttMs int) {
	if id <= 0 || rttMs <= 0 {
		return
	}
	s.mu.Lock()
	defer s.mu.Unlock()
	prev, ok := s.ewma[id]
	if !ok || prev >= expressUnmeasured {
		s.ewma[id] = float64(rttMs)
		return
	}
	s.ewma[id] = ExpressEWMAAlpha*float64(rttMs) + (1-ExpressEWMAAlpha)*prev
}

// Current is the choice without re-deciding.
func (s *ExpressSelector) Current() ExpressChoice {
	s.mu.Lock()
	defer s.mu.Unlock()
	return s.choiceLocked(false, "")
}

func (s *ExpressSelector) choiceLocked(switched bool, reason string) ExpressChoice {
	rtt := 0
	if v, ok := s.ewma[s.current]; ok && v < expressUnmeasured {
		rtt = int(v + 0.5)
	}
	return ExpressChoice{ExitID: s.current, SocksPort: expressSocksPort(s.current), RTTms: rtt,
		Since: s.since, Switched: switched, Reason: reason}
}

// Choose decides the exit for now among cands (exits whose Hysteria path is alive).
func (s *ExpressSelector) Choose(now time.Time, cands []ExpressCandidate) ExpressChoice {
	s.mu.Lock()
	defer s.mu.Unlock()
	alive := map[int]bool{}
	best := 0
	for _, c := range cands {
		if c.ID <= 0 {
			continue
		}
		alive[c.ID] = true
		if _, ok := s.ewma[c.ID]; !ok {
			if c.RTTms > 0 {
				s.ewma[c.ID] = float64(c.RTTms)
			} else {
				s.ewma[c.ID] = expressUnmeasured
			}
		}
		if best == 0 || s.ewma[c.ID] < s.ewma[best] || (s.ewma[c.ID] == s.ewma[best] && c.ID < best) {
			best = c.ID
		}
	}
	var reason string
	switch {
	case best == 0:
		return s.choiceLocked(false, "нет exit с живым путём Hysteria — выбор не меняется")
	case s.current == 0:
		reason = "первый выбор"
	case !alive[s.current]:
		reason = fmt.Sprintf("у exit #%d нет живого пути Hysteria", s.current)
	case best == s.current, now.Sub(s.since) < ExpressMinHold:
		return s.choiceLocked(false, "")
	case s.ewma[best]*100 > s.ewma[s.current]*(100-ExpressMinGainPct):
		return s.choiceLocked(false, "")
	default:
		reason = fmt.Sprintf("exit #%d быстрее на %d%%", best, int(100*(1-s.ewma[best]/s.ewma[s.current])+0.5))
	}
	s.current, s.since = best, now
	return s.choiceLocked(true, reason)
}

// ─────────────── The process-wide selector (DB-backed) ───────────────

var (
	expressMu  sync.Mutex
	expressSel *ExpressSelector
)

// expressSelector returns the selector, seeded once from app_settings so an API restart neither
// forgets the current exit nor restarts its 10-minute hold. A failed read is an error (retried by
// the next call), never "no exit": that would move Bamboo and restart hysteria2-server.
func expressSelector(ctx context.Context) (*ExpressSelector, error) {
	expressMu.Lock()
	defer expressMu.Unlock()
	if expressSel != nil {
		return expressSel, nil
	}
	read := func(key string) (string, error) {
		v, err := GetSettingContext(ctx, key)
		if errors.Is(err, sql.ErrNoRows) {
			return "", nil
		}
		return strings.TrimSpace(v), err
	}
	idStr, err := read("hysteria2_bound_exit_id")
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	sinceStr, err := read("hysteria2_bound_exit_since")
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	id, _ := strconv.Atoi(idStr)
	since, _ := time.Parse(time.RFC3339, sinceStr) // absent (pre-phase-1): zero, the hold is over
	expressSel = NewExpressSelector(id, since)
	return expressSel, nil
}

// ExpressCurrent is the current choice without touching the database (admin status).
func ExpressCurrent() (ExpressChoice, bool) {
	expressMu.Lock()
	s := expressSel
	expressMu.Unlock()
	if s == nil {
		return ExpressChoice{}, false
	}
	return s.Current(), true
}

const expressCandidatesQuery = `
	SELECT id, COALESCE(last_rtt_ms, 0)
	  FROM servers
	 WHERE is_exit_node = TRUE
	   AND lifecycle_state = 'online'
	   AND tunnel_status = 'healthy'
	   AND tunnel_protocol = 'hysteria2'
	 ORDER BY id`

// filterExpressCandidates drops exits whose Hysteria path the monitor saw dead (the exit itself
// may still be healthy through its TCP path, which Bamboo cannot use). An exit the monitor has
// not probed since the API started is kept: its healthy tunnel_status is the last word.
func filterExpressCandidates(cands []ExpressCandidate, paths func(int) (ExitPaths, bool)) []ExpressCandidate {
	out := cands[:0:0]
	for _, c := range cands {
		if p, ok := paths(c.ID); ok && p.Hy != PathHealthy {
			continue
		}
		out = append(out, c)
	}
	return out
}

func listExpressCandidates(ctx context.Context) ([]ExpressCandidate, error) {
	rows, err := db.DB.QueryContext(ctx, expressCandidatesQuery)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	defer rows.Close()
	var cands []ExpressCandidate
	for rows.Next() {
		var c ExpressCandidate
		if err := rows.Scan(&c.ID, &c.RTTms); err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		cands = append(cands, c)
	}
	if err := rows.Err(); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	return filterExpressCandidates(cands, GetExitPaths), nil
}

// ExpressExit decides Bamboo's exit now and persists a change. On a database error it returns
// the current choice with the error: the caller must keep server.yaml as it is.
func ExpressExit() (ExpressChoice, error) {
	ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 10*time.Second)
	defer cancel()
	sel, err := expressSelector(ctx)
	if err != nil {
		return ExpressChoice{SocksPort: ExpressFallbackPort}, fmt.Errorf("read the bound exit: %w", err)
	}
	cands, err := listExpressCandidates(ctx)
	if err != nil {
		return sel.Current(), fmt.Errorf("list exits for Bamboo: %w", err)
	}
	c := sel.Choose(time.Now(), cands)
	if c.Switched {
		for key, val := range map[string]string{
			"hysteria2_bound_exit_id":    strconv.Itoa(c.ExitID),
			"hysteria2_bound_exit_since": c.Since.UTC().Format(time.RFC3339),
		} {
			if err := SetSettingContext(ctx, key, val); err != nil {
				log.Printf("[bamboo] не удалось сохранить %s: %v", key, err)
			}
		}
	}
	return c, nil
}

// UpdateExitRTT writes the per-probe RTT of the exit's Hysteria path into last_rtt_ms /
// last_rtt_at and feeds Bamboo's EWMA. Called by the tunnel monitor on every successful Hysteria
// probe only, so transient failures never poison the selection.
func UpdateExitRTT(serverID int, rttMs int) error {
	if rttMs <= 0 {
		return nil
	}
	ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 10*time.Second)
	defer cancel()
	if s, err := expressSelector(ctx); err == nil {
		s.Observe(serverID, rttMs)
	}
	_, err := db.DB.ExecContext(ctx, `
		UPDATE servers
		   SET last_rtt_ms = $1,
		       last_rtt_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
		 WHERE id = $2
	`, rttMs, serverID)
	return err
}
```

```go
package biz

import (
	"context"
	"database/sql"
	"database/sql/driver"
	"errors"
	"io"
	"reflect"
	"strings"
	"sync"
	"testing"

	"github.com/heyearth/backend/internal/db"
)

// txLog is a database/sql connector that journals statements; statements run inside a
// transaction get the "tx:" prefix, and the first one containing failOn fails.
type txLog struct {
	mu     sync.Mutex
	events []string
	failOn string
}

func (l *txLog) add(e string) { l.mu.Lock(); l.events = append(l.events, e); l.mu.Unlock() }

func (l *txLog) Connect(context.Context) (driver.Conn, error) { return &txLogConn{log: l}, nil }
func (l *txLog) Driver() driver.Driver                         { return txLogDriver{l} }

type txLogDriver struct{ l *txLog }

func (d txLogDriver) Open(string) (driver.Conn, error) { return &txLogConn{log: d.l}, nil }

type txLogConn struct {
	log  *txLog
	inTx bool
}

func (c *txLogConn) Prepare(q string) (driver.Stmt, error) { return &txLogStmt{c: c, q: q}, nil }
func (c *txLogConn) Close() error                          { return nil }
func (c *txLogConn) Begin() (driver.Tx, error)             { c.inTx = true; c.log.add("BEGIN"); return c, nil }
func (c *txLogConn) Commit() error                         { c.inTx = false; c.log.add("COMMIT"); return nil }
func (c *txLogConn) Rollback() error                       { c.inTx = false; c.log.add("ROLLBACK"); return nil }

type txLogStmt struct {
	c *txLogConn
	q string
}

func (s *txLogStmt) Close() error  { return nil }
func (s *txLogStmt) NumInput() int { return -1 }

func (s *txLogStmt) record() error {
	f := strings.Fields(s.q)
	n := 3 // "INSERT INTO plans", "DELETE FROM plan_servers"
	if len(f) > 0 && strings.EqualFold(f[0], "UPDATE") {
		n = 2 // "UPDATE plans"
	}
	if len(f) < n {
		n = len(f)
	}
	e := strings.Join(f[:n], " ")
	if s.c.inTx {
		e = "tx:" + e
	}
	s.c.log.add(e)
	if s.c.log.failOn != "" && strings.Contains(s.q, s.c.log.failOn) {
		return errors.New("boom")
	}
	return nil
}

func (s *txLogStmt) Exec([]driver.Value) (driver.Result, error) {
	if err := s.record(); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	return driver.RowsAffected(1), nil
}

func (s *txLogStmt) Query([]driver.Value) (driver.Rows, error) {
	if err := s.record(); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	return &idRows{}, nil
}

type idRows struct{ done bool }

func (r *idRows) Columns() []string { return []string{"id"} }
func (r *idRows) Close() error      { return nil }
func (r *idRows) Next(dest []driver.Value) error {
	if r.done {
		return io.EOF
	}
	r.done, dest[0] = true, int64(42)
	return nil
}

func withTxLog(t *testing.T, failOn string) *txLog {
	t.Helper()
	l := &txLog{failOn: failOn}
	old := db.DB
	db.DB = sql.OpenDB(l)
	db.DB.SetMaxOpenConns(2) // a statement outside the transaction gets its own (non-tx) connection
	t.Cleanup(func() { db.DB.Close(); db.DB = old })
	return l
}

func TestUpdatePlanWritesPlanServersInItsTransaction(t *testing.T) {
	l := withTxLog(t, "")
	if err := UpdatePlan(3, &Plan{Slug: "s", Name: "n", Features: "{}", ServerIDs: []int{2, 20}}); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	want := []string{"BEGIN", "tx:UPDATE plans", "tx:DELETE FROM plan_servers", "tx:INSERT INTO plan_servers", "COMMIT"}
	if !reflect.DeepEqual(l.events, want) {
		t.Fatalf("events %v, want %v", l.events, want)
	}
}

func TestUpdatePlanRollsBackWhenPlanServersFail(t *testing.T) {
	l := withTxLog(t, "INSERT INTO plan_servers")
	err := UpdatePlan(3, &Plan{Slug: "s", Name: "n", Features: "{}", ServerIDs: []int{2}})
	if err == nil || !strings.Contains(err.Error(), "plan_servers") {
		t.Fatalf("err = %v, want the plan_servers error (it used to be ignored)", err)
	}
	want := []string{"BEGIN", "tx:UPDATE plans", "tx:DELETE FROM plan_servers", "tx:INSERT INTO plan_servers", "ROLLBACK"}
	if !reflect.DeepEqual(l.events, want) {
		t.Fatalf("events %v, want %v", l.events, want)
	}
}

func TestUpdatePlanWithoutServersOnlyDeletes(t *testing.T) {
	l := withTxLog(t, "")
	if err := UpdatePlan(3, &Plan{Slug: "s", Name: "n", Features: "{}"}); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	want := []string{"BEGIN", "tx:UPDATE plans", "tx:DELETE FROM plan_servers", "COMMIT"}
	if !reflect.DeepEqual(l.events, want) {
		t.Fatalf("events %v, want %v", l.events, want)
	}
}

func TestCreatePlanBindsServersInItsTransaction(t *testing.T) {
```

В `server/backend/internal/biz/plans.go` заменить `CreatePlan`, `UpdatePlan` (:240-286) и `replacePlanServers` (:294-299) на:

```go
// planWriteTimeout bounds one plan write (the plan row and its plan_servers in one transaction).
const planWriteTimeout = 15 * time.Second

const (
	deletePlanServersSQL = `DELETE FROM plan_servers WHERE plan_id = $1`
	insertPlanServersSQL = `INSERT INTO plan_servers (plan_id, server_id) SELECT $1, unnest($2::int[]) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING`
)

// replacePlanServersTx replaces a plan's exits inside the caller's transaction, so the xray sync
// never sees a plan whose old rows are gone and the new ones not yet in (its users would fall to
// the catch-all balancer = other plans' exits).
func replacePlanServersTx(ctx context.Context, tx *sql.Tx, planID int, serverIDs []int) error {
	if _, err := tx.ExecContext(ctx, deletePlanServersSQL, planID); err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("delete plan_servers: %w", err)
	}
	if len(serverIDs) == 0 {
		return nil
	}
	ids := make([]int64, 0, len(serverIDs))
	for _, id := range serverIDs {
		ids = append(ids, int64(id))
	}
	if _, err := tx.ExecContext(ctx, insertPlanServersSQL, planID, pq.Array(ids)); err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("insert plan_servers: %w", err)
	}
	return nil
}

// CreatePlan creates a new plan with its exits in one transaction.
func CreatePlan(p *Plan) (int, error) {
	ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), planWriteTimeout)
	defer cancel()
	tx, err := db.DB.BeginTx(ctx, nil)
	if err != nil {
		return 0, fmt.Errorf("begin: %w", err)
	}
	defer tx.Rollback()
	var id int
	err = tx.QueryRowContext(ctx, `
		INSERT INTO plans (slug, name, description, price_rub, duration_days, traffic_limit_bytes,
		                   allowed_protocols, features, is_active, direct_routing_enabled, sort_order,
		                   auto_renew_default, max_activations_per_user,
		                   express_enabled, express_up_mbps, express_down_mbps,
		                   amnezia_wg_enabled)
		VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6, $7, $8::jsonb, $9, $10, $11, $12, $13, $14, $15, $16, $17)
		RETURNING id
	`, p.Slug, p.Name, p.Description, p.PriceRub, p.DurationDays, p.TrafficLimitBytes,
		pq.Array(p.AllowedProtocols), p.Features, p.IsActive, p.DirectRoutingEnabled,
		p.SortOrder, p.AutoRenewDefault, p.MaxActivationsPerUser,
		p.ExpressEnabled, p.ExpressUpMbps, p.ExpressDownMbps,
		p.AmneziaWGEnabled).Scan(&id)
	if err != nil {
		return 0, err
	}
	if err := replacePlanServersTx(ctx, tx, id, p.ServerIDs); err != nil {
		return 0, err
	}
	if err := tx.Commit(); err != nil {
		return 0, fmt.Errorf("commit: %w", err)
	}
	return id, nil
}

// UpdatePlan updates a plan and replaces its exits (p.ServerIDs) in one transaction.
func UpdatePlan(id int, p *Plan) error {
	ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), planWriteTimeout)
	defer cancel()
	tx, err := db.DB.BeginTx(ctx, nil)
	if err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("begin: %w", err)
	}
	defer tx.Rollback()
	if _, err := tx.ExecContext(ctx, `
		UPDATE plans SET slug=$1, name=$2, description=$3, price_rub=$4, duration_days=$5,
		       traffic_limit_bytes=$6, allowed_protocols=$7, features=$8::jsonb, is_active=$9,
		       direct_routing_enabled=$10, sort_order=$11, auto_renew_default=$12,
		       max_activations_per_user=$13,
		       express_enabled=$14, express_up_mbps=$15, express_down_mbps=$16,
		       amnezia_wg_enabled=$17,
		       updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
		WHERE id = $18
	`, p.Slug, p.Name, p.Description, p.PriceRub, p.DurationDays, p.TrafficLimitBytes,
		pq.Array(p.AllowedProtocols), p.Features, p.IsActive, p.DirectRoutingEnabled,
		p.SortOrder, p.AutoRenewDefault, p.MaxActivationsPerUser,
		p.ExpressEnabled, p.ExpressUpMbps, p.ExpressDownMbps,
		p.AmneziaWGEnabled, id); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if err := replacePlanServersTx(ctx, tx, id, p.ServerIDs); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if err := tx.Commit(); err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("commit: %w", err)
	}
	return nil
}
```
