```go
// goneHandler answers 410 Gone with a Russian explanation: endpoints phase 1 removed.
func goneHandler(msg string) http.HandlerFunc {
	return func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) { writeAdminError(w, http.StatusGone, msg) }
}

const (
	addServerGoneMsg   = "Добавление сервера через старую форму отключено: она делала неполную настройку и перезапускала API. Новый exit добавляется мастером «Добавить ноду» (следующее обновление админки)."
	fileWriteGoneMsg   = "Запись файлов на серверах из админки отключена: ручная правка конфигов и ключей ломала туннели. Журналы доступны только для чтения."
	tunnelCredsGoneMsg = "Генерация ключей туннеля в браузере отключена: ключи создаются на самой ноде при настройке."
	setupGoneMsg       = "Настройка exit из старой формы отключена: она перезапускала API и не доделывала шаги. Новый exit настраивается мастером «Добавить ноду» (следующее обновление админки)."
)

// removedServerActions answer 410: they broke the tunnel (fetch_tunnel_creds switched it to
// shadowsocks:8388; sync_tunnel TCP-dialled the UDP port and marked a working exit unhealthy;
// sync_metrics overwrote the protocol) or restarted the API itself mid-provisioning.
var removedServerActions = map[string]string{
	"fetch_tunnel_creds": "Действие «Получить ключи туннеля» удалено: оно переключало туннель на Shadowsocks и отключало exit. Для проверки используйте «Проверить туннель».",
	"sync_tunnel":        "Действие «Синхронизировать туннель» удалено: оно помечало рабочий exit недоступным. Для проверки используйте «Проверить туннель».",
	"sync_metrics":       "Действие «Синхронизировать метрики» удалено: оно перезаписывало протокол туннеля. Метрики обновляются автоматически.",
	"setup_exit_node":    setupGoneMsg,
	"reprovision":        setupGoneMsg,
}

// serverLifecycleStates are the values of servers.lifecycle_state (migration 000040).
var serverLifecycleStates = map[string]bool{
	"pending": true, "provisioning": true, "online": true, "failed": true, "deprovisioning": true, "offline": true,
}

// serverListWhere builds the servers list filter: search (name/IP), status (node-agent
// availability), lifecycle_state and country (ISO alpha-2). A bad lifecycle state or country is a
// 400, never a silently ignored filter.
func serverListWhere(q url.Values) (string, []any, error) {
	where, args := "1=1", []any{}
	add := func(cond string, v any) {
		args = append(args, v)
		where += " AND " + fmt.Sprintf(cond, len(args))
	}
	if s := strings.TrimSpace(q.Get("search")); s != "" {
		add("(s.name ILIKE $%[1]d OR s.ip_address ILIKE $%[1]d)", "%"+s+"%")
	}
	if s := strings.TrimSpace(q.Get("status")); s != "" {
		add("s.status = $%d", s)
	}
	if s := strings.TrimSpace(q.Get("lifecycle_state")); s != "" {
		if !serverLifecycleStates[s] {
			return "", nil, fmt.Errorf("неизвестное состояние ноды %q", s)
		}
		add("s.lifecycle_state = $%d", s)
	}
	if s := strings.TrimSpace(q.Get("country")); s != "" {
		if len(s) != 2 || validateCountryCode(s) != nil {
			return "", nil, fmt.Errorf("страна — двухбуквенный код ISO, например NL")
		}
		add("UPPER(s.country_code) = $%d", strings.ToUpper(s))
	}
	return where, args, nil
}

// redactServer drops every secret before a server leaves the API (Review Focus 5): the SSH
// password, the exit's private Reality key, the tunnel UUID (the Hub's VLESS credential on the
// exit) and the Hysteria tunnel password. The browser only learns whether they are set.
func redactServer(s serverResponse) serverResponse {
	s.HasSSHPassword = strings.TrimSpace(s.SSHPassword) != ""
	s.HasTunnelCreds = s.TunnelUUID != "" || s.TunnelSSPass != "" || s.TunnelPrivateKey != ""
	s.SSHPassword, s.TunnelUUID, s.TunnelPrivateKey, s.TunnelSSPass = "", "", "", ""
	return s
}

// validateServerUpdate: weight 1..10 (0 = keep), tunnel protocol hysteria2 or vless (the only ones
// the xray generator builds since phase 1).
func validateServerUpdate(req serverPayload) error {
	if req.LoadWeight != 0 && (req.LoadWeight < 1 || req.LoadWeight > 10) {
		return fmt.Errorf("приоритет должен быть от 1 до 10")
	}
	switch req.TunnelProtocol {
	case "", "hysteria2", "vless":
		return nil
	}
	return fmt.Errorf("протокол туннеля %q не поддерживается: только hysteria2 или vless", req.TunnelProtocol)
}
```

```go
package admin

import (
	"context"
	"database/sql"
	"errors"
	"net/http"
	"time"
)

// TunnelPathCheck is one path of an exit in «Проверить туннель».
type TunnelPathCheck struct {
	Path   string `json:"path"`   // hy | vr
	Name   string `json:"name"`   // shown to the owner
	Status string `json:"status"` // ok | fail | absent
	RTTms  int    `json:"rtt_ms,omitempty"`
	Error  string `json:"error,omitempty"`
}

// TunnelCheckResult is the answer of POST /api/admin/servers/{id}/check-tunnel.
type TunnelCheckResult struct {
	ServerID  int               `json:"server_id"`
	CheckedAt string            `json:"checked_at"`
	Summary   string            `json:"summary"`
	Paths     []TunnelPathCheck `json:"paths"`
}

// TunnelCheckFn is set by cmd/api: a read-only end-to-end check of an exit's paths (generate_204
// through each of them). It changes no status, alert or config. sql.ErrNoRows: not an exit.
var TunnelCheckFn func(ctx context.Context, serverID int) (TunnelCheckResult, error)

// CheckTunnelHandler serves POST /api/admin/servers/{id}/check-tunnel.
func CheckTunnelHandler(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	id, ok := parseLastPathSegmentBeforeFinal(r.URL.Path, "check-tunnel")
	if !ok {
		writeAdminError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "Неверный id сервера")
		return
	}
	if TunnelCheckFn == nil {
		writeAdminError(w, http.StatusNotImplemented, "Проверка туннеля недоступна в этом процессе")
		return
	}
	ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(r.Context(), 30*time.Second)
	defer cancel()
	res, err := TunnelCheckFn(ctx, id)
	switch {
	case errors.Is(err, sql.ErrNoRows):
		writeAdminError(w, http.StatusNotFound, "Exit-нода не найдена")
	case err != nil:
		writeAdminError(w, http.StatusBadGateway, "Проверка не выполнилась: "+err.Error())
	default:
		writeAdminJSON(w, http.StatusOK, res)
	}
}
```

```go
package main

import (
	"context"
	"time"

	"github.com/heyearth/backend/internal/admin"
	"github.com/heyearth/backend/internal/biz"
)

// checkExitTunnel is admin.TunnelCheckFn: the monitor's own probes (exitPathProber) on demand.
// Read-only: no status, alert or config is touched.
func checkExitTunnel(ctx context.Context, serverID int) (admin.TunnelCheckResult, error) {
	node, err := biz.GetExitNodeTunnel(ctx, serverID)
	if err != nil {
		return admin.TunnelCheckResult{}, err
	}
	return tunnelCheckResult(node, exitPathProber(node), time.Now()), nil
}

// tunnelCheckResult words one probe of both paths for the owner.
func tunnelCheckResult(node biz.ExitNodeTunnel, p exitPathProbe, now time.Time) admin.TunnelCheckResult {
	path := func(key, name string, pp pathProbe, absentWhy string) admin.TunnelPathCheck {
		c := admin.TunnelPathCheck{Path: key, Name: name}
		switch {
		case !pp.present:
			c.Status, c.Error = "absent", absentWhy
		case pp.ok:
			c.Status, c.RTTms = "ok", pp.rttMs
		default:
			c.Status, c.Error = "fail", pp.err
		}
		return c
	}
	hy := path("hy", "Hysteria (UDP)", p.hy, "у exit нет пути Hysteria (протокол "+node.TunnelProtocol+")")
	vr := path("vr", "TCP (VLESS Reality)", p.vr, "нет учётки VLESS Reality — запасного пути нет")
	if vr.Status == "fail" && node.LifecycleState != "online" {
		vr.Error = "exit не в работе (" + node.LifecycleState + "): проверочного входа в xray нет. " + vr.Error
	}
	return admin.TunnelCheckResult{
		ServerID: node.ID, CheckedAt: now.UTC().Format(time.RFC3339),
		Summary: tunnelCheckSummary(hy.Status, vr.Status), Paths: []admin.TunnelPathCheck{hy, vr},
	}
}

func tunnelCheckSummary(hy, vr string) string {
	switch {
	case hy == "ok" && vr == "ok":
		return "Оба пути работают."
	case hy == "ok" && vr == "absent":
		return "Hysteria работает. Запасного TCP-пути нет: при блокировке UDP exit отключится."
	case hy == "ok":
		return "Hysteria работает, запасной TCP-путь не работает: при блокировке UDP exit отключится."
	case vr == "ok" && hy == "absent":
		return "Работает TCP-путь (пути Hysteria у этого exit нет)."
	case vr == "ok":
		return "Hysteria не проходит — трафик exit идёт по запасному TCP-пути, Бамбук через этот exit не работает."
	default:
		return "Ни один путь не работает: exit недоступен, его трафик идёт через другие exit."
	}
}
```

```go
package admin

import (
	"net/http"
	"net/http/httptest"
	"os"
	"slices"
	"strings"
	"testing"
)

// Review Focus 5 → a refund (and the other money actions) without payments.refund is a 403 and
// never reaches YooKassa; payments.write alone is not enough.
func TestPaymentMoneyActionsRequireRefundPermission(t *testing.T) {
	t.Setenv("JWT_SECRET", "test-jwt-secret")
	oldActive, oldPA := adminIsActive, PaymentActionHandler
	t.Cleanup(func() { adminIsActive, PaymentActionHandler = oldActive, oldPA })
	adminIsActive = func(int) (bool, error) { return true, nil }
	called := 0
	PaymentActionHandler = func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) { called++; w.WriteHeader(http.StatusOK) }
	token := func(perms ...string) string {
		tok, err := GenerateToken(AdminUser{ID: 7, Username: "operator", Permissions: perms})
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		return tok
	}
	do := func(path, tok string) int {
		req := httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodPost, path, strings.NewReader(`{"amount":249}`))
		req.Header.Set("Authorization", "Bearer "+tok)
		rec := httptest.NewRecorder()
		paymentsItemRouter(rec, req)
		return rec.Code
	}
	for _, path := range []string{"/api/admin/payments/12/cancel", "/api/admin/payments/12/check-status", "/api/admin/payments/resend"} {
		called = 0
		if code := do(path, token("payments.read", "payments.write")); code != http.StatusForbidden || called != 0 {
			t.Fatalf("%s without payments.refund: status %d, YooKassa called %d times", path, code, called)
		}
		if code := do(path, token("payments.refund")); code != http.StatusOK || called != 1 {
			t.Fatalf("%s with payments.refund: status %d, called %d", path, code, called)
		}
	}
}

func TestPaymentsRefundPermissionSeeded(t *testing.T) {
	if !slices.Contains(allPermissionKeys(), "payments.refund") {
		t.Fatal("payments.refund is missing from permissionCatalog: ensureSuperAdminRole would strip it from super_admin on every login")
	}
	up, err := os.ReadFile("../../migrations/000059_payments_refund_permission.up.sql")
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	for _, want := range []string{"'payments.refund'", "ON CONFLICT (permission_key) DO NOTHING", "r.role_key = 'super_admin'", "ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING"} {
		if !strings.Contains(string(up), want) {
			t.Errorf("000059 up lacks %q", want)
		}
	}
	down, err := os.ReadFile("../../migrations/000059_payments_refund_permission.down.sql")
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	for _, want := range []string{"DELETE FROM admin_role_permissions", "DELETE FROM admin_permissions", "'payments.refund'"} {
		if !strings.Contains(string(down), want) {
			t.Errorf("000059 down lacks %q", want)
		}
	}
}
```

```go
			t.Errorf("%s: in settings=%v, secrets_set=%v", k, leaked, resp.SecretsSet[k])
		}
	}
```

`server/backend/internal/admin/routes.go`: обработчик `/api/admin/payments/` (:113-137) → `http.HandleFunc("/api/admin/payments/", AuthMiddleware(paymentsItemRouter))` и в конец файла:

```go
// permPaymentsRefund guards every action that moves money or touches YooKassa for a payment.
const permPaymentsRefund = "payments.refund"

// paymentsItemRouter serves /api/admin/payments/…: the money actions (refund = /cancel,
// /check-status, /resend) need payments.refund — payments.write is not enough.
func paymentsItemRouter(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	path := r.URL.Path
	// B2B reconciliation: /api/admin/payments/{id}/attach-tenant binds an orphaned b2b_invoice
	// payment to a tenant + credits the wallet if the payment is already paid.
	if strings.HasSuffix(path, "/attach-tenant") {
		RequirePermission("tenants.write", AttachPaymentToTenantHandler).ServeHTTP(w, r)
		return
	}
	if isPaymentMoneyAction(path) {
		RequirePermission(permPaymentsRefund, func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
			if PaymentActionHandler == nil {
				writeAdminError(w, http.StatusNotImplemented, "Payment actions not configured")
				return
			}
			PaymentActionHandler(w, r)
		}).ServeHTTP(w, r)
		return
	}
	if r.Method == http.MethodPatch {
		RequirePermission("payments.write", UpdatePaymentHandler).ServeHTTP(w, r)
		return
	}
	writeAdminError(w, http.StatusMethodNotAllowed, "Method not allowed")
}

func isPaymentMoneyAction(path string) bool {
	return strings.HasSuffix(path, "/cancel") || strings.HasSuffix(path, "/check-status") || path == "/api/admin/payments/resend"
}
```

`server/backend/internal/admin/settings_handlers.go`: `ListSettingsHandler` заменить на (импорт `slices`):

```go
// secretSettingKeys never leave the API (Review Focus 5): GET /settings drops them and reports
// only whether each is set; POST /settings still writes them (write-only fields in the UI, like
// the bot token on «Алерты»). Any other key isSensitiveSettingKey flags is dropped as well.
var secretSettingKeys = []string{
	"yookassa_secret_key", "smtp_password",
	"hysteria2_obfs_password", "hysteria2_stats_secret", "hub_tunnel_password",
	"awg_server_private_key", "alert_telegram_bot_token", "vless_uuid",
}

// loadAllSettings is biz.GetAllSettings; tests swap it.
var loadAllSettings = biz.GetAllSettings

func isSecretSetting(key string) bool {
	k := strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(key))
	return slices.Contains(secretSettingKeys, k) || isSensitiveSettingKey(k)
}

// redactSettings splits app_settings into what the browser may see and, for every secret (the
// listed ones always, other sensitive-looking ones when present), whether it is set.
func redactSettings(all map[string]string) (map[string]string, map[string]bool) {
	plain, set := make(map[string]string, len(all)), map[string]bool{}
	for _, k := range secretSettingKeys {
		set[k] = false
	}
	for k, v := range all {
		if isSecretSetting(k) {
			set[k] = strings.TrimSpace(v) != ""
			continue
		}
		plain[k] = v
	}
	return plain, set
}

func ListSettingsHandler(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	all, err := loadAllSettings()
	if err != nil {
		writeAdminError(w, http.StatusInternalServerError, "Failed to load settings")
		return
	}
	plain, set := redactSettings(all)
	writeAdminJSON(w, http.StatusOK, map[string]any{"settings": plain, "secrets_set": set})
}
```

```go
package admin

import (

// «Запустить сейчас» used to answer "triggered" while no goroutine read the channel (the tuner
// starts only if it was enabled at API start). Now it says so.
func TestAutoTunerRunNowIsHonest(t *testing.T) {
	oldSetting := autoTunerSetting
	t.Cleanup(func() { autoTunerSetting = oldSetting; SetAutoTunerLoopRunning(false) })
	drain := func() {
		select {
		case <-AutoTunerRunChan:
		default:
		}
	}
	drain()
	run := func() *httptest.ResponseRecorder {
		rec := httptest.NewRecorder()
		AutoTunerRunNowHandler(rec, httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodPost, "/api/admin/auto-tuner/run-now", nil))
		return rec
	}

	SetAutoTunerLoopRunning(false)
	if rec := run(); rec.Code != http.StatusConflict || !strings.Contains(rec.Body.String(), "не запущен") || len(AutoTunerRunChan) != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("no tuner goroutine: %d %s (queued %d)", rec.Code, rec.Body.String(), len(AutoTunerRunChan))
	}
	SetAutoTunerLoopRunning(true)
	autoTunerSetting = func(string, string) string { return "false" }
	if rec := run(); rec.Code != http.StatusConflict || !strings.Contains(rec.Body.String(), "выключен") || len(AutoTunerRunChan) != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("tuner switched off: %d %s", rec.Code, rec.Body.String())
	}
	autoTunerSetting = func(string, string) string { return "true" }
	if rec := run(); rec.Code != http.StatusOK || len(AutoTunerRunChan) != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("running and enabled: %d %s (queued %d)", rec.Code, rec.Body.String(), len(AutoTunerRunChan))
	}
	drain()
}
```

Create `server/backend/internal/biz/bamboo_status.go`:

```go
package biz

import (
	"sync/atomic"
	"time"
)

// BambooProbe is the last real verdict of the outside Bamboo probe (cmd/api bamboo_probe.go):
// skips (DNS, no exit, not deployed) are not verdicts and do not change it. In memory only.
type BambooProbe struct {
	OK     bool      `json:"ok"`
	At     time.Time `json:"at"`
	Detail string    `json:"detail"`
}

var lastBambooProbe atomic.Pointer[BambooProbe]

// RecordBambooProbe stores a verdict.
func RecordBambooProbe(p BambooProbe) { lastBambooProbe.Store(&p) }

// LastBambooProbe returns a copy of the last verdict; nil before the first one.
func LastBambooProbe() *BambooProbe {
	p := lastBambooProbe.Load()
	if p == nil {
		return nil
	}
	c := *p
	return &c
}
```

```js
const API_BASE = '/api/admin'

let logoutCallback = null

export function setLogoutCallback(fn) {
  logoutCallback = fn
}

function getToken() {
  try {
    return localStorage.getItem('admin_token') || ''
  } catch {
    return ''
  }
}

// ApiError carries the HTTP status, so a page can tell «нет прав» from other failures.
export class ApiError extends Error {
  constructor(message, status) {
    super(message)
    this.name = 'ApiError'
    this.status = status
  }
}

export const FORBIDDEN_MESSAGE = 'Нет прав на это действие'

export async function apiFetch(path, { method = 'GET', body, headers = {}, raw = false } = {}) {
  const token = getToken()
  const opts = {
    method,
    headers: {
      ...headers,
      ...(token ? { Authorization: `Bearer ${token}` } : {}),
    },
  }
  if (body && !(body instanceof FormData)) {
    opts.headers['Content-Type'] = 'application/json'
    opts.body = JSON.stringify(body)
  } else if (body) {
    opts.body = body
  }

  const res = await fetch(`${API_BASE}${path}`, opts)

  // 401: the session is gone (expired or revoked) — log out. 403: the session is fine, this
  // admin just lacks the permission — say so and stay logged in.
  if (res.status === 401) {
    if (logoutCallback) logoutCallback()
    throw new ApiError('Сессия истекла — войдите снова', 401)
  }
  if (res.status === 403) {
    throw new ApiError(FORBIDDEN_MESSAGE, 403)
  }

  if (raw) return res

  const ct = res.headers.get('content-type') || ''
  if (!ct.includes('application/json')) {
    throw new ApiError('Сервер вернул не JSON', res.status)
  }

  const data = await res.json()
  if (!res.ok) {
    throw new ApiError(data.error || data.message || `Ошибка ${res.status}`, res.status)
  }
  return data
}

export async function pagedFetch(path, { page = 1, pageSize = 20, search = '', status = '', ...extra } = {}) {
  const params = new URLSearchParams()
  params.set('page', page)
  params.set('page_size', pageSize)
  if (search) params.set('search', search)
  if (status) params.set('status', status)
  // Дополнительные параметры (period и т.д.)
  for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(extra)) {
    if (v !== undefined && v !== null && v !== '') params.set(k, v)
  }
  return apiFetch(`${path}?${params}`)
}
```

```js
// Which admin pages an admin may open: the same permission keys the backend checks
// (internal/admin/routes.go). One source for the sidebar and the ⌘K palette.

// href → permission; null = every admin (account, theme, logout live on /settings).
export const PAGE_PERMS = {
  '/dashboard': 'dashboard.read',
  '/traffic': 'dashboard.read',
  '/users': 'users.read',
  '/subscriptions': 'subscriptions.read',
  '/promocodes': 'promocodes.read',
  '/servers': 'servers.read',
  '/ssh-keys': 'servers.read',
  '/releases': 'releases.read',
  '/traffic-masking': 'traffic_masking.read',
  '/direct-routes': 'routing.direct.view',
  '/mtproto': 'settings.read',
  '/auto-tuner': 'settings.read',
  '/alerts': 'settings.read',
  '/plans': 'settings.read',
  '/payments': 'payments.read',
  '/payment-ops': 'payments.read',
  '/admins': 'admins.read',
  '/audit-log': 'audit.read',
  '/tenants': 'tenants.read',
  '/b2b-analytics': 'tenants.read',
  '/settings': null,
}

// Pages a tenant (B2B) admin never sees, whatever the permissions.
export const TENANT_HIDDEN = new Set([
  '/servers', '/ssh-keys', '/releases', '/traffic-masking', '/direct-routes', '/mtproto',
  '/auto-tuner', '/alerts', '/admins', '/audit-log', '/tenants', '/b2b-analytics', '/settings',
])

export function canOpen(href, { can, isTenantAdmin }) {
  if (isTenantAdmin && TENANT_HIDDEN.has(href)) return false
  const perm = PAGE_PERMS[href]
  if (perm === undefined) return false // an unknown page is hidden, not shown by default
  return perm === null || can(perm)
}

// visibleItems keeps the pages an admin may open (by i.href or i.to) and every action.
export function visibleItems(items, ctx) {
  return items.filter((i) => i.kind === 'action' || canOpen(i.href ?? i.to, ctx))
}
```

```js
// Truthful words for node state (phase 1): lifecycle from servers.lifecycle_state, paths from the
// tunnel monitor. Anything unexpected is shown as it is, never as «В работе».
export const LIFECYCLE = {
  pending: { variant: 'default', label: 'Ожидает настройки' },
  provisioning: { variant: 'info', label: 'Настраивается' },
  online: { variant: 'success', label: 'В работе' },
  failed: { variant: 'danger', label: 'Ошибка настройки' },
  deprovisioning: { variant: 'warning', label: 'Выводится' },
  offline: { variant: 'default', label: 'Выключена' },
}

export function lifecycleView(state) {
  return LIFECYCLE[state] || { variant: 'warning', label: state ? `Неизвестно: ${state}` : 'Нет данных' }
}

export const PATH = {
  healthy: { variant: 'success', label: 'работает' },
  unhealthy: { variant: 'danger', label: 'не работает' },
  unknown: { variant: 'warning', label: 'проверяется' },
  absent: { variant: 'default', label: 'нет' },
}

export function pathView(status) {
  return PATH[status] || PATH.unknown
}

// inWork: a node that actually carries user traffic.
export function inWork(s) {
  return s.lifecycle_state === 'online' && s.tunnel_status === 'healthy'
}

// The list filter: the same values GET /api/admin/servers?lifecycle_state= accepts.
export const LIFECYCLE_FILTER = [
  { value: '', label: 'Все состояния' },
  ...Object.entries(LIFECYCLE).map(([value, v]) => ({ value, label: v.label })),
]
```

```jsx
import { useEffect, useState } from 'react'
import { Activity } from 'lucide-react'
import { checkServerTunnel } from '../../api/admin.js'
import { Badge, Button, Dialog, Spinner } from '../ui/index.js'

const STATUS = {
  ok: { variant: 'success', label: 'работает' },
  fail: { variant: 'danger', label: 'не работает' },
  absent: { variant: 'default', label: 'нет' },
}

// Read-only «Проверить туннель»: the backend fetches generate_204 through each path of the exit
// and changes nothing (no status, no config, no restart).
export default function TunnelCheckDialog({ server, onClose }) {
  const [state, setState] = useState({ loading: true, result: null, error: '' })

  async function run() {
    setState({ loading: true, result: null, error: '' })
    try {
      setState({ loading: false, result: await checkServerTunnel(server.id), error: '' })
    } catch (e) {
      setState({ loading: false, result: null, error: e.message })
    }
  }

  useEffect(() => { run() }, [server.id]) // eslint-disable-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps

  const { loading, result, error } = state
  return (
    <Dialog open onClose={onClose} title={`Проверка туннеля — ${server.name || server.ip_address}`}
      icon={<Activity className="w-4 h-4" />} maxWidth="max-w-lg">
      <p className="text-xs text-tertiary mb-4">Запрос generate_204 через каждый путь до exit. Только чтение: статусы и конфиги не меняются.</p>
      {loading ? (
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-sm text-secondary"><Spinner size="sm" /> Проверяем оба пути (до 10 секунд)…</div>
      ) : error ? (
        <p className="text-sm text-danger">{error}</p>
      ) : (
        <div className="space-y-3">
          {result.paths.map((p) => {
            const s = STATUS[p.status] || STATUS.absent
            return (
              <div key={p.path} className="flex flex-col gap-1 border-b border-default pb-3">
                <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2">
                  <span className="text-sm text-primary">{p.name}</span>
                  <span className="flex items-center gap-2">
                    {p.rtt_ms > 0 && <span className="font-mono tabular-nums text-xs text-secondary">{p.rtt_ms} мс</span>}
                    <Badge variant={s.variant}>{s.label}</Badge>
                  </span>
                </div>
                {p.error && <p className="text-xs font-mono text-tertiary break-all">{p.error}</p>}
              </div>
            )
          })}
          <p className="text-sm text-primary">{result.summary}</p>
        </div>
      )}
      <div className="flex justify-end gap-2 mt-6">
        <Button variant="ghost" onClick={run} disabled={loading}>Повторить</Button>
        <Button variant="primary" onClick={onClose}>Закрыть</Button>
      </div>
    </Dialog>
  )
}
```

```jsx
import { useState, useEffect, useRef } from 'react'
import { Check, Circle, X } from 'lucide-react'
import { fetchActionProgress } from '../api/admin.js'
import { Button, Dialog, Spinner } from './ui/index.js'

function StepIcon({ status }) {
  if (status === 'done') return <Check className="w-4 h-4 text-success shrink-0" aria-label="готово" />
  if (status === 'error') return <X className="w-4 h-4 text-danger shrink-0" aria-label="ошибка" />
  if (status === 'running') return <Spinner size="xs" />
  return <Circle className="w-4 h-4 text-tertiary shrink-0" aria-label="ожидает" />
}

// Progress of a long server operation. Closable at any moment: the operation keeps running on the
// server, closing only stops watching (the old dialog stayed locked until "finished", and an API
// restart mid-operation locked it forever).
export default function ProvisionProgressDialog({ open, server, title = 'Операция с нодой', onClose }) {
  const [steps, setSteps] = useState([])
  const [finished, setFinished] = useState(false)
  const [error, setError] = useState(null)
  const intervalRef = useRef(null)

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!open || !server?.id) return
    let mounted = true
    async function poll() {
      try {
        const data = await fetchActionProgress(server.id)
        if (!mounted) return
        if (data.active === false) {
          setFinished(true)
          setError('API не помнит эту операцию (возможно, он перезапускался). Проверьте состояние ноды на её странице.')
          clearInterval(intervalRef.current)
          return
        }
        setSteps(data.steps || [])
        setError(null)
        if (data.finished) {
          setFinished(true)
          clearInterval(intervalRef.current)
        }
      } catch (err) {
        if (mounted) setError(err.message)
      }
    }
    poll()
    intervalRef.current = setInterval(poll, 1000)
    return () => {
      mounted = false
      clearInterval(intervalRef.current)
    }
  }, [open, server?.id])

  return (
    <Dialog open={open} onClose={onClose} title={title} maxWidth="max-w-lg">
      <p className="text-sm text-secondary mb-4">{server?.name}</p>
      <div className="space-y-3 mb-4 max-h-80 overflow-y-auto">
        {steps.length === 0 && !error && (
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-sm text-secondary"><Spinner size="xs" /> Ждём данные о шагах…</div>
        )}
        {steps.map((step, idx) => (
          <div key={idx} className="flex items-start gap-3">
            <StepIcon status={step.status} />
            <div className="flex-1 min-w-0">
              <p className={`text-sm ${step.status === 'error' ? 'text-danger' : step.status === 'done' ? 'text-primary' : 'text-secondary'}`}>
                {step.description}
              </p>
              {step.error && <p className="text-xs text-danger mt-0.5 break-all">{step.error}</p>}
            </div>
          </div>
        ))}
        {error && <p className="text-sm text-danger">{error}</p>}
      </div>
      {!finished && <p className="text-xs text-tertiary mb-4">Окно можно закрыть — операция продолжится на сервере.</p>}
      <div className="flex justify-end">
        <Button variant={finished ? 'primary' : 'secondary'} onClick={onClose}>{finished ? 'Готово' : 'Закрыть'}</Button>
      </div>
    </Dialog>
  )
}
```

```js
import { test } from 'node:test'
import assert from 'node:assert/strict'
import { validateRefund, refundableAmount, REFUND_CONFIRM_WORD } from './refund.js'

const ok = (amountText, maxAmount = 5000) => validateRefund({ amountText, maxAmount, confirmText: REFUND_CONFIRM_WORD })

test('what is left to refund', () => {
  assert.equal(refundableAmount({ amount: '300', refunded_amount: '50.5' }), 249.5)
  assert.equal(refundableAmount({ amount: 100, refunded_amount: 150 }), 0)
  assert.equal(refundableAmount({ amount: '249' }), 249)
})

test('amounts in rubles', () => {
  for (const [text, want] of [['249', 249], ['249,50', 249.5], ['1 249.5', 1249.5]]) {
    assert.deepEqual(ok(text), { ok: true, amount: want }, text)
  }
  for (const bad of ['', 'abc', '-5', '0', '1,234,5', '10.123']) {
    assert.equal(ok(bad).ok, false, bad)
  }
})

test('never more than is left', () => {

  assert.equal(r.ok, false)
  assert.match(r.error, /не больше/)
})

test('the typed confirmation word is required (any case, trimmed)', () => {
  assert.equal(validateRefund({ amountText: '10', maxAmount: 100, confirmText: 'да' }).ok, false)
  assert.equal(validateRefund({ amountText: '10', maxAmount: 100, confirmText: ' возврат ' }).ok, true)
})
```

```js
export const REFUND_CONFIRM_WORD = 'ВОЗВРАТ'

const round2 = (n) => Math.round(n * 100) / 100

export function formatRub(n) {
  return `${Number(n).toLocaleString('ru-RU', { minimumFractionDigits: 2, maximumFractionDigits: 2 })} ₽`
}

// refundableAmount is what is left to refund of a payment.
export function refundableAmount(p) {
  return Math.max(0, round2((parseFloat(p.amount) || 0) - (parseFloat(p.refunded_amount) || 0)))
}

// validateRefund checks the typed amount (rubles: "249", "249,50", "1 249.5") against what is
// refundable, and the typed confirmation word.
export function validateRefund({ amountText, maxAmount, confirmText }) {
  const s = String(amountText ?? '').replace(/[\s ]/g, '').replace(',', '.')
  if (!/^\d+(\.\d{1,2})?$/.test(s)) return { ok: false, error: 'Введите сумму в рублях, например 249 или 249,50' }
  const amount = round2(Number(s))
  if (amount <= 0) return { ok: false, error: 'Сумма должна быть больше нуля' }
  if (amount > round2(maxAmount)) return { ok: false, error: `Можно вернуть не больше ${formatRub(maxAmount)}` }
  if (String(confirmText ?? '').trim().toUpperCase() !== REFUND_CONFIRM_WORD) {
    return { ok: false, error: `Для подтверждения введите слово ${REFUND_CONFIRM_WORD}` }
  }
  return { ok: true, amount }
}
```

```jsx
import { useState } from 'react'
import { RotateCcw } from 'lucide-react'
import { cancelPayment } from '../../api/admin.js'
import { REFUND_CONFIRM_WORD, formatRub, refundableAmount, validateRefund } from '../../utils/refund.js'
import { Button, Dialog, Input } from '../ui/index.js'

// Refund through YooKassa: an amount (up to what is left), a reason and the typed word ВОЗВРАТ.
// Money leaves the account and cannot be taken back; the backend also requires payments.refund.
export default function RefundDialog({ payment, onClose, onDone }) {
  const max = refundableAmount(payment)
  const [amountText, setAmountText] = useState(String(max).replace('.', ','))
  const [reason, setReason] = useState('Возврат по обращению пользователя')
  const [confirmText, setConfirmText] = useState('')
  const [error, setError] = useState('')
  const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false)

  async function submit(e) {
    e.preventDefault()
    const v = validateRefund({ amountText, maxAmount: max, confirmText })
    if (!v.ok) {
      setError(v.error)
      return
    }
    setSaving(true)
    setError('')
    try {
      const res = await cancelPayment(payment.id, reason.trim() || 'Возврат', v.amount)
      onDone(`Возврат ${formatRub(v.amount)} создан, статус ЮKassa: ${res.status || 'pending'}`)
    } catch (err) {
      setError(err.message)
    } finally {
      setSaving(false)
    }
  }

  return (
    <Dialog open onClose={onClose} title={`Возврат по платежу #${payment.id}`} icon={<RotateCcw className="w-4 h-4" />} maxWidth="max-w-md">
      <form onSubmit={submit} className="space-y-4">
        <p className="text-sm text-secondary">
          Деньги вернутся плательщику через ЮKassa, отменить возврат нельзя. Доступно к возврату:{' '}
          <span className="font-mono tabular-nums text-primary">{formatRub(max)}</span>.
        </p>
        <div>
          <label htmlFor="refund-amount" className="text-xs text-tertiary block mb-1">Сумма, ₽</label>
          <Input id="refund-amount" inputMode="decimal" className="font-mono tabular-nums" value={amountText}
            onChange={(e) => setAmountText(e.target.value)} />
        </div>
        <div>
          <label htmlFor="refund-reason" className="text-xs text-tertiary block mb-1">Причина (видна в ЮKassa)</label>
          <Input id="refund-reason" value={reason} onChange={(e) => setReason(e.target.value)} />
        </div>
        <div>
          <label htmlFor="refund-confirm" className="text-xs text-tertiary block mb-1">Для подтверждения введите {REFUND_CONFIRM_WORD}</label>
          <Input id="refund-confirm" autoComplete="off" value={confirmText} onChange={(e) => setConfirmText(e.target.value)} />
        </div>
        {error && <p className="text-sm text-danger">{error}</p>}
        <div className="flex justify-end gap-2">
          <Button type="button" variant="ghost" onClick={onClose}>Отмена</Button>
          <Button type="submit" variant="danger" loading={saving}>Вернуть деньги</Button>
        </div>
      </form>
    </Dialog>
  )
}
```

Create `admin_web/src/utils/bamboo.js`:

```js
// The Bamboo (Hysteria2 on the Hub) badge: deployment first, then the outside probe, then sync errors.
export function bambooVerdict(st) {
  if (!st) return { variant: 'default', label: 'нет данных' }
  if (!st.binary_installed || !st.config_present) return { variant: 'default', label: 'не развёрнут' }
  if (!st.active_plans) return { variant: 'default', label: 'нет тарифов с Бамбуком' }
  if (st.probe && !st.probe.ok) return { variant: 'danger', label: 'не отвечает снаружи' }
  if (st.last_error) return { variant: 'warning', label: 'ошибка синхронизации' }
  if (st.probe?.ok) return { variant: 'success', label: 'работает' }
  return { variant: 'warning', label: 'внешняя проба ещё не прошла' }
}

export function ageText(iso, now = Date.now()) {
  if (!iso) return 'не было'
  const ms = now - Date.parse(iso)
  if (!(ms >= 0)) return iso
  const d = Math.floor(ms / 86400000)
  const h = Math.floor((ms % 86400000) / 3600000)
  return d > 0 ? `${d} дн ${h} ч назад` : `${h} ч назад`
}
```

```jsx
import { useEffect, useState } from 'react'
import { fetchHysteria2Status } from '../../api/admin.js'
import { ageText, bambooVerdict } from '../../utils/bamboo.js'
import { Badge, Card, CardBody, CardHeader, Skeleton } from '../ui/index.js'

function Fact({ label, value, mono }) {
  return (
    <div>
      <p className="text-[10px] uppercase tracking-wider text-tertiary mb-1">{label}</p>
      <p className={`text-primary ${mono ? 'font-mono tabular-nums' : ''}`}>{value}</p>
    </div>
  )
}

// «Бамбук» (Hysteria2 on the Hub): does it answer from outside, which exit it leaves through,
// when the obfs password was rotated. Read-only; refreshes every 30 s.
export default function BambooCard() {
  const [st, setSt] = useState(null)
  const [error, setError] = useState('')

  useEffect(() => {
    let alive = true
    const load = () => fetchHysteria2Status()
      .then((s) => { if (alive) { setSt(s); setError('') } })
      .catch((e) => { if (alive) setError(e.message) })
    load()
    const timer = setInterval(() => { if (document.visibilityState === 'visible') load() }, 30000)
    return () => { alive = false; clearInterval(timer) }
  }, [])

  const v = bambooVerdict(st)
  return (
    <Card className="mb-6">
      <CardHeader className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2">
        <h3 className="text-sm font-semibold text-primary">Бамбук (Hysteria2 на Hub)</h3>
        <Badge variant={v.variant}>{v.label}</Badge>
      </CardHeader>
      <CardBody>
        {error ? <p className="text-sm text-danger">{error}</p> : !st ? <Skeleton className="h-16" /> : (
          <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-3 text-sm">
            <Fact label="Выход за рубежом" value={st.bound_exit_id ? `${st.bound_exit_name || 'exit'} (#${st.bound_exit_id})` : 'не выбран'} />
            <Fact label="Выбран" value={st.bound_exit_since ? new Date(st.bound_exit_since).toLocaleString('ru-RU') : '—'} />
            <Fact label="Сглаженный RTT" value={st.bound_exit_rtt_ms ? `${st.bound_exit_rtt_ms} мс` : '—'} mono />
            <Fact label="Ротация obfs" value={ageText(st.obfs_rotated_at)} />
          </div>
        )}
        {st?.probe && (
          <p className="mt-3 text-xs text-tertiary">Проверка снаружи в {new Date(st.probe.at).toLocaleTimeString('ru-RU')}: {st.probe.detail}</p>
        )}
        {st?.last_error && <p className="mt-2 text-xs font-mono text-danger break-all">{st.last_error}</p>}
        <p className="mt-3 text-[11px] text-tertiary">
          Exit выбирается по задержке пути Hysteria и меняется не чаще раза в 10 минут — только если другой быстрее на 20 % или текущий перестал отвечать.
        </p>
      </CardBody>
    </Card>
  )
}
```

```jsx
import { useState } from 'react'
import { Badge, Button, Input } from '../ui/index.js'

// A write-only secret (like the bot token on «Алерты»): the value never comes back from the API,
// the field is always empty, saving sends only a newly typed value.
export default function SecretSettingField({ id, label, hint, isSet, onSave }) {
  const [value, setValue] = useState('')
  const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false)

  async function save() {
    setSaving(true)
    try {
      await onSave(value)
      setValue('')
    } catch {
      // the page already showed the error; keep the typed value
    } finally {
      setSaving(false)
    }
  }

  return (
    <div className="py-3">
      <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mb-1">
        <label htmlFor={id} className="text-sm font-medium text-primary">{label}</label>
        <Badge variant={isSet ? 'success' : 'warning'}>{isSet ? 'задан' : 'не задан'}</Badge>
      </div>
      {hint && <p className="text-xs text-tertiary mb-2">{hint}</p>}
      <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row gap-2">
        <Input id={id} type="password" autoComplete="new-password" value={value} onChange={(e) => setValue(e.target.value)}
          placeholder={isSet ? 'Сохранён на сервере — введите новый, чтобы заменить' : 'Введите значение'} className="sm:flex-1" />
        <Button variant="secondary" onClick={save} disabled={!value.trim()} loading={saving} className="w-full sm:w-auto">Сохранить</Button>
      </div>
    </div>
  )
}
```

### Фаза 1 — выкатка и проверка (контроллер)

Только контроллер (Global Constraints). Условия: задачи 1.1–1.12 закрыты двойным ревью; на HEAD ветки `vpn/node-pool` зелёные `cd server/backend && go build ./... && go vet ./... && go test ./... -count=1` и `cd admin_web && npm test && npm run build`; в сборке есть зеркало `vless-reality-pp` (PROXY-режим на проде включён).

**0. Вспомогательный скрипт** (не коммитится) — `C:/tmp/phase1_check.sh`, исполняется на Hub от root; учётка и токены остаются в переменных оболочки и в `/root/phase1-state` (700), секреты не печатаются:

```bash
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Node pool phase 1 rollout checks on the Hub (controller only, not committed).
#   vr <id>  — pre-flight: does exit <id> serve the Hub's VLESS Reality (Vision) on :10443?
#   before   — save a pre-deploy admin token (it has no payments.refund), xray/hysteria start times, server.yaml hash
#   after    — one xray restart, both exit paths, Bamboo untouched, no secrets in admin API, refund needs the right
set -eu
API=http://127.0.0.1:8000/api/admin
ENV=/opt/heyearth/mainserver/api.env
ST=/root/phase1-state
mkdir -p "$ST" && chmod 700 "$ST"
Q() { sudo -u postgres psql -d heyearth -tA -c "$1"; }
login() {
  API="$API" U="$(grep '^ADMIN_USER=' "$ENV" | cut -d= -f2-)" P="$(grep '^ADMIN_PASS=' "$ENV" | cut -d= -f2-)" python3 -c '
import json, os, urllib.request
body = json.dumps({"username": os.environ["U"], "password": os.environ["P"]}).encode()
req = urllib.request.Request(os.environ["API"] + "/login", data=body, headers={"Content-Type": "application/json"})
print(json.load(urllib.request.urlopen(req))["token"])'
}
code() { curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' "$@"; }
case "${1:-}" in
vr)
  ID=${2:-2}
  IP=$(Q "SELECT ip_address FROM servers WHERE id=$ID"); UUID=$(Q "SELECT tunnel_uuid FROM servers WHERE id=$ID")
  PBK=$(Q "SELECT tunnel_public_key FROM servers WHERE id=$ID"); SID=$(Q "SELECT COALESCE(tunnel_short_id,'') FROM servers WHERE id=$ID")
  SNI=$(Q "SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(tunnel_sni,''),'microsoft.com') FROM servers WHERE id=$ID")
  CFG=$(mktemp --suffix=.json /tmp/vr-stand-XXXXXX); trap 'rm -f "$CFG"' EXIT
  cat > "$CFG" <<EOF
{"log":{"loglevel":"warning"},
 "inbounds":[{"tag":"in","listen":"127.0.0.1","port":20809,"protocol":"socks","settings":{"auth":"noauth"}}],
 "outbounds":[{"tag":"vr","protocol":"vless",
   "settings":{"vnext":[{"address":"$IP","port":10443,"users":[{"id":"$UUID","encryption":"none","flow":"xtls-rprx-vision"}]}]},
   "streamSettings":{"network":"tcp","security":"reality","realitySettings":{"fingerprint":"chrome","serverName":"$SNI","publicKey":"$PBK","shortId":"$SID"}}}]}
EOF
  /opt/heyearth/xray/xray run -test -config "$CFG" | tail -1
  /opt/heyearth/xray/xray run -config "$CFG" >/tmp/vr-stand.log 2>&1 & PID=$!
  sleep 3
  echo "exit #$ID vr generate_204: $(code --max-time 10 --socks5-hostname 127.0.0.1:20809 https://www.gstatic.com/generate_204 || echo FAIL)"
  kill "$PID"; wait "$PID" 2>/dev/null || true ;;
before)
  login > "$ST/old-token"; chmod 600 "$ST/old-token"
  date -u '+%F %T' > "$ST/t0"
  systemctl show xray -p ExecMainStartTimestamp --value > "$ST/xray-start"
  systemctl show hysteria2-server -p ExecMainStartTimestamp --value > "$ST/hy-start"
  md5sum /etc/hysteria/server.yaml | cut -d' ' -f1 > "$ST/hy-md5"
  echo "saved: token $(wc -c < "$ST/old-token") bytes; t0 $(cat "$ST/t0") UTC; xray started $(cat "$ST/xray-start")" ;;
after)
  T0="$(cat "$ST/t0") UTC"
  echo "xray restarts since t0 (API log): $(journalctl -u heyearth-api --since "$T0" --no-pager | grep -c 'Конфиг обновлён (рестарт' || true)"
  echo "xray start: was $(cat "$ST/xray-start") / now $(systemctl show xray -p ExecMainStartTimestamp --value)"
  echo "hysteria2-server start: was $(cat "$ST/hy-start") / now $(systemctl show hysteria2-server -p ExecMainStartTimestamp --value)"
  [ "$(md5sum /etc/hysteria/server.yaml | cut -d' ' -f1)" = "$(cat "$ST/hy-md5")" ] && echo "server.yaml unchanged: yes" || echo "server.yaml unchanged: NO"
  python3 - <<'PY'
import json
c = json.load(open("/opt/heyearth/xray/config.json"))
print("exit/probe outbounds:", [o["tag"] for o in c["outbounds"] if o["tag"].startswith(("exit-", "probe-"))])
print("probe inbounds:", [(i["tag"], i["listen"], i["port"]) for i in c["inbounds"] if i["tag"].startswith("probe-")])
for b in c["routing"].get("balancers", []):
    print("balancer", b["tag"], b["selector"], b["strategy"]["type"], "fallback", b["fallbackTag"],
          "costs", [(x["match"], x["value"]) for x in b["strategy"].get("settings", {}).get("costs", [])])
print("observatory:", c.get("observatory", {}).get("subjectSelector"))
PY
  /opt/heyearth/xray/xray run -test -config /opt/heyearth/xray/config.json | tail -1
  for p in 1090 12002; do
    echo "generate_204 via 127.0.0.1:$p: $(code --max-time 10 --socks5-hostname 127.0.0.1:$p https://www.gstatic.com/generate_204 || echo FAIL)"
  done
  Q "SELECT id, tunnel_status, COALESCE(tunnel_error,'') FROM servers WHERE is_exit_node ORDER BY id"
  Q "SELECT key || '=' || value FROM app_settings WHERE key LIKE 'hysteria2_bound_exit_%' ORDER BY key"
  echo "legacy express unit: $(systemctl is-enabled hysteria2-client-express 2>&1 || true)"
  journalctl -u heyearth-api --since "$T0" --no-pager | grep -E 'Бамбук-проба (OK|провалена)' | tail -2 || echo "Bamboo probe: no verdict logged yet"
  TOK=$(login); OUT=$(mktemp -d); trap 'rm -rf "$OUT"' EXIT
  for ep in "servers?page_size=100" "servers/2" "settings" "hysteria2/status" "auto-tuner/status" "ssh-keys"; do
    curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOK" "$API/$ep" > "$OUT/$(echo "$ep" | tr '/?=' '___').json"
  done
  Q "SELECT key || chr(9) || value FROM app_settings WHERE key IN ('yookassa_secret_key','smtp_password','hysteria2_obfs_password','hysteria2_stats_secret','hub_tunnel_password','awg_server_private_key','alert_telegram_bot_token','vless_uuid') AND length(value) >= 8
     UNION ALL SELECT 'tunnel_uuid#' || id || chr(9) || tunnel_uuid FROM servers WHERE length(COALESCE(tunnel_uuid,'')) >= 8
     UNION ALL SELECT 'tunnel_ss_password#' || id || chr(9) || tunnel_ss_password FROM servers WHERE length(COALESCE(tunnel_ss_password,'')) >= 8
     UNION ALL SELECT 'tunnel_private_key#' || id || chr(9) || tunnel_private_key FROM servers WHERE length(COALESCE(tunnel_private_key,'')) >= 8" > "$OUT/secrets.tsv"
  python3 - "$OUT" <<'PY'
import os, sys
d = sys.argv[1]
secrets = [l.rstrip("\n").split("\t", 1) for l in open(os.path.join(d, "secrets.tsv")) if "\t" in l]
bodies = {f: open(os.path.join(d, f), encoding="utf-8", errors="replace").read() for f in os.listdir(d) if f.endswith(".json")}
bad = [f"value of {k} in {f}" for k, v in secrets for f, b in bodies.items() if v and v in b]
bad += [f"key {k} in {f}" for f, b in bodies.items() for k in ('"ssh_password"', '"tunnel_uuid"', '"tunnel_private_key"', '"tunnel_ss_password"') if k in b]
for x in bad:
    print("LEAK", x)
print(f"checked {len(secrets)} secrets in {len(bodies)} responses:", "OK" if not bad else "FAIL")
PY
  echo "refund with the pre-deploy token (no payments.refund): $(code -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $(cat "$ST/old-token")" "$API/payments/0/cancel") (want 403)"
  echo "refund of payment 0 with a fresh token: $(code -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOK" "$API/payments/0/cancel") (want 400: right granted, nothing to refund)"
  echo "removed action sync_tunnel: $(code -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOK" -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"action":"sync_tunnel"}' "$API/servers/2/actions") (want 410)"
  rm -f "$ST/old-token" ;;
*) echo "usage: $0 vr <id>|before|after"; exit 2 ;;
esac
```

## Фаза 2 — Ядро провижининга и мастер exit

**Цель фазы:** один движок `internal/provision` (Hub ходит на ноду по SSH с подтверждённым отпечатком, шаги apply/verify/rollback, задачи в `provision_jobs/steps`) для админки и CLI; рецепт exit (Hysteria + запасной TCP Reality + node-agent со своим mTLS + клиент на Hub + проверка обоих путей); вывод ноды; мастер «Добавить ноду», страница «Ноды», карточка ноды. API больше никогда не перезапускает себя.

**Опирается на фазу 1 (имена из заголовка):** теги `exit-<id>.hy`/`exit-<id>.vr`, `exitOutboundTags(id)`, `exitHasHyPath/exitHasVRPath` и `buildExitConfig` в `cmd/api/xray_exits.go` (генератор строит `.vr` как VLESS Reality TCP на `<exit>:10443`), `biz.ExitNodeTunnel` со списком колонок `exitNodeColumns` + `scanExitNode` (`internal/biz/server.go`), живое состояние путей `biz.GetExitPaths(id)` (`internal/biz/exit_paths.go`: `healthy|unhealthy|unknown|absent`), `biz.ExpressExit() (biz.ExpressChoice, error)`, `admin.redactServer()`, `removedServerActions` + `goneHandler` (410), «Проверить туннель» (`POST /servers/{id}/check-tunnel`, `components/servers/TunnelCheckDialog.jsx`), `auth/access.js` (`PAGE_PERMS`/`TENANT_HIDDEN` — новые страницы регистрируются там), право `payments.refund`, `npm test` = `node --test`.

**Решения фазы (сверены с кодом ветки):**
1. **Сходимость шага:** `Verify` прошёл → шаг `ok` без изменений; не прошёл → `Apply` → снова `Verify`; провал после `Apply` → `Rollback` (если есть). Вид `verify` выполняет только `Verify` (расхождение = статус шага `drift`, на ноде ничего не меняется). `Resume` перезапускает задачу с первого шага (шаги идемпотентны — пройденные дают `ok`), в UI это «Продолжить».
2. **Отпечаток до пароля:** `POST /servers/probe` выполняет только обмен ключами SSH и обрывает соединение до аутентификации — пароль не уходит на неподтверждённый хост. Принимается только ключ ed25519 (как `dialExitNode` в CLI). TOFU (`ssh_tofu.go`) и все `InsecureIgnoreHostKey` в коде нод удаляются; ключ, сохранённый TOFU, переносится миграцией в `ssh_host_key_fp` **без** `confirmed_at` — владелец подтверждает его сам.
3. **Ключи туннеля живут на ноде** (`/opt/heyearth/state/reality-keys.json`, недостающие поля генерируются в Go: X25519 через `crypto/ecdh`, без разбора вывода `xray x25519`, формат которого менялся). В БД — публичные части и пароль туннеля, `tunnel_private_key` обнуляется.
4. **Перезапуск только при изменении:** перед записью отличающегося файла ставится маркер `/opt/heyearth/state/restart-pending/<unit>`, снимается после двухточечной проверки (`is-active` + неизменный `NRestarts` за ~9 с). Обрыв SSH между записью и рестартом не теряет рестарт, повтор не даёт второго.
5. **Xray на exit закреплён:** `v26.3.27`, sha256 архива `23cd9af937744d97776ee35ecad4972cf4b2109d1e0fe6be9930467608f7c8ae` (из `Xray-linux-64.zip.dgst` релиза). Конфиг exit — только VLESS Reality `:10443`, flow `xtls-rprx-vision`, dest `microsoft.com:443` (как сейчас), + guard-правила; вход SS+WS `:443` убирается: после фазы 1 Hub его не использует нигде (генератор не строит outbound `shadowsocks` — Task 1.1; монитор проверяет только пути `hy`/`vr` — Task 1.2; действия `fetch_tunnel_creds/sync_tunnel/sync_metrics` → 410 и `PATCH tunnel_protocol` ∈ {`hysteria2`,`vless`} — Task 1.5). Колонка `tunnel_ss_password` остаётся: это пароль Hysteria-клиента Hub (`HubProvisionExisting`, `Tunnel.Password`), а не SS.
6. **CA node-agent на Hub:** `ca-key.pem` выкладывается в `/opt/heyearth/mainserver/certs/` (0600); каждой ноде — свой лист (ECDSA P-256, SAN `node-agent`, `localhost`, IP ноды, 1 год).
7. **Ключ Hub:** `/opt/heyearth/state/hub-ssh/id_ed25519` (каталог `state` уже в ежедневном бэкапе), создаётся один раз скриптом на Hub (и из API, и из CLI).
8. **Удаление записи — отдельно от вывода:** `provision_jobs` удаляется каскадом вместе с `servers`, поэтому задача вывода заканчивается `offline`, а «Удалить запись» — синхронный `DELETE /servers/{id}` только для `offline|pending|failed`.
9. **Сверх первоначального списка заголовка** (теперь внесены в «Общие интерфейсы»: их используют фазы 3–5): `POST /servers/{id}/host-key`, `POST /servers/{id}/preflight`, `PUT /servers/{id}/routing`, `GET /nodes`, `GET /provision-jobs?server_id=`, `GET /ssh-keys/hub`; в `000060` дополнительно `mtproto_status='disabled'` (выключенный в мастере MTProxy реконсилер не доустанавливает) и частичный уникальный индекс «одна активная задача на ноду».

```go
package db

import (
	"errors"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"regexp"
	"strings"
	"testing"

	"github.com/golang-migrate/migrate/v4"
	_ "github.com/golang-migrate/migrate/v4/database/postgres"
	_ "github.com/golang-migrate/migrate/v4/source/file"
)

const migDir = "../../migrations"

func readMigration(t *testing.T, name string) string {
	t.Helper()
	b, err := os.ReadFile(filepath.Join(migDir, name))
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	return string(b)
}

// golang-migrate cannot step down through a lone up half.
func TestMigrationsArePaired(t *testing.T) {
	ups, _ := filepath.Glob(filepath.Join(migDir, "*.up.sql"))
	if len(ups) == 0 {
		t.Fatal("no migrations found")
	}
	for _, up := range ups {
		if _, err := os.Stat(strings.TrimSuffix(up, ".up.sql") + ".down.sql"); err != nil {
			t.Errorf("%s has no down half", filepath.Base(up))
		}
	}
}

func TestMigration000060Shape(t *testing.T) {
	up := readMigration(t, "000060_node_roles_and_jobs.up.sql")
	for _, re := range []string{
		`ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS role TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'exit'`,
		`CHECK \(role IN \('exit', 'relay'\)\)`,
		`ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS ssh_host_key_fp TEXT`,
		`ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS ssh_host_key_confirmed_at TIMESTAMPTZ`,
		`ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS tunnel_fallback_enabled BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT true`,
		`ALTER COLUMN lifecycle_state SET DEFAULT 'pending'`,
		`server_id INT NOT NULL REFERENCES servers\(id\) ON DELETE CASCADE`,
		`job_id BIGINT NOT NULL REFERENCES provision_jobs\(id\) ON DELETE CASCADE`,
		`CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS uq_provision_jobs_active\s+ON provision_jobs \(server_id\) WHERE status IN \('queued', 'running'\)`,
		`'unhealthy', 'disabled'`,
		`\('nodes\.provision',`,
	} {
		if !regexp.MustCompile(re).MatchString(up) {
			t.Errorf("000060 up lacks /%s/", re)
		}
	}
	// The owner confirms every host key himself: nothing is marked confirmed by a migration.
	if regexp.MustCompile(`(?i)ssh_host_key_confirmed_at\s*=`).MatchString(up) {
		t.Error("000060 must not set ssh_host_key_confirmed_at")
	}
	down := readMigration(t, "000060_node_roles_and_jobs.down.sql")
	for _, want := range []string{"DROP TABLE IF EXISTS provision_steps", "DROP TABLE IF EXISTS provision_jobs",
		"SET DEFAULT 'online'", "DROP COLUMN IF EXISTS role", "permission_key = 'nodes.provision'"} {
		if !strings.Contains(down, want) {
			t.Errorf("000060 down lacks %q", want)
		}
	}
	if strings.Index(down, "provision_steps") > strings.Index(down, "DROP TABLE IF EXISTS provision_jobs") {
		t.Error("down must drop provision_steps before provision_jobs")
	}
}

// With TEST_DATABASE_URL (a throwaway database) the chain runs up, one step down and up again.
func TestMigrationsApplyOnPostgres(t *testing.T) {
	url := os.Getenv("TEST_DATABASE_URL")
	if url == "" {
		t.Skip("TEST_DATABASE_URL not set")
	}
	m, err := migrate.New("file://"+migDir, url)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if err := m.Up(); err != nil && !errors.Is(err, migrate.ErrNoChange) {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if err := m.Steps(-1); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if err := m.Up(); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
}
```

```sql
-- Subproject 2 «Пул нод», phase 2: node roles, owner-confirmed SSH host keys, the per-exit TCP
-- fallback switch, provisioning jobs that survive an API restart, the nodes.provision permission.
ALTER TABLE servers ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS role TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'exit';
DO $$ BEGIN
  ALTER TABLE servers ADD CONSTRAINT chk_servers_role CHECK (role IN ('exit', 'relay'));
EXCEPTION WHEN duplicate_object THEN NULL; END $$;
ALTER TABLE servers ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS ssh_host_key_fp TEXT;
ALTER TABLE servers ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS ssh_host_key_confirmed_at TIMESTAMPTZ;
ALTER TABLE servers ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS tunnel_fallback_enabled BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT true;
ALTER TABLE servers ALTER COLUMN lifecycle_state SET DEFAULT 'pending';

-- The key TOFU stored (base64 of the wire blob) becomes a fingerprint the owner still has to confirm.
UPDATE servers
   SET ssh_host_key_fp = 'SHA256:' || rtrim(encode(sha256(decode(ssh_host_key, 'base64')), 'base64'), '=')
 WHERE ssh_host_key_fp IS NULL
   AND ssh_host_key ~ '^[A-Za-z0-9+/]+={0,2}$' AND length(ssh_host_key) % 4 = 0;

-- 'disabled': MTProxy switched off in the wizard (ListExitsNeedingMTProto skips it).
ALTER TABLE servers DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS servers_mtproto_status_check;
ALTER TABLE servers ADD CONSTRAINT servers_mtproto_status_check
  CHECK (mtproto_status IN ('unknown', 'installing', 'healthy', 'unhealthy', 'disabled'));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS provision_jobs (
  id BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
  server_id INT NOT NULL REFERENCES servers(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (kind IN ('provision', 'reprovision', 'deprovision', 'verify')),
  status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (status IN ('queued', 'running', 'succeeded', 'failed', 'interrupted')),
  error TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),
  started_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
  finished_at TIMESTAMPTZ
);
-- One job per node at a time, enforced by the database (two admins, a double click, the CLI).
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS uq_provision_jobs_active
  ON provision_jobs (server_id) WHERE status IN ('queued', 'running');
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_provision_jobs_server ON provision_jobs (server_id, id DESC);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS provision_steps (
  id BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
  job_id BIGINT NOT NULL REFERENCES provision_jobs(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  idx INT NOT NULL,
  name TEXT NOT NULL,
  status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending',
  output_tail TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  started_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
  finished_at TIMESTAMPTZ
);
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS uq_provision_steps_job_idx ON provision_steps (job_id, idx);

INSERT INTO admin_permissions (permission_key, name, description) VALUES
  ('nodes.provision', 'Provision nodes', 'Add, set up, verify and retire exit and relay nodes over SSH')
ON CONFLICT (permission_key) DO NOTHING;
INSERT INTO admin_role_permissions (role_id, permission_id)
SELECT r.id, p.id FROM admin_roles r CROSS JOIN admin_permissions p
 WHERE r.role_key = 'super_admin' AND p.permission_key = 'nodes.provision'
ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING;
```

```go
package config

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"flag"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"reflect"
	"strings"
	"testing"
)

var update = flag.Bool("update", false, "rewrite testdata/*.golden")

func golden(t *testing.T, name string, got []byte) {
	t.Helper()
	p := filepath.Join("testdata", name)
	if *update {
		if err := os.WriteFile(p, got, 0o644); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
	}
	want, err := os.ReadFile(p)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("%v (run once with -update)", err)
	}
	if string(want) != string(got) {
		t.Fatalf("%s differs from golden:\n%s", name, got)
	}
}

var testKeys = ExitRealityKeys{PrivateKey: "cHJpdmF0ZS1rZXktMzItYnl0ZXMtLS0tLS0tLS0tLS0", PublicKey: "cHVibGljLWtleS0zMi1ieXRlcy0tLS0tLS0tLS0tLS0",
	ShortID: "0123456789abcdef", UUID: "aaaaaaaa-bbbb-4ccc-8ddd-eeeeeeeeeeee", SSPassword: "c2VjcmV0LXR1bm5lbC1wdw=="}

// Production tuning of the exit server and the shared ACL, in one template for admin panel and CLI.
func TestExitHysteriaServerYAML(t *testing.T) {
	y := ExitHysteriaServerYAML(testKeys.SSPassword, "203.0.113.7", 8443)
	for _, w := range []string{"listen: :50443\n", "  password: " + testKeys.SSPassword + "\n",
		"quic:\n  initStreamReceiveWindow: 26843545\n  maxStreamReceiveWindow: 26843545\n  initConnReceiveWindow: 67108864\n  maxConnReceiveWindow: 67108864\n",
		"bandwidth:\n  up: 100 mbps\n  down: 100 mbps\n", "    - direct(203.0.113.7, tcp/8443)\n", "    - reject(203.0.113.7)\n"} {
		if !strings.Contains(y, w) {
			t.Errorf("server.yaml lacks %q", w)
		}
	}
	if !strings.HasSuffix(y, "    - direct(all)\n") {
		t.Error("the ACL must end the file with direct(all)")
	}
	for _, bad := range []string{"8388608", "20971520", "1 gbps"} {
		if strings.Contains(y, bad) {
			t.Errorf("old CLI tuning %q leaked into the exit template", bad)
		}
	}
	golden(t, "exit_hysteria_server.golden", []byte(y))
}

func TestExitXrayConfigJSON(t *testing.T) {
	b, err := ExitXrayConfigJSON(testKeys, "203.0.113.7", 8443)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	var c struct {
		Inbounds []struct {
			Port     int    `json:"port"`
			Protocol string `json:"protocol"`
			Settings struct {
				Clients []struct{ ID, Flow string } `json:"clients"`
			} `json:"settings"`
			StreamSettings struct {
				RealitySettings struct {
					Dest        string   `json:"dest"`
					ServerNames []string `json:"serverNames"`
					PrivateKey  string   `json:"privateKey"`
					ShortIDs    []string `json:"shortIds"`
				} `json:"realitySettings"`
			} `json:"streamSettings"`
		} `json:"inbounds"`
		Routing struct {
			Rules []map[string]any `json:"rules"`
		} `json:"routing"`
	}
	if err := json.Unmarshal(b, &c); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if len(c.Inbounds) != 1 || c.Inbounds[0].Port != ExitRealityPort || c.Inbounds[0].Protocol != "vless" {
		t.Fatalf("want only the VLESS Reality inbound on :10443, got %+v", c.Inbounds)
	}
	in := c.Inbounds[0]
	if in.Settings.Clients[0].ID != testKeys.UUID || in.Settings.Clients[0].Flow != ExitRealityFlow {
		t.Errorf("client %+v", in.Settings.Clients)
	}
	rs := in.StreamSettings.RealitySettings
	if rs.Dest != ExitRealityDest || rs.PrivateKey != testKeys.PrivateKey || !reflect.DeepEqual(rs.ShortIDs, []string{testKeys.ShortID}) ||
		!reflect.DeepEqual(rs.ServerNames, []string{"microsoft.com", "www.microsoft.com"}) {
		t.Errorf("reality %+v", rs)
	}
	r := c.Routing.Rules
	if len(r) != 3 || r[0]["outboundTag"] != "direct" || r[0]["port"] != "8443" || r[1]["outboundTag"] != "block" ||
		!reflect.DeepEqual(r[2]["protocol"], []any{"bittorrent"}) {
		t.Fatalf("routing: guard allow, guard block, bittorrent — got %v", r)
	}
	golden(t, "exit_xray_config.golden", b)
}

	}
}
```

```go
package config

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	"strconv"
)

// Exit node layout, shared by every provisioning path (internal/provision ExitRecipe for the
// admin panel and deploy --setup-exit-node).
const (
	ExitHysteriaPort = 50443
	ExitRealityPort  = 10443
	ExitRealitySNI   = "microsoft.com"
	ExitRealityDest  = "microsoft.com:443"
	ExitRealityFlow  = "xtls-rprx-vision"
	NodeAgentPort    = 50052

	ExitKeysPath       = "/opt/heyearth/state/reality-keys.json"
	ExitHysteriaConfig = "/opt/heyearth/hysteria/server.yaml"
	ExitXrayConfig     = "/opt/heyearth/xray/config.json"
	NodeAgentBinary    = "/opt/heyearth/node-agent"
	NodeAgentCACert    = "/opt/heyearth/certs/ca-cert.pem"
	NodeAgentCert      = "/opt/heyearth/certs/server-cert.pem"
	NodeAgentKey       = "/opt/heyearth/certs/server-key.pem"
	NodeAgentUnitPath  = "/etc/systemd/system/node-agent.service"
	RestartMarkerDir   = "/opt/heyearth/state/restart-pending"
	HubSSHKeyPath      = "/opt/heyearth/state/hub-ssh/id_ed25519"
)

// RestartMarker exists while a unit's new config/binary is written but not yet confirmed running.
func RestartMarker(unit string) string { return RestartMarkerDir + "/" + unit }

// ExitRealityKeys is /opt/heyearth/state/reality-keys.json: created on the exit once, the
// private key never leaves it except transiently in the Hub's memory while rendering.
type ExitRealityKeys struct {
	PrivateKey string `json:"privateKey"`
	PublicKey  string `json:"publicKey"`
	ShortID    string `json:"shortId"`
	UUID       string `json:"uuid"`
	SSPassword string `json:"ssPassword"`
}

// ExitHysteriaServerYAML renders the exit's hysteria server (the Hub→exit tunnel): production
// tuning (QUIC windows 26843545/67108864, Brutal 100/100 mbps, the 2026-10-12 benchmark) and
// the shared ACL. password is base64 (validated by the caller): safe unquoted in YAML.
func ExitHysteriaServerYAML(password, exitIP string, mtprotoPort int) string {
	return `# Generated by heyearth (config.ExitHysteriaServerYAML)
listen: :` + strconv.Itoa(ExitHysteriaPort) + `

tls:
  cert: /opt/heyearth/certs/hy2.crt
  key: /opt/heyearth/certs/hy2.key

auth:
  type: password
  password: ` + password + `

masquerade:
  type: proxy
  proxy:
    url: https://www.microsoft.com
    rewriteHost: true

quic:
  initStreamReceiveWindow: 26843545
  maxStreamReceiveWindow: 26843545
  initConnReceiveWindow: 67108864
  maxConnReceiveWindow: 67108864

bandwidth:
  up: 100 mbps
  down: 100 mbps

` + ExitHysteriaACL(exitIP, mtprotoPort)
}

const ExitHysteriaUnit = `[Unit]
Description=Hysteria2 VPN Server (HeYearth)
After=network.target
[Service]
Type=simple
ExecStart=/usr/local/bin/hysteria server -c /opt/heyearth/hysteria/server.yaml
Restart=always
RestartSec=3
LimitNOFILE=65535
[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
`

const ExitXrayUnit = `[Unit]
Description=Xray Exit Node (HeYearth)
After=network.target
[Service]
Type=simple
ExecStart=/opt/heyearth/xray/xray run -config /opt/heyearth/xray/config.json
Restart=always
RestartSec=5
LimitNOFILE=65535
[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
`

// NodeAgentUnit: mTLS gRPC on :50052 with the node's own certificate (internal/provision IssueNodeCert).
const NodeAgentUnit = `[Unit]
Description=HeYearth Node Agent
After=network.target
[Service]
Type=simple
User=root
WorkingDirectory=/opt/heyearth
ExecStart=` + NodeAgentBinary + `
Restart=always
RestartSec=5
Environment="PORT=50052"
Environment="TLS_CERT_FILE=` + NodeAgentCert + `"
Environment="TLS_KEY_FILE=` + NodeAgentKey + `"
Environment="TLS_CA_FILE=` + NodeAgentCACert + `"
[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
`

// ExitSysctlConf is /etc/sysctl.d/99-bbr.conf (the same file and values the admin panel wrote).
const ExitSysctlConf = `net.core.default_qdisc = fq
net.ipv4.tcp_congestion_control = bbr
net.core.rmem_max = 16777216
net.core.wmem_max = 16777216
net.ipv4.tcp_rmem = 4096 131072 16777216
net.ipv4.tcp_wmem = 4096 131072 16777216
net.ipv4.tcp_fastopen = 3
net.ipv4.tcp_slow_start_after_idle = 0
net.ipv4.tcp_mtu_probing = 1
net.ipv6.conf.all.disable_ipv6 = 1
net.ipv6.conf.default.disable_ipv6 = 1
`

const (
	ExitPortHopConfPath = "/etc/nftables-hysteria.conf"
	ExitPortHopUnitPath = "/etc/systemd/system/nftables-hysteria.service"
)

// ExitPortHopConf redirects UDP ExitHopRange to :50443; create + delete + define in one nft
// transaction, so re-applying never duplicates the rule.
const ExitPortHopConf = `table inet hysteria_porthopping
delete table inet hysteria_porthopping
table inet hysteria_porthopping {
  chain prerouting {
    type nat hook prerouting priority dstnat; policy accept;
    udp dport ` + ExitHopRange + ` counter redirect to :50443
  }
}
`

const ExitPortHopUnit = `[Unit]
Description=nftables port hopping for Hysteria2
After=network.target
[Service]
Type=oneshot
ExecStart=/usr/sbin/nft -f /etc/nftables-hysteria.conf
RemainAfterExit=yes
[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
`

// ExitXrayConfigJSON renders /opt/heyearth/xray/config.json of an exit: the TCP fallback tunnel
// (VLESS Reality :10443, flow xtls-rprx-vision) with the guard rules shared with the hysteria ACL.
func ExitXrayConfigJSON(k ExitRealityKeys, exitIP string, mtprotoPort int) ([]byte, error) {
	var rules []any
	if err := json.Unmarshal([]byte("["+ExitXrayGuardRules(exitIP, "direct", "block", mtprotoPort)+"]"), &rules); err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("guard rules: %w", err)
	}
	rules = append(rules, map[string]any{"type": "field", "protocol": []string{"bittorrent"}, "outboundTag": "block"})
	sockopt := map[string]any{"tcpFastOpen": true, "tcpNoDelay": true, "tcpKeepAliveInterval": 30}
	cfg := map[string]any{
		"log": map[string]any{"loglevel": "warning"},
		"dns": map[string]any{"servers": []string{"8.8.8.8", "1.1.1.1"}, "queryStrategy": "UseIPv4"},
		"inbounds": []any{map[string]any{
			"tag": "vless-reality", "listen": "0.0.0.0", "port": ExitRealityPort, "protocol": "vless",
			"settings": map[string]any{"decryption": "none",
				"clients": []any{map[string]any{"id": k.UUID, "flow": ExitRealityFlow}}},
			"streamSettings": map[string]any{"network": "tcp", "security": "reality", "sockopt": sockopt,
				"realitySettings": map[string]any{"show": false, "dest": ExitRealityDest, "xver": 0,
					"serverNames": []string{ExitRealitySNI, "www." + ExitRealitySNI},
					"privateKey":  k.PrivateKey, "shortIds": []string{k.ShortID}}},
			"sniffing": map[string]any{"enabled": true, "destOverride": []string{"http", "tls", "quic"}},
		}},
		"outbounds": []any{
			map[string]any{"protocol": "freedom", "tag": "direct", "settings": map[string]any{"domainStrategy": "UseIPv4"},
				"streamSettings": map[string]any{"sockopt": sockopt}},
			map[string]any{"protocol": "blackhole", "tag": "block", "settings": map[string]any{"response": map[string]any{"type": "none"}}},
		},
		"routing": map[string]any{"domainStrategy": "IPIfNonMatch", "rules": rules},
		"policy": map[string]any{"levels": map[string]any{"0": map[string]any{
			"handshake": 4, "connIdle": 300, "uplinkOnly": 2, "downlinkOnly": 5, "bufferSize": 512}}},
	}
	b, err := json.MarshalIndent(cfg, "", "  ")
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	return append(b, '\n'), nil
}

// RealityProbe is what the Hub needs to dial an exit's TCP fallback.
type RealityProbe struct{ ExitIP, UUID, PublicKey, ShortID, SNI string }

// VRProbeSocksPort is the loopback SOCKS of the short-lived Hub xray that checks exit <id>'s TCP
// path (3088..3599: outside the hysteria clients' 1088..1599 and every Hub listener).
func VRProbeSocksPort(serverID int) int { return 3088 + serverID }

// ExitRealityProbeConfig renders a minimal xray client: SOCKS on 127.0.0.1:socksPort → VLESS
// Reality to <exit>:10443 with the same flow/SNI/keys as the Hub's exit-<id>.vr outbound.
func ExitRealityProbeConfig(socksPort int, p RealityProbe) ([]byte, error) {
	cfg := map[string]any{
		"log": map[string]any{"loglevel": "warning"},
		"inbounds": []any{map[string]any{"listen": "127.0.0.1", "port": socksPort, "protocol": "socks",
			"settings": map[string]any{"udp": false}}},
		"outbounds": []any{map[string]any{"protocol": "vless",
			"settings": map[string]any{"vnext": []any{map[string]any{"address": p.ExitIP, "port": ExitRealityPort,
				"users": []any{map[string]any{"id": p.UUID, "encryption": "none", "flow": ExitRealityFlow}}}}},
			"streamSettings": map[string]any{"network": "tcp", "security": "reality",
				"realitySettings": map[string]any{"fingerprint": "chrome", "serverName": p.SNI,
					"publicKey": p.PublicKey, "shortId": p.ShortID}}}},
	}
	b, err := json.MarshalIndent(cfg, "", "  ")
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	return append(b, '\n'), nil
}
```

```go
package config

import (
	"bytes"
	"os"
	"os/exec"
	"path/filepath"
	"strings"
	"testing"
)

// shellRun runs prelude+script in a temp dir with /opt/heyearth/ and /etc/ rewritten to ./…,
// refusing to run if an absolute path survived the rewrite.
func shellRun(t *testing.T, dir, prelude, script string, env ...string) (string, error) {
	t.Helper()
	s := strings.NewReplacer("/opt/heyearth/", "./opt/heyearth/", "/etc/", "./etc/").Replace(script)
	if strings.Contains(s, " /opt/heyearth") || strings.Contains(s, " /etc/") {
		t.Fatal("path rewrite incomplete")
	}
	cmd := exec.Command("bash", "-s")
	cmd.Dir = dir
	cmd.Env = append(os.Environ(), append([]string{"RESTART_CHECK_SLEEP=0", "RESTART_CHECK_SLEEP2=0"}, env...)...)
	cmd.Stdin = strings.NewReader(prelude + s)
	var out bytes.Buffer
	cmd.Stdout, cmd.Stderr = &out, &out
	err := cmd.Run()
	return out.String(), err
}

// systemctl stub: ./active.<unit> = running; restart increments ./restarts.<unit>;
// FLAP=1 makes NRestarts grow between the two samples; DEAD=1 keeps units down after restart.
const systemctlStub = `systemctl() {
  case "$1" in
    restart) echo "$2" >> ./restarts; [ "${DEAD:-0}" = 1 ] || touch "./active.$2" ;;
    is-active) [ -f "./active.${@: -1}" ] ;;
    show) n=$(cat "./nr.${@: -1}" 2>/dev/null || echo 0); echo "$n"; [ "${FLAP:-0}" = 1 ] && echo $((n+1)) > "./nr.${@: -1}"; true ;;
    disable) echo "disable $*" >> ./calls; rm -f "./active.${@: -1}" ;;
    *) echo "$*" >> ./calls ;;
  esac
}
`

func count(dir, file, line string) int {
	b, _ := os.ReadFile(filepath.Join(dir, file))
	n := 0
	for _, l := range strings.Split(string(b), "\n") {
		if l == line {
			n++
		}
	}
	return n
}

func TestRestartCheckedTwoSamples(t *testing.T) {
	if !haveBash() {
		t.Skip("no bash")
	}
	for _, tc := range []struct {
		name, env string
		ok        bool
		out       string
	}{
		{"stable", "X=1", true, "работает стабильно"},
		{"not started", "DEAD=1", false, "не запустился"},
		{"crash loop", "FLAP=1", false, "перезапускается сам"},
	} {
		t.Run(tc.name, func(t *testing.T) {
			out, err := shellRun(t, t.TempDir(), systemctlStub, "set -e\n"+RestartCheckFunc+"restart_checked xray\n", tc.env)
			if (err == nil) != tc.ok || !strings.Contains(out, tc.out) {
				t.Fatalf("err=%v out=%s", err, out)
			}
		})
	}
}

func TestUnitConvergeRestartsOnlyOnMarkerOrDown(t *testing.T) {
	if !haveBash() {
		t.Skip("no bash")
	}
	dir := t.TempDir()
	os.MkdirAll(filepath.Join(dir, "opt/heyearth/state/restart-pending"), 0o755)
	run := func() string {
		out, err := shellRun(t, dir, systemctlStub, UnitConvergeScript("xray", ""))
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatalf("%v\n%s", err, out)
		}
		return out
	}
	run() // down → started
	if count(dir, "restarts", "xray") != 1 {
		t.Fatal("a stopped unit must be started")
	}
	run() // up, no marker → untouched
	if count(dir, "restarts", "xray") != 1 {
		t.Fatal("an unchanged running unit was restarted")
	}
	os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(dir, "opt/heyearth/state/restart-pending/xray"), nil, 0o644)
	run() // marker (written but not restarted before an SSH drop) → exactly one restart, marker gone
	if count(dir, "restarts", "xray") != 2 {
		t.Fatal("the pending marker must trigger a restart")
	}
	if _, err := os.Stat(filepath.Join(dir, "opt/heyearth/state/restart-pending/xray")); err == nil {
		t.Fatal("marker left after a successful restart")
	}
}

func TestUnitRollbackRestoresOnlyChangedFiles(t *testing.T) {
	if !haveBash() {
		t.Skip("no bash")
	}
	dir := t.TempDir()

	os.MkdirAll(cfg, 0o755)
	os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(cfg, "config.json"), []byte("new"), 0o600)
	os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(cfg, "config.json.bak"), []byte("old"), 0o600)
	os.MkdirAll(filepath.Join(dir, "etc/systemd/system"), 0o755)
	os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(dir, "etc/systemd/system/xray.service"), []byte("fresh"), 0o644)

		t.Fatalf("config.json = %q, want the .bak", b)
	}
	if _, err := os.Stat(filepath.Join(dir, "etc/systemd/system/xray.service")); err == nil {
		t.Fatal("a file that had no previous version must be removed")
	}
	if count(dir, "restarts", "xray") != 1 || !strings.Contains(out, "возвращена прежняя версия") {
		t.Fatalf("restored unit must be restarted once:\n%s", out)
	}
}

const fwStubs = `ufw() { echo "ufw $*" >> ./fw.log
  case "$1" in status) [ "${UFW_ACTIVE:-0}" = 1 ] && echo "Status: active" || echo "Status: inactive" ;;
  allow) grep -qxF "$*" ./ufw.rules 2>/dev/null || echo "$*" >> ./ufw.rules ;; esac; }
iptables() { echo "iptables $*" >> ./fw.log
  case "$1" in -S) echo "-P INPUT ${IPT_POLICY:-ACCEPT}"; cat ./ipt.rules 2>/dev/null ;;
  -C) shift; grep -qxF -- "-A $*" ./ipt.rules 2>/dev/null ;; -I) shift; echo "-A $*" >> ./ipt.rules ;; esac; }
`

func TestExitFirewallScript(t *testing.T) {
	if !haveBash() {
		t.Skip("no bash")
	}
	script := ExitFirewallScript(2222, []string{"138.16.181.225", "bad;id"}, 8443)
	t.Run("ufw active: rules added, never enabled, no duplicates", func(t *testing.T) {
		dir := t.TempDir()
		for i := 0; i < 2; i++ {
			if out, err := shellRun(t, dir, fwStubs, script, "UFW_ACTIVE=1"); err != nil {
				t.Fatalf("%v\n%s", err, out)
			}
		}
		for _, r := range []string{"allow 2222/tcp", "allow 10443/tcp", "allow 8443/tcp", "allow 50443/udp", "allow 20000:50000/udp",
			"allow from 138.16.181.225 to any port 50052 proto tcp"} {
			if count(dir, "ufw.rules", r) != 1 {
				t.Errorf("rule %q present %d times", r, count(dir, "ufw.rules", r))
			}
		}
		if b, _ := os.ReadFile(filepath.Join(dir, "fw.log")); strings.Contains(string(b), "enable") || strings.Contains(string(b), "bad;id") {
			t.Errorf("ufw enabled or an invalid hub address passed through:\n%s", b)
		}
	})
	t.Run("firewall off: nothing touched", func(t *testing.T) {
		dir := t.TempDir()
		out, err := shellRun(t, dir, fwStubs, script)
		if err != nil || !strings.Contains(out, "фаервол выключен") {
			t.Fatalf("%v\n%s", err, out)
		}
		if _, err := os.Stat(filepath.Join(dir, "ipt.rules")); err == nil {
			t.Error("iptables rules added while the firewall is off")
		}
	})
	t.Run("iptables DROP policy: rules inserted once", func(t *testing.T) {
		dir := t.TempDir()
		for i := 0; i < 2; i++ {
			if out, err := shellRun(t, dir, fwStubs, script, "IPT_POLICY=DROP"); err != nil {
				t.Fatalf("%v\n%s", err, out)
			}
		}
		if n := count(dir, "ipt.rules", "-A INPUT -p tcp --dport 2222 -j ACCEPT"); n != 1 {
			t.Errorf("ssh rule %d times", n)
		}
		if n := count(dir, "ipt.rules", "-A INPUT -p tcp -s 138.16.181.225 --dport 50052 -j ACCEPT"); n != 1 {
			t.Errorf("node-agent rule %d times", n)
		}
	})
}

func TestXrayExitInstall(t *testing.T) {
	if !haveBash() {
		t.Skip("no bash")
	}
	fake := func(v string) string { return "#!/bin/sh\necho 'Xray " + v + " (Xray, Penetrates Everything.)'\n" }
	stubs := `curl() { out=""; while [ $# -gt 0 ]; do case "$1" in -o) out="$2"; shift 2;; *) shift;; esac; done; [ -f ./download ] || return 22; cp ./download "$out"; }
unzip() { d=""; while [ $# -gt 0 ]; do case "$1" in -d) d="$2"; shift 2;; *) shift;; esac; done; cp ./payload "$d/xray"; }
`
	for _, tc := range []struct {
		name, current string
		wrongSHA, ok  bool
		wantVer, want string
	}{
		{"fresh", "", false, true, "26.3.27", "XR_REPLACED=1"},
		{"current kept", fake("26.3.27"), false, true, "26.3.27", "XR_REPLACED=0"},
		{"sha mismatch keeps old", fake("25.1.1"), true, false, "25.1.1", "ERROR"},
	} {
		t.Run(tc.name, func(t *testing.T) {
			dir := t.TempDir()
			os.MkdirAll(filepath.Join(dir, "opt/heyearth/xray"), 0o755)
			if tc.current != "" {
				os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(dir, "opt/heyearth/xray/xray"), []byte(tc.current), 0o755)
			}
			os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(dir, "download"), []byte("zip"), 0o644)
			os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(dir, "payload"), []byte(fake("26.3.27")), 0o755)
			sha := sha256Hex("zip")
			if tc.wrongSHA {
				sha = sha256Hex("other")
			}
			out, err := shellRun(t, dir, stubs, "set -e\n"+xrayExitInstallScript(sha)+"echo XR_REPLACED=$XR_REPLACED\n")
			if (err == nil) != tc.ok || !strings.Contains(out, tc.want) {
				t.Fatalf("err=%v\n%s", err, out)
			}
			ver, _ := exec.Command("bash", filepath.Join(dir, "opt/heyearth/xray/xray")).Output()
			if !strings.Contains(string(ver), tc.wantVer) {
				t.Fatalf("binary now %q, want %s", ver, tc.wantVer)
			}
		})
	}
}

df() { printf 'Filesystem 1024-blocks Used Available Capacity Mounted\n/dev/vda1 1 1 9000000 1%% /\n'; }
timeout() { [ "${NET:-1}" = 1 ]; }
ss() { case "$*" in *10443*) echo 'LISTEN 0 4096 *:10443 *:* users:(("nginx",pid=1,fd=6))' ;; *50052*) echo 'LISTEN 0 4096 *:50052 *:* users:(("node-agent",pid=2,fd=3))' ;; esac; }
`
	out, err := shellRun(t, dir, stubs, ExitPreflightScript())
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("%v\n%s", err, out)
	}
	for _, w := range []string{"PF os ok Ubuntu 24.04", "PF arch ok", "PF root ok", "PF disk ok", "PF internet ok",
		"PF port_50443 ok", "PF port_50052 ok", "PF port_10443 fail", "PF_TIME "} {
		if !strings.Contains(out, w) {
			t.Errorf("preflight lacks %q:\n%s", w, out)
		}
	}
}

// Every op script carries its marker line and parses under bash -n.
func TestOpScriptsMarkedAndParse(t *testing.T) {
	if !haveBash() {
		t.Skip("no bash")
	}
	for name, s := range map[string]string{
		"converge": UnitConvergeScript("xray", ExitXrayPrepareScript()), "rollback": UnitRollbackScript("x", []string{"/a b"}),
		"state": UnitStateScript("xray"), "mark": MarkRestartScript("xray"), "sums": SumsScript("/a", "/b c"), "cat": CatScript("/a"),
		"firewall": ExitFirewallScript(22, nil, 0), "preflight": ExitPreflightScript(), "base": ExitBaseScript, "basecheck": ExitBaseCheckScript,
		"hop": ExitPortHopApplyScript, "hy": HysteriaCheckScript, "xr": XrayCheckScript, "hubkey": HubSSHKeyEnsureScript,
		"hyprep": ExitHysteriaPrepareScript(), "auth": AuthorizedKeyScript("ssh-ed25519 AAAA"), "authc": AuthorizedKeyCheckScript("ssh-ed25519 AAAA"),
		"socks": SocksProbeScript(1095), "vr": VRProbeScript("/opt/heyearth/xray/xray", "/opt/heyearth/state/vr-probe-7.json", 3095),
	} {
		if name != "hyprep" && !strings.HasPrefix(s, "# hp:") {
			t.Errorf("%s: no marker line", name)
		}
		if out, err := exec.Command("bash", "-n", "-c", s).CombinedOutput(); err != nil {
			t.Errorf("%s: bash -n: %v %s", name, err, out)
		}
	}
}
```
