```go
package config

import (
	"fmt"
	"strconv"
	"strings"
)

func shQuote(s string) string { return "'" + strings.ReplaceAll(s, "'", `'\''`) + "'" }

// RestartCheckFunc defines restart_checked UNIT: restart, then two samples ~9 s apart —
// is-active both times and NRestarts unchanged (a crash loop with Restart=always would
// otherwise look "active").
const RestartCheckFunc = `restart_checked() {
  systemctl restart "$1"
  sleep "${RESTART_CHECK_SLEEP:-3}"
  if ! systemctl is-active --quiet "$1"; then echo "[unit] $1 не запустился" >&2; return 1; fi
  n1=$(systemctl show -p NRestarts --value "$1")
  sleep "${RESTART_CHECK_SLEEP2:-6}"
  n2=$(systemctl show -p NRestarts --value "$1")
  if ! systemctl is-active --quiet "$1" || [ "$n1" != "$n2" ]; then echo "[unit] $1 перезапускается сам (NRestarts $n1 -> $n2)" >&2; return 1; fi
  echo "[unit] $1 работает стабильно (NRestarts=$n2)"
}
`

// UnitConvergeScript runs extra (installers, config tests; they may touch the marker), enables
// the unit and restarts it only when its marker exists or it is not running.
func UnitConvergeScript(unit, extra string) string {
	m := RestartMarker(unit)
	return "# hp:converge " + unit + "\nset -e\n" + RestartCheckFunc + "mkdir -p " + RestartMarkerDir + "\nsystemctl daemon-reload\n" + extra +
		"systemctl enable " + unit + " >/dev/null 2>&1 || true\n" +
		"if [ -f " + m + " ] || ! systemctl is-active --quiet " + unit + "; then\n  restart_checked " + unit + "\n  rm -f " + m +
		"\nelse\n  echo \"[unit] " + unit + ": без изменений и работает — без перезапуска\"\nfi\n"
}

// UnitRollbackScript puts back the files changed in this run (.bak written by PutFile), removes
// files that had no previous version, and restarts the unit (or stops a fresh install).
func UnitRollbackScript(unit string, changed []string) string {
	var b strings.Builder
	b.WriteString("# hp:rollback " + unit + "\nset -e\n" + RestartCheckFunc + "restored=0\n")
	for _, p := range changed {
		q := shQuote(p)
		fmt.Fprintf(&b, "if [ -f %s.bak ]; then mv -f %s.bak %s; restored=1; else rm -f %s; fi\n", q, q, q, q)
	}
	b.WriteString("systemctl daemon-reload\nrm -f " + RestartMarker(unit) + "\n")
	b.WriteString(`if [ "$restored" = 1 ]; then restart_checked ` + unit + `; echo "[unit] ` + unit + `: возвращена прежняя версия"
else systemctl disable --now ` + unit + ` >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; echo "[unit] ` + unit + `: новая установка снята"; fi
`)
	return b.String()
}

func UnitStateScript(unit string) string {
	return "# hp:unit-state " + unit + "\nif systemctl is-active --quiet " + unit + "; then echo ACTIVE=1; else echo ACTIVE=0; fi\n" +
		"if [ -f " + RestartMarker(unit) + " ]; then echo MARKER=1; else echo MARKER=0; fi\n"
}

func MarkRestartScript(unit string) string {
	return "# hp:mark " + unit + "\nmkdir -p " + RestartMarkerDir + " && touch " + RestartMarker(unit) + "\n"
}

func SumsScript(paths ...string) string {
	q := make([]string, len(paths))
	for i, p := range paths {
		q[i] = shQuote(p)
	}
	return "# hp:sums " + strings.Join(paths, " ") + "\nfor p in " + strings.Join(q, " ") + "; do if [ -f \"$p\" ]; then sha256sum \"$p\"; fi; done\ntrue\n"
}

func CatScript(path string) string { return "# hp:cat " + path + "\ncat " + shQuote(path) + " 2>/dev/null || true\n" }

// ExitFirewallScript never switches a firewall on. If ufw is active (or iptables filters INPUT)
// it allows the real SSH port, the tunnels, the MTProxy port and node-agent :50052 from the Hub
// only; ufw skips existing rules itself, iptables rules are checked with -C first.
func ExitFirewallScript(sshPort int, hubIPs []string, mtprotoPort int) string {
	tcp := []string{strconv.Itoa(sshPort), strconv.Itoa(ExitRealityPort)}
	if mtprotoPort > 0 {
		tcp = append(tcp, strconv.Itoa(mtprotoPort))
	}
	udp := []string{strconv.Itoa(ExitHysteriaPort), strings.ReplaceAll(ExitHopRange, "-", ":")}
	var hubs []string
	for _, ip := range hubIPs {
		if c := canonicalIP(ip); c != "" {
			hubs = append(hubs, c)
		}
	}
	var b strings.Builder
	b.WriteString("# hp:firewall\nset -e\nif command -v ufw >/dev/null 2>&1 && ufw status 2>/dev/null | grep -q '^Status: active'; then\n" +
		"  echo \"[fw] ufw включён — добавляю разрешения\"\n")
	for _, p := range tcp {
		fmt.Fprintf(&b, "  ufw allow %s/tcp >/dev/null\n", p)
	}
	for _, p := range udp {
		fmt.Fprintf(&b, "  ufw allow %s/udp >/dev/null\n", p)
	}
	for _, h := range hubs {
		fmt.Fprintf(&b, "  ufw allow from %s to any port %d proto tcp >/dev/null\n", h, NodeAgentPort)
	}
	b.WriteString("elif iptables -S INPUT 2>/dev/null | grep -qE '^-P INPUT (DROP|REJECT)|^-A INPUT .*-j (DROP|REJECT)'; then\n" +
		"  echo \"[fw] iptables фильтрует входящие — добавляю разрешения\"\n" +
		"  ipt_allow() { iptables -C INPUT \"$@\" -j ACCEPT 2>/dev/null || iptables -I INPUT \"$@\" -j ACCEPT; }\n")
	for _, p := range tcp {
		fmt.Fprintf(&b, "  ipt_allow -p tcp --dport %s\n", p)
	}
	for _, p := range udp {
		fmt.Fprintf(&b, "  ipt_allow -p udp --dport %s\n", p)
	}
	for _, h := range hubs {
		fmt.Fprintf(&b, "  ipt_allow -p tcp -s %s --dport %d\n", h, NodeAgentPort)
	}
	b.WriteString("  if command -v netfilter-persistent >/dev/null 2>&1; then netfilter-persistent save >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; fi\n" +
		"else\n  echo \"[fw] фаервол выключен — не включаю и ничего не меняю\"\nfi\n")
	return b.String()
}

// Exit Xray: pinned like hysteria. SHA256 = the "SHA2-256" line of Xray-linux-64.zip.dgst of the release.
const (
	XrayExitVersion = "v26.3.27"
	XrayExitSHA256  = "23cd9af937744d97776ee35ecad4972cf4b2109d1e0fe6be9930467608f7c8ae"
)

func XrayExitDownloadURL() string {
	return "https://github.com/XTLS/Xray-core/releases/download/" + XrayExitVersion + "/Xray-linux-64.zip"
}

func XrayExitInstallScript() string { return xrayExitInstallScript(XrayExitSHA256) }

// xrayExitInstallScript: download to a temp dir on the same filesystem, sha256 before unzip and
// execution, version check, previous binary → xray.bak, atomic rename. XR_REPLACED=1 when replaced.
func xrayExitInstallScript(sha string) string {
	return `XR_WANT="` + strings.TrimPrefix(XrayExitVersion, "v") + `"
XR_SHA256="` + sha + `"
XR_REPLACED=0
XR_CUR=$(/opt/heyearth/xray/xray version 2>/dev/null | awk 'NR==1{print $2}') || XR_CUR=""
if [ "$XR_CUR" != "$XR_WANT" ]; then
  mkdir -p /opt/heyearth/xray
  XR_TMP=$(mktemp -d /opt/heyearth/xray/.dl.XXXXXX)
  if curl -fsSL --connect-timeout 15 --max-time 300 --retry 3 --retry-delay 2 -o "$XR_TMP/xray.zip" "` + XrayExitDownloadURL() + `" \
    && echo "$XR_SHA256  $XR_TMP/xray.zip" | sha256sum -c --quiet \
    && unzip -o -q "$XR_TMP/xray.zip" xray -d "$XR_TMP" \
    && chmod +x "$XR_TMP/xray" \
    && [ "$("$XR_TMP/xray" version 2>/dev/null | awk 'NR==1{print $2}')" = "$XR_WANT" ] \
    && { [ ! -x /opt/heyearth/xray/xray ] || cp -p /opt/heyearth/xray/xray /opt/heyearth/xray/xray.bak; } \
    && mv -f "$XR_TMP/xray" /opt/heyearth/xray/xray; then
    XR_REPLACED=1
    echo "[xray] installed $XR_WANT (previous: ${XR_CUR:-none})"
    rm -rf "$XR_TMP"
  else
    rm -rf "$XR_TMP"
    echo "[xray] ERROR: download/sha256/verify of $XR_WANT failed, binary unchanged" >&2
    false
  fi
else
  echo "[xray] $XR_WANT already installed"
fi
`
}

// ExitXrayPrepareScript (converge extra): pinned binary, then `xray run -test` on the new config
// before any restart.
func ExitXrayPrepareScript() string {
	return XrayExitInstallScript() + `if [ "$XR_REPLACED" = 1 ]; then touch ` + RestartMarker("xray") + `; fi
/opt/heyearth/xray/xray run -test -config ` + ExitXrayConfig + ` >/dev/null
`
}

// ExitHysteriaPrepareScript (converge extra): pinned hysteria (HysteriaInstallScript) and the
// self-signed TLS pair; both mark hysteria2 for a restart when they changed something.
func ExitHysteriaPrepareScript() string {
	return HysteriaInstallScript() + `if [ "$HY_REPLACED" = 1 ]; then touch ` + RestartMarker("hysteria2") + `; fi
mkdir -p /opt/heyearth/certs
if [ ! -f /opt/heyearth/certs/hy2.crt ] || [ ! -f /opt/heyearth/certs/hy2.key ]; then
  openssl req -x509 -newkey ec -pkeyopt ec_paramgen_curve:prime256v1 -days 3650 -nodes \
    -keyout /opt/heyearth/certs/hy2.key -out /opt/heyearth/certs/hy2.crt -subj "/CN=www.microsoft.com" 2>/dev/null
  chmod 600 /opt/heyearth/certs/hy2.key
  touch ` + RestartMarker("hysteria2") + `
fi
`
}

// ExitPreflightScript changes nothing; one "PF <check> ok|fail <detail>" line per check.
func ExitPreflightScript() string {
	return `# hp:preflight
. /etc/os-release 2>/dev/null || true
case "${ID:-}" in ubuntu|debian) echo "PF os ok ${PRETTY_NAME:-$ID}" ;; *) echo "PF os fail нужна Ubuntu или Debian, а здесь ${PRETTY_NAME:-неизвестная ОС}" ;; esac
a=$(uname -m); if [ "$a" = x86_64 ]; then echo "PF arch ok x86_64"; else echo "PF arch fail нужна x86_64, а здесь $a"; fi
if [ "$(id -u)" = 0 ]; then echo "PF root ok"; else echo "PF root fail нужен вход под root"; fi
avail=$(df -Pk / | awk 'NR==2{print $4}')
if [ "${avail:-0}" -ge 1048576 ]; then echo "PF disk ok $((avail/1024)) МБ свободно"; else echo "PF disk fail свободно меньше 1 ГБ"; fi
if timeout 10 bash -c 'exec 3<>/dev/tcp/www.gstatic.com/443' 2>/dev/null; then echo "PF internet ok"; else echo "PF internet fail нет выхода в интернет (www.gstatic.com:443)"; fi
for spec in udp:50443:hysteria tcp:10443:xray tcp:50052:node-agent; do
  proto=${spec%%:*}; rest=${spec#*:}; port=${rest%%:*}; own=${rest#*:}
  if [ "$proto" = udp ]; then line=$(ss -Hulpn "sport = :$port" 2>/dev/null); else line=$(ss -Htlpn "sport = :$port" 2>/dev/null); fi
  if [ -z "$line" ] || printf '%s' "$line" | grep -q "\"$own\""; then echo "PF port_$port ok"
  else echo "PF port_$port fail порт $port занят: $(printf '%s' "$line" | grep -o 'users:(("[^"]*"' | head -1)"; fi
done
echo "PF_TIME $(date +%s)"
`
}

const ExitBaseScript = `# hp:base
set -e
sysctl -p /etc/sysctl.d/99-bbr.conf >/dev/null
missing=""
for p in curl unzip nftables openssl ca-certificates; do dpkg -s "$p" >/dev/null 2>&1 || missing="$missing $p"; done
if [ -n "$missing" ]; then
  export DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive
  apt-get update -qq && apt-get install -y -qq $missing
fi
echo "[base] BBR: $(sysctl -n net.ipv4.tcp_congestion_control), пакеты на месте"
`

const ExitBaseCheckScript = `# hp:base-check
if [ "$(sysctl -n net.ipv4.tcp_congestion_control 2>/dev/null)" = bbr ]; then echo BBR=1; else echo BBR=0; fi
ok=1; for p in curl unzip nftables openssl ca-certificates; do dpkg -s "$p" >/dev/null 2>&1 || ok=0; done; echo PKGS=$ok
`

const ExitPortHopApplyScript = `# hp:hop-apply
set -e
nft -f ` + ExitPortHopConfPath + `
systemctl daemon-reload
systemctl enable nftables-hysteria >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
nft list table inet hysteria_porthopping | grep -q 'redirect to :50443'
echo "[hop] UDP ` + ExitHopRange + ` -> :50443"
`

const HysteriaCheckScript = `# hp:hy-check
echo "VERSION=$(/usr/local/bin/hysteria version 2>/dev/null | awk '$1=="Version:"{print $2}')"
if ss -Hulpn 'sport = :50443' 2>/dev/null | grep -q '"hysteria"'; then echo LISTEN=1; else echo LISTEN=0; fi
if nft list table inet hysteria_porthopping 2>/dev/null | grep -q 'redirect to :50443'; then echo HOP=1; else echo HOP=0; fi
`

const XrayCheckScript = `# hp:xray-check
echo "VERSION=$(/opt/heyearth/xray/xray version 2>/dev/null | awk 'NR==1{print $2}')"
if ss -Htlpn 'sport = :10443' 2>/dev/null | grep -q '"xray"'; then echo LISTEN=1; else echo LISTEN=0; fi
`

// HubSSHKeyEnsureScript (run on the Hub): the Hub's own ed25519 key, created once; prints the public line.
const HubSSHKeyEnsureScript = `# hp:hub-key
set -e
K=` + HubSSHKeyPath + `
umask 077
mkdir -p "$(dirname "$K")"
[ -f "$K" ] || ssh-keygen -q -t ed25519 -N '' -C heyearth-hub -f "$K"
cat "$K.pub"
`

// AuthorizedKeyScript appends pub (a validated "ssh-ed25519 AAAA…" line) once.
func AuthorizedKeyScript(pub string) string {
	return "# hp:authkey\nset -e\nKEY=" + shQuote(pub) + "\numask 077\nmkdir -p \"$HOME/.ssh\"\ntouch \"$HOME/.ssh/authorized_keys\"\n" +
		"grep -qxF \"$KEY\" \"$HOME/.ssh/authorized_keys\" || printf '%s\\n' \"$KEY\" >> \"$HOME/.ssh/authorized_keys\"\n" +
		"chmod 700 \"$HOME/.ssh\"\nchmod 600 \"$HOME/.ssh/authorized_keys\"\n"
}

func AuthorizedKeyCheckScript(pub string) string {
	return "# hp:authkey-check\nKEY=" + shQuote(pub) + "\nif grep -qxF \"$KEY\" \"$HOME/.ssh/authorized_keys\" 2>/dev/null; then echo PRESENT=1; else echo PRESENT=0; fi\n"
}

// SocksProbeScript (Hub): generate_204 through a local SOCKS, 3 tries.
func SocksProbeScript(port int) string {
	p := strconv.Itoa(port)
	return "# hp:socks-probe " + p + "\ncode=000\nfor i in 1 2 3; do\n" +
		"  code=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' --max-time 15 --socks5-hostname 127.0.0.1:" + p + " https://www.gstatic.com/generate_204 || true)\n" +
		"  [ \"$code\" = 204 ] && break\n  sleep 3\ndone\necho \"HTTP=$code\"\n"
}

// VRProbeScript (Hub): a short-lived xray with ExitRealityProbeConfig, one generate_204, cleanup.
func VRProbeScript(xrayBin, cfgPath string, port int) string {
	p := strconv.Itoa(port)
	return "# hp:vr-probe " + p + "\n" + shQuote(xrayBin) + " run -config " + shQuote(cfgPath) + " >/dev/null 2>&1 &\npid=$!\n" +
		"trap 'kill $pid 2>/dev/null; rm -f " + shQuote(cfgPath) + "' EXIT\n" +
		"for i in $(seq 1 25); do ss -Htln 'sport = :" + p + "' | grep -q . && break; sleep 0.2; done\n" +
		"code=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' --max-time 15 --socks5-hostname 127.0.0.1:" + p + " https://www.gstatic.com/generate_204 || true)\n" +
		"echo \"HTTP=$code\"\n"
}
```

Контракт `PutFile`: запись через временный файл в том же каталоге + `mv`, сверка sha256 переданного, старая версия → `<path>.bak`, `changed=false` при совпадении содержимого и прав. `Run`: скрипт уходит на stdin обёртки, кладётся во временный 0600-файл и исполняется `bash <file> </dev/null` — секреты не попадают в argv, команды внутри не «съедают» остаток скрипта.

`server/backend/internal/provision/remote_test.go`:

```go
package provision

import (
	"bytes"
	"context"
	"crypto/ed25519"
	"crypto/rand"
	"errors"
	"net"
	"os"
	"os/exec"
	"path/filepath"
	"runtime"
	"strconv"
	"strings"
	"sync/atomic"
	"testing"

	"golang.org/x/crypto/ssh"
)

func haveBash() bool {
	out, err := exec.Command("bash", "-c", "echo ok").Output()
	return err == nil && strings.TrimSpace(string(out)) == "ok"
}

type testSSHD struct {
	addr, fp     string
	host, port   string
	passwordUsed atomic.Int32
}

// startSSHD: ed25519 host key; accepts password (if non-empty) and/or the authorized key; every
// exec request runs as `bash -c <cmd>` in dir with the channel as stdin/stdout.
func startSSHD(t *testing.T, dir, password string, authorized ssh.PublicKey) *testSSHD {
	t.Helper()
	_, priv, _ := ed25519.GenerateKey(rand.Reader)
	signer, _ := ssh.NewSignerFromKey(priv)
	d := &testSSHD{fp: ssh.FingerprintSHA256(signer.PublicKey())}
	cfg := &ssh.ServerConfig{
		PasswordCallback: func(_ ssh.ConnMetadata, pw []byte) (*ssh.Permissions, error) {
			d.passwordUsed.Add(1)
			if password != "" && string(pw) == password {
				return nil, nil
			}
			return nil, errors.New("denied")
		},
		PublicKeyCallback: func(_ ssh.ConnMetadata, k ssh.PublicKey) (*ssh.Permissions, error) {
			if authorized != nil && bytes.Equal(k.Marshal(), authorized.Marshal()) {
				return nil, nil
			}
			return nil, errors.New("denied")
		},
	}
	cfg.AddHostKey(signer)
	ln, err := net.Listen("tcp", "127.0.0.1:0")
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	t.Cleanup(func() { ln.Close() })
	d.addr = ln.Addr().String()
	d.host, d.port, _ = net.SplitHostPort(d.addr)
	go func() {
		for {
			c, err := ln.Accept()
			if err != nil {
				return
			}
			go func() {
				_, chans, reqs, err := ssh.NewServerConn(c, cfg)
				if err != nil {
					c.Close()
					return
				}
				go ssh.DiscardRequests(reqs)
				for nc := range chans {
					ch, in, err := nc.Accept()
					if err != nil {
						continue
					}
					go func() {
						defer ch.Close()
						for req := range in {
							if req.Type != "exec" {
								req.Reply(false, nil)
								continue
							}
							var p struct{ Command string }
							_ = ssh.Unmarshal(req.Payload, &p)
							req.Reply(true, nil)
							cmd := exec.Command("bash", "-c", p.Command)
							cmd.Dir = dir
							cmd.Stdin, cmd.Stdout, cmd.Stderr = ch, ch, ch.Stderr()
							code := 0
							if err := cmd.Run(); err != nil {
								code = 1
								var ee *exec.ExitError
								if errors.As(err, &ee) {
									code = ee.ExitCode()
								}
							}
							ch.SendRequest("exit-status", false, ssh.Marshal(struct{ C uint32 }{uint32(code)}))
							return
						}
					}()
				}
			}()
		}
	}()
	return d
}

func (d *testSSHD) node(fp, pw string, hub ssh.Signer) Node {
	p, _ := strconv.Atoi(d.port)
	return Node{ID: 7, IP: d.host, SSHPort: p, SSHUser: "root", Password: pw, HubSigner: hub, HostKeyFP: fp, HostKeyConfirmed: true}
}

func TestDialNodeNeedsConfirmedKey(t *testing.T) {
	if _, err := DialNode(Node{IP: "203.0.113.7", SSHPort: 22, Password: "pw", HostKeyFP: "SHA256:x"}); !errors.Is(err, ErrHostKeyNotConfirmed) {
		t.Fatalf("unconfirmed key: %v", err)
	}
}

func TestDialNodePinnedAndAuthOrder(t *testing.T) {
	if !haveBash() {
		t.Skip("no bash")
	}
	_, hubPriv, _ := ed25519.GenerateKey(rand.Reader)
	hub, _ := ssh.NewSignerFromKey(hubPriv)
	keyOnly := startSSHD(t, t.TempDir(), "", hub.PublicKey())
	r, err := DialNode(keyOnly.node(keyOnly.fp, "", hub))
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("hub key: %v", err)
	}
	if out, err := r.Run(context.Background(), "echo ok"); err != nil || strings.TrimSpace(out) != "ok" {
		t.Fatalf("run: %q %v", out, err)
	}
	Close(r)
	pwOnly := startSSHD(t, t.TempDir(), "pw", nil)
	if r, err := DialNode(pwOnly.node(pwOnly.fp, "pw", hub)); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("hub key refused, password must follow: %v", err)
	} else {
		Close(r)
	}
	if _, err := DialNode(pwOnly.node("SHA256:AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA", "pw", nil)); err == nil || !strings.Contains(err.Error(), "не совпадает") {
		t.Fatalf("wrong fingerprint accepted: %v", err)
	}
	if pwOnly.passwordUsed.Load() != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("the password went to a host with the wrong key (%d password attempts)", pwOnly.passwordUsed.Load())
	}
}

// The owner sees the fingerprint before any secret leaves the Hub.
func TestProbeNeverAuthenticates(t *testing.T) {
	d := startSSHD(t, t.TempDir(), "pw", nil)
	p, _ := strconv.Atoi(d.port)
	res, err := Probe(context.Background(), d.host, p)
	if err != nil || res.Fingerprint != d.fp || res.KeyType != ssh.KeyAlgoED25519 {
		t.Fatalf("probe: %+v %v (want %s)", res, err, d.fp)
	}
	if d.passwordUsed.Load() != 0 {
		t.Fatal("probe sent a password")
	}
}

func putFileContract(t *testing.T, r Remote, path string, abs string) {
	t.Helper()
	ctx := context.Background()
	for i, tc := range []struct {
		data    string
		changed bool
	}{{"v1\n", true}, {"v1\n", false}, {"v2\n", true}} {
		ch, err := r.PutFile(ctx, path, []byte(tc.data), 0o644)
		if err != nil || ch != tc.changed {
			t.Fatalf("write %d: changed=%v err=%v, want changed=%v", i, ch, err, tc.changed)
		}
	}
	if b, _ := os.ReadFile(abs); string(b) != "v2\n" {
		t.Fatalf("content %q", b)
	}
	if b, _ := os.ReadFile(abs + ".bak"); string(b) != "v1\n" {
		t.Fatalf(".bak %q, want the previous version", b)
	}
	left, _ := filepath.Glob(abs + ".*")
	if len(left) != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("temp files left behind: %v", left)
	}
}

func TestSSHRemoteContract(t *testing.T) {
	if !haveBash() {
		t.Skip("no bash")
	}
	dir := t.TempDir()
	d := startSSHD(t, dir, "pw", nil)
	r, err := DialNode(d.node(d.fp, "pw", nil))

	}
}

func TestLocalRemoteContract(t *testing.T) {
	if !haveBash() {

}
```

```go
// Package provision is the single provisioning core of the admin panel and deploy
// --setup-exit-node: SSH to nodes only with the owner-confirmed host key, idempotent steps
// (apply/verify/rollback), jobs persisted in provision_jobs/provision_steps.
package provision

import (
	"bytes"
	"context"
	"crypto/sha256"
	"encoding/hex"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"io"
	"net"
	"os"
	"os/exec"
	"path/filepath"
	"runtime"
	"strconv"
	"strings"
	"sync"
	"time"
	"unicode/utf8"

	"golang.org/x/crypto/ssh"
)

// Remote runs root shell scripts and installs files on one host: a node over SSH, or the Hub itself.
type Remote interface {
	Run(ctx context.Context, script string) (string, error)
	PutFile(ctx context.Context, path string, data []byte, mode uint32) (changed bool, err error)
}

var (
	ErrHostKeyNotConfirmed = errors.New("отпечаток ключа хоста не подтверждён владельцем")
	ErrNoCredentials       = errors.New("нет SSH-доступа: ни ключа Hub, ни пароля")
	errProbeDone           = errors.New("probe: host key captured")
)

const dialTimeout = 15 * time.Second

// Node is one servers row as provisioning sees it; secrets are decrypted and never serialised.
type Node struct {
	ID, SSHPort, LoadWeight                                                  int
	Name, Role, CountryCode, IP, SSHUser, Lifecycle, MTProtoStatus, HostKeyFP string
	Password                                                                 string     // decrypted ssh_password_enc
	KeySigner                                                                ssh.Signer // legacy ssh_keys row
	HubSigner                                                                ssh.Signer // the Hub's own key, nil until created
	HostKeyConfirmed, FallbackEnabled                                        bool
}

func (n Node) addr() string { return net.JoinHostPort(n.IP, strconv.Itoa(n.SSHPort)) }

func pinned(fp string) ssh.HostKeyCallback {
	return func(host string, _ net.Addr, key ssh.PublicKey) error {
		if got := ssh.FingerprintSHA256(key); got != fp {
			return fmt.Errorf("ключ хоста %s не совпадает с подтверждённым (%s ≠ %s)", host, got, fp)
		}
		return nil
	}
}

// DialNode connects only with the confirmed ed25519 host key. Auth order: Hub key, legacy
// ssh_keys key, password (the password is never offered before the host key matched).
func DialNode(n Node) (Remote, error) {
	if !n.HostKeyConfirmed || strings.TrimSpace(n.HostKeyFP) == "" {
		return nil, ErrHostKeyNotConfirmed
	}
	var signers []ssh.Signer
	for _, s := range []ssh.Signer{n.HubSigner, n.KeySigner} {
		if s != nil {
			signers = append(signers, s)
		}
	}
	var auth []ssh.AuthMethod
	if len(signers) > 0 {
		auth = append(auth, ssh.PublicKeys(signers...))
	}
	if n.Password != "" {
		auth = append(auth, ssh.Password(n.Password))
	}
	if len(auth) == 0 {
		return nil, ErrNoCredentials
	}
	user := n.SSHUser
	if user == "" {
		user = "root"
	}
	c, err := ssh.Dial("tcp", n.addr(), &ssh.ClientConfig{User: user, Auth: auth, HostKeyCallback: pinned(n.HostKeyFP),
		HostKeyAlgorithms: []string{ssh.KeyAlgoED25519}, Timeout: dialTimeout})
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("ssh %s: %w", n.addr(), err)
	}
	return &SSHRemote{client: c}, nil
}

type ProbeResult struct {
	Fingerprint string `json:"fingerprint"`
	KeyType     string `json:"key_type"`
}

// Probe runs only the SSH key exchange and aborts in the host-key callback: no user name
// matters, no password or key is ever offered.
func Probe(ctx context.Context, ip string, port int) (ProbeResult, error) {
	addr := net.JoinHostPort(ip, strconv.Itoa(port))
	conn, err := (&net.Dialer{Timeout: dialTimeout}).DialContext(ctx, "tcp", addr)
	if err != nil {
		return ProbeResult{}, fmt.Errorf("нет TCP-соединения с %s: %w", addr, err)
	}
	defer conn.Close()
	_ = conn.SetDeadline(time.Now().Add(dialTimeout))
	var res ProbeResult
	_, _, _, err = ssh.NewClientConn(conn, addr, &ssh.ClientConfig{User: "probe",
		HostKeyCallback: func(_ string, _ net.Addr, key ssh.PublicKey) error {
			res = ProbeResult{Fingerprint: ssh.FingerprintSHA256(key), KeyType: key.Type()}
			return errProbeDone
		},
		HostKeyAlgorithms: []string{ssh.KeyAlgoED25519}})
	if res.Fingerprint != "" {
		return res, nil
	}
	return ProbeResult{}, fmt.Errorf("SSH на %s не предъявил ключ ed25519: %w", addr, err)
}

// SSHRemote runs on a node (or, in the deploy CLI, on the Hub) over one SSH client.
type SSHRemote struct {
	client   *ssh.Client
	borrowed bool
}

// NewSSHRemote wraps a client owned by the caller (deploy CLI's session to the Hub).
func NewSSHRemote(c *ssh.Client) *SSHRemote { return &SSHRemote{client: c, borrowed: true} }

func (r *SSHRemote) Close() error {
	if r.borrowed {
		return nil
	}
	return r.client.Close()
}

// Close closes r when it owns a connection.
func Close(r Remote) {
	if c, ok := r.(io.Closer); ok {
		_ = c.Close()
	}
}

// runWrapper is what the remote login shell executes; the script itself arrives on stdin.
const runWrapper = `umask 077; t=$(mktemp /tmp/heyearth-run.XXXXXX) || exit 1; cat > "$t"; bash "$t" </dev/null; rc=$?; rm -f "$t"; exit $rc`

func (r *SSHRemote) Run(ctx context.Context, script string) (string, error) {
	return r.exec(ctx, runWrapper, strings.NewReader(script))
}

func (r *SSHRemote) PutFile(ctx context.Context, path string, data []byte, mode uint32) (bool, error) {
	sum := sha256Hex(data)
	cur, err := r.Run(ctx, statScript(path))
	if err != nil {
		return false, err
	}
	if strings.TrimSpace(cur) == sum+" "+modeString(mode) {
		return false, nil
	}
	if _, err := r.exec(ctx, putScript(path, sum, mode), bytes.NewReader(data)); err != nil {
		return false, fmt.Errorf("запись %s: %w", path, err)
	}
	return true, nil
}

func (r *SSHRemote) exec(ctx context.Context, cmd string, stdin io.Reader) (string, error) {
	sess, err := r.client.NewSession()
	if err != nil {
		return "", fmt.Errorf("ssh-сессия: %w", err)
	}
	defer sess.Close()
	var out lockedBuffer
	sess.Stdout, sess.Stderr, sess.Stdin = &out, &out, stdin
	done := make(chan error, 1)
	go func() { done <- sess.Run(cmd) }()
	select {
	case err := <-done:
		if err != nil {
			return out.String(), fmt.Errorf("%w: %s", err, tail(out.String(), 2000))
		}
		return out.String(), nil
	case <-ctx.Done():
		_ = sess.Signal(ssh.SIGKILL)
		_ = sess.Close()
		return out.String(), ctx.Err()
	}
}

func statScript(path string) string {
	q := shQuote(path)
	return "if [ -f " + q + " ]; then printf '%s %s\\n' \"$(sha256sum " + q + " | cut -c1-64)\" \"$(stat -c %a " + q + ")\"; fi\n"
}

// putScript (run by the login shell, data on stdin): temp file next to the target, sha256 of
// what arrived, chmod, previous version → .bak, atomic mv.
func putScript(path, sum string, mode uint32) string {
	return "set -e; p=" + shQuote(path) + "; mkdir -p \"$(dirname \"$p\")\"; t=$(mktemp \"$p.XXXXXX\"); trap 'rm -f \"$t\"' EXIT; cat > \"$t\"; " +
		"[ \"$(sha256sum \"$t\" | cut -c1-64)\" = " + sum + " ] || { echo 'контрольная сумма не совпала' >&2; exit 1; }; " +
		"chmod " + modeString(mode) + " \"$t\"; if [ -f \"$p\" ]; then cp -p \"$p\" \"$p.bak\"; fi; mv -f \"$t\" \"$p\"; trap - EXIT"
}

// LocalRemote is heyearth-api on the Hub itself (root).
type LocalRemote struct{}

func (LocalRemote) Run(ctx context.Context, script string) (string, error) {
	f, err := os.CreateTemp("", "heyearth-run-*.sh")
	if err != nil {
		return "", err
	}
	defer os.Remove(f.Name())
	if _, err := f.WriteString(script); err != nil {
		f.Close()
		return "", err
	}
	f.Close()
	cmd := exec.CommandContext(ctx, "bash", filepath.ToSlash(f.Name()))
	var out lockedBuffer
	cmd.Stdout, cmd.Stderr = &out, &out
	if err := cmd.Run(); err != nil {
		return out.String(), fmt.Errorf("%w: %s", err, tail(out.String(), 2000))
	}
	return out.String(), nil
}

func (LocalRemote) PutFile(_ context.Context, path string, data []byte, mode uint32) (bool, error) {
	if cur, err := os.ReadFile(path); err == nil && bytes.Equal(cur, data) {
		if st, err := os.Stat(path); err == nil && (runtime.GOOS == "windows" || uint32(st.Mode().Perm()) == mode) {
			return false, nil
		}
	}
	if err := os.MkdirAll(filepath.Dir(path), 0o755); err != nil {
		return false, err
	}
	tmp, err := os.CreateTemp(filepath.Dir(path), filepath.Base(path)+".tmp*")
	if err != nil {
		return false, err
	}
	defer os.Remove(tmp.Name())
	if _, err := tmp.Write(data); err != nil {
		tmp.Close()
		return false, err
	}
	if err := tmp.Chmod(os.FileMode(mode)); err != nil && runtime.GOOS != "windows" {
		tmp.Close()
		return false, err
	}
	if err := tmp.Close(); err != nil {
		return false, err
	}
	if old, err := os.ReadFile(path); err == nil {
		if err := os.WriteFile(path+".bak", old, os.FileMode(mode)); err != nil {
			return false, err
		}
	}
	return true, os.Rename(tmp.Name(), path)
}

type lockedBuffer struct {
	mu sync.Mutex
	b  bytes.Buffer
}

func (l *lockedBuffer) Write(p []byte) (int, error) { l.mu.Lock(); defer l.mu.Unlock(); return l.b.Write(p) }
func (l *lockedBuffer) String() string             { l.mu.Lock(); defer l.mu.Unlock(); return l.b.String() }

// tail returns the last n bytes of s, starting on a rune boundary.
func tail(s string, n int) string {
	if len(s) <= n {
		return s
	}
	i := len(s) - n
	for i < len(s) && !utf8.RuneStart(s[i]) {
		i++
	}
	return s[i:]
}

func shQuote(s string) string       { return "'" + strings.ReplaceAll(s, "'", `'\''`) + "'" }
func modeString(m uint32) string     { return strconv.FormatUint(uint64(m), 8) }
func sha256Hex(b []byte) string      { s := sha256.Sum256(b); return hex.EncodeToString(s[:]) }
```

```go
package provision

import (
	"context"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"slices"
	"strings"
	"sync"
	"testing"
)

type memJob struct {
	Job
	Error string
	Steps []StepView
}

type memStore struct {
	mu    sync.Mutex
	node  Node
	hooks *fakeHooks
	jobs  map[int64]*memJob
	next  int64
}

func newMemStore(n Node, h *fakeHooks) *memStore { return &memStore{node: n, hooks: h, jobs: map[int64]*memJob{}} }

func (m *memStore) LoadNode(context.Context, int) (Node, error) {
	n := m.node
	n.Lifecycle = m.hooks.lifecycle
	return n, nil
}
func (m *memStore) CreateJob(_ context.Context, sid int, kind string) (int64, error) {
	m.mu.Lock()
	defer m.mu.Unlock()
	for _, j := range m.jobs {
		if j.ServerID == sid && j.Status == JobRunning {
			return 0, ErrJobActive
		}
	}
	m.next++
	m.jobs[m.next] = &memJob{Job: Job{ID: m.next, ServerID: sid, Kind: kind, Status: JobRunning}}
	return m.next, nil
}
func (m *memStore) ReopenJob(_ context.Context, id int64) (Job, error) {
	m.mu.Lock()
	defer m.mu.Unlock()
	j := m.jobs[id]
	if j == nil || (j.Status != JobInterrupted && j.Status != JobFailed) {
		return Job{}, ErrJobNotResumable
	}
	j.Status, j.Error = JobRunning, ""
	return j.Job, nil
}
func (m *memStore) SetSteps(_ context.Context, id int64, names []string) error {
	m.mu.Lock()
	defer m.mu.Unlock()
	m.jobs[id].Steps = nil
	for i, n := range names {
		m.jobs[id].Steps = append(m.jobs[id].Steps, StepView{Idx: i, Name: n, Status: StepPending})
	}
	return nil
}
func (m *memStore) MarkStep(_ context.Context, id int64, idx int, status, out string) error {
	m.mu.Lock()
	defer m.mu.Unlock()
	m.jobs[id].Steps[idx].Status, m.jobs[id].Steps[idx].OutputTail = status, out
	return nil
}
func (m *memStore) FinishJob(_ context.Context, id int64, status, msg string) error {
	m.mu.Lock()
	defer m.mu.Unlock()
	m.jobs[id].Status, m.jobs[id].Error = status, msg
	return nil
}
func (m *memStore) InterruptRunning(context.Context) (int64, error) {
	m.mu.Lock()
	defer m.mu.Unlock()
	var n int64
	for _, j := range m.jobs {
		if j.Status == JobRunning {
			j.Status = JobInterrupted
			n++
			for i := range j.Steps {
				if j.Steps[i].Status == StepRunning {
					j.Steps[i].Status = StepInterrupted
				}
			}
		}
	}
	return n, nil
}
func (m *memStore) statuses(id int64) []string {
	var s []string
	for _, st := range m.jobs[id].Steps {
		s = append(s, st.Name+"="+st.Status)
	}
	return s
}

type fakeHooks struct {
	lifecycle    string
	tunnelStatus string
	history      []string
	tunnel    Tunnel
	syncs     int
	bumps     int
	mtproto   []string
}

func (f *fakeHooks) Hooks() Hooks {
	return Hooks{
		Lifecycle: func(context.Context, int) (string, error) { return f.lifecycle, nil },
		SetLifecycle: func(_ context.Context, _ int, from []string, to string) error {
			if f.lifecycle == to {
				return nil
			}
			if !slices.Contains(from, f.lifecycle) {
				return fmt.Errorf("переход %s → %s запрещён", f.lifecycle, to)
			}
			f.lifecycle = to
			f.history = append(f.history, to)
			return nil
		},
		LoadTunnel: func(context.Context, int) (Tunnel, error) { return f.tunnel, nil },
		SaveTunnel: func(_ context.Context, _ int, t Tunnel) (bool, error) {
			if f.tunnel == t {
				return false, nil
			}
			f.tunnel = t
			return true, nil
		},
		ForgetTunnel: func(context.Context, int) error { f.tunnel.Password = ""; return nil },
		Activate: func(context.Context, int) error {
			if f.lifecycle != "provisioning" {
				return fmt.Errorf("activate from %s", f.lifecycle)
			}
			f.lifecycle, f.tunnelStatus = "online", "healthy"
			f.history = append(f.history, "online")
			return nil
		},
		MarkMTProto:      func(_ context.Context, _ int, s string) error { f.mtproto = append(f.mtproto, s); return nil },
		BumpSubscription: func(context.Context) error { f.bumps++; return nil },
		RequestSync:      func() { f.syncs++ },
	}
}

type nopRemote struct{}

func (nopRemote) Run(context.Context, string) (string, error)                 { return "", nil }
func (nopRemote) PutFile(context.Context, string, []byte, uint32) (bool, error) { return false, nil }

func testRunner(store *memStore, h *fakeHooks, recipe func(kind string, st *State) Recipe) *Runner {
	return &Runner{Store: store, Go: func(f func()) { f() },
		Dial: func(Node) (Remote, error) { return nopRemote{}, nil },
		Recipe: func(_ context.Context, n Node, kind string) (Recipe, *State, error) {
			st := NewState(kind, n, nopRemote{}, h.Hooks())
			return recipe(kind, st), st, nil
		}}
}

func TestRunnerConverges(t *testing.T) {
	h := &fakeHooks{lifecycle: "pending"}
	store := newMemStore(Node{ID: 7}, h)
	var applyA, applyB int
	fixed := false
	r := testRunner(store, h, func(string, *State) Recipe {
		return Recipe{
			{Name: "a", Verify: func(context.Context, Remote, *State) error { return nil }, Apply: func(context.Context, Remote, *State) error { applyA++; return nil }},
			{Name: "b", Verify: func(context.Context, Remote, *State) error {
				if !fixed {
					return errors.New("not yet")
				}
				return nil
			}, Apply: func(context.Context, Remote, *State) error { applyB++; fixed = true; return nil }},
		}
	})
	id, err := r.Start(context.Background(), 7, KindProvision)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if got := store.statuses(id); !slices.Equal(got, []string{"a=ok", "b=done"}) || applyA != 0 || applyB != 1 || store.jobs[id].Status != JobSucceeded {
		t.Fatalf("statuses %v applyA=%d applyB=%d job=%s", got, applyA, applyB, store.jobs[id].Status)
	}
}

func TestRunnerRollsBackAndStops(t *testing.T) {
	h := &fakeHooks{lifecycle: "pending"}
	store := newMemStore(Node{ID: 7}, h)
	rolled, failHook := false, false
	r := testRunner(store, h, func(_ string, st *State) Recipe {
		st.Fail = func(context.Context) { failHook = true }
		return Recipe{
			{Name: "hysteria", Apply: func(context.Context, Remote, *State) error { return nil },
				Verify:   func(context.Context, Remote, *State) error { return errors.New("не слушает :50443") },
				Rollback: func(context.Context, Remote, *State) error { rolled = true; return nil }},
			{Name: "xray", Apply: func(context.Context, Remote, *State) error { t.Fatal("ran after a failed step"); return nil }},
		}
	})
	id, _ := r.Start(context.Background(), 7, KindProvision)
	j := store.jobs[id]
	if !rolled || !failHook || j.Status != JobFailed || !strings.Contains(j.Error, Title("hysteria")) ||
		!slices.Equal(store.statuses(id), []string{"hysteria=rolled_back", "xray=pending"}) {
		t.Fatalf("rolled=%v fail=%v job=%+v steps=%v", rolled, failHook, j.Job, store.statuses(id))
	}
}

func TestRunnerVerifyKindNeverApplies(t *testing.T) {
	h := &fakeHooks{lifecycle: "online"}
	store := newMemStore(Node{ID: 2}, h)
	r := testRunner(store, h, func(string, *State) Recipe {
		apply := func(context.Context, Remote, *State) error { t.Fatal("Apply in verify mode"); return nil }
		return Recipe{
			{Name: "ok", Apply: apply, Verify: func(context.Context, Remote, *State) error { return nil }},
			{Name: "drift", Apply: apply, Verify: func(context.Context, Remote, *State) error { return errors.New("файл отличается") }},
			{Name: "noverify", Apply: apply},
		}
	})
	id, _ := r.Start(context.Background(), 2, KindVerify)
	if got := store.statuses(id); !slices.Equal(got, []string{"ok=ok", "drift=drift", "noverify=skipped"}) || store.jobs[id].Status != JobSucceeded {
		t.Fatalf("%v %s", got, store.jobs[id].Status)
	}
}

func TestRunnerOneActiveJobAndResumeAfterRestart(t *testing.T) {
	h := &fakeHooks{lifecycle: "pending"}
	store := newMemStore(Node{ID: 7}, h)
	runs := 0
	r := testRunner(store, h, func(string, *State) Recipe {
		return Recipe{{Name: "a", Apply: func(context.Context, Remote, *State) error { runs++; return nil }}}
	})
	r.Go = func(func()) {} // the API dies before the goroutine runs
	id, err := r.Start(context.Background(), 7, KindProvision)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if _, err := r.Start(context.Background(), 7, KindProvision); !errors.Is(err, ErrJobActive) {
		t.Fatalf("second job: %v", err)
	}
	if n, _ := store.InterruptRunning(context.Background()); n != 1 || store.jobs[id].Status != JobInterrupted {
		t.Fatalf("restart must mark the job interrupted: %d %s", n, store.jobs[id].Status)
	}
	r.Go = func(f func()) { f() }
	if err := r.Resume(context.Background(), id); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if store.jobs[id].Status != JobSucceeded || runs != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("resume: %s runs=%d", store.jobs[id].Status, runs)
	}
	if err := r.Resume(context.Background(), id); !errors.Is(err, ErrJobNotResumable) {
		t.Fatalf("a succeeded job is not resumable: %v", err)
	}
}

func TestRunnerRedactsAndTrims(t *testing.T) {
	h := &fakeHooks{lifecycle: "pending"}
	store := newMemStore(Node{ID: 7, Password: "root-Pa55word"}, h)
	r := testRunner(store, h, func(_ string, st *State) Recipe {
		st.AddSecret("tunnel-S3cret==")
		return Recipe{{Name: "a", Apply: func(_ context.Context, _ Remote, s *State) error {
			s.Printf("%s", strings.Repeat("ш", 20000))
			s.Printf("pw=root-Pa55word tunnel=tunnel-S3cret==")
			return errors.New("ssh: auth root-Pa55word failed")
		}}}
	})
	id, _ := r.Start(context.Background(), 7, KindProvision)
	out := store.jobs[id].Steps[0].OutputTail
	if len(out) > MaxOutputTail || strings.Contains(out, "Pa55word") || strings.Contains(out, "S3cret") ||
		strings.Contains(store.jobs[id].Error, "Pa55word") || !strings.Contains(out, "pw=*** tunnel=***") {
		t.Fatalf("len=%d tail=%q err=%q", len(out), out[max(0, len(out)-120):], store.jobs[id].Error)
	}
}

func TestRunnerSkippedAndUnreachable(t *testing.T) {
	h := &fakeHooks{lifecycle: "online"}
	store := newMemStore(Node{ID: 7}, h)
	var runErr error
	r := testRunner(store, h, func(string, *State) Recipe {
		return Recipe{
			{Name: "node", Apply: func(ctx context.Context, rm Remote, s *State) error {
				_, runErr = rm.Run(ctx, "true")
				return fmt.Errorf("%w: %v", ErrSkipped, runErr)
			}},
			{Name: "after", Apply: func(context.Context, Remote, *State) error { return nil }},
		}
	})
	r.Dial = func(Node) (Remote, error) { return nil, errors.New("dial tcp: i/o timeout") }
	id, _ := r.Start(context.Background(), 7, KindDeprovision)
	if !errors.Is(runErr, ErrNodeUnreachable) || !slices.Equal(store.statuses(id), []string{"node=skipped", "after=done"}) {
		t.Fatalf("runErr=%v steps=%v", runErr, store.statuses(id))
	}
}
```

```go
package provision

import (
	"errors"
	"regexp"
	"strings"
	"testing"

	"github.com/lib/pq"
)

func norm(s string) string { return strings.Join(strings.Fields(s), " ") }

func TestSQLShapes(t *testing.T) {
	for name, c := range map[string]struct{ q, want string }{
		"create runs at once":             {createJobQuery, "VALUES ($1, $2, 'running', NOW())"},
		"resume only interrupted/failed":  {reopenJobQuery, "status IN ('interrupted', 'failed')"},
		"restart interrupts active jobs":  {interruptJobsQuery, "WHERE status IN ('queued', 'running')"},
		"lifecycle guarded by from-state": {setLifecycleQuery, "lifecycle_state = ANY($3)"},
		"private key never kept":          {saveTunnelQuery, "tunnel_private_key = NULL"},
		"online and healthy in one write": {activateQuery, "SET lifecycle_state = 'online', tunnel_status = 'healthy'"},
		"tunnel write only on change":     {saveTunnelQuery, "tunnel_ss_password IS DISTINCT FROM $6"},
		"paid plans":                      {paidPlansQuery, "is_active = TRUE AND price_rub > 0"},
	} {
		if !strings.Contains(norm(c.q), norm(c.want)) {
			t.Errorf("%s: %q lacks %q", name, norm(c.q), c.want)
		}
	}
	if regexp.MustCompile(`ssh_password[^_]`).MatchString(loadNodeQuery) {
		t.Error("LoadNode must read only ssh_password_enc (plaintext passwords are migrated away)")
	}
}

func TestUniqueViolationIsJobActive(t *testing.T) {
	if !errors.Is(mapActive(&pq.Error{Code: "23505"}), ErrJobActive) {
		t.Error("23505 on uq_provision_jobs_active must become ErrJobActive")
	}
	if other := errors.New("x"); mapActive(other) != other {
		t.Error("other errors pass through")
	}
}
```

`server/backend/internal/provision/state.go`:

```go
package provision

import (
	"context"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"sort"
	"strings"
	"time"
	"unicode/utf8"

	"github.com/heyearth/backend/internal/config"
)

type Step struct {
	Name     string
	Apply    func(ctx context.Context, r Remote, s *State) error
	Verify   func(ctx context.Context, r Remote, s *State) error
	Rollback func(ctx context.Context, r Remote, s *State) error
}

type Recipe []Step

// ErrSkipped from Apply: the step deliberately did nothing (it printed why); the job goes on.
var ErrSkipped = errors.New("шаг пропущен")

// Tunnel is what servers.tunnel_* must say about an exit. Stale: a legacy private key or a
// protocol/port other than hysteria2:50443 is still stored.
type Tunnel struct {
	UUID, PublicKey, ShortID, SNI, Password string
	Stale                                   bool
}

// Hooks are the database/Hub side effects of recipes (SQLStore.Hooks in the API and the CLI).
type Hooks struct {
	Lifecycle        func(ctx context.Context, serverID int) (string, error)
	SetLifecycle     func(ctx context.Context, serverID int, from []string, to string) error
	LoadTunnel       func(ctx context.Context, serverID int) (Tunnel, error)
	SaveTunnel       func(ctx context.Context, serverID int, t Tunnel) (changed bool, err error)
	ForgetTunnel     func(ctx context.Context, serverID int) error
	// Activate: provisioning → online AND tunnel_status healthy in ONE write, after the recipe
	// checked both paths itself (phase-1 contract: adding an exit costs exactly one Xray restart).
	Activate func(ctx context.Context, serverID int) error
	MarkMTProto      func(ctx context.Context, serverID int, status string) error
	BumpSubscription func(ctx context.Context) error
	RequestSync      func()                                     // xray + hysteria sync; never restarts the API
	ProbeAgent       func(ctx context.Context, ip string) error // nil: not checked (deploy CLI)
}

// State is one job run: the node, the Hub, options, and what steps learnt (keys, changed files).
type State struct {
	Node  Node
	Kind  string
	Hub   Remote
	Exit  ExitOptions
	Hooks Hooks
	Keys  config.ExitRealityKeys
	Begin func(ctx context.Context) error // before the first step (lifecycle → provisioning)
	Fail  func(ctx context.Context)       // after a failed step (provisioning → failed)
	Now   func() time.Time
	Sleep func(ctx context.Context, d time.Duration) error

	out     *tailBuffer
	secrets []string
	changed map[string][]string // unit → files written in this run (rollback restores only these)
}

func NewState(kind string, n Node, hub Remote, h Hooks) *State {
	return &State{Node: n, Kind: kind, Hub: hub, Hooks: h, Now: time.Now, Sleep: sleepCtx, changed: map[string][]string{}}
}

func sleepCtx(ctx context.Context, d time.Duration) error {
	t := time.NewTimer(d)
	defer t.Stop()
	select {
	case <-t.C:
		return nil
	case <-ctx.Done():
		return ctx.Err()
	}
}

// Printf appends a line to the current step's output (redacted and trimmed before it is stored).
func (s *State) Printf(format string, a ...any) {
	msg := strings.TrimRight(fmt.Sprintf(format, a...), "\n")
	if s.out != nil && msg != "" {
		s.out.WriteString(msg + "\n")
	}
}

func (s *State) AddSecret(v ...string) { s.secrets = append(s.secrets, v...) }

// Secrets never reach provision_steps.output_tail or provision_jobs.error.
func (s *State) Secrets() []string {
	all := append([]string{s.Node.Password, s.Keys.PrivateKey, s.Keys.SSPassword}, s.secrets...)
	if s.Exit.MTProto != nil {
		all = append(all, s.Exit.MTProto.Secret)
	}
	var out []string
	for _, v := range all {
		if len(v) >= 6 {
			out = append(out, v)
		}
	}
	return out
}

func (s *State) noteChanged(unit, path string) { s.changed[unit] = append(s.changed[unit], path) }

func (s *State) needKeys() error {
	if s.Keys.UUID == "" || s.Keys.SSPassword == "" || s.Keys.PrivateKey == "" {
		return errors.New("ключи туннеля не прочитаны (шаг «Ключи туннеля»)")
	}
	return nil
}

func redact(text string, secrets []string) string {
	sorted := append([]string(nil), secrets...)
	sort.Slice(sorted, func(i, j int) bool { return len(sorted[i]) > len(sorted[j]) })
	for _, sec := range sorted {
		text = strings.ReplaceAll(text, sec, "***")
	}
	return text
}

// tailBuffer keeps the last max bytes (rune-aligned).
type tailBuffer struct {
	max int
	b   []byte
}

func (t *tailBuffer) WriteString(s string) {
	t.b = append(t.b, s...)
	if len(t.b) > t.max {
		cut := len(t.b) - t.max
		for cut < len(t.b) && !utf8.RuneStart(t.b[cut]) {
			cut++
		}
		t.b = append([]byte(nil), t.b[cut:]...)
	}
}

func (t *tailBuffer) String() string { return string(t.b) }

var titles = map[string]string{
	"preflight": "Предпроверка сервера", "hub_key": "Ключ Hub на ноде", "reality_keys": "Ключи туннеля",
	"base": "Сеть и пакеты", "firewall": "Фаервол", "hysteria": "Основной туннель (Hysteria) и прыжки портов",
	"xray": "Запасной TCP-туннель (Reality)", "mtproxy": "Telegram-прокси (MTProxy)", "node_agent": "Агент мониторинга",
	"save_tunnel": "Данные туннеля в базе", "hub_client": "Клиент туннеля на Hub",
	"path_hy": "Проверка пути: основной туннель", "path_tcp": "Проверка пути: запасной TCP",
	"activate": "Включение в маршрутизацию", "exclude": "Исключение из маршрутизации",
	"hub_client_remove": "Удаление клиента туннеля на Hub", "rotate_password": "Смена пароля туннеля",
	"stop_services": "Остановка сервисов на ноде", "remove_hop": "Снятие правил прыжков портов", "finalize": "Нода отключена",
}

// Title is the owner-facing name of a step (admin UI and CLI).
func Title(name string) string {
	if t, ok := titles[name]; ok {
		return t
	}
	return name
}
```

`server/backend/internal/provision/runner.go`:

```go
package provision

import (
	"context"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"strings"
	"sync"
	"time"
)

const (
	KindProvision   = "provision"
	KindReprovision = "reprovision"
	KindDeprovision = "deprovision"
	KindVerify      = "verify"

	JobRunning     = "running"
	JobSucceeded   = "succeeded"
	JobFailed      = "failed"
	JobInterrupted = "interrupted"

	StepPending     = "pending"
	StepRunning     = "running"
	StepOK          = "ok"
	StepDone        = "done"
	StepSkipped     = "skipped"
	StepDrift       = "drift"
	StepFailed      = "failed"
	StepRolledBack  = "rolled_back"
	StepInterrupted = "interrupted"

	MaxOutputTail = 8 << 10
	JobTimeout    = 40 * time.Minute // first MTProxy build alone may take 12 min
)

var (
	ErrJobActive       = errors.New("для этой ноды уже выполняется задача")
	ErrJobNotResumable = errors.New("задачу нельзя продолжить: она не прервана и не завершилась ошибкой")
	ErrNodeUnreachable = errors.New("нода недоступна по SSH")
)

type Job struct {
	ID       int64
	ServerID int
	Kind     string
	Status   string
}

// Store persists jobs (SQLStore; an in-memory one in tests).
type Store interface {
	LoadNode(ctx context.Context, serverID int) (Node, error)
	CreateJob(ctx context.Context, serverID int, kind string) (int64, error) // ErrJobActive
	ReopenJob(ctx context.Context, jobID int64) (Job, error)                 // ErrJobActive / ErrJobNotResumable
	SetSteps(ctx context.Context, jobID int64, names []string) error
	MarkStep(ctx context.Context, jobID int64, idx int, status, outputTail string) error
	FinishJob(ctx context.Context, jobID int64, status, errMsg string) error
	InterruptRunning(ctx context.Context) (int64, error)
}

type Runner struct {
	Store  Store
	Dial   func(Node) (Remote, error) // DialNode
	Recipe func(ctx context.Context, n Node, kind string) (Recipe, *State, error)
	Go     func(func()) // nil: go f()
	Logf   func(format string, a ...any)
}

func ValidKind(k string) bool {
	switch k {
	case KindProvision, KindReprovision, KindDeprovision, KindVerify:
		return true
	}
	return false
}

// Start creates the job (one active job per node, enforced by the database) and runs it in the background.
func (r *Runner) Start(ctx context.Context, serverID int, kind string) (int64, error) {
	if !ValidKind(kind) {
		return 0, fmt.Errorf("неизвестный вид задачи %q", kind)
	}
	n, err := r.Store.LoadNode(ctx, serverID)
	if err != nil {
		return 0, err
	}
	recipe, st, err := r.Recipe(ctx, n, kind)
	if err != nil {
		return 0, err
	}
	id, err := r.Store.CreateJob(ctx, serverID, kind)
	if err != nil {
		return 0, err
	}
	if err := r.Store.SetSteps(ctx, id, stepNames(recipe)); err != nil {
		r.finish(id, JobFailed, err.Error())
		return id, err
	}
	r.spawn(func() { r.run(id, n, recipe, st) })
	return id, nil
}

// Resume re-runs an interrupted or failed job from its first step (steps are idempotent).
func (r *Runner) Resume(ctx context.Context, jobID int64) error {
	job, err := r.Store.ReopenJob(ctx, jobID)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	fail := func(err error) error { r.finish(jobID, JobFailed, err.Error()); return err }
	n, err := r.Store.LoadNode(ctx, job.ServerID)
	if err != nil {
		return fail(err)
	}
	recipe, st, err := r.Recipe(ctx, n, job.Kind)
	if err != nil {
		return fail(err)
	}
	if err := r.Store.SetSteps(ctx, jobID, stepNames(recipe)); err != nil {
		return fail(err)
	}
	r.spawn(func() { r.run(jobID, n, recipe, st) })
	return nil
}

func stepNames(rc Recipe) []string {
	names := make([]string, len(rc))
	for i, s := range rc {
		names[i] = s.Name
	}
	return names
}

func (r *Runner) spawn(f func()) {
	if r.Go != nil {
		r.Go(f)
		return
	}
	go f()
}

func (r *Runner) logf(format string, a ...any) {
	if r.Logf != nil {
		r.Logf(format, a...)
	}
}

// Bookkeeping writes use their own short context: they must land even when the job's expired.
func (r *Runner) finish(id int64, status, msg string) {
	ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 10*time.Second)
	defer cancel()
	if err := r.Store.FinishJob(ctx, id, status, msg); err != nil {
		r.logf("[provision] job %d finish: %v", id, err)
	}
}

func (r *Runner) mark(id int64, idx int, status, out string) {
	ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 10*time.Second)
	defer cancel()
	if err := r.Store.MarkStep(ctx, id, idx, status, out); err != nil {
		r.logf("[provision] job %d step %d: %v", id, idx, err)
	}
}

func (r *Runner) run(jobID int64, n Node, recipe Recipe, st *State) {
	ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), JobTimeout)
	defer cancel()
	node := &lazyRemote{dial: func() (Remote, error) { return r.Dial(n) }}
	defer node.close()
	if st.Begin != nil {
		if err := st.Begin(ctx); err != nil {
			r.finish(jobID, JobFailed, redact(err.Error(), st.Secrets()))
			return
		}
	}
	for i, step := range recipe {
		buf := &tailBuffer{max: 8 * MaxOutputTail}
		st.out = buf
		r.mark(jobID, i, StepRunning, "")
		status, err := runStep(ctx, st.Kind, step, node, st)
		text := buf.String()
		if err != nil {
			text += err.Error()
		}
		st.out = nil
		r.mark(jobID, i, status, tail(redact(strings.TrimSpace(text), st.Secrets()), MaxOutputTail))
		if status == StepFailed || status == StepRolledBack {
			if st.Fail != nil {
				fctx, fcancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 10*time.Second)
				st.Fail(fctx)
				fcancel()
			}
			msg := redact(fmt.Sprintf("шаг «%s»: %v", Title(step.Name), err), st.Secrets())
			r.finish(jobID, JobFailed, msg)
			r.logf("[provision] job %d (node %d, %s): %s", jobID, n.ID, st.Kind, msg)
			return
		}
	}
	r.finish(jobID, JobSucceeded, "")
	r.logf("[provision] job %d (node %d, %s): готово", jobID, n.ID, st.Kind)
}

// runStep: verify → (apply → verify) with rollback on failure; verify jobs never apply.
func runStep(ctx context.Context, kind string, s Step, r Remote, st *State) (string, error) {
	if kind == KindVerify {
		if s.Verify == nil {
			st.Printf("в режиме проверки этот шаг не выполняется")
			return StepSkipped, nil
		}
		if err := s.Verify(ctx, r, st); err != nil {
			st.Printf("расхождение: %v", err)
			return StepDrift, nil
		}
		return StepOK, nil
	}
	if s.Verify != nil {
		verr := s.Verify(ctx, r, st)
		if verr == nil {
			return StepOK, nil
		}
		if s.Apply == nil {
			return StepFailed, verr
		}
		st.Printf("нужна настройка: %v", verr)
	}
	if s.Apply == nil {
		return StepOK, nil
	}
	if err := s.Apply(ctx, r, st); err != nil {
		if errors.Is(err, ErrSkipped) {
			return StepSkipped, nil
		}
		return rollback(ctx, s, r, st, err)
	}
	if s.Verify != nil {
		if err := s.Verify(ctx, r, st); err != nil {
			return rollback(ctx, s, r, st, fmt.Errorf("после настройки проверка не прошла: %w", err))
		}
	}
	return StepDone, nil
}

func rollback(ctx context.Context, s Step, r Remote, st *State, cause error) (string, error) {
	if s.Rollback == nil {
		return StepFailed, cause
	}
	if err := s.Rollback(ctx, r, st); err != nil {
		return StepFailed, fmt.Errorf("%v; откат не удался: %v", cause, err)
	}
	st.Printf("изменения шага откачены")
	return StepRolledBack, cause
}

// lazyRemote dials the node on first use, so Hub-only steps (and deprovision of a dead VPS)
// work without it; a failed dial is ErrNodeUnreachable.
type lazyRemote struct {
	dial func() (Remote, error)
	once sync.Once
	r    Remote
	err  error
}

func (l *lazyRemote) get() (Remote, error) {
	l.once.Do(func() {
		l.r, l.err = l.dial()
		if l.err != nil {
			l.err = fmt.Errorf("%w: %w", ErrNodeUnreachable, l.err)
		}
	})
	return l.r, l.err
}

func (l *lazyRemote) Run(ctx context.Context, s string) (string, error) {
	r, err := l.get()
	if err != nil {
		return "", err
	}
	return r.Run(ctx, s)
}

func (l *lazyRemote) PutFile(ctx context.Context, p string, d []byte, m uint32) (bool, error) {
	r, err := l.get()
	if err != nil {
		return false, err
	}
	return r.PutFile(ctx, p, d, m)
}

func (l *lazyRemote) close() {
	if l.r != nil {
		Close(l.r)
	}
}
```

```go
package provision

import (
	"context"
	"database/sql"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"os"
	"time"

	"github.com/lib/pq"
	"golang.org/x/crypto/ssh"

// SQLStore is the PostgreSQL Store (and Hooks) of the API and of deploy --setup-exit-node.
type SQLStore struct {
	DB         *sql.DB
	HubKeyPath string                       // "" = this machine has no Hub key (deploy CLI)
	Decrypt    func([]byte) (string, error) // internal/crypto.Decrypt
}

type StepView struct {
	Idx        int        `json:"idx"`
	Name       string     `json:"name"`
	Title      string     `json:"title"`
	Status     string     `json:"status"`
	OutputTail string     `json:"output_tail"`
	StartedAt  *time.Time `json:"started_at"`
	FinishedAt *time.Time `json:"finished_at"`
}

type JobView struct {
	ID         int64      `json:"id"`
	ServerID   int        `json:"server_id"`
	Kind       string     `json:"kind"`
	Status     string     `json:"status"`
	Error      string     `json:"error"`
	CreatedAt  time.Time  `json:"created_at"`
	StartedAt  *time.Time `json:"started_at"`
	FinishedAt *time.Time `json:"finished_at"`
	Steps      []StepView `json:"steps,omitempty"`
}

const loadNodeQuery = `
SELECT s.id, COALESCE(s.name, ''), s.role, COALESCE(s.country_code, ''), s.ip_address,
       COALESCE(s.ssh_port, 22), COALESCE(s.ssh_user, 'root'), s.ssh_password_enc,
       COALESCE(sk.private_key, ''), COALESCE(s.ssh_host_key_fp, ''), s.ssh_host_key_confirmed_at IS NOT NULL,
       s.lifecycle_state, COALESCE(s.load_weight, 1), s.mtproto_status, s.tunnel_fallback_enabled
  FROM servers s LEFT JOIN ssh_keys sk ON sk.id = s.ssh_key_id
 WHERE s.id = $1`

func (s *SQLStore) LoadNode(ctx context.Context, id int) (Node, error) {
	var n Node
	var enc []byte
	var keyPEM string
	err := s.DB.QueryRowContext(ctx, loadNodeQuery, id).Scan(&n.ID, &n.Name, &n.Role, &n.CountryCode, &n.IP,
		&n.SSHPort, &n.SSHUser, &enc, &keyPEM, &n.HostKeyFP, &n.HostKeyConfirmed, &n.Lifecycle, &n.LoadWeight,
		&n.MTProtoStatus, &n.FallbackEnabled)
	if errors.Is(err, sql.ErrNoRows) {
		return Node{}, fmt.Errorf("нода %d не найдена", id)
	}
	if err != nil {
		return Node{}, err
	}
	if len(enc) > 0 {
		if s.Decrypt == nil {
			return Node{}, errors.New("нет функции расшифровки пароля SSH")
		}
		if n.Password, err = s.Decrypt(enc); err != nil {
			return Node{}, fmt.Errorf("пароль SSH ноды %d не расшифровывается (SSH_ENCRYPTION_KEY на Hub): %w", id, err)
		}
	}
	if keyPEM != "" {
		if signer, err := ssh.ParsePrivateKey([]byte(keyPEM)); err == nil {
			n.KeySigner = signer
		}
	}
	if s.HubKeyPath != "" {
		if n.HubSigner, err = LoadHubSigner(s.HubKeyPath); err != nil {
			return Node{}, err
		}
	}
	return n, nil
}

// LoadHubSigner reads the Hub's key; nil, nil while it has not been created yet.
func LoadHubSigner(path string) (ssh.Signer, error) {
	b, err := os.ReadFile(path)
	if errors.Is(err, os.ErrNotExist) {
		return nil, nil
	}
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	signer, err := ssh.ParsePrivateKey(b)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("ключ Hub %s повреждён: %w", path, err)
	}
	return signer, nil
}

const (
	createJobQuery     = `INSERT INTO provision_jobs (server_id, kind, status, started_at) VALUES ($1, $2, 'running', NOW()) RETURNING id`
	reopenJobQuery     = `UPDATE provision_jobs SET status = 'running', error = '', started_at = NOW(), finished_at = NULL
 WHERE id = $1 AND status IN ('interrupted', 'failed') RETURNING server_id, kind`
	insertStepsQuery   = `INSERT INTO provision_steps (job_id, idx, name, status)
SELECT $1, t.ord - 1, t.name, 'pending' FROM unnest($2::text[]) WITH ORDINALITY AS t(name, ord)`
	markStepQuery      = `UPDATE provision_steps SET status = $3, output_tail = $4,
       started_at = CASE WHEN $3 = 'running' THEN NOW() ELSE COALESCE(started_at, NOW()) END,
       finished_at = CASE WHEN $3 = 'running' THEN NULL ELSE NOW() END
 WHERE job_id = $1 AND idx = $2`
	finishJobQuery     = `UPDATE provision_jobs SET status = $2, error = $3, finished_at = NOW() WHERE id = $1`
	interruptJobsQuery = `UPDATE provision_jobs SET status = 'interrupted', finished_at = NOW(),
       error = 'API перезапустился во время задачи — нажмите «Продолжить»'
 WHERE status IN ('queued', 'running') RETURNING id`
	interruptStepsQuery = `UPDATE provision_steps SET status = 'interrupted', finished_at = NOW() WHERE status = 'running' AND job_id = ANY($1)`
	jobQuery            = `SELECT id, server_id, kind, status, error, created_at, started_at, finished_at FROM provision_jobs`
	jobStepsQuery       = `SELECT idx, name, status, output_tail, started_at, finished_at FROM provision_steps WHERE job_id = $1 ORDER BY idx`
	setLifecycleQuery   = `UPDATE servers SET lifecycle_state = $2, lifecycle_updated_at = NOW(), updated_at = NOW()
 WHERE id = $1 AND lifecycle_state = ANY($3)`
	loadTunnelQuery = `SELECT COALESCE(tunnel_uuid, ''), COALESCE(tunnel_public_key, ''), COALESCE(tunnel_short_id, ''),
       COALESCE(tunnel_sni, ''), COALESCE(tunnel_ss_password, ''),
       COALESCE(tunnel_private_key, '') <> '' OR tunnel_protocol IS DISTINCT FROM 'hysteria2' OR tunnel_port IS DISTINCT FROM 50443
  FROM servers WHERE id = $1`
	saveTunnelQuery = `UPDATE servers
   SET tunnel_protocol = 'hysteria2', tunnel_port = 50443, tunnel_uuid = $2, tunnel_public_key = $3,
       tunnel_short_id = $4, tunnel_sni = $5, tunnel_ss_password = $6, tunnel_private_key = NULL, updated_at = NOW()
 WHERE id = $1 AND (tunnel_protocol IS DISTINCT FROM 'hysteria2' OR tunnel_port IS DISTINCT FROM 50443
       OR tunnel_uuid IS DISTINCT FROM $2 OR tunnel_public_key IS DISTINCT FROM $3 OR tunnel_short_id IS DISTINCT FROM $4
       OR tunnel_sni IS DISTINCT FROM $5 OR tunnel_ss_password IS DISTINCT FROM $6 OR tunnel_private_key IS NOT NULL)`
	forgetTunnelQuery = `UPDATE servers SET tunnel_ss_password = NULL, tunnel_private_key = NULL, tunnel_status = 'unknown', updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = $1`
	activateQuery     = `UPDATE servers SET lifecycle_state = 'online', tunnel_status = 'healthy', tunnel_error = '',
       lifecycle_updated_at = NOW(), updated_at = NOW()
 WHERE id = $1 AND lifecycle_state = 'provisioning'`
	markMTProtoQuery  = `UPDATE servers SET mtproto_status = $1, mtproto_last_check = NOW(),
       mtproto_installed_at = COALESCE(mtproto_installed_at, CASE WHEN $1 = 'healthy' THEN NOW() END), updated_at = NOW()
 WHERE id = $2`
	bumpSubscriptionQuery = `UPDATE app_settings SET value = (COALESCE(NULLIF(value, '')::bigint, 0) + 1)::text WHERE key = 'subscription_version'`
	paidPlansQuery        = `SELECT id FROM plans WHERE is_active = TRUE AND price_rub > 0 ORDER BY sort_order, id`
)

func mapActive(err error) error {
	var pe *pq.Error
	if errors.As(err, &pe) && pe.Code == "23505" {
		return ErrJobActive
	}
	return err
}

func (s *SQLStore) CreateJob(ctx context.Context, serverID int, kind string) (int64, error) {
	var id int64
	err := s.DB.QueryRowContext(ctx, createJobQuery, serverID, kind).Scan(&id)
	return id, mapActive(err)
}

func (s *SQLStore) ReopenJob(ctx context.Context, jobID int64) (Job, error) {
	j := Job{ID: jobID, Status: JobRunning}
	err := s.DB.QueryRowContext(ctx, reopenJobQuery, jobID).Scan(&j.ServerID, &j.Kind)
	if errors.Is(err, sql.ErrNoRows) {
		return Job{}, ErrJobNotResumable
	}
	return j, mapActive(err)
}

func (s *SQLStore) SetSteps(ctx context.Context, jobID int64, names []string) error {
	tx, err := s.DB.BeginTx(ctx, nil)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	defer tx.Rollback()
	if _, err := tx.ExecContext(ctx, `DELETE FROM provision_steps WHERE job_id = $1`, jobID); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if _, err := tx.ExecContext(ctx, insertStepsQuery, jobID, pq.Array(names)); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	return tx.Commit()
}

func (s *SQLStore) MarkStep(ctx context.Context, jobID int64, idx int, status, out string) error {
	_, err := s.DB.ExecContext(ctx, markStepQuery, jobID, idx, status, out)
	return err
}

func (s *SQLStore) FinishJob(ctx context.Context, jobID int64, status, msg string) error {
	_, err := s.DB.ExecContext(ctx, finishJobQuery, jobID, status, msg)
	return err
}

// InterruptRunning is called once at API start: a job that was running is dead with the old process.
func (s *SQLStore) InterruptRunning(ctx context.Context) (int64, error) {
	tx, err := s.DB.BeginTx(ctx, nil)
	if err != nil {
		return 0, err
	}
	defer tx.Rollback()
	rows, err := tx.QueryContext(ctx, interruptJobsQuery)
	if err != nil {
		return 0, err
	}
	var ids []int64
	for rows.Next() {
		var id int64
		if err := rows.Scan(&id); err != nil {
			rows.Close()
			return 0, err
		}
		ids = append(ids, id)
	}
	rows.Close()
	if _, err := tx.ExecContext(ctx, interruptStepsQuery, pq.Array(ids)); err != nil {
		return 0, err
	}
	return int64(len(ids)), tx.Commit()
}

func scanJob(sc interface{ Scan(...any) error }) (JobView, error) {
	var j JobView
	var st, fin sql.NullTime
	err := sc.Scan(&j.ID, &j.ServerID, &j.Kind, &j.Status, &j.Error, &j.CreatedAt, &st, &fin)
	j.StartedAt, j.FinishedAt = timePtr(st), timePtr(fin)
	return j, err
}

func timePtr(t sql.NullTime) *time.Time {
	if !t.Valid {
		return nil
	}
	return &t.Time
}

// JobView is one job with its steps (titles included).
func (s *SQLStore) JobView(ctx context.Context, jobID int64) (JobView, error) {
	j, err := scanJob(s.DB.QueryRowContext(ctx, jobQuery+` WHERE id = $1`, jobID))
	if err != nil {
		return j, err
	}
	rows, err := s.DB.QueryContext(ctx, jobStepsQuery, jobID)
	if err != nil {
		return j, err
	}
	defer rows.Close()
	for rows.Next() {
		var v StepView
		var st, fin sql.NullTime
		if err := rows.Scan(&v.Idx, &v.Name, &v.Status, &v.OutputTail, &st, &fin); err != nil {
			return j, err
		}
		v.Title, v.StartedAt, v.FinishedAt = Title(v.Name), timePtr(st), timePtr(fin)
		j.Steps = append(j.Steps, v)
	}
	return j, rows.Err()
}

// ListJobs: the latest jobs of a node, newest first, without steps.
func (s *SQLStore) ListJobs(ctx context.Context, serverID, limit int) ([]JobView, error) {
	rows, err := s.DB.QueryContext(ctx, jobQuery+` WHERE server_id = $1 ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT $2`, serverID, limit)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	defer rows.Close()
	out := []JobView{}
	for rows.Next() {
		j, err := scanJob(rows)
		if err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		out = append(out, j)
	}
	return out, rows.Err()
}

// Hooks binds recipe side effects to this database.
func (s *SQLStore) Hooks(requestSync func(), probeAgent func(context.Context, string) error) Hooks {
	return Hooks{
		Lifecycle: func(ctx context.Context, id int) (string, error) {
			var v string
			err := s.DB.QueryRowContext(ctx, `SELECT lifecycle_state FROM servers WHERE id = $1`, id).Scan(&v)
			return v, err
		},
		SetLifecycle: func(ctx context.Context, id int, from []string, to string) error {
			res, err := s.DB.ExecContext(ctx, setLifecycleQuery, id, to, pq.Array(from))
			if err != nil {
				return err
			}
			if n, _ := res.RowsAffected(); n == 0 {
				var cur string
				if err := s.DB.QueryRowContext(ctx, `SELECT lifecycle_state FROM servers WHERE id = $1`, id).Scan(&cur); err != nil {
					return err
				}
				if cur != to {
					return fmt.Errorf("нода в состоянии «%s», переход в «%s» невозможен", cur, to)
				}
			}
			return nil
		},
		LoadTunnel: func(ctx context.Context, id int) (Tunnel, error) {
			var t Tunnel
			err := s.DB.QueryRowContext(ctx, loadTunnelQuery, id).Scan(&t.UUID, &t.PublicKey, &t.ShortID, &t.SNI, &t.Password, &t.Stale)
			return t, err
		},
		SaveTunnel: func(ctx context.Context, id int, t Tunnel) (bool, error) {
			res, err := s.DB.ExecContext(ctx, saveTunnelQuery, id, t.UUID, t.PublicKey, t.ShortID, t.SNI, t.Password)
			if err != nil {
				return false, err
			}
			n, _ := res.RowsAffected()
			return n > 0, nil
		},
		ForgetTunnel: func(ctx context.Context, id int) error { _, err := s.DB.ExecContext(ctx, forgetTunnelQuery, id); return err },
		Activate: func(ctx context.Context, id int) error {
			res, err := s.DB.ExecContext(ctx, activateQuery, id)
			if err != nil {
				return err
			}
			if n, _ := res.RowsAffected(); n == 0 {
				return errors.New("нода не в состоянии «настраивается» — включение пропущено")
			}
			return nil
		},
		MarkMTProto: func(ctx context.Context, id int, status string) error {
			_, err := s.DB.ExecContext(ctx, markMTProtoQuery, status, id)
			return err
		},
		BumpSubscription: func(ctx context.Context) error { _, err := s.DB.ExecContext(ctx, bumpSubscriptionQuery); return err },
		RequestSync:      requestSync,
		ProbeAgent:       probeAgent,
	}
}

// BindPlans makes planIDs exactly the plans that route through serverID (one transaction).
func BindPlans(ctx context.Context, db *sql.DB, serverID int, planIDs []int) error {
	ids := make([]int64, len(planIDs))
	for i, p := range planIDs {
		ids[i] = int64(p)
	}
	tx, err := db.BeginTx(ctx, nil)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	defer tx.Rollback()
	if _, err := tx.ExecContext(ctx, `DELETE FROM plan_servers WHERE server_id = $1`, serverID); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if _, err := tx.ExecContext(ctx, `INSERT INTO plan_servers (plan_id, server_id) SELECT unnest($2::int[]), $1 ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING`,
		serverID, pq.Array(ids)); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	return tx.Commit()
}

// PaidPlanIDs is the wizard's default binding: every active paid plan.
func PaidPlanIDs(ctx context.Context, db *sql.DB) ([]int, error) {
	rows, err := db.QueryContext(ctx, paidPlansQuery)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	defer rows.Close()
	var ids []int
	for rows.Next() {
		var id int
		if err := rows.Scan(&id); err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		ids = append(ids, id)
	}
	return ids, rows.Err()
}
```

```go
package provision

import (
	"context"
	"crypto/ed25519"
	"crypto/rand"
	"crypto/rsa"
	"crypto/tls"
	"crypto/x509"
	"crypto/x509/pkix"
	"encoding/pem"
	"math/big"
	"strings"
	"testing"
	"time"

	"golang.org/x/crypto/ssh"
)

var testNow = time.Date(2026, 10, 12, 12, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC)

// testCA mimics deploy's CA: RSA, PKCS#1 key.
func testCA(t *testing.T) (certPEM, keyPEM []byte) {
	t.Helper()
	k, err := rsa.GenerateKey(rand.Reader, 2048)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	tmpl := &x509.Certificate{SerialNumber: big.NewInt(1), Subject: pkix.Name{CommonName: "HeYearth Node-Agent CA"},
		NotBefore: testNow.Add(-time.Hour), NotAfter: testNow.AddDate(10, 0, 0), IsCA: true, BasicConstraintsValid: true,
		KeyUsage: x509.KeyUsageCertSign | x509.KeyUsageCRLSign}
	der, err := x509.CreateCertificate(rand.Reader, tmpl, tmpl, &k.PublicKey, k)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	return pem.EncodeToMemory(&pem.Block{Type: "CERTIFICATE", Bytes: der}),
		pem.EncodeToMemory(&pem.Block{Type: "RSA PRIVATE KEY", Bytes: x509.MarshalPKCS1PrivateKey(k)})
}

func TestIssueAndCheckNodeCert(t *testing.T) {
	ca, caKey := testCA(t)
	cert, key, err := IssueNodeCert(ca, caKey, "203.0.113.7", testNow)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if err := CheckNodeCert(cert, ca, "203.0.113.7", testNow); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("fresh cert: %v", err)
	}
	if err := CheckNodeCert(cert, ca, "203.0.113.8", testNow); err == nil {
		t.Error("a cert for another node must be refused")
	}
	if err := CheckNodeCert(cert, ca, "203.0.113.7", testNow.AddDate(0, 11, 10)); err == nil || !strings.Contains(err.Error(), "истекает") {
		t.Errorf("must be renewed 30 days before expiry: %v", err)
	}
	otherCA, _ := testCA(t)
	if err := CheckNodeCert(cert, otherCA, "203.0.113.7", testNow); err == nil {
		t.Error("a cert of another CA must be refused")
	}
	if err := CheckNodeCert([]byte(""), ca, "203.0.113.7", testNow); err == nil {
		t.Error("no cert on the node must be reported")
	}
	// heyearth-api's mTLS client (ServerName "node-agent", the CA as root) accepts it.
	pair, err := tls.X509KeyPair(cert, key)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	ln, err := tls.Listen("tcp", "127.0.0.1:0", &tls.Config{Certificates: []tls.Certificate{pair}, MinVersion: tls.VersionTLS13})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	defer ln.Close()
	go func() {
		if c, err := ln.Accept(); err == nil {
			c.(*tls.Conn).Handshake()
			c.Close()
		}
	}()
	pool := x509.NewCertPool()
	pool.AppendCertsFromPEM(ca)
	conn, err := tls.Dial("tcp", ln.Addr().String(), &tls.Config{RootCAs: pool, ServerName: "node-agent", MinVersion: tls.VersionTLS13,
		Time: func() time.Time { return testNow }})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("api-side handshake: %v", err)
	}
	conn.Close()
}

type funcRemote func(script string) (string, error)

func (f funcRemote) Run(_ context.Context, s string) (string, error)                { return f(s) }
func (f funcRemote) PutFile(context.Context, string, []byte, uint32) (bool, error) { return false, nil }

func TestEnsureHubKey(t *testing.T) {
	pub, _, _ := ed25519.GenerateKey(rand.Reader)
	sp, _ := ssh.NewPublicKey(pub)
	line := strings.TrimSpace(string(ssh.MarshalAuthorizedKey(sp)))
	got, err := EnsureHubKey(context.Background(), funcRemote(func(s string) (string, error) {
		if !strings.HasPrefix(s, "# hp:hub-key") {
			t.Fatalf("unexpected script %q", s)
		}
		return line + " heyearth-hub\n", nil
	}))
	if err != nil || got != line || HubKeyFingerprint(got) != ssh.FingerprintSHA256(sp) {
		t.Fatalf("%q %v", got, err)
	}
	if _, err := EnsureHubKey(context.Background(), funcRemote(func(string) (string, error) { return "garbage\n", nil })); err == nil {
		t.Error("garbage accepted")
	}
}
```

`server/backend/internal/provision/nodecert.go`:

```go
package provision

import (
	"crypto"
	"crypto/ecdsa"
	"crypto/elliptic"
	"crypto/rand"
	"crypto/x509"
	"crypto/x509/pkix"
	"encoding/pem"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"math/big"
	"net"
	"strings"
	"time"
)

// IssueNodeCert signs node-agent's server certificate for one node with the Hub CA (deploy's
// ca-cert.pem / ca-key.pem): ECDSA P-256, SAN node-agent + localhost (heyearth-api dials with
// ServerName "node-agent") and the node IP, valid one year.
func IssueNodeCert(caCertPEM, caKeyPEM []byte, nodeIP string, now time.Time) ([]byte, []byte, error) {
	ip := net.ParseIP(strings.TrimSpace(nodeIP))
	if ip == nil {
		return nil, nil, fmt.Errorf("IP ноды %q некорректен", nodeIP)
	}
	ca, err := parseCert(caCertPEM)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, nil, fmt.Errorf("CA: %w", err)
	}
	caKey, err := parseKey(caKeyPEM)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, nil, fmt.Errorf("ключ CA: %w", err)
	}
	key, err := ecdsa.GenerateKey(elliptic.P256(), rand.Reader)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, nil, err
	}
	serial, err := rand.Int(rand.Reader, new(big.Int).Lsh(big.NewInt(1), 127))
	if err != nil {
		return nil, nil, err
	}
	tmpl := &x509.Certificate{
		SerialNumber: serial, Subject: pkix.Name{CommonName: "node-agent", Organization: []string{"HeYearth"}},
		NotBefore: now.Add(-time.Hour), NotAfter: now.AddDate(1, 0, 0),
		KeyUsage: x509.KeyUsageDigitalSignature, ExtKeyUsage: []x509.ExtKeyUsage{x509.ExtKeyUsageServerAuth},
		DNSNames: []string{"node-agent", "localhost"}, IPAddresses: []net.IP{ip},
	}
	der, err := x509.CreateCertificate(rand.Reader, tmpl, ca, &key.PublicKey, caKey)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, nil, err
	}
	kder, err := x509.MarshalECPrivateKey(key)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, nil, err
	}
	return pem.EncodeToMemory(&pem.Block{Type: "CERTIFICATE", Bytes: der}),
		pem.EncodeToMemory(&pem.Block{Type: "EC PRIVATE KEY", Bytes: kder}), nil
}

// CheckNodeCert is nil when certPEM chains to the CA, names nodeIP and is valid ≥ 30 more days.
// The old shared server-cert.pem (no IP SAN) fails, so every node gets its own on the next run.
func CheckNodeCert(certPEM, caCertPEM []byte, nodeIP string, now time.Time) error {
	cert, err := parseCert(certPEM)
	if err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("сертификата нет или он повреждён: %w", err)
	}
	ca, err := parseCert(caCertPEM)
	if err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("CA: %w", err)
	}
	pool := x509.NewCertPool()
	pool.AddCert(ca)
	if _, err := cert.Verify(x509.VerifyOptions{Roots: pool, CurrentTime: now, DNSName: "node-agent",
		KeyUsages: []x509.ExtKeyUsage{x509.ExtKeyUsageServerAuth}}); err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("сертификат не от CA Hub или просрочен: %w", err)
	}
	ip := net.ParseIP(nodeIP)
	found := false
	for _, a := range cert.IPAddresses {
		found = found || a.Equal(ip)
	}
	if !found {
		return fmt.Errorf("сертификат выписан не на %s", nodeIP)
	}
	if cert.NotAfter.Sub(now) < 30*24*time.Hour {
		return fmt.Errorf("сертификат истекает %s", cert.NotAfter.Format("2006-01-02"))
	}
	return nil
}

func parseCert(p []byte) (*x509.Certificate, error) {
	b, _ := pem.Decode(p)
	if b == nil {
		return nil, errors.New("нет PEM-блока")
	}
	return x509.ParseCertificate(b.Bytes)
}

func parseKey(p []byte) (crypto.Signer, error) {
	b, _ := pem.Decode(p)
	if b == nil {
		return nil, errors.New("нет PEM-блока")
	}
	if k, err := x509.ParsePKCS1PrivateKey(b.Bytes); err == nil {
		return k, nil
	}
	if k, err := x509.ParseECPrivateKey(b.Bytes); err == nil {
		return k, nil
	}
	k, err := x509.ParsePKCS8PrivateKey(b.Bytes)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	s, ok := k.(crypto.Signer)
	if !ok {
		return nil, errors.New("неподдерживаемый тип ключа")
	}
	return s, nil
}
```

`server/backend/internal/provision/hubkey.go`:

```go
package provision

import (
	"context"
	"fmt"
	"strings"

	"github.com/heyearth/backend/internal/config"
	"golang.org/x/crypto/ssh"
)

// EnsureHubKey creates the Hub's ed25519 key once (on the Hub, through hub) and returns its
// authorized_keys line, re-marshalled without a comment (safe inside single quotes).
func EnsureHubKey(ctx context.Context, hub Remote) (string, error) {
	out, err := hub.Run(ctx, config.HubSSHKeyEnsureScript)
	if err != nil {
		return "", fmt.Errorf("ключ Hub: %w", err)
	}
	lines := strings.Split(strings.TrimSpace(out), "\n")
	pub, _, _, _, err := ssh.ParseAuthorizedKey([]byte(lines[len(lines)-1]))
	if err != nil {
		return "", fmt.Errorf("публичный ключ Hub не читается: %w", err)
	}
	if pub.Type() != ssh.KeyAlgoED25519 {
		return "", fmt.Errorf("ключ Hub должен быть ed25519, а не %s", pub.Type())
	}
	return strings.TrimSpace(string(ssh.MarshalAuthorizedKey(pub))), nil
}

func HubKeyFingerprint(line string) string {
	pub, _, _, _, err := ssh.ParseAuthorizedKey([]byte(line))
	if err != nil {
		return ""
	}
	return ssh.FingerprintSHA256(pub)
}
```
