`server/backend/internal/provision/fakehost_test.go` (единый фейковый хост — нода или Hub; операции узнаются по строке `# hp:<op>`):

```go
package provision

import (
	"bytes"
	"context"
	"crypto/ed25519"
	"crypto/rand"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"slices"
	"strings"

	"github.com/heyearth/backend/internal/config"
	"golang.org/x/crypto/ssh"
)

var testHubPub = func() string {
	pub, _, _ := ed25519.GenerateKey(rand.Reader)
	sp, _ := ssh.NewPublicKey(pub)
	return strings.TrimSpace(string(ssh.MarshalAuthorizedKey(sp)))
}()

type fakeHost struct {
	files       map[string][]byte
	writes      int
	active      map[string]bool
	marker      map[string]bool
	restarts    map[string]int
	authKeys    []string
	ops         []string
	dropOnce    string // the first op with this prefix loses the SSH connection…
	dropped     bool
	down        bool // …and everything after it fails too (no rollback) until the next job dials again
	mtproxyFail bool
}

var errLost = errors.New("ssh: connection lost")

func newFakeHost() *fakeHost {
	return &fakeHost{files: map[string][]byte{}, active: map[string]bool{}, marker: map[string]bool{}, restarts: map[string]int{}}
}

func (h *fakeHost) PutFile(_ context.Context, path string, data []byte, _ uint32) (bool, error) {
	if h.down {
		return false, errLost
	}
	if old, ok := h.files[path]; ok {
		if bytes.Equal(old, data) {
			return false, nil
		}
		h.files[path+".bak"] = old
	}
	h.files[path] = append([]byte(nil), data...)
	h.writes++
	return true, nil
}

func between(s, a, b string) string {
	_, rest, ok := strings.Cut(s, a)
	if !ok {
		return ""
	}
	v, _, _ := strings.Cut(rest, b)
	return v
}

func b01(b bool) string {
	if b {
		return "1"
	}
	return "0"
}

func (h *fakeHost) count(op string) int {
	n := 0
	for _, o := range h.ops {
		if o == op {
			n++
		}
	}
	return n
}

func (h *fakeHost) Run(_ context.Context, script string) (string, error) {
	first, _, _ := strings.Cut(script, "\n")
	op := strings.TrimPrefix(first, "# hp:")
	h.ops = append(h.ops, op)
	if h.down {
		return "", errLost
	}
	if h.dropOnce != "" && !h.dropped && strings.HasPrefix(op, h.dropOnce) {
		h.dropped, h.down = true, true
		return "", errLost
	}
	f := strings.Fields(op)
	if len(f) == 0 {
		return "", nil
	}
	switch f[0] {
	case "preflight":
		return fmt.Sprintf("PF os ok Ubuntu 24.04\nPF arch ok x86_64\nPF root ok\nPF disk ok 9000 МБ\nPF internet ok\n"+
			"PF port_50443 ok\nPF port_10443 ok\nPF port_50052 ok\nPF_TIME %d\n", testNow.Unix()), nil
	case "cat":
		return string(h.files[f[1]]), nil
	case "sums":
		var b strings.Builder
		for _, p := range f[1:] {
			if d, ok := h.files[p]; ok {
				fmt.Fprintf(&b, "%s  %s\n", sha256Hex(d), p)
			}
		}
		return b.String(), nil
	case "mark":
		h.marker[f[1]] = true
	case "converge":
		if h.marker[f[1]] || !h.active[f[1]] {
			h.restarts[f[1]]++
			h.active[f[1]] = true
			delete(h.marker, f[1])
		}
	case "unit-state":
		return "ACTIVE=" + b01(h.active[f[1]]) + "\nMARKER=" + b01(h.marker[f[1]]) + "\n", nil
	case "rollback":
		h.active[f[1]] = false
	case "hy-check":
		return "VERSION=" + config.HysteriaVersion + "\nLISTEN=" + b01(h.active["hysteria2"]) + "\nHOP=" + b01(h.files[config.ExitPortHopConfPath] != nil) + "\n", nil
	case "xray-check":
		return "VERSION=" + strings.TrimPrefix(config.XrayExitVersion, "v") + "\nLISTEN=" + b01(h.active["xray"]) + "\n", nil
	case "base-check":
		return "BBR=1\nPKGS=1\n", nil
	case "authkey":
		if k := between(script, "KEY='", "'"); !slices.Contains(h.authKeys, k) {
			h.authKeys = append(h.authKeys, k)
		}
	case "authkey-check":
		return "PRESENT=" + b01(slices.Contains(h.authKeys, between(script, "KEY='", "'"))) + "\n", nil
	case "hub-key":
		return testHubPub + " heyearth-hub\n", nil
	case "socks-probe", "vr-probe":
		return "HTTP=204\n", nil
	case "mtproxy-install":
		if h.mtproxyFail {
			return "", errors.New("exit status 1: fronting domain does not resolve to this node")
		}
		h.active["mtproxy"] = true
	case "mtproxy-check":
		a := b01(h.active["mtproxy"])
		return "ACTIVE=" + a + "\nLISTEN=" + a + "\nSECRET=" + a + "\n", nil
	case "hub-client-remove":
		u := "hysteria2-client-" + f[1]
		delete(h.files, "/etc/systemd/system/"+u+".service")
		delete(h.files, config.HubHysteriaDir+"/client-"+f[1]+".yaml")
		h.active[u] = false
	case "hub-client-state":
		u := "hysteria2-client-" + f[1]
		return "UNIT=" + b01(h.files["/etc/systemd/system/"+u+".service"] != nil) + "\nACTIVE=" + b01(h.active[u]) + "\n", nil
	case "stop-services":
		for _, u := range []string{"hysteria2", "xray", "node-agent", "mtproxy"} {
			h.active[u] = false
		}
	case "remove-hop":
		delete(h.files, config.ExitPortHopConfPath)
	}
	return "", nil
}
```

```go
	r := &Runner{Store: store, Go: func(f func()) { f() }, Dial: func(Node) (Remote, error) { return node, nil },
		Recipe: func(_ context.Context, n Node, kind string) (Recipe, *State, error) {
			st := NewState(kind, n, hub, h.Hooks())
			st.Sleep = func(context.Context, time.Duration) error { return nil }

func TestDeprovisionExit(t *testing.T) {
	node, hub, h, store, r := deproFixture(t)
	id, err := r.Start(context.Background(), 7, KindDeprovision)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	want := []string{"exclude=done", "hub_client_remove=done", "rotate_password=done", "stop_services=done", "remove_hop=done", "finalize=done"}
	if got := store.statuses(id); !slices.Equal(got, want) || store.jobs[id].Status != JobSucceeded {
		t.Fatalf("%v %s", got, store.jobs[id].Error)
	}
	if !slices.Equal(h.history, []string{"deprovisioning", "offline"}) || h.tunnel.Password != "" || h.syncs != 2 {
		t.Fatalf("history=%v tunnel=%+v syncs=%d", h.history, h.tunnel, h.syncs)
	}
	for _, u := range []string{"hysteria2", "xray", "node-agent", "mtproxy"} {
		if node.active[u] {
			t.Errorf("%s still running on the exit", u)
		}
	}
	if hub.files["/etc/systemd/system/hysteria2-client-7.service"] != nil || node.files[config.ExitPortHopConfPath] != nil || node.count("rotate-password") != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("hub unit / nft / password rotation: %v %v", hub.ops, node.ops)
	}
}

// A VPS that is already gone: the Hub side is cleaned, the node steps are skipped, the row ends offline.
func TestDeprovisionDeadNode(t *testing.T) {
	_, _, h, store, r := deproFixture(t)
	r.Dial = func(Node) (Remote, error) { return nil, errors.New("dial tcp 203.0.113.7:22: i/o timeout") }
	id, _ := r.Start(context.Background(), 7, KindDeprovision)
	want := []string{"exclude=done", "hub_client_remove=done", "rotate_password=skipped", "stop_services=skipped", "remove_hop=skipped", "finalize=done"}
	if got := store.statuses(id); !slices.Equal(got, want) || h.lifecycle != "offline" || h.tunnel.Password != "" {
		t.Fatalf("%v lifecycle=%s tunnel=%+v", got, h.lifecycle, h.tunnel)
	}
}

func TestMTProxyInstallValidates(t *testing.T) {
	host := newFakeHost()
	if _, err := InstallMTProxy(context.Background(), host, MTProtoOptions{Port: 8443, Secret: "", Domain: "x.org", Script: []byte("#!/bin/bash")}); err == nil {
		t.Error("an empty secret must be refused before touching the node")
	}
	if _, err := InstallMTProxy(context.Background(), host, MTProtoOptions{Port: 8443, Secret: "ee00112233445566778899aabbccddeeff", Domain: "x.org; reboot", Script: []byte("#!/bin/bash")}); err == nil {
		t.Error("a domain with shell characters must be refused")
	}
	if host.writes != 0 || len(host.ops) != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("node touched: %v", host.ops)
	}
}
```

```go
package config

import (
	"fmt"
	"strconv"
)

// HubClientRemoveScript (Hub): stop the per-exit client, archive its config and unit (the .bak
// copies carry the old tunnel password and are deleted), daemon-reload.
func HubClientRemoveScript(id int) string {
	n := strconv.Itoa(id)
	return `# hp:hub-client-remove ` + n + `
set -e
u=hysteria2-client-` + n + `
systemctl disable --now "$u" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
pkill -9 -f "client-` + n + `.yaml" 2>/dev/null || true
d=/opt/heyearth/state/server-archive/` + n + `-$(date +%s)
mkdir -p "$d"
for f in ` + HubHysteriaDir + `/client-` + n + `.yaml /etc/systemd/system/$u.service; do
  if [ -f "$f" ]; then mv -f "$f" "$d/"; fi
  rm -f "$f.bak"
done
journalctl -u "$u" -n 100 --no-pager > "$d/journal-snapshot.log" 2>&1 || true
systemctl daemon-reload
echo "[hub] клиент туннеля $u снят, архив: $d"
`
}

func HubClientStateScript(id int) string {
	n := strconv.Itoa(id)
	return "# hp:hub-client-state " + n + "\nif [ -f /etc/systemd/system/hysteria2-client-" + n + ".service ]; then echo UNIT=1; else echo UNIT=0; fi\n" +
		"if systemctl is-active --quiet hysteria2-client-" + n + "; then echo ACTIVE=1; else echo ACTIVE=0; fi\n"
}

// ExitRotatePasswordScript makes the retired exit refuse the old tunnel password (base64 → safe
// with the | sed delimiter); never prints it.
func ExitRotatePasswordScript(newPassword string) string {
	return `# hp:rotate-password
set -e
NEW=` + shQuote(newPassword) + `
if [ -f ` + ExitHysteriaConfig + ` ]; then sed -i "s|^  password: .*|  password: $NEW|" ` + ExitHysteriaConfig + `; rm -f ` + ExitHysteriaConfig + `.bak; fi
if [ -f ` + ExitKeysPath + ` ]; then sed -i "s|\"ssPassword\": *\"[^\"]*\"|\"ssPassword\": \"$NEW\"|" ` + ExitKeysPath + `; rm -f ` + ExitKeysPath + `.bak; fi
echo "[exit] пароль туннеля сменён"
`
}

const ExitStopServicesScript = `# hp:stop-services
for u in hysteria2 xray node-agent mtproxy; do systemctl disable --now "$u" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; done
for u in hysteria2 xray node-agent mtproxy; do
  if systemctl is-active --quiet "$u"; then echo "[exit] $u всё ещё работает" >&2; exit 1; fi
done
echo "[exit] сервисы hysteria2, xray, node-agent, mtproxy остановлены и выключены"
`

const ExitRemoveHopScript = `# hp:remove-hop
systemctl disable --now nftables-hysteria >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
nft delete table inet hysteria_porthopping 2>/dev/null || true
rm -f ` + ExitPortHopConfPath + ` ` + ExitPortHopUnitPath + `
systemctl daemon-reload
echo "[exit] правила прыжков портов сняты"
`

// MTProxyRunScript runs install-mtproxy.sh (idempotent; secret/domain validated by the caller).
func MTProxyRunScript(path string, port int, secret, domain string) string {
	return fmt.Sprintf("# hp:mtproxy-install\nset -e\nbash %s %d %s %s\n", shQuote(path), port, shQuote(secret), shQuote(domain))
}

func MTProxyCheckScript(port int, secret string) string {
	p := strconv.Itoa(port)
	return "# hp:mtproxy-check\nS=" + shQuote(secret) + "\n" +
		"if systemctl is-active --quiet mtproxy; then echo ACTIVE=1; else echo ACTIVE=0; fi\n" +
		"if ss -Htln 'sport = :" + p + "' 2>/dev/null | grep -q .; then echo LISTEN=1; else echo LISTEN=0; fi\n" +
		"if grep -qF -- \"$S\" /opt/mtproxy/config.toml 2>/dev/null; then echo SECRET=1; else echo SECRET=0; fi\n"
}
```

```go
package provision

import (
	"context"
	"crypto/rand"
	"encoding/base64"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"strings"
	"time"

	"github.com/heyearth/backend/internal/config"
)

type stepFunc = func(ctx context.Context, r Remote, s *State) error

// DeprovisionRecipe takes a node out of service: out of routing first, then the Hub side,
// then (best effort — the VPS may already be gone) the node; the row ends 'offline'.
func DeprovisionRecipe(role string) Recipe {
	r := Recipe{{Name: "exclude", Apply: excludeApply, Verify: lifecycleIs("deprovisioning")}}
	if role == "exit" {
		r = append(r,
			Step{Name: "hub_client_remove", Apply: hubClientRemove, Verify: hubClientGone},
			Step{Name: "rotate_password", Apply: bestEffort(rotatePassword)},
			Step{Name: "stop_services", Apply: bestEffort(runPrint(config.ExitStopServicesScript))},
			Step{Name: "remove_hop", Apply: bestEffort(runPrint(config.ExitRemoveHopScript))},
		)
	}
	return append(r, Step{Name: "finalize", Apply: finalizeApply, Verify: lifecycleIs("offline")})
}

var deprovisionFrom = []string{"online", "failed", "offline", "provisioning", "pending", "deprovisioning"}

func excludeApply(ctx context.Context, _ Remote, s *State) error {
	if err := s.Hooks.SetLifecycle(ctx, s.Node.ID, deprovisionFrom, "deprovisioning"); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if err := s.Hooks.BumpSubscription(ctx); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	s.Hooks.RequestSync()
	s.Printf("нода исключена из маршрутизации; 3 с на переезд соединений на другие выходы")
	return s.Sleep(ctx, 3*time.Second)
}

func finalizeApply(ctx context.Context, _ Remote, s *State) error {
	if err := s.Hooks.SetLifecycle(ctx, s.Node.ID, []string{"deprovisioning"}, "offline"); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if err := s.Hooks.BumpSubscription(ctx); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	s.Hooks.RequestSync()
	return nil
}

func lifecycleIs(want string) stepFunc {
	return func(ctx context.Context, _ Remote, s *State) error {
		cur, err := s.Hooks.Lifecycle(ctx, s.Node.ID)
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		if cur != want {
			return fmt.Errorf("состояние ноды «%s», нужно «%s»", cur, want)
		}
		return nil
	}
}

func hubClientRemove(ctx context.Context, _ Remote, s *State) error {
	out, err := s.Hub.Run(ctx, config.HubClientRemoveScript(s.Node.ID))
	s.Printf("%s", out)
	return err
}

func hubClientGone(ctx context.Context, _ Remote, s *State) error {
	kv, err := runKV(ctx, s.Hub, config.HubClientStateScript(s.Node.ID))
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if kv["UNIT"] != "0" || kv["ACTIVE"] != "0" {
		return errors.New("клиент туннеля на Hub ещё установлен")
	}
	return nil
}

// rotatePassword: the Hub forgets the tunnel password first (it no longer needs it), then the
// exit gets a random one nobody knows.
func rotatePassword(ctx context.Context, r Remote, s *State) error {
	if err := s.Hooks.ForgetTunnel(ctx, s.Node.ID); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	pw, err := randomPassword()
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	s.AddSecret(pw)
	return runPrint(config.ExitRotatePasswordScript(pw))(ctx, r, s)
}

func runPrint(script string) stepFunc {
	return func(ctx context.Context, r Remote, s *State) error {
		out, err := r.Run(ctx, script)
		s.Printf("%s", out)
		return err
	}
}

// bestEffort turns "the node is unreachable" into a skipped step (the job goes on).
func bestEffort(f stepFunc) stepFunc {
	return func(ctx context.Context, r Remote, s *State) error {
		err := f(ctx, r, s)
		if errors.Is(err, ErrNodeUnreachable) {
			s.Printf("нода недоступна (%v) — пропускаю. Если сервер ещё работает, повторите вывод, когда он будет доступен.", err)
			return fmt.Errorf("%w: %v", ErrSkipped, err)
		}
		return err
	}
}

func runKV(ctx context.Context, r Remote, script string) (map[string]string, error) {
	out, err := r.Run(ctx, script)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	return parseKV(out), nil
}

// parseKV reads KEY=VALUE lines.
func parseKV(out string) map[string]string {
	kv := map[string]string{}
	for _, l := range strings.Split(out, "\n") {
		if k, v, ok := strings.Cut(strings.TrimSpace(l), "="); ok {
			kv[k] = v
		}
	}
	return kv
}

// randomPassword: 16 random bytes, standard base64 (the tunnel password alphabet).
func randomPassword() (string, error) {
	b := make([]byte, 16)
	if _, err := rand.Read(b); err != nil {
		return "", err
	}
	return base64.StdEncoding.EncodeToString(b), nil
}

// RecipeFor picks the recipe of a job kind (Task 2.8 adds the exit kinds).
func RecipeFor(kind string, n Node, st *State) (Recipe, error) {
	if n.ID < 1 || n.ID > 511 {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("id ноды %d вне 1..511: порт 1088+id выходит за диапазон egress guard", n.ID)
	}
	if kind == KindDeprovision {
		return DeprovisionRecipe(n.Role), nil
	}
	return recipeForSetup(kind, n, st)
}
```

```go
package provision

import (
	"context"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"regexp"
	"time"

	"github.com/heyearth/backend/internal/config"
)

const mtproxyScriptPath = "/opt/heyearth/mtproxy/install-mtproxy.sh"

var (
	mtSecretRe = regexp.MustCompile(`^[0-9a-f]{34,}$`)       // "ee" + 32 hex + hex(domain)
	mtDomainRe = regexp.MustCompile(`^[A-Za-z0-9.-]{3,253}$`)
)

// InstallMTProxy uploads install-mtproxy.sh and runs it over the pinned connection (it was
// biz.InstallMTProtoOnExit with InsecureIgnoreHostKey). Idempotent; a first build takes minutes.
func InstallMTProxy(ctx context.Context, r Remote, o MTProtoOptions) (string, error) {
	switch {
	case !mtSecretRe.MatchString(o.Secret):
		return "", errors.New("mtproto_secret в настройках пуст или не в формате mtg")
	case !mtDomainRe.MatchString(o.Domain):
		return "", errors.New("mtproto_fronting_domain не задан или некорректен: нужен домен с A-записью на эту ноду")
	case len(o.Script) == 0:
		return "", errors.New("нет install-mtproxy.sh на Hub")
	}
	if _, err := r.PutFile(ctx, mtproxyScriptPath, o.Script, 0o700); err != nil {
		return "", err
	}
	ictx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(ctx, 12*time.Minute)
	defer cancel()
	return r.Run(ictx, config.MTProxyRunScript(mtproxyScriptPath, o.Port, o.Secret, o.Domain))
}

// mtproxyApply never fails the exit: a MTProxy problem is reported and the step is skipped
// (mtproto_status=unhealthy; the reconciler retries every 30 min).
func mtproxyApply(o MTProtoOptions) stepFunc {
	return func(ctx context.Context, r Remote, s *State) error {
		_ = s.Hooks.MarkMTProto(ctx, s.Node.ID, "installing")
		out, err := InstallMTProxy(ctx, r, o)
		s.Printf("%s", tail(out, 2000))
		if err != nil {
			_ = s.Hooks.MarkMTProto(ctx, s.Node.ID, "unhealthy")
			s.Printf("MTProxy не установлен: %v. Выход работает и без него; повтор — «Переустановить» в карточке ноды.", err)
			return fmt.Errorf("%w: %v", ErrSkipped, err)
		}
		if err := s.Hooks.MarkMTProto(ctx, s.Node.ID, "healthy"); err != nil {
			return err
		}
		return s.Hooks.BumpSubscription(ctx)
	}
}

func mtproxyVerify(o MTProtoOptions) stepFunc {
	return func(ctx context.Context, r Remote, s *State) error {
		if !mtSecretRe.MatchString(o.Secret) {
			return errors.New("mtproto_secret не задан")
		}
		kv, err := runKV(ctx, r, config.MTProxyCheckScript(o.Port, o.Secret))
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		switch {
		case kv["ACTIVE"] != "1":
			return errors.New("mtproxy не запущен")
		case kv["LISTEN"] != "1":
			return fmt.Errorf("никто не слушает TCP %d", o.Port)
		case kv["SECRET"] != "1":
			return errors.New("секрет MTProxy на ноде отличается от настроек")
		}
		return nil
	}
}
```

```go
		t.Fatalf("hub client:\n%s", c)
	}
	if !slices.Equal(e.h.history, []string{"provisioning", "online"}) || e.h.tunnelStatus != "healthy" || e.h.syncs != 1 || e.h.bumps != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("lifecycle %v, tunnel %q, syncs %d, bumps %d", e.h.history, e.h.tunnelStatus, e.h.syncs, e.h.bumps)
	}
	if e.h.tunnel != (Tunnel{UUID: k.UUID, PublicKey: k.PublicKey, ShortID: k.ShortID, SNI: config.ExitRealitySNI, Password: k.SSPassword}) {
		t.Fatalf("tunnel in DB: %+v", e.h.tunnel)
	}
	wantRestarts := map[string]int{"hysteria2": 1, "xray": 1, "node-agent": 1}
	if !maps.Equal(e.node.restarts, wantRestarts) || e.hub.restarts["hysteria2-client-7"] != 1 || len(e.node.authKeys) != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("restarts node=%v hub=%v keys=%d", e.node.restarts, e.hub.restarts, len(e.node.authKeys))
	}
	for _, st := range e.store.jobs[id].Steps {
		if strings.Contains(st.OutputTail, k.SSPassword) || strings.Contains(st.OutputTail, k.PrivateKey) || strings.Contains(st.OutputTail, "Pa55word") {
			t.Fatalf("secret in step %s output: %q", st.Name, st.OutputTail)
		}
	}
	// The same node again (Drawer → «Переустановить»): nothing written, nothing restarted, no sync.
	writes := e.node.writes
	id2, err := e.r.Start(ctx, 7, KindReprovision)
	if err != nil || e.store.jobs[id2].Status != JobSucceeded || e.node.writes != writes || !maps.Equal(e.node.restarts, wantRestarts) ||
		e.hub.restarts["hysteria2-client-7"] != 1 || e.h.syncs != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("re-run changed something: %v writes %d→%d restarts %v syncs %d", e.store.statuses(id2), writes, e.node.writes, e.node.restarts, e.h.syncs)
	}
}

// Review Focus → 2: an SSH drop in the middle leaves a failed job and a node out of routing;
// «Продолжить» finishes it without duplicates (Hub key, nft table, units) and restarts every
// unit exactly once; an API restart mid-job gives an interrupted job that resumes the same way.
func TestExitRecipeDropAndResume(t *testing.T) {
	ctx := context.Background()
	e := exitFixture(t, false)
	e.node.dropOnce = "converge xray"
	id, _ := e.r.Start(ctx, 7, KindProvision)
	j := e.store.jobs[id]
	if j.Status != JobFailed || e.h.lifecycle != "failed" || slices.Contains(e.h.history, "online") || e.h.syncs != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("after the drop: job=%s lifecycle=%s history=%v syncs=%d", j.Status, e.h.lifecycle, e.h.history, e.h.syncs)
	}
	if !strings.Contains(j.Error, Title("xray")) {
		t.Fatalf("the error must name the step: %q", j.Error)
	}
	if err := e.r.Resume(ctx, id); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if e.store.jobs[id].Status != JobSucceeded || e.h.lifecycle != "online" || e.h.syncs != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("resume: %s %s syncs=%d %v", e.store.jobs[id].Status, e.h.lifecycle, e.h.syncs, e.store.statuses(id))
	}
	if !maps.Equal(e.node.restarts, map[string]int{"hysteria2": 1, "xray": 1, "node-agent": 1}) || e.hub.restarts["hysteria2-client-7"] != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("restarts node=%v hub=%v", e.node.restarts, e.hub.restarts)
	}
	// hysteria converged in the first run, so the resume only verifies it: nft is applied once;
	// the firewall step has no verify and runs on every pass — ufw/iptables -C keep it duplicate-free (Task 2.3).
	if len(e.node.authKeys) != 1 || e.node.count("hop-apply") != 1 || e.node.count("firewall") != 2 ||
		!strings.HasPrefix(string(e.node.files[config.ExitPortHopConfPath]), "table inet hysteria_porthopping\ndelete table inet hysteria_porthopping\n") {
		t.Fatalf("duplicates: keys=%d hop=%d fw=%d", len(e.node.authKeys), e.node.count("hop-apply"), e.node.count("firewall"))
	}

	// A changed config of a RUNNING unit, connection lost after the write and before the restart
	// (rollback impossible): the marker makes «Продолжить» restart it — once.
	e.opts.MTProtoPort = 9443
	e.node.dropOnce, e.node.dropped = "converge hysteria2", false
	id3, _ := e.r.Start(ctx, 7, KindReprovision)
	if e.store.jobs[id3].Status != JobFailed || e.h.lifecycle != "online" {
		t.Fatalf("reprovision drop: %s %s", e.store.jobs[id3].Status, e.h.lifecycle)
	}
	if err := e.r.Resume(ctx, id3); err != nil || e.store.jobs[id3].Status != JobSucceeded {
		t.Fatalf("resume: %v %v", err, e.store.statuses(id3))
	}
	if e.node.restarts["hysteria2"] != 2 || !strings.Contains(string(e.node.files[config.ExitHysteriaConfig]), "tcp/9443") {
		t.Fatalf("the new config must be running: restarts=%d", e.node.restarts["hysteria2"])
	}

	// API restart while the job runs.
	e2 := exitFixture(t, false)
	e2.r.Go = func(func()) {}
	id2, _ := e2.r.Start(ctx, 7, KindProvision)
	if n, _ := e2.store.InterruptRunning(ctx); n != 1 || e2.store.jobs[id2].Status != JobInterrupted || e2.h.lifecycle == "online" {
		t.Fatalf("interrupt: %d %s %s", n, e2.store.jobs[id2].Status, e2.h.lifecycle)
	}
	e2.r.Go = func(f func()) { f() }
	if err := e2.r.Resume(ctx, id2); err != nil || e2.store.jobs[id2].Status != JobSucceeded || e2.h.lifecycle != "online" {
		t.Fatalf("resume after restart: %v %s %s", err, e2.store.jobs[id2].Status, e2.h.lifecycle)
	}
}

// verify-only on a live exit with a hand-edited config: drift is reported, nothing is touched.
```

```go
package provision

import (
	"context"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"strconv"
	"strings"
	"time"

	"github.com/heyearth/backend/internal/config"
)

// File is one file a step installs.
type File struct {
	Path string
	Data []byte
	Mode uint32
}

// ExitRecipe: spec §2 steps 1–9 for one exit. Every step converges (verify → apply → verify);
// a service restarts only when its files/binary changed, with the two-sample health check.
func ExitRecipe(o ExitOptions) Recipe {
	r := Recipe{
		{Name: "preflight", Verify: exitPreflight},
		{Name: "hub_key", Apply: hubKeyApply, Verify: hubKeyVerify},
		{Name: "reality_keys", Apply: keysApply, Verify: keysVerify},
		{Name: "base", Apply: baseApply, Verify: baseVerify},
		{Name: "firewall", Apply: firewallApply(o)},
		{Name: "hysteria", Apply: hysteriaApply(o), Verify: hysteriaVerify(o), Rollback: unitRollback("hysteria2")},
		{Name: "xray", Apply: xrayApply(o), Verify: xrayVerify(o), Rollback: unitRollback("xray")},
	}
	if o.MTProto != nil {
		r = append(r, Step{Name: "mtproxy", Apply: mtproxyApply(*o.MTProto), Verify: mtproxyVerify(*o.MTProto)})
	}
	return append(r,
		Step{Name: "node_agent", Apply: agentApply(o), Verify: agentVerify(o), Rollback: unitRollback("node-agent")},
		Step{Name: "save_tunnel", Apply: tunnelApply, Verify: tunnelVerify},
		Step{Name: "hub_client", Apply: hubClientApply, Verify: hubClientVerify, Rollback: hubClientRollback},
		Step{Name: "path_hy", Verify: pathHysteria},
		Step{Name: "path_tcp", Verify: pathTCP(o)},
		Step{Name: "activate", Apply: activateApply, Verify: lifecycleIs("online")},
	)
}

func recipeForSetup(kind string, n Node, st *State) (Recipe, error) {
	if n.Role != "exit" {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("настройка роли «%s» появится вместе с резервными входами", n.Role)
	}
	switch kind {
	case KindProvision:
		if n.Lifecycle == "online" || n.Lifecycle == "deprovisioning" {
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("нода в состоянии «%s»: для работающей — «Переустановить», для выводимой — дождитесь конца вывода", n.Lifecycle)
		}
		st.Begin = func(ctx context.Context) error {
			return st.Hooks.SetLifecycle(ctx, n.ID, []string{"pending", "failed", "offline", "provisioning"}, "provisioning")
		}
		st.Fail = func(ctx context.Context) { _ = st.Hooks.SetLifecycle(ctx, n.ID, []string{"provisioning"}, "failed") }
	case KindReprovision:
		if n.Lifecycle != "online" {
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("переустановка — только для работающей ноды, а она «%s»", n.Lifecycle)
		}
	case KindVerify:
	default:
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("неизвестный вид задачи %q", kind)
	}
	return ExitRecipe(st.Exit), nil
}

// ── preflight ──

type Check struct {
	Name   string `json:"name"`
	OK     bool   `json:"ok"`
	Detail string `json:"detail"`
}

var checkNames = map[string]string{"os": "Операционная система", "arch": "Архитектура", "root": "Вход под root",
	"disk": "Свободное место", "internet": "Выход в интернет", "port_50443": "UDP 50443 (основной туннель)",
	"port_10443": "TCP 10443 (запасной туннель)", "port_50052": "TCP 50052 (агент)"}

// Preflight runs the read-only checks (the wizard calls it synchronously, the recipe as step 1).
func Preflight(ctx context.Context, r Remote, now time.Time) ([]Check, error) {
	out, err := r.Run(ctx, config.ExitPreflightScript())
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	return parsePreflight(out, now), nil
}

func parsePreflight(out string, now time.Time) []Check {
	var cs []Check
	sawTime := false
	for _, line := range strings.Split(out, "\n") {
		f := strings.SplitN(strings.TrimSpace(line), " ", 4)
		switch {
		case len(f) >= 2 && f[0] == "PF_TIME":
			sawTime = true
			ts, _ := strconv.ParseInt(f[1], 10, 64)
			d := now.Sub(time.Unix(ts, 0)).Abs().Round(time.Second)
			cs = append(cs, Check{Name: "Часы сервера", OK: d <= 2*time.Minute, Detail: "расхождение с Hub " + d.String()})
		case len(f) >= 3 && f[0] == "PF":
			c := Check{Name: checkNames[f[1]], OK: f[2] == "ok"}
			if c.Name == "" {
				c.Name = f[1]
			}
			if len(f) == 4 {
				c.Detail = f[3]
			}
			cs = append(cs, c)
		}
	}
	if !sawTime {
		cs = append(cs, Check{Name: "Часы сервера", Detail: "время сервера не прочитано"})
	}
	return cs
}

func failedChecks(cs []Check) []string {
	var bad []string
	for _, c := range cs {
		if !c.OK {
			bad = append(bad, strings.TrimSpace(c.Name+": "+c.Detail))
		}
	}
	return bad
}

func exitPreflight(ctx context.Context, r Remote, s *State) error {
	cs, err := Preflight(ctx, r, s.Now())
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	for _, c := range cs {
		mark := "✓"
		if !c.OK {
			mark = "✗"
		}
		s.Printf("%s %s %s", mark, c.Name, c.Detail)
	}
	if bad := failedChecks(cs); len(bad) > 0 {
		return fmt.Errorf("сервер не подходит: %s", strings.Join(bad, "; "))
	}
	return nil
}

// ── Hub key, base, firewall ──

func hubKeyApply(ctx context.Context, r Remote, s *State) error {
	pub, err := EnsureHubKey(ctx, s.Hub)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if _, err := r.Run(ctx, config.AuthorizedKeyScript(pub)); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	s.Printf("ключ Hub %s добавлен; дальше Hub входит по нему, пароль остаётся запасным", HubKeyFingerprint(pub))
	return nil
}

func hubKeyVerify(ctx context.Context, r Remote, s *State) error {
	pub, err := EnsureHubKey(ctx, s.Hub)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	kv, err := runKV(ctx, r, config.AuthorizedKeyCheckScript(pub))
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if kv["PRESENT"] != "1" {
		return errors.New("ключа Hub на ноде нет")
	}
	return nil
}

var sysctlFile = File{"/etc/sysctl.d/99-bbr.conf", []byte(config.ExitSysctlConf), 0o644}

func baseApply(ctx context.Context, r Remote, s *State) error {
	if _, err := r.PutFile(ctx, sysctlFile.Path, sysctlFile.Data, sysctlFile.Mode); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	return runPrint(config.ExitBaseScript)(ctx, r, s)
}

func baseVerify(ctx context.Context, r Remote, s *State) error {
	if err := filesMatch(ctx, r, []File{sysctlFile}); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	kv, err := runKV(ctx, r, config.ExitBaseCheckScript)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if kv["BBR"] != "1" {
		return errors.New("BBR не включён")
	}
	if kv["PKGS"] != "1" {
		return errors.New("не хватает пакетов (curl, unzip, nftables, openssl, ca-certificates)")
	}
	return nil
}

func firewallApply(o ExitOptions) stepFunc {
	return func(ctx context.Context, r Remote, s *State) error {
		mt := 0
		if o.MTProto != nil {
			mt = o.MTProto.Port
		}
		return runPrint(config.ExitFirewallScript(s.Node.SSHPort, o.HubIPs, mt))(ctx, r, s)
	}
}

// ── units: files → marker → converge (restart only when needed) ──

func remoteSums(ctx context.Context, r Remote, files []File) (map[string]string, error) {
	paths := make([]string, len(files))
	for i, f := range files {
		paths[i] = f.Path
	}
	out, err := r.Run(ctx, config.SumsScript(paths...))
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	sums := map[string]string{}
	for _, l := range strings.Split(out, "\n") {
		if f := strings.Fields(l); len(f) == 2 {
			sums[f[1]] = f[0]
		}
	}
	return sums, nil
}

func filesMatch(ctx context.Context, r Remote, files []File) error {
	sums, err := remoteSums(ctx, r, files)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	for _, f := range files {
		if sums[f.Path] != sha256Hex(f.Data) {
			return fmt.Errorf("%s отличается от эталона", f.Path)
		}
	}
	return nil
}

// installUnit marks the unit for a restart BEFORE writing a differing file, so an SSH drop
// between the write and the restart cannot lose the restart.
func installUnit(ctx context.Context, r Remote, s *State, unit string, files []File, extra string) error {
	sums, err := remoteSums(ctx, r, files)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	for _, f := range files {
		if sums[f.Path] != sha256Hex(f.Data) {
			if _, err := r.Run(ctx, config.MarkRestartScript(unit)); err != nil {
				return err
			}
			break
		}
	}
	for _, f := range files {
		changed, err := r.PutFile(ctx, f.Path, f.Data, f.Mode)
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		if changed {
			s.noteChanged(unit, f.Path)
			s.Printf("записан %s", f.Path)
		}
	}
	return runPrint(config.UnitConvergeScript(unit, extra))(ctx, r, s)
}

func unitVerify(ctx context.Context, r Remote, unit string, files []File) error {
	if err := filesMatch(ctx, r, files); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	kv, err := runKV(ctx, r, config.UnitStateScript(unit))
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if kv["MARKER"] == "1" {
		return fmt.Errorf("%s ждёт перезапуска с новой конфигурацией", unit)
	}
	if kv["ACTIVE"] != "1" {
		return fmt.Errorf("%s не запущен", unit)
	}
	return nil
}

func unitRollback(unit string) stepFunc {
	return func(ctx context.Context, r Remote, s *State) error {
		return runPrint(config.UnitRollbackScript(unit, s.changed[unit]))(ctx, r, s)
	}
}

func orNone(v string) string {
	if v == "" {
		return "нет"
	}
	return v
}

// ── hysteria (main tunnel) + port hopping ──

var hopFiles = []File{{config.ExitPortHopConfPath, []byte(config.ExitPortHopConf), 0o644}, {config.ExitPortHopUnitPath, []byte(config.ExitPortHopUnit), 0o644}}

func hysteriaFiles(o ExitOptions, s *State) []File {
	return []File{
		{config.ExitHysteriaConfig, []byte(config.ExitHysteriaServerYAML(s.Keys.SSPassword, s.Node.IP, o.MTProtoPort)), 0o600},
		{"/etc/systemd/system/hysteria2.service", []byte(config.ExitHysteriaUnit), 0o644},
	}
}

func hysteriaApply(o ExitOptions) stepFunc {
	return func(ctx context.Context, r Remote, s *State) error {
		if err := s.needKeys(); err != nil {
			return err
		}
		if err := installUnit(ctx, r, s, "hysteria2", hysteriaFiles(o, s), config.ExitHysteriaPrepareScript()); err != nil {
			return err
		}
		for _, f := range hopFiles {
			if _, err := r.PutFile(ctx, f.Path, f.Data, f.Mode); err != nil {
				return err
			}
		}
		return runPrint(config.ExitPortHopApplyScript)(ctx, r, s)
	}
}

func hysteriaVerify(o ExitOptions) stepFunc {
	return func(ctx context.Context, r Remote, s *State) error {
		if err := s.needKeys(); err != nil {
			return err
		}
		if err := unitVerify(ctx, r, "hysteria2", append(hysteriaFiles(o, s), hopFiles...)); err != nil {
			return err
		}
		kv, err := runKV(ctx, r, config.HysteriaCheckScript)
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		switch {
		case kv["VERSION"] != config.HysteriaVersion:
			return fmt.Errorf("hysteria %s, нужна %s", orNone(kv["VERSION"]), config.HysteriaVersion)
		case kv["LISTEN"] != "1":
			return errors.New("hysteria не слушает UDP 50443")
		case kv["HOP"] != "1":
			return errors.New("правило прыжков портов не применено")
		}
		return nil
	}
}

// ── xray (TCP fallback, VLESS Reality :10443) ──

func xrayFiles(o ExitOptions, s *State) ([]File, error) {
	cfg, err := config.ExitXrayConfigJSON(s.Keys, s.Node.IP, o.MTProtoPort)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	return []File{{config.ExitXrayConfig, cfg, 0o600}, {"/etc/systemd/system/xray.service", []byte(config.ExitXrayUnit), 0o644}}, nil
}

func xrayApply(o ExitOptions) stepFunc {
	return func(ctx context.Context, r Remote, s *State) error {
		if err := s.needKeys(); err != nil {
			return err
		}
		files, err := xrayFiles(o, s)
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		return installUnit(ctx, r, s, "xray", files, config.ExitXrayPrepareScript())
	}
}

func xrayVerify(o ExitOptions) stepFunc {
	return func(ctx context.Context, r Remote, s *State) error {
		if err := s.needKeys(); err != nil {
			return err
		}
		files, err := xrayFiles(o, s)
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		if err := unitVerify(ctx, r, "xray", files); err != nil {
			return err
		}
		kv, err := runKV(ctx, r, config.XrayCheckScript)
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		if want := strings.TrimPrefix(config.XrayExitVersion, "v"); kv["VERSION"] != want {
			return fmt.Errorf("xray %s, нужна %s", orNone(kv["VERSION"]), want)
		}
		if kv["LISTEN"] != "1" {
			return errors.New("xray не слушает TCP 10443")
		}
		return nil
	}
}

// ── node-agent with its own certificate ──

func agentBaseFiles(o ExitOptions) ([]File, []byte, []byte, error) {
	bin, err := o.NodeAgent()
	if err != nil {
		return nil, nil, nil, fmt.Errorf("бинарник node-agent на Hub: %w", err)
	}
	ca, caKey, err := o.CA()
	if err != nil {
		return nil, nil, nil, fmt.Errorf("CA node-agent на Hub: %w", err)
	}
	return []File{{config.NodeAgentBinary, bin, 0o755}, {config.NodeAgentCACert, ca, 0o644},
		{config.NodeAgentUnitPath, []byte(config.NodeAgentUnit), 0o644}}, ca, caKey, nil
}

func agentApply(o ExitOptions) stepFunc {
	return func(ctx context.Context, r Remote, s *State) error {
		files, ca, caKey, err := agentBaseFiles(o)
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		cur, err := r.Run(ctx, config.CatScript(config.NodeAgentCert))
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		if cerr := CheckNodeCert([]byte(cur), ca, s.Node.IP, s.Now()); cerr != nil {
			cert, key, err := IssueNodeCert(ca, caKey, s.Node.IP, s.Now())
			if err != nil {
				return err
			}
			s.Printf("сертификат агента: %v — выпускаю собственный для %s", cerr, s.Node.IP)
			files = append(files, File{config.NodeAgentCert, cert, 0o644}, File{config.NodeAgentKey, key, 0o600})
		}
		return installUnit(ctx, r, s, "node-agent", files, "")
	}
}

func agentVerify(o ExitOptions) stepFunc {
	return func(ctx context.Context, r Remote, s *State) error {
		files, ca, _, err := agentBaseFiles(o)
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		cur, err := r.Run(ctx, config.CatScript(config.NodeAgentCert))
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		if err := CheckNodeCert([]byte(cur), ca, s.Node.IP, s.Now()); err != nil {
			return err
		}
		if err := unitVerify(ctx, r, "node-agent", files); err != nil {
			return err
		}
		if s.Hooks.ProbeAgent != nil {
			if err := s.Hooks.ProbeAgent(ctx, s.Node.IP); err != nil {
				return fmt.Errorf("Hub не достучался до агента по mTLS: %v (TCP 50052 с IP Hub должен быть открыт, в том числе в панели хостера)", err)
			}
		}
		return nil
	}
}

// ── DB tunnel row, Hub client, end-to-end paths, activation ──

func wantTunnel(s *State) Tunnel {
	return Tunnel{UUID: s.Keys.UUID, PublicKey: s.Keys.PublicKey, ShortID: s.Keys.ShortID, SNI: config.ExitRealitySNI, Password: s.Keys.SSPassword}
}

func tunnelVerify(ctx context.Context, _ Remote, s *State) error {
	if err := s.needKeys(); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	cur, err := s.Hooks.LoadTunnel(ctx, s.Node.ID)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if cur != wantTunnel(s) {
		return errors.New("данные туннеля в базе не совпадают с ключами на ноде")
	}
	return nil
}

func tunnelApply(ctx context.Context, _ Remote, s *State) error {
	if err := s.needKeys(); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	changed, err := s.Hooks.SaveTunnel(ctx, s.Node.ID, wantTunnel(s))
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if changed && s.Node.Lifecycle == "online" {
		s.Hooks.RequestSync()
		s.Printf("данные туннеля обновлены — Xray на Hub получит их при синхронизации")
	}
	return nil
}

func hubUnit(s *State) string { return "hysteria2-client-" + strconv.Itoa(s.Node.ID) }

func hubClientFiles(s *State) []File {
	id := s.Node.ID
	return []File{
		{fmt.Sprintf("%s/client-%d.yaml", config.HubHysteriaDir, id), []byte(config.HubHysteriaClientYAML(id, s.Node.IP, s.Keys.SSPassword, 1088+id)), 0o600},
		{fmt.Sprintf("/etc/systemd/system/hysteria2-client-%d.service", id), []byte(config.HubHysteriaClientUnit(id, s.Node.IP)), 0o644},
	}
}

func hubClientApply(ctx context.Context, _ Remote, s *State) error {
	if err := s.needKeys(); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	return installUnit(ctx, s.Hub, s, hubUnit(s), hubClientFiles(s), config.HysteriaEnsureScript())
}

func hubClientVerify(ctx context.Context, _ Remote, s *State) error {
	if err := s.needKeys(); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	return unitVerify(ctx, s.Hub, hubUnit(s), hubClientFiles(s))
}

func hubClientRollback(ctx context.Context, _ Remote, s *State) error {
	return runPrint(config.UnitRollbackScript(hubUnit(s), s.changed[hubUnit(s)]))(ctx, s.Hub, s)
}

func pathHysteria(ctx context.Context, _ Remote, s *State) error {
	port := 1088 + s.Node.ID
	kv, err := runKV(ctx, s.Hub, config.SocksProbeScript(port))
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if kv["HTTP"] != "204" {
		return fmt.Errorf("через основной туннель нет ответа 204 (код %s)", orNone(kv["HTTP"]))
	}
	s.Printf("generate_204 через 127.0.0.1:%d — 204", port)
	return nil
}

func pathTCP(o ExitOptions) stepFunc {
	return func(ctx context.Context, _ Remote, s *State) error {
		if !s.Node.FallbackEnabled {
			s.Printf("запасной TCP-путь выключен владельцем — не проверяю")
			return nil
		}
		if err := s.needKeys(); err != nil {
			return err
		}
		port := config.VRProbeSocksPort(s.Node.ID)
		cfg, err := config.ExitRealityProbeConfig(port, config.RealityProbe{ExitIP: s.Node.IP, UUID: s.Keys.UUID,
			PublicKey: s.Keys.PublicKey, ShortID: s.Keys.ShortID, SNI: config.ExitRealitySNI})
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		path := fmt.Sprintf("/opt/heyearth/state/vr-probe-%d.json", s.Node.ID)
		if _, err := s.Hub.PutFile(ctx, path, cfg, 0o600); err != nil {
			return err
		}
		kv, err := runKV(ctx, s.Hub, config.VRProbeScript(o.HubXray, path, port))
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		if kv["HTTP"] != "204" {
			return fmt.Errorf("через запасной TCP-путь нет ответа 204 (код %s)", orNone(kv["HTTP"]))
		}
		s.Printf("generate_204 через VLESS Reality %s:%d — 204", s.Node.IP, config.ExitRealityPort)
		return nil
	}
}

// activateApply: both paths were just checked by this job, so the node goes online AND healthy
// in one write — the Xray generator (phase 1) sees it once: exactly one restart.
func activateApply(ctx context.Context, _ Remote, s *State) error {
	if err := s.Hooks.Activate(ctx, s.Node.ID); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if err := s.Hooks.BumpSubscription(ctx); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	s.Hooks.RequestSync()
	s.Printf("нода включена в маршрутизацию; Xray пересоберёт конфигурацию один раз")
	return nil
}
```

`server/backend/internal/provision/keys.go`:

```go
package provision

import (
	"context"
	"crypto/ecdh"
	"crypto/rand"
	"encoding/base64"
	"encoding/hex"
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"regexp"
	"strings"

	"github.com/heyearth/backend/internal/config"
)

var (
	uuidRe     = regexp.MustCompile(`^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$`)
	shortIDRe  = regexp.MustCompile(`^([0-9a-f]{2}){1,8}$`)
	tunnelPwRe = regexp.MustCompile(`^[A-Za-z0-9+/=]{16,}$`)
)

func readKeys(ctx context.Context, r Remote) (config.ExitRealityKeys, bool, error) {
	var k config.ExitRealityKeys
	out, err := r.Run(ctx, config.CatScript(config.ExitKeysPath))
	if err != nil || strings.TrimSpace(out) == "" {
		return k, false, err
	}
	if err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(out), &k); err != nil {
		return k, true, fmt.Errorf("файл ключей %s не читается: %w", config.ExitKeysPath, err)
	}
	return k, true, nil
}

func keysVerify(ctx context.Context, r Remote, s *State) error {
	k, ok, err := readKeys(ctx, r)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if !ok {
		return errors.New("файла ключей туннеля ещё нет")
	}
	if err := validKeys(k); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	s.Keys = k
	return nil
}

// keysApply keeps every existing key (Amsterdam keeps its tunnel) and only adds missing ones.
func keysApply(ctx context.Context, r Remote, s *State) error {
	k, _, err := readKeys(ctx, r)
	if err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("%w — не перезаписываю, нужна ручная проверка", err)
	}
	if k, err = completeKeys(k); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	b, err := json.MarshalIndent(k, "", "  ")
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if _, err := r.PutFile(ctx, config.ExitKeysPath, append(b, '\n'), 0o600); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	s.Keys = k
	s.Printf("ключи туннеля готовы (открытый ключ %s…)", k.PublicKey[:8])
	return nil
}

func derivePublic(priv string) (string, error) {
	raw, err := base64.RawURLEncoding.DecodeString(priv)
	if err != nil || len(raw) != 32 {
		return "", errors.New("закрытый ключ Reality повреждён")
	}
	k, err := ecdh.X25519().NewPrivateKey(raw)
	if err != nil {
		return "", err
	}
	return base64.RawURLEncoding.EncodeToString(k.PublicKey().Bytes()), nil
}

func completeKeys(k config.ExitRealityKeys) (config.ExitRealityKeys, error) {
	if k.PrivateKey == "" {
		priv, err := ecdh.X25519().GenerateKey(rand.Reader)
		if err != nil {
			return k, err
		}
		k.PrivateKey = base64.RawURLEncoding.EncodeToString(priv.Bytes())
	}
	pub, err := derivePublic(k.PrivateKey)
	if err != nil {
		return k, err
	}
	k.PublicKey = pub
	if k.ShortID == "" {
		b := make([]byte, 8)
		if _, err := rand.Read(b); err != nil {
			return k, err
		}
		k.ShortID = hex.EncodeToString(b)
	}
	if k.UUID == "" {
		b := make([]byte, 16)
		if _, err := rand.Read(b); err != nil {
			return k, err
		}
		b[6], b[8] = b[6]&0x0f|0x40, b[8]&0x3f|0x80
		k.UUID = fmt.Sprintf("%x-%x-%x-%x-%x", b[0:4], b[4:6], b[6:8], b[8:10], b[10:])
	}
	if k.SSPassword == "" {
		if k.SSPassword, err = randomPassword(); err != nil {
			return k, err
		}
	}
	return k, validKeys(k)
}

func validKeys(k config.ExitRealityKeys) error {
	pub, err := derivePublic(k.PrivateKey)
	switch {
	case err != nil:
		return err
	case pub != k.PublicKey:
		return errors.New("открытый ключ Reality не соответствует закрытому")
	case !uuidRe.MatchString(k.UUID):
		return errors.New("UUID туннеля некорректен")
	case !shortIDRe.MatchString(k.ShortID):
		return errors.New("shortId некорректен")
	case !tunnelPwRe.MatchString(k.SSPassword):
		return errors.New("пароль туннеля некорректен")
	}
	return nil
}
```

```go
	p := &fakeProvisioner{}
	withProvisioning(t, p, provision.Node{ID: 7, Lifecycle: "pending"})
	if rec := call(ProvisionNodeHandler, "POST", "/api/admin/servers/7/provision", `{"mtproxy":true,"plan_ids":[1,2]}`); rec.Code != 202 {
		t.Fatalf("%d %s", rec.Code, rec.Body)
	}
	NodeJobs = fakeJobs{node: provision.Node{ID: 7, Lifecycle: "online"}}
	call(ProvisionNodeHandler, "POST", "/api/admin/servers/7/provision", "")
	if !slices.Equal(p.kinds, []string{provision.KindProvision, provision.KindReprovision}) {
		t.Fatalf("kinds %v", p.kinds)
	}
	if rec := call(ProvisionNodeHandler, "POST", "/api/admin/servers/7/provision", `{"load_weight":11}`); rec.Code != 400 {
		t.Fatalf("weight 11: %d", rec.Code)
	}
	p.err = provision.ErrJobActive
	if rec := call(ProvisionNodeHandler, "POST", "/api/admin/servers/7/provision", ""); rec.Code != 409 {
		t.Fatalf("active job: %d", rec.Code)
	}
}

func TestDeprovisionNeedsTypedName(t *testing.T) {
	p := &fakeProvisioner{}
	withProvisioning(t, p, provision.Node{ID: 7, Name: "Франкфурт", Lifecycle: "online"})
	if rec := call(DeprovisionNodeHandler, "POST", "/api/admin/servers/7/deprovision", `{"confirm_name":"франкфурт"}`); rec.Code != 400 || len(p.kinds) != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("wrong name: %d %v", rec.Code, p.kinds)
	}
	if rec := call(DeprovisionNodeHandler, "POST", "/api/admin/servers/7/deprovision", `{"confirm_name":"Франкфурт"}`); rec.Code != 202 || p.kinds[0] != provision.KindDeprovision {
		t.Fatalf("%d %v", rec.Code, p.kinds)
	}
}

func TestResumeAndHostKeyConflicts(t *testing.T) {
	p := &fakeProvisioner{err: provision.ErrJobNotResumable}
	withProvisioning(t, p, provision.Node{ID: 7, IP: "203.0.113.7", SSHPort: 22})
	if rec := call(ResumeJobHandler, "POST", "/api/admin/provision-jobs/42/resume", ""); rec.Code != 409 || !slices.Equal(p.resumed, []int64{42}) {
		t.Fatalf("%d %v", rec.Code, p.resumed)
	}
	NodeProbe = func(context.Context, string, int) (provision.ProbeResult, error) {
		return provision.ProbeResult{Fingerprint: "SHA256:BBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBB"}, nil
	}
	rec := call(ConfirmHostKeyHandler, "POST", "/api/admin/servers/7/host-key", `{"fingerprint":"SHA256:AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA"}`)
	if rec.Code != 409 || !strings.Contains(rec.Body.String(), "SHA256:BBBB") {
		t.Fatalf("a fingerprint the server does not present must not be stored: %d %s", rec.Code, rec.Body)
	}
}

// Review Focus 5 for this phase's endpoints: the node list never selects a secret column.
func TestListNodesQueryHasNoSecrets(t *testing.T) {
	if regexp.MustCompile(`ssh_password|private_key|tunnel_ss_password|tunnel_uuid`).MatchString(listNodesQuery) {
		t.Fatalf("secret column in listNodesQuery:\n%s", listNodesQuery)
	}
	withProvisioning(t, &fakeProvisioner{}, provision.Node{})
	var resp map[string]any
	rec := call(GetJobHandler, "GET", "/api/admin/provision-jobs/42", "")
	if err := json.Unmarshal(rec.Body.Bytes(), &resp); err != nil || resp["id"] != float64(42) {
		t.Fatalf("job view: %d %s", rec.Code, rec.Body)
	}
}

func TestNodeRoutesUseProvisionPermission(t *testing.T) {
	b, err := os.ReadFile("routes.go")
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	src := string(b)
	for _, h := range []string{"ProbeNodeHandler", "CreateNodeHandler", "ConfirmHostKeyHandler", "PreflightNodeHandler", "ProvisionNodeHandler",
		"VerifyNodeHandler", "DeprovisionNodeHandler", "DeleteServerHandler", "NodeRoutingHandler", "ResumeJobHandler"} {
		if !strings.Contains(src, `RequirePermission("nodes.provision", `+h+`)`) {
			t.Errorf("%s is not behind nodes.provision", h)
		}
	}
	if strings.Contains(src, "ServerActionProgressHandler") {
		t.Error("the in-memory progress endpoint must be gone")
	}
	// ensureSuperAdminRole rebuilds super_admin from permissionCatalog on every login (phase 1,
	// Task 1.7): a key only in migration 000060 would be stripped from the owner.
	if !slices.Contains(allPermissionKeys(), "nodes.provision") {
		t.Error("nodes.provision is missing from permissionCatalog")
	}
}

// SSH to nodes only with the owner-confirmed key; the API never restarts itself.
func TestAdminHasNoUnpinnedSSHOrSelfRestart(t *testing.T) {
	files, _ := filepath.Glob("*.go")
	for _, f := range files {
		if strings.HasSuffix(f, "_test.go") {
			continue
		}
		b, _ := os.ReadFile(f)
		s := string(b)
		if strings.Contains(s, "InsecureIgnoreHostKey") || strings.Contains(s, "toFUHostKeyCallback") || strings.Contains(s, "ssh.Dial(") ||
			regexp.MustCompile(`exec\.Command\([^)]*heyearth-api`).MatchString(s) {
			t.Errorf("%s: unpinned SSH or API self-restart", f)
		}
	}
}
```

```go
package admin

import (
	"context"
	"database/sql"
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"io"
	"net"
	"net/http"
	"regexp"
	"strconv"
	"strings"
	"time"

	"github.com/heyearth/backend/internal/biz"
	"github.com/heyearth/backend/internal/crypto"
	"github.com/heyearth/backend/internal/db"
	pbnode "github.com/heyearth/backend/internal/pb/node_agent_v1"
	"github.com/heyearth/backend/internal/provision"
	"github.com/lib/pq"
)

// Provisioner runs node jobs (internal/provision.Runner, set by cmd/api).
type Provisioner interface {
	Start(ctx context.Context, serverID int, kind string) (int64, error)
	Resume(ctx context.Context, jobID int64) error
}

// NodeJobStore reads nodes and jobs (*provision.SQLStore, set by cmd/api).
type NodeJobStore interface {
	LoadNode(ctx context.Context, serverID int) (provision.Node, error)
	JobView(ctx context.Context, jobID int64) (provision.JobView, error)
	ListJobs(ctx context.Context, serverID, limit int) ([]provision.JobView, error)
}

var (
	NodeProvisioner Provisioner
	NodeJobs        NodeJobStore
	NodeProbe       = provision.Probe
	NodeDial        = provision.DialNode
	HubPublicKey    func(ctx context.Context) (string, error)
	saveNodeOptions = saveNodeOptionsDB
)

var fingerprintRe = regexp.MustCompile(`^SHA256:[A-Za-z0-9+/]{43}$`)

func provisionReady(w http.ResponseWriter) bool {
	if NodeProvisioner == nil || NodeJobs == nil {
		writeAdminError(w, http.StatusServiceUnavailable, "Провижининг не инициализирован")
		return false
	}
	return true
}

func writeJobError(w http.ResponseWriter, err error) {
	switch {
	case errors.Is(err, provision.ErrJobActive):
		writeAdminError(w, http.StatusConflict, "Для этой ноды уже выполняется задача — дождитесь её окончания")
	case errors.Is(err, provision.ErrJobNotResumable):
		writeAdminError(w, http.StatusConflict, err.Error())
	case errors.Is(err, provision.ErrHostKeyNotConfirmed):
		writeAdminError(w, http.StatusConflict, "Сначала подтвердите отпечаток ключа сервера")
	default:
		writeAdminError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, err.Error())
	}
}

// decodeOptional: an empty body is an empty object.
func decodeOptional(r *http.Request, v any) error {
	if err := json.NewDecoder(r.Body).Decode(v); err != nil && !errors.Is(err, io.EOF) {
		return err
	}
	return nil
}

func nodeRemote(ctx context.Context, serverID int) (provision.Remote, error) {
	if NodeJobs == nil {
		return nil, errors.New("провижининг не инициализирован")
	}
	n, err := NodeJobs.LoadNode(ctx, serverID)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	return NodeDial(n)
}

// ProbeNodeAgent: one mTLS GetMetrics (the recipe's node-agent check).
func ProbeNodeAgent(ctx context.Context, ip string) error {
	ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(ctx, 10*time.Second)
	defer cancel()
	client, conn, err := connectToNodeAgent(ctx, ip)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	defer conn.Close()
	_, err = client.GetMetrics(ctx, &pbnode.GetMetricsRequest{})
	return err
}

type probePayload struct {
	IPAddress string `json:"ip_address"`
	SSHPort   int    `json:"ssh_port"`
	ServerID  int    `json:"server_id"`
}

// ProbeNodeHandler — SSH key exchange only: nothing stored, no password leaves the Hub.
func ProbeNodeHandler(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	var req probePayload
	if err := json.NewDecoder(r.Body).Decode(&req); err != nil {
		writeAdminError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "Invalid request body")
		return
	}
	if req.ServerID > 0 {
		if !provisionReady(w) {
			return
		}
		n, err := NodeJobs.LoadNode(r.Context(), req.ServerID)
		if err != nil {
			writeAdminError(w, http.StatusNotFound, err.Error())
			return
		}
		req.IPAddress, req.SSHPort = n.IP, n.SSHPort
	}
	ip := net.ParseIP(strings.TrimSpace(req.IPAddress))
	if ip == nil {
		writeAdminError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "IP-адрес сервера некорректен")
		return
	}
	if req.SSHPort == 0 {
		req.SSHPort = 22
	}
	if req.SSHPort < 1 || req.SSHPort > 65535 {
		writeAdminError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "SSH-порт должен быть от 1 до 65535")
		return
	}
	ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(r.Context(), 20*time.Second)
	defer cancel()
	res, err := NodeProbe(ctx, ip.String(), req.SSHPort)
	if err != nil {
		writeAdminError(w, http.StatusBadGateway, err.Error())
		return
	}
	writeAdminJSON(w, http.StatusOK, res)
}

type createNodePayload struct {
	Name        string `json:"name"`
	Role        string `json:"role"`
	CountryCode string `json:"country_code"`
	IPAddress   string `json:"ip_address"`
	SSHPort     int    `json:"ssh_port"`
	SSHUser     string `json:"ssh_user"`
	SSHPassword string `json:"ssh_password"`
	HostKeyFP   string `json:"ssh_host_key_fp"`
}

const insertNodeQuery = `
INSERT INTO servers (name, role, is_exit_node, ip_address, ssh_port, ssh_user, ssh_password_enc, country_code,
                     status, lifecycle_state, ssh_host_key_fp, ssh_host_key_confirmed_at, load_weight, updated_at)
VALUES ($1, $2, $2 = 'exit', $3, $4, $5, $6, $7, 'provisioning', 'pending', $8, NOW(), 1, NOW())
RETURNING id`

// CreateNodeHandler stores a pending node: the fingerprint the owner just confirmed, the root
// password encrypted (never in plaintext — no key, no node).
func CreateNodeHandler(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	var req createNodePayload
	if err := json.NewDecoder(r.Body).Decode(&req); err != nil {
		writeAdminError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "Invalid request body")
		return
	}
	ip := net.ParseIP(strings.TrimSpace(req.IPAddress))
	if ip == nil {
		writeAdminError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "IP-адрес сервера некорректен")
		return
	}
	if req.Role == "" {
		req.Role = "exit"
	}
	if req.Role != "exit" {
		writeAdminError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "Резервные входы в РФ добавляются в следующем обновлении")
		return
	}
	if err := validateCountryCode(req.CountryCode); err != nil {
		writeAdminError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, err.Error())
		return
	}
	req.CountryCode = strings.ToUpper(strings.TrimSpace(req.CountryCode))
	if req.SSHPort == 0 {
		req.SSHPort = 22
	}
	if req.SSHPort < 1 || req.SSHPort > 65535 {
		writeAdminError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "SSH-порт должен быть от 1 до 65535")
		return
	}
	if strings.TrimSpace(req.SSHUser) == "" {
		req.SSHUser = "root"
	}
	if !fingerprintRe.MatchString(strings.TrimSpace(req.HostKeyFP)) {
		writeAdminError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "Сначала проверьте подключение и подтвердите отпечаток ключа сервера")
		return
	}
	if strings.TrimSpace(req.SSHPassword) == "" {
		writeAdminError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "Нужен пароль root: он хранится зашифрованно и нужен, пока на сервер не поставлен ключ Hub")
		return
	}
	enc, err := crypto.Encrypt(req.SSHPassword)
	if err != nil || len(enc) == 0 {
		writeAdminError(w, http.StatusServiceUnavailable, "На Hub не задан SSH_ENCRYPTION_KEY — пароль нельзя сохранить зашифрованно. Выполните go run ./cmd/deploy --ensure-hub-provisioning")
		return
	}
	name := strings.TrimSpace(req.Name)
	if name == "" {
		name = "Выход " + req.CountryCode
	}
	var exists bool
	if err := db.DB.QueryRowContext(r.Context(), `SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM servers WHERE ip_address = $1)`, ip.String()).Scan(&exists); err != nil {
		writeAdminError(w, http.StatusInternalServerError, "Failed to check server")
		return
	}
	if exists {
		writeAdminError(w, http.StatusConflict, "Сервер с этим IP уже добавлен")
		return
	}
	var id int
	if err := db.DB.QueryRowContext(r.Context(), insertNodeQuery, name, req.Role, ip.String(), req.SSHPort, strings.TrimSpace(req.SSHUser),
		enc, req.CountryCode, strings.TrimSpace(req.HostKeyFP)).Scan(&id); err != nil {
		writeAdminError(w, http.StatusInternalServerError, "Failed to insert server")
		return
	}
	WriteAuditLog(r, "create_node", "server", strconv.Itoa(id), map[string]string{"name": name, "ip": ip.String(), "fingerprint": req.HostKeyFP})
	writeAdminJSON(w, http.StatusCreated, map[string]any{"id": id})
}

func ConfirmHostKeyHandler(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	id, ok := parseLastPathSegmentBeforeFinal(r.URL.Path, "host-key")
	if !ok {
		writeAdminError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "Invalid server id")
		return
	}
	var req struct {
		Fingerprint string `json:"fingerprint"`
	}
	if err := json.NewDecoder(r.Body).Decode(&req); err != nil || !fingerprintRe.MatchString(strings.TrimSpace(req.Fingerprint)) {
		writeAdminError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "Отпечаток должен выглядеть как SHA256:…")
		return
	}
	if !provisionReady(w) {
		return
	}
	ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(r.Context(), 20*time.Second)
	defer cancel()
	n, err := NodeJobs.LoadNode(ctx, id)
	if err != nil {
		writeAdminError(w, http.StatusNotFound, err.Error())
		return
	}
	live, err := NodeProbe(ctx, n.IP, n.SSHPort)
	if err != nil {
		writeAdminError(w, http.StatusBadGateway, err.Error())
		return
	}
	fp := strings.TrimSpace(req.Fingerprint)
	if live.Fingerprint != fp {
		writeAdminError(w, http.StatusConflict, fmt.Sprintf("Сервер сейчас предъявляет другой ключ (%s). Сверьте с панелью хостера.", live.Fingerprint))
		return
	}
	if _, err := db.DB.ExecContext(ctx, `UPDATE servers SET ssh_host_key_fp = $2, ssh_host_key_confirmed_at = NOW(), updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = $1`, id, fp); err != nil {
		writeAdminError(w, http.StatusInternalServerError, "Failed to save fingerprint")
		return
	}
	WriteAuditLog(r, "confirm_host_key", "server", strconv.Itoa(id), map[string]string{"fingerprint": fp})
	writeAdminJSON(w, http.StatusOK, map[string]any{"fingerprint": fp, "confirmed": true})
}

func PreflightNodeHandler(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	id, ok := parseLastPathSegmentBeforeFinal(r.URL.Path, "preflight")
	if !ok || !provisionReady(w) {
		if !ok {
			writeAdminError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "Invalid server id")
		}
		return
	}
	ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(r.Context(), 60*time.Second)
	defer cancel()
	rm, err := nodeRemote(ctx, id)
	if errors.Is(err, provision.ErrHostKeyNotConfirmed) {
		writeJobError(w, err)
		return
	}
	if err != nil {
		writeAdminError(w, http.StatusBadGateway, "Не удалось войти на сервер: "+err.Error())
		return
	}
	defer provision.Close(rm)
	checks, err := provision.Preflight(ctx, rm, time.Now())
	if err != nil {
		writeAdminError(w, http.StatusBadGateway, err.Error())
		return
	}
	ok = true
	for _, c := range checks {
		ok = ok && c.OK
	}
	writeAdminJSON(w, http.StatusOK, map[string]any{"ok": ok, "checks": checks})
}

type provisionPayload struct {
	MTProxy    *bool  `json:"mtproxy"`
	PlanIDs    *[]int `json:"plan_ids"`
	LoadWeight *int   `json:"load_weight"`
}

// saveNodeOptionsDB stores the wizard's choices before the job (they must survive a resume).
func saveNodeOptionsDB(ctx context.Context, id int, o provisionPayload) error {
	if o.PlanIDs != nil {
		if err := provision.BindPlans(ctx, db.DB, id, *o.PlanIDs); err != nil {
			return err
		}
	}
	if o.LoadWeight != nil {
		if _, err := db.DB.ExecContext(ctx, `UPDATE servers SET load_weight = $2, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = $1`, id, *o.LoadWeight); err != nil {
			return err
		}
	}
	if o.MTProxy != nil {
		q := `UPDATE servers SET mtproto_status = 'unknown' WHERE id = $1 AND mtproto_status = 'disabled'`
		if !*o.MTProxy {
			q = `UPDATE servers SET mtproto_status = 'disabled', mtproto_installed_at = NULL WHERE id = $1`
		}
		if _, err := db.DB.ExecContext(ctx, q, id); err != nil {
			return err
		}
	}
	return nil
}

func ProvisionNodeHandler(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	id, ok := parseLastPathSegmentBeforeFinal(r.URL.Path, "provision")
	if !ok {
		writeAdminError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "Invalid server id")
		return
	}
	var req provisionPayload
	if err := decodeOptional(r, &req); err != nil {
		writeAdminError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "Invalid request body")
		return
	}
	if req.LoadWeight != nil && (*req.LoadWeight < 1 || *req.LoadWeight > 10) {
		writeAdminError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "Приоритет — от 1 до 10")
		return
	}
	if !provisionReady(w) {
		return
	}
	n, err := NodeJobs.LoadNode(r.Context(), id)
	if err != nil {
		writeAdminError(w, http.StatusNotFound, err.Error())
		return
	}
	kind := provision.KindProvision
	if n.Lifecycle == "online" {
		kind = provision.KindReprovision
	}
	if err := saveNodeOptions(r.Context(), id, req); err != nil {
		writeAdminError(w, http.StatusInternalServerError, "Не удалось сохранить настройки ноды: "+err.Error())
		return
	}
	startJob(w, r, id, kind)
}

func startJob(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request, id int, kind string) {
	jobID, err := NodeProvisioner.Start(r.Context(), id, kind)
	if err != nil {
		writeJobError(w, err)
		return
	}
	WriteAuditLog(r, "node_job_"+kind, "server", strconv.Itoa(id), map[string]any{"job_id": jobID})
	writeAdminJSON(w, http.StatusAccepted, map[string]any{"job_id": jobID, "kind": kind})
}

func VerifyNodeHandler(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	id, ok := parseLastPathSegmentBeforeFinal(r.URL.Path, "verify")
	if !ok {
		writeAdminError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "Invalid server id")
		return
	}
	if provisionReady(w) {
		startJob(w, r, id, provision.KindVerify)
	}
}

type confirmPayload struct {
	ConfirmName string `json:"confirm_name"`
}

// confirmedNode loads the node and checks the typed name (ConfirmDanger in the UI, enforced here too).
func confirmedNode(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request, suffix string) (int, bool) {
	id, ok := parseLastPathSegmentBeforeFinal(r.URL.Path, suffix)
	if suffix == "" {
		id, ok = parseLastPathInt(r.URL.Path)
	}
	var req confirmPayload
	if !ok || decodeOptional(r, &req) != nil {
		writeAdminError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "Invalid request")
		return 0, false
	}
	if !provisionReady(w) {
		return 0, false
	}
	n, err := NodeJobs.LoadNode(r.Context(), id)
	if err != nil {
		writeAdminError(w, http.StatusNotFound, err.Error())
		return 0, false
	}
	if strings.TrimSpace(req.ConfirmName) != n.Name {
		writeAdminError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "Введите название ноды точно — так подтверждается опасное действие")
		return 0, false
	}
	return id, true
}

func DeprovisionNodeHandler(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	if id, ok := confirmedNode(w, r, "deprovision"); ok {
		startJob(w, r, id, provision.KindDeprovision)
	}
}

const deleteNodeQuery = `DELETE FROM servers WHERE id = $1 AND lifecycle_state IN ('pending', 'offline', 'failed')
   AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM provision_jobs WHERE server_id = $1 AND status IN ('queued', 'running'))`

// DeleteServerHandler removes the row of a node that is already out of service (its jobs go
// with it, ON DELETE CASCADE); a live node is first switched off by the deprovision job.
func DeleteServerHandler(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	id, ok := confirmedNode(w, r, "")
	if !ok {
		return
	}
	res, err := db.DB.ExecContext(r.Context(), deleteNodeQuery, id)
	if err != nil {
		writeAdminError(w, http.StatusInternalServerError, "Failed to delete server")
		return
	}
	if n, _ := res.RowsAffected(); n == 0 {
		writeAdminError(w, http.StatusConflict, "Удалить можно только отключённую ноду без активной задачи — сначала «Отключить»")
		return
	}
	biz.BumpSubscriptionVersion()
	WriteAuditLog(r, "delete_server", "server", strconv.Itoa(id), nil)
	writeAdminJSON(w, http.StatusOK, map[string]string{"message": "Нода удалена"})
}

type routingPayload struct {
	PlanIDs         *[]int `json:"plan_ids"`
	LoadWeight      int    `json:"load_weight"`
	FallbackEnabled *bool  `json:"tunnel_fallback_enabled"`
}

func NodeRoutingHandler(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	id, ok := parseLastPathSegmentBeforeFinal(r.URL.Path, "routing")
	var req routingPayload
	if !ok || json.NewDecoder(r.Body).Decode(&req) != nil {
		writeAdminError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "Invalid request")
		return
	}
	if req.LoadWeight < 1 || req.LoadWeight > 10 || req.PlanIDs == nil {
		writeAdminError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "Нужны plan_ids (пустой список — только общий пул) и приоритет от 1 до 10")
		return
	}
	if err := provision.BindPlans(r.Context(), db.DB, id, *req.PlanIDs); err != nil {
		writeAdminError(w, http.StatusInternalServerError, "Failed to bind plans")
		return
	}
	if _, err := db.DB.ExecContext(r.Context(), `UPDATE servers SET load_weight = $2,
	        tunnel_fallback_enabled = COALESCE($3, tunnel_fallback_enabled), updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = $1`,
		id, req.LoadWeight, req.FallbackEnabled); err != nil {
		writeAdminError(w, http.StatusInternalServerError, "Failed to update server")
		return
	}
	biz.RequestSync()
	WriteAuditLog(r, "node_routing", "server", strconv.Itoa(id), req)
	writeAdminJSON(w, http.StatusOK, map[string]string{"message": "Сохранено — маршрутизация обновится в течение нескольких секунд"})
}

func GetJobHandler(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	id, ok := parseLastPathInt(r.URL.Path)
	if !ok || !provisionReady(w) {
		if !ok {
			writeAdminError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "Invalid job id")
		}
		return
	}
	j, err := NodeJobs.JobView(r.Context(), int64(id))
	if errors.Is(err, sql.ErrNoRows) {
		writeAdminError(w, http.StatusNotFound, "Задача не найдена")
		return
	}
	if err != nil {
		writeAdminError(w, http.StatusInternalServerError, "Failed to load job")
		return
	}
	writeAdminJSON(w, http.StatusOK, j)
}

func ListJobsHandler(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	sid, err := strconv.Atoi(r.URL.Query().Get("server_id"))
	if err != nil || !provisionReady(w) {
		if err != nil {
			writeAdminError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "server_id обязателен")
		}
		return
	}
	jobs, err := NodeJobs.ListJobs(r.Context(), sid, 20)
	if err != nil {
		writeAdminError(w, http.StatusInternalServerError, "Failed to list jobs")
		return
	}
	writeAdminJSON(w, http.StatusOK, map[string]any{"items": jobs})
}

func ResumeJobHandler(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	id, ok := parseLastPathSegmentBeforeFinal(r.URL.Path, "resume")
	if !ok || !provisionReady(w) {
		if !ok {
			writeAdminError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "Invalid job id")
		}
		return
	}
	if err := NodeProvisioner.Resume(r.Context(), int64(id)); err != nil {
		writeJobError(w, err)
		return
	}
	WriteAuditLog(r, "node_job_resume", "provision_job", strconv.Itoa(id), nil)
	writeAdminJSON(w, http.StatusAccepted, map[string]any{"job_id": id})
}

func HubKeyHandler(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	if HubPublicKey == nil {
		writeAdminError(w, http.StatusServiceUnavailable, "Провижининг не инициализирован")
		return
	}
	pub, err := HubPublicKey(r.Context())
	if err != nil {
		writeAdminError(w, http.StatusInternalServerError, err.Error())
		return
	}
	writeAdminJSON(w, http.StatusOK, map[string]string{"public_key": pub, "fingerprint": provision.HubKeyFingerprint(pub)})
}

const listNodesQuery = `
SELECT s.id, s.name, s.role, COALESCE(s.country_code, ''), s.ip_address, s.lifecycle_state, COALESCE(s.load_weight, 1),
       COALESCE(s.tunnel_status, 'unknown'), s.tunnel_fallback_enabled, s.mtproto_status,
       COALESCE(s.ssh_host_key_fp, ''), s.ssh_host_key_confirmed_at IS NOT NULL,
       COALESCE((SELECT array_agg(ps.plan_id ORDER BY ps.plan_id) FROM plan_servers ps WHERE ps.server_id = s.id), '{}'),
       lj.id, lj.kind, lj.status, hy.status, hy.finished_at, tcp.status, tcp.finished_at
  FROM servers s
  LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT id, kind, status FROM provision_jobs WHERE server_id = s.id ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1) lj ON TRUE
  LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT st.status, st.finished_at FROM provision_steps st JOIN provision_jobs j ON j.id = st.job_id
       WHERE j.server_id = s.id AND st.name = 'path_hy' AND st.status IN ('ok', 'done', 'failed', 'drift', 'rolled_back')
       ORDER BY st.finished_at DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1) hy ON TRUE
  LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT st.status, st.finished_at FROM provision_steps st JOIN provision_jobs j ON j.id = st.job_id
       WHERE j.server_id = s.id AND st.name = 'path_tcp' AND st.status IN ('ok', 'done', 'failed', 'drift', 'rolled_back')
       ORDER BY st.finished_at DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1) tcp ON TRUE
 WHERE ($1 = '' OR s.role = $1)
 ORDER BY s.id`

type nodePath struct {
	Status    string     `json:"status"`
	CheckedAt *time.Time `json:"checked_at"`
}

type nodeJobRef struct {
	ID     int64  `json:"id"`
	Kind   string `json:"kind"`
	Status string `json:"status"`
}

type nodeItem struct {
	ID              int     `json:"id"`
	Name            string  `json:"name"`
	Role            string  `json:"role"`
	CountryCode     string  `json:"country_code"`
	IPAddress       string  `json:"ip_address"`
	Lifecycle       string  `json:"lifecycle_state"`
	LoadWeight      int     `json:"load_weight"`
	TunnelStatus    string  `json:"tunnel_status"`
	FallbackEnabled bool    `json:"tunnel_fallback_enabled"`
	MTProtoStatus   string  `json:"mtproto_status"`
	HostKey         struct {
		Fingerprint string `json:"fingerprint"`
		Confirmed   bool   `json:"confirmed"`
	} `json:"host_key"`
	PlanIDs pq.Int64Array `json:"plan_ids"`
	LastJob *nodeJobRef   `json:"last_job"`
	Paths   struct {
		Hy  nodePath `json:"hy"`
		TCP nodePath `json:"tcp"`
	} `json:"paths"`
}

// ListNodesHandler — the «Ноды» page: truthful state, both tunnel paths, never a secret.
func ListNodesHandler(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	role := r.URL.Query().Get("role")
	if role != "" && role != "exit" && role != "relay" {
		writeAdminError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "role: exit или relay")
		return
	}
	rows, err := db.DB.QueryContext(r.Context(), listNodesQuery, role)
	if err != nil {
		writeAdminError(w, http.StatusInternalServerError, "Failed to list nodes")
		return
	}
	defer rows.Close()
	items := []nodeItem{}
	for rows.Next() {
		var it nodeItem
		var jobID sql.NullInt64
		var jobKind, jobStatus, hySt, tcpSt sql.NullString
		var hyAt, tcpAt sql.NullTime
		if err := rows.Scan(&it.ID, &it.Name, &it.Role, &it.CountryCode, &it.IPAddress, &it.Lifecycle, &it.LoadWeight,
			&it.TunnelStatus, &it.FallbackEnabled, &it.MTProtoStatus, &it.HostKey.Fingerprint, &it.HostKey.Confirmed,
			&it.PlanIDs, &jobID, &jobKind, &jobStatus, &hySt, &hyAt, &tcpSt, &tcpAt); err != nil {
			writeAdminError(w, http.StatusInternalServerError, "Failed to scan node")
			return
		}
		if jobID.Valid {
			it.LastJob = &nodeJobRef{ID: jobID.Int64, Kind: jobKind.String, Status: jobStatus.String}
		}
		it.Paths.Hy = nodePath{Status: hySt.String}
		if hyAt.Valid {
			it.Paths.Hy.CheckedAt = &hyAt.Time
		}
		it.Paths.TCP = nodePath{Status: tcpSt.String}
		if tcpAt.Valid {
			it.Paths.TCP.CheckedAt = &tcpAt.Time
		}
		// The live tunnel monitor (phase 1, biz.GetExitPaths: healthy|unhealthy|unknown|absent) beats
		// the last job's path check; the job's result is shown only until the monitor has seen the exit.
		if p, ok := biz.GetExitPaths(it.ID); ok && it.Role == "exit" {
			at := p.CheckedAt
			it.Paths.Hy = nodePath{Status: p.Hy, CheckedAt: &at}
			it.Paths.TCP = nodePath{Status: p.VR, CheckedAt: &at}
		}
		items = append(items, it)
	}
	writeAdminJSON(w, http.StatusOK, map[string]any{"items": items, "total": len(items)})
}
```

```go
package main

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"regexp"
	"strings"
	"testing"

	"github.com/heyearth/backend/internal/biz"
	"github.com/heyearth/backend/internal/config"
)

func outboundsByTag(t *testing.T, cfg []byte) map[string]json.RawMessage {
	t.Helper()
	var c struct {
		Outbounds []json.RawMessage `json:"outbounds"`
	}
	if err := json.Unmarshal(cfg, &c); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	m := map[string]json.RawMessage{}
	for _, o := range c.Outbounds {
		var tag struct{ Tag string }
		_ = json.Unmarshal(o, &tag)
		m[tag.Tag] = o
	}
	return m
}

type vlessOutbound struct {
	Settings struct {
		Vnext []struct {
			Address string `json:"address"`
			Port    int    `json:"port"`
			Users   []struct {
				ID   string `json:"id"`
				Flow string `json:"flow"`
			} `json:"users"`
		} `json:"vnext"`
	} `json:"settings"`
	StreamSettings struct {
		Network         string `json:"network"`
		Security        string `json:"security"`
		RealitySettings struct {
			ServerName string `json:"serverName"`
			PublicKey  string `json:"publicKey"`
			ShortID    string `json:"shortId"`
		} `json:"realitySettings"`
	} `json:"streamSettings"`
}

// The wizard's TCP path check dials exactly what Xray's exit-<id>.vr outbound (phase 1) dials.
func TestVRProbeMatchesXrayOutbound(t *testing.T) {
	ex := testExit(2, "hysteria2")
	ex.TunnelSNI = config.ExitRealitySNI
	ex.TunnelPort = 50443 // production: tunnel_port is the hysteria port, the .vr path must still dial :10443
	in := baseInputs()
	in.exitNodes = []biz.ExitNodeTunnel{ex}
	cfg, _ := genConfig(t, in, quotaCutoff{})
	_, vrTag := exitOutboundTags(2)
	raw, ok := outboundsByTag(t, cfg)[vrTag]
	if !ok {
		t.Fatalf("no %s outbound", vrTag)
	}
	probeCfg, err := config.ExitRealityProbeConfig(config.VRProbeSocksPort(2), config.RealityProbe{ExitIP: ex.IPAddress,
		UUID: ex.TunnelUUID, PublicKey: ex.TunnelPubKey, ShortID: ex.TunnelShortID, SNI: ex.TunnelSNI})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	var probe struct {
		Outbounds []vlessOutbound `json:"outbounds"`
	}
	var xr vlessOutbound
	if json.Unmarshal(probeCfg, &probe) != nil || json.Unmarshal(raw, &xr) != nil {
		t.Fatal("unparsable")
	}
	p, x := probe.Outbounds[0], xr
	if x.Settings.Vnext[0].Port != config.ExitRealityPort || x.Settings.Vnext[0].Users[0].Flow != config.ExitRealityFlow ||
		x.Settings.Vnext[0].Address != p.Settings.Vnext[0].Address || x.StreamSettings.Network != "tcp" ||
		x.StreamSettings.RealitySettings != p.StreamSettings.RealitySettings {
		t.Fatalf("xray %+v\nprobe %+v", x, p)
	}
}

func TestFallbackSwitchDropsVROutbound(t *testing.T) {
	on, off := testExit(2, "hysteria2"), testExit(3, "hysteria2")
	off.FallbackEnabled = false
	in := baseInputs()
	in.exitNodes = []biz.ExitNodeTunnel{on, off}
	cfg, _ := genConfig(t, in, quotaCutoff{})
	tags := outboundsByTag(t, cfg)
	_, vr2 := exitOutboundTags(2)
	hy3, vr3 := exitOutboundTags(3)
	if _, ok := tags[vr2]; !ok {
		t.Error("exit 2 lost its TCP fallback")
	}
	if _, ok := tags[vr3]; ok {
		t.Error("exit 3 has the fallback switched off")
	}
	if _, ok := tags[hy3]; !ok {
		t.Error("exit 3 must keep its hysteria path")
	}
}

func TestLegacyPasswordAction(t *testing.T) {
	good := func([]byte) (string, error) { return "pw", nil }
	bad := func([]byte) (string, error) { return "", errors.New("auth failed") }
	for _, tc := range []struct {
		enc  []byte
		dec  func([]byte) (string, error)
		want string
	}{{nil, good, "encrypt"}, {[]byte{1}, good, "clear"}, {[]byte{1}, bad, "keep"}} {
		if got := legacyPasswordAction(tc.enc, tc.dec); got != tc.want {
			t.Errorf("%v: %s, want %s", tc.enc, got, tc.want)
		}
	}
}

// No node code dials SSH without the confirmed key; nothing in the API restarts the API.
func TestNoUnpinnedSSHAnywhere(t *testing.T) {
	selfRestart := regexp.MustCompile(`exec\.Command\([^)]*heyearth-api`)
	for _, dir := range []string{".", "../../internal/biz", "../../internal/admin", "../../internal/provision"} {
		files, _ := filepath.Glob(filepath.Join(dir, "*.go"))
		for _, f := range files {
			if strings.HasSuffix(f, "_test.go") {
				continue
			}
			b, _ := os.ReadFile(f)
			if strings.Contains(string(b), "InsecureIgnoreHostKey") || selfRestart.Match(b) {
				t.Errorf("%s: unpinned SSH or API self-restart", f)
			}
		}
	}
	if _, err := os.Stat("../../internal/biz/exit_teardown.go"); err == nil {
		t.Error("exit_teardown.go (wrong unit names, unpinned SSH) must be gone")
	}
}
```
