```go
package biz

import (
	"context"
	"database/sql"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"strconv"
	"strings"
	"time"

	"github.com/heyearth/backend/internal/db"
)

// Entries: the addresses users connect to (spec 2026-10-12 «Пул нод», section 4). Entry 0 is the
// Hub (its address is main_server_host); every other entry is a servers row with role 'relay' —
// a RU VPS that DNATs the Hub's user ports to the Hub (internal/config/relay_nft.go). Health is
// written only by the entries monitor (cmd/api/entry_monitor.go).

const (
	EntryKindHub       = "hub"
	EntryKindRelay     = "relay"
	EntryUnknown       = "unknown"
	EntryHealthy       = "healthy"
	EntryUnhealthy     = "unhealthy"
	EntryAddressIP     = "ip"
	EntryAddressDomain = "domain"
)

// EntryHealth: External = TLS to <entry>:443 with the Reality SNI through a foreign exit; UDP =
// the Bamboo VN probe through the entry's hop ports; RU = check-host RU nodes, TCP :443
// (reachable|unreachable|unknown). *Error is the last error, RULink the check-host report.
type EntryHealth struct {
	External      string     `json:"external"`
	ExternalAt    *time.Time `json:"external_at"`
	ExternalError string     `json:"external_error"`
	UDP           string     `json:"udp"`
	UDPAt         *time.Time `json:"udp_at"`
	UDPError      string     `json:"udp_error"`
	RU            string     `json:"ru"`
	RUAt          *time.Time `json:"ru_at"`
	RULink        string     `json:"ru_link"`
}

type Entry struct {
	ID          int         `json:"id"` // 0 = Hub, otherwise servers.id of a relay
	Name        string      `json:"name"`
	Kind        string      `json:"kind"`    // hub | relay
	Address     string      `json:"address"` // what the subscription puts in front of the ports
	IP          string      `json:"ip"`      // relay: servers.ip_address; Hub: main_server_host
	AddressMode string      `json:"address_mode"`
	Domain      string      `json:"domain"`
	Country     string      `json:"country"`
	Lifecycle   string      `json:"lifecycle"`
	Health      EntryHealth `json:"health"`
}

// EntryFailover is the auto-swap state (app_settings entry_failover_*): while Active the main
// subscription lines point at relay Target.
type EntryFailover struct {
	Active bool      `json:"active"`
	Target int       `json:"target"`
	Since  time.Time `json:"since"`
}

// EntryCheck is one persisted check of an entry. Status: ext/udp unknown|healthy|unhealthy,
// ru unknown|reachable|unreachable. Detail: ext/udp the last error ("" = OK), ru the report link.
type EntryCheck struct {
	Status string
	At     time.Time
	Detail string
}

var ErrEntryDomainUnavailable = errors.New("режим «домен» станет доступен после настройки раздела «Домены»")

// EntryDomainModeAvailable and EntryDomainCheck are replaced by phase 4 (domain registry: DNS of
// the domain must point at the entry). Until then only the IP mode can be selected.
var (
	EntryDomainModeAvailable = func() bool { return false }
	EntryDomainCheck         = func(ctx context.Context, entryID int, domain string) error { return ErrEntryDomainUnavailable }
)

const entryStateColumns = `COALESCE(e.address_mode, 'ip'), COALESCE(e.domain, ''),
	COALESCE(e.ext_status, 'unknown'), e.ext_checked_at, COALESCE(e.ext_error, ''),
	COALESCE(e.udp_status, 'unknown'), e.udp_checked_at, COALESCE(e.udp_error, ''),
	COALESCE(e.ru_status, 'unknown'), e.ru_checked_at, COALESCE(e.ru_link, '')`

const relayEntriesQuery = `
	SELECT s.id, COALESCE(s.name, ''), s.ip_address, COALESCE(s.country_code, ''), COALESCE(s.lifecycle_state, ''),
	       ` + entryStateColumns + `
	  FROM servers s LEFT JOIN entry_state e ON e.entry_id = s.id
	 WHERE s.role = 'relay' AND s.lifecycle_state = 'online'
	 ORDER BY s.id`

const hubEntryStateQuery = `SELECT ` + entryStateColumns + ` FROM entry_state e WHERE e.entry_id = 0`

func scanEntry(scan func(dest ...any) error, head []any, e *Entry) error {
	var extAt, udpAt, ruAt sql.NullTime
	dest := append(head, &e.AddressMode, &e.Domain,
		&e.Health.External, &extAt, &e.Health.ExternalError,
		&e.Health.UDP, &udpAt, &e.Health.UDPError,
		&e.Health.RU, &ruAt, &e.Health.RULink)
	if err := scan(dest...); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	ptr := func(t sql.NullTime) *time.Time {
		if !t.Valid {
			return nil
		}
		return &t.Time
	}
	e.Health.ExternalAt, e.Health.UDPAt, e.Health.RUAt = ptr(extAt), ptr(udpAt), ptr(ruAt)
	e.Address = EntryAddress(e.IP, e.AddressMode, e.Domain)
	return nil
}

// ListRelayEntries returns the online relays with their state, by id. A failed read is an error
// (the subscription answers 503 on it, never a profile without the reserve lines).
func ListRelayEntries(ctx context.Context) ([]Entry, error) {
	rows, err := db.DB.QueryContext(ctx, relayEntriesQuery)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("list relay entries: %w", err)
	}
	defer rows.Close()
	var out []Entry
	for rows.Next() {
		e := Entry{Kind: EntryKindRelay}
		if err := scanEntry(rows.Scan, []any{&e.ID, &e.Name, &e.IP, &e.Country, &e.Lifecycle}, &e); err != nil {
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("list relay entries: %w", err)
		}
		out = append(out, e)
	}
	if err := rows.Err(); err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("list relay entries: %w", err)
	}
	return out, nil
}

// ListEntries returns the Hub (ID 0) followed by the online relays.
func ListEntries(ctx context.Context) ([]Entry, error) {
	host, err := entrySetting(ctx, "main_server_host", "")
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	hub := Entry{ID: 0, Name: "Основной вход (Hub)", Kind: EntryKindHub, IP: host, Country: "RU", Lifecycle: "online"}
	err = scanEntry(db.DB.QueryRowContext(ctx, hubEntryStateQuery).Scan, nil, &hub)
	if errors.Is(err, sql.ErrNoRows) {
		hub.AddressMode, hub.Address = EntryAddressIP, host
		hub.Health = EntryHealth{External: EntryUnknown, UDP: EntryUnknown, RU: EntryUnknown}
	} else if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("hub entry state: %w", err)
	}
	relays, err := ListRelayEntries(ctx)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	return append([]Entry{hub}, relays...), nil
}

// EntryAddress: the domain in domain mode (when set), the IP otherwise.
func EntryAddress(ip, mode, domain string) string {
	if mode == EntryAddressDomain && domain != "" {
		return domain
	}
	return ip
}

// entrySetting: def for an absent or blank key, an error for a failed read.
func entrySetting(ctx context.Context, key, def string) (string, error) {
	v, err := GetSettingContext(ctx, key)
	if errors.Is(err, sql.ErrNoRows) {
		return def, nil
	}
	if err != nil {
		return "", fmt.Errorf("read setting %s: %w", key, err)
	}
	if v = strings.TrimSpace(v); v == "" {
		return def, nil
	}
	return v, nil
}

const (
	settingFailoverActive = "entry_failover_active"
	settingFailoverTarget = "entry_failover_target"
	settingFailoverSince  = "entry_failover_since"
)

func GetEntryFailover(ctx context.Context) (EntryFailover, error) {
	var raw [3]string
	for i, k := range []string{settingFailoverActive, settingFailoverTarget, settingFailoverSince} {
		v, err := entrySetting(ctx, k, "")
		if err != nil {
			return EntryFailover{}, err
		}
		raw[i] = v
	}
	return ParseEntryFailover(raw[0], raw[1], raw[2]), nil
}

// ParseEntryFailover: active only with "true" and a positive target; a broken since is zero.
func ParseEntryFailover(active, target, since string) EntryFailover {
	id, err := strconv.Atoi(strings.TrimSpace(target))
	if strings.TrimSpace(active) != "true" || err != nil || id <= 0 {
		return EntryFailover{}
	}
	at, _ := time.Parse(time.RFC3339, strings.TrimSpace(since))
	return EntryFailover{Active: true, Target: id, Since: at}
}

// SetEntryFailover writes the three keys in one statement (atomic).
func SetEntryFailover(ctx context.Context, st EntryFailover) error {
	if st.Active && st.Target <= 0 {
		return errors.New("entry failover: active without a target")
	}
	active, target, since := "false", "0", ""
	if st.Active {
		active, target, since = "true", strconv.Itoa(st.Target), st.Since.UTC().Format(time.RFC3339)
	}
	_, err := db.DB.ExecContext(ctx, `
		INSERT INTO app_settings (key, value, updated_at) VALUES ($1, $2, NOW()), ($3, $4, NOW()), ($5, $6, NOW())
		ON CONFLICT (key) DO UPDATE SET value = EXCLUDED.value, updated_at = NOW()`,
		settingFailoverActive, active, settingFailoverTarget, target, settingFailoverSince, since)
	if err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("save entry failover: %w", err)
	}
	return nil
}

// EntryIsFailoverTarget: the main lines point at relay id right now (deprovision must refuse).
func EntryIsFailoverTarget(ctx context.Context, id int) (bool, error) {
	st, err := GetEntryFailover(ctx)
	return err == nil && st.Active && st.Target == id, err
}

var entryCheckQueries = map[string]string{
	"ext": `INSERT INTO entry_state (entry_id, ext_status, ext_checked_at, ext_error) VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4)
		ON CONFLICT (entry_id) DO UPDATE SET ext_status = EXCLUDED.ext_status, ext_checked_at = EXCLUDED.ext_checked_at,
		ext_error = EXCLUDED.ext_error, updated_at = NOW()`,
	"udp": `INSERT INTO entry_state (entry_id, udp_status, udp_checked_at, udp_error) VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4)
		ON CONFLICT (entry_id) DO UPDATE SET udp_status = EXCLUDED.udp_status, udp_checked_at = EXCLUDED.udp_checked_at,
		udp_error = EXCLUDED.udp_error, updated_at = NOW()`,
	"ru": `INSERT INTO entry_state (entry_id, ru_status, ru_checked_at, ru_link) VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4)
		ON CONFLICT (entry_id) DO UPDATE SET ru_status = EXCLUDED.ru_status, ru_checked_at = EXCLUDED.ru_checked_at,
		ru_link = EXCLUDED.ru_link, updated_at = NOW()`,
}

func SaveEntryCheck(ctx context.Context, entryID int, kind string, c EntryCheck) error {
	q, ok := entryCheckQueries[kind]
	if !ok {
		return fmt.Errorf("entry check: unknown kind %q", kind)
	}
	if len(c.Detail) > 500 {
		c.Detail = c.Detail[:500]
	}
	if _, err := db.DB.ExecContext(ctx, q, entryID, c.Status, c.At, c.Detail); err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("save entry %d %s check: %w", entryID, kind, err)
	}
	return nil
}

func SetEntryAddressMode(ctx context.Context, entryID int, mode, domain string) error {
	switch mode {
	case EntryAddressIP:
		domain = ""
	case EntryAddressDomain:
	default:
		return fmt.Errorf("address mode %q: ip или domain", mode)
	}
	_, err := db.DB.ExecContext(ctx, `INSERT INTO entry_state (entry_id, address_mode, domain) VALUES ($1, $2, $3)
		ON CONFLICT (entry_id) DO UPDATE SET address_mode = EXCLUDED.address_mode, domain = EXCLUDED.domain, updated_at = NOW()`,
		entryID, mode, domain)
	return err
}

// DeleteEntryState removes a relay's row after its deprovision (the Hub row 0 stays).
func DeleteEntryState(ctx context.Context, entryID int) error {
	_, err := db.DB.ExecContext(ctx, `DELETE FROM entry_state WHERE entry_id = $1 AND entry_id > 0`, entryID)
	return err
}
```

```go
package config

import (
	"flag"
	"os"
	"os/exec"
	"path/filepath"
	"strings"
	"testing"
)

var updateRelayGolden = flag.Bool("update-relay-golden", false, "rewrite testdata/relay_nft_lab.golden")

const labHub = "198.51.100.2" // TEST-NET-2: the Hub of the netns lab (scripts/relay_netns_lab.sh)

func TestRelayNftRuleset(t *testing.T) {
	rs, err := RelayNftRuleset(labHub)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	// Atomic replace: create-if-missing, delete, define — one nft -f transaction.
	if !strings.Contains(rs, "table ip heyearth_relay\ndelete table ip heyearth_relay\ntable ip heyearth_relay {\n") {
		t.Errorf("ruleset is not an atomic replace:\n%s", rs)
	}
	for _, must := range []string{
		"type nat hook prerouting priority dstnat; policy accept;",
		"fib daddr type local tcp dport { 443, 2443 } dnat to " + labHub + "\n",
		"fib daddr type local udp dport 30000-65000 dnat to " + labHub + ":50443\n",
		"type nat hook postrouting priority srcnat; policy accept;",
		"ip daddr " + labHub + " ct status dnat masquerade\n",
	} {
		if !strings.Contains(rs, must) {
			t.Errorf("ruleset lacks %q:\n%s", must, rs)
		}
	}
	if n := strings.Count(rs, "masquerade"); n != 1 {
		t.Errorf("want exactly one (DNAT-only) masquerade, got %d", n)
	}
	if RelayBambooPort < RelayHopMin || RelayBambooPort > RelayHopMax {
		t.Error("50443 must be inside the hop range (one UDP rule covers both)")
	}
	for _, banned := range []string{"flush ruleset", "dport 22", "dport ssh"} {
		if strings.Contains(rs, banned) {
			t.Errorf("ruleset contains %q", banned)
		}
	}
	golden := filepath.Join("testdata", "relay_nft_lab.golden")
	if *updateRelayGolden {
		if err := os.WriteFile(golden, []byte(rs), 0o644); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
	}
	if want, err := os.ReadFile(golden); err != nil || string(want) != rs {
		t.Errorf("ruleset differs from %s (the lab tests that file): %v", golden, err)
	}
}

func TestRelayHubIPRejects(t *testing.T) {
	for _, bad := range []string{"", "hiearth.ru", "10.0.0.1", "192.168.1.1", "127.0.0.1", "0.0.0.0",
		"169.254.1.1", "224.0.0.1", "::1", "2001:db8::1", "1.2.3.4; nft flush ruleset"} {
		if _, err := RelayHubIP(bad); err == nil {
			t.Errorf("RelayHubIP(%q) accepted", bad)
		}
		if _, err := RelayNftRuleset(bad); err == nil {
			t.Errorf("RelayNftRuleset(%q) accepted", bad)
		}
	}
	if a, err := RelayHubIP(" 138.16.181.225 "); err != nil || a.String() != "138.16.181.225" {
		t.Errorf("public IPv4 rejected: %v %v", a, err)
	}
}

func TestRelayUnitSysctlJail(t *testing.T) {
	u := RelayUnit("/etc/heyearth/relay.nft")
	for _, must := range []string{"Type=oneshot", "RemainAfterExit=yes", "After=network-pre.target nftables.service ufw.service",
		"ExecStart=/usr/sbin/nft -f /etc/heyearth/relay.nft", "ExecReload=/usr/sbin/nft -f /etc/heyearth/relay.nft",
		"ExecStop=/usr/sbin/nft delete table ip heyearth_relay", "WantedBy=multi-user.target"} {
		if !strings.Contains(u, must) {
			t.Errorf("unit lacks %q", must)
		}
	}
	s := RelaySysctl()
	for _, must := range []string{"net.ipv4.ip_forward = 1", "net.ipv4.conf.all.send_redirects = 0",
		"net.ipv4.conf.default.send_redirects = 0", "net.netfilter.nf_conntrack_max = 262144",
		"net.netfilter.nf_conntrack_udp_timeout_stream = 180", "net.netfilter.nf_conntrack_tcp_timeout_established = 7440"} {
		if !strings.Contains(s, must) {
			t.Errorf("sysctl lacks %q", must)
		}
	}
	j := RelayJail(2222, "138.16.181.225")
	for _, must := range []string{"[sshd]", "enabled = true", "port = 2222", "backend = systemd", "ignoreip = 127.0.0.1/8 ::1 138.16.181.225"} {
		if !strings.Contains(j, must) {
			t.Errorf("jail lacks %q", must)
		}
	}
}

// nft -c parses the ruleset with the real nft (Linux, root); skipped elsewhere — the lab covers it.
func TestRelayNftRulesetParsesWithNft(t *testing.T) {
	if _, err := exec.LookPath("nft"); err != nil || os.Geteuid() != 0 {
		t.Skip("needs nft and root")
	}
	rs, _ := RelayNftRuleset(labHub)
	f := filepath.Join(t.TempDir(), "relay.nft")
	if err := os.WriteFile(f, []byte(rs), 0o644); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if out, err := exec.Command("nft", "-c", "-f", f).CombinedOutput(); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("nft -c: %v\n%s", err, out)
	}
}
```

```go
package config

import (
	"fmt"
	"net/netip"
	"strconv"
	"strings"
)

// Reserve entry in RU ("relay", spec 2026-10-12 «Пул нод», section 4): a VPS of another provider
// that forwards the Hub's user ports to the Hub. No apps and no user data on it; the Hub sees the
// relay's address as the client. One set of templates for the admin wizard and the CLI.
const (
	RelayNftTable   = "heyearth_relay"
	RelayUnitName   = "heyearth-relay.service"
	RelayNftPath    = "/etc/heyearth/relay.nft"
	RelayHopMin     = 30000
	RelayHopMax     = 65000
	RelayBambooPort = 50443
)

// RelayTCPPorts go to the same port of the Hub: 443 (nginx stream → Reality «Берёза») and
// 2443 (XHTTP «Дуб», whose inbound checks the Host header, not the address).
var RelayTCPPorts = []int{443, 2443}

// RelayHubIP validates the DNAT target: a public IPv4 literal (the table is family ip).
func RelayHubIP(s string) (netip.Addr, error) {
	a, err := netip.ParseAddr(strings.TrimSpace(s))
	if err != nil || !a.Is4() {
		return netip.Addr{}, fmt.Errorf("адрес Hub %q: нужен IPv4-адрес", s)
	}
	if a.IsPrivate() || a.IsLoopback() || a.IsUnspecified() || a.IsLinkLocalUnicast() || a.IsMulticast() {
		return netip.Addr{}, fmt.Errorf("адрес Hub %s не публичный", a)
	}
	return a, nil
}

// RelayNftRuleset is /etc/heyearth/relay.nft. Its first two lines make "nft -f" replace the table
// in one transaction (also when it does not exist yet): no window without forwarding, no
// duplicates on a re-run.
//
// UDP: the whole hop range (50443 included) goes to Hub:50443 itself. Keeping the client's hop
// port would let two flows that the relay's masquerade left on one source port collide in the
// Hub's own hop DNAT (identical reply tuples → the Hub drops the second flow). With :50443 the
// relay's masquerade allocates unique source ports; the Hub's rule (30000:65000 → :50443, dst
// LOCAL) still applies and is the identity. Proven by scripts/relay_netns_lab.sh.
func RelayNftRuleset(hubIP string) (string, error) {
	hub, err := RelayHubIP(hubIP)
	if err != nil {
		return "", err
	}
	tcp := make([]string, len(RelayTCPPorts))
	for i, p := range RelayTCPPorts {
		tcp[i] = strconv.Itoa(p)
	}
	return fmt.Sprintf(`#!/usr/sbin/nft -f
# HiEarth reserve entry -> Hub %[1]s. Generated by internal/config (RelayNftRuleset); do not edit.
table ip %[2]s
delete table ip %[2]s
table ip %[2]s {
	chain prerouting {
		type nat hook prerouting priority dstnat; policy accept;
		fib daddr type local tcp dport { %[3]s } dnat to %[1]s
		fib daddr type local udp dport %[4]d-%[5]d dnat to %[1]s:%[6]d
	}
	chain postrouting {
		type nat hook postrouting priority srcnat; policy accept;
		ip daddr %[1]s ct status dnat masquerade
	}
}
`, hub, RelayNftTable, strings.Join(tcp, ", "), RelayHopMin, RelayHopMax, RelayBambooPort), nil
}

// RelayUnit loads the rules at boot after nftables.service (whose "flush ruleset" would wipe
// them) and ufw. reload = atomic replace; stop removes the table.
func RelayUnit(nftPath string) string {
	return fmt.Sprintf(`[Unit]
Description=HiEarth reserve entry: forward TCP 443/2443 and UDP %[2]d-%[3]d to the Hub
Wants=network-pre.target
After=network-pre.target nftables.service ufw.service

[Service]
Type=oneshot
RemainAfterExit=yes
ExecStartPre=/usr/sbin/sysctl -q -w net.ipv4.ip_forward=1
ExecStart=/usr/sbin/nft -f %[1]s
ExecReload=/usr/sbin/nft -f %[1]s
ExecStop=/usr/sbin/nft delete table ip %[4]s

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
`, nftPath, RelayHopMin, RelayHopMax, RelayNftTable)
}

// RelaySysctl: forwarding on; no ICMP redirects (in and out on one NIC); conntrack sized for NAT
// of user traffic: 5-day established TCP entries would fill the table, Bamboo hops every 15 s.
func RelaySysctl() string {
	return `# HiEarth reserve entry. Generated by internal/config (RelaySysctl); do not edit.
net.ipv4.ip_forward = 1
net.ipv4.conf.all.send_redirects = 0
net.ipv4.conf.default.send_redirects = 0
net.netfilter.nf_conntrack_max = 262144
net.netfilter.nf_conntrack_tcp_timeout_established = 7440
net.netfilter.nf_conntrack_udp_timeout = 60
net.netfilter.nf_conntrack_udp_timeout_stream = 180
`
}

// RelayJail: fail2ban for the relay's real SSH port; the Hub (which provisions over SSH) is never banned.
func RelayJail(sshPort int, hubIP string) string {
	return fmt.Sprintf(`# HiEarth reserve entry. Generated by internal/config (RelayJail); do not edit.
[sshd]
enabled = true
port = %d
backend = systemd
maxretry = 5
findtime = 10m
bantime = 1h
ignoreip = 127.0.0.1/8 ::1 %s
`, sshPort, hubIP)
}
```

**Interfaces:** `sudo bash server/backend/scripts/relay_netns_lab.sh` → последняя строка `LAB PASS (11/11)`, код 0; `LAB_MUTATE=no-masq|same-port|dup` → `LAB FAIL (…)`, код 1. Трогает только свои namespace `hel-*`; корневой namespace не меняется. Зависимости: `ip`, `nft`, `iptables` (iptables-nft), `python3`.

Топология (как у одноинтерфейсного VPS): мост в `hel-br`; клиент `hel-c` (`203.0.113.10`, `.11`, маршрут по умолчанию через ретранслятор); ретранслятор `hel-r` — **один** интерфейс с `203.0.113.1/24` и `198.51.100.1/24`, `ip_forward=1`, правила из golden Task 3.2; Hub `hel-h` — `198.51.100.2/24`, **без маршрута** в сеть клиента (ответ вернётся только через masquerade), hop-правило Hub — дословно `hysteria2PortHopRule`, слушатели TCP 22/443/2443 и UDP 50443.

- [ ] **Step 1: Написать скрипт** `server/backend/scripts/relay_netns_lab.sh`:
```bash
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Network-namespace lab of the reserve-entry ruleset (phase 3, Task 3.3). Evidence step, not CI.
# Root on Linux/WSL with ip, nft, iptables (iptables-nft) and python3. Creates and removes only
# the hel-* namespaces. LAB_MUTATE=no-masq|same-port|dup breaks the rules on purpose: the lab
# must then FAIL (proves it can see the defect).
set -euo pipefail
here=$(cd "$(dirname "$0")" && pwd)
RULES_SRC=${RULES_SRC:-$here/../internal/config/testdata/relay_nft_lab.golden}
HUB=198.51.100.2 R_C=203.0.113.1 R_H=198.51.100.1 C1=203.0.113.10 C2=203.0.113.11
NS="hel-br hel-c hel-r hel-h"
pids=()
tmp=$(mktemp -d)
cleanup() {
  for p in "${pids[@]:-}"; do [ -n "$p" ] && kill "$p" 2>/dev/null || true; done
  for n in $NS; do ip netns del "$n" 2>/dev/null || true; done
}
trap 'cleanup; rm -rf "$tmp"' EXIT
for b in ip nft iptables python3; do command -v "$b" >/dev/null || { echo "нет $b"; exit 2; }; done
[ "$(id -u)" = 0 ] || { echo "нужен root"; exit 2; }
cleanup
x() { local n=$1; shift; ip netns exec "hel-$n" "$@"; }
for n in $NS; do ip netns add "$n"; done
x br ip link add br0 type bridge; x br ip link set br0 up
for n in c r h; do
  ip link add "v$n" netns "hel-$n" type veth peer name "b$n" netns hel-br
  x br ip link set "b$n" master br0; x br ip link set "b$n" up
  x "$n" ip link set lo up; x "$n" ip link set "v$n" up
done
x c ip addr add $C1/24 dev vc; x c ip addr add $C2/24 dev vc; x c ip route add default via $R_C
x r ip addr add $R_C/24 dev vr; x r ip addr add $R_H/24 dev vr
x h ip addr add $HUB/24 dev vh # no route to 203.0.113.0/24: replies need the relay's SNAT
x r sysctl -qw net.ipv4.ip_forward=1 net.ipv4.conf.all.send_redirects=0

cp "$RULES_SRC" "$tmp/relay.nft"
case "${LAB_MUTATE:-}" in
  "") ;;
  no-masq) sed -i '/masquerade/d' "$tmp/relay.nft" ;;
  same-port) sed -i "s/dnat to $HUB:50443/dnat to $HUB/" "$tmp/relay.nft" ;;
  dup) sed -i '/^delete table/d' "$tmp/relay.nft" ;;
  *) echo "неизвестный LAB_MUTATE"; exit 2 ;;
esac
x r nft -f "$tmp/relay.nft" && x r nft -f "$tmp/relay.nft" || true # twice: a re-run must not duplicate
# the Hub's real hop rule (cmd/deploy hysteria2PortHopRule)
x h iptables -t nat -I PREROUTING 1 -p udp --dport 30000:65000 -m addrtype --dst-type LOCAL -j DNAT --to-destination :50443

x h python3 -c '
import socket, threading
def tcp(port):
    s = socket.socket(); s.setsockopt(socket.SOL_SOCKET, socket.SO_REUSEADDR, 1); s.bind(("0.0.0.0", port)); s.listen(16)
    while True:
        c, a = s.accept(); c.sendall(f"hub tcp {port} from {a[0]}\n".encode()); c.close()
for p in (22, 443, 2443): threading.Thread(target=tcp, args=(p,), daemon=True).start()
u = socket.socket(socket.AF_INET, socket.SOCK_DGRAM); u.bind(("0.0.0.0", 50443))
while True:
    d, a = u.recvfrom(2048); u.sendto(b"hub udp from " + a[0].encode(), a)
' & pids+=($!)
sleep 1

probe() { # probe tcp|udp SRC DST PORT [SPORT] → reply text or "ERR …"
  x c python3 -c '
import socket, sys
kind, src, dst, port = sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2], sys.argv[3], int(sys.argv[4])
sport = int(sys.argv[5]) if len(sys.argv) > 5 else 0
try:
    if kind == "tcp":
        s = socket.create_connection((dst, port), timeout=3, source_address=(src, sport)); print(s.recv(200).decode().strip())
    else:
        s = socket.socket(socket.AF_INET, socket.SOCK_DGRAM); s.bind((src, sport)); s.settimeout(3)
        s.sendto(b"ping", (dst, port)); d, a = s.recvfrom(2048); print(d.decode(), "reply-from", f"{a[0]}:{a[1]}")
except Exception as e:
    print("ERR", type(e).__name__, e)
' "$@"
}
fails=0 total=0
check() {
  total=$((total+1))
  if [[ "$2" == *"$3"* ]]; then echo "OK   $1: $2"; else echo "FAIL $1: получено «$2», нужно «$3»"; fails=$((fails+1)); fi
}
live=$(x r nft list table ip heyearth_relay 2>&1 || true)
check "одна таблица после двух nft -f" "$(x r nft list tables | grep -c heyearth_relay)" "1"
check "ровно 2 DNAT (проверка шага Verify)" "$(printf '%s\n' "$live" | grep -c "dnat to $HUB")" "2"
check "masquerade как в Verify" "$(printf '%s\n' "$live" | grep -c "ip daddr $HUB ct status dnat masquerade")" "1"
check "TCP 443 → Hub, Hub видит ретранслятор" "$(probe tcp $C1 $R_C 443)" "hub tcp 443 from $R_H"
check "TCP 2443" "$(probe tcp $C1 $R_C 2443)" "hub tcp 2443 from $R_H"
check "UDP 50443" "$(probe udp $C1 $R_C 50443)" "reply-from $R_C:50443"
check "UDP hop 41234: ответ с того же адреса и порта" "$(probe udp $C1 $R_C 41234)" "reply-from $R_C:41234"
# Two clients, one source port, two hop ports: with "same port" both land on R_H:40000 → H:50443.
check "клиент 1, sport 40000 → hop 41000" "$(probe udp $C1 $R_C 41000 40000)" "reply-from $R_C:41000"
check "клиент 2, sport 40000 → hop 42000" "$(probe udp $C2 $R_C 42000 40000)" "reply-from $R_C:42000"
check "TCP 22 не пересылается" "$(probe tcp $C1 $R_C 22)" "ERR"
check "UDP 29999 не пересылается" "$(probe udp $C1 $R_C 29999)" "ERR"
if [ "$fails" = 0 ]; then echo "LAB PASS ($total/$total)"; else echo "LAB FAIL ($fails из $total)"; exit 1; fi
```
Мутация `dup` (без `delete table`): второй `nft -f` дописывает правила в существующие цепочки → 4 DNAT и 2 masquerade → проверки 2–3 FAIL.

```go
		t.Skip("no working bash")
	}
	h := &relayHost{dir: filepath.ToSlash(t.TempDir()), env: map[string]string{}}
	for k, v := range env {
		h.env[k] = v
	}
	h.env["NFT_FILE"] = h.layout().nft
	if out, err := h.Run(context.Background(), relayStubsSh); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("stubs: %v\n%s", err, out)
	}
	return h
}

func (h *relayHost) Run(ctx context.Context, script string) (string, error) {
	var b strings.Builder
	fmt.Fprintf(&b, "export T=%s\nexport PATH=\"$T/bin:$PATH\"\n", relayQ(h.dir))
	for k, v := range h.env {
		fmt.Fprintf(&b, "export %s=%s\n", k, relayQ(v))
	}
	out, err := exec.CommandContext(ctx, "bash", "-c", b.String()+script).CombinedOutput()
	return string(out), err
}

func (h *relayHost) PutFile(_ context.Context, path string, data []byte, mode uint32) (bool, error) {
	if old, err := os.ReadFile(path); err == nil && bytes.Equal(old, data) {
		return false, nil
	}
	if err := os.MkdirAll(filepath.Dir(path), 0o755); err != nil {
		return false, err
	}
	return true, os.WriteFile(path, data, os.FileMode(mode))
}

func (h *relayHost) layout() relayLayout {
	p := func(s string) string { return h.dir + s }
	return relayLayout{osRelease: p("/etc/os-release"), nft: p("/etc/heyearth/relay.nft"),
		unit: p("/etc/systemd/system/heyearth-relay.service"), sysctl: p("/etc/sysctl.d/90-heyearth-relay.conf"),
		modules: p("/etc/modules-load.d/heyearth-relay.conf"), jail: p("/etc/fail2ban/jail.d/heyearth-sshd.local")}
}

func (h *relayHost) file(name string) string { b, _ := os.ReadFile(h.dir + name); return string(b) }
func (h *relayHost) calls() string            { return h.file("/calls") }
func (h *relayHost) resetCalls()              { _ = os.WriteFile(h.dir+"/calls", nil, 0o644) }

func relayOpts() RelayOptions {
	return RelayOptions{RelayIP: "203.0.113.50", HubIP: "198.51.100.2", SSHPort: 2222,
		VerifyPath: func(context.Context) error { return nil }}
}

func runRelay(h *relayHost, rc Recipe) error {
	for _, st := range rc {
		if err := st.Apply(context.Background(), h, nil); err != nil {
			return fmt.Errorf("%s: apply: %w", st.Name, err)
		}
		if err := st.Verify(context.Background(), h, nil); err != nil {
			return fmt.Errorf("%s: verify: %w", st.Name, err)
		}
	}
	return nil
}

func relayStep(t *testing.T, rc Recipe, name string) Step {
	t.Helper()
	for _, st := range rc {
		if st.Name == name {
			return st
		}
	}
	t.Fatalf("no step %q", name)
	return Step{}
}

func TestRelayRecipeFreshHostThenIdempotent(t *testing.T) {
	h := newRelayHost(t, nil)
	verified := 0
	o := relayOpts()
	o.VerifyPath = func(context.Context) error { verified++; return nil }
	if err := runRelay(h, relayRecipe(o, h.layout())); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	rules, _ := config.RelayNftRuleset("198.51.100.2")
	if h.file("/state/live.nft") != rules || h.file("/etc/heyearth/relay.nft") != rules {
		t.Fatal("the live rules are not the template")
	}
	for _, want := range []string{"apt-get install -y -qq nftables fail2ban python3-systemd", "nft -c -f",
		"sysctl -q -p", "systemctl enable heyearth-relay.service", "systemctl start heyearth-relay.service", "systemctl restart fail2ban"} {
		if !strings.Contains(h.calls(), want) {
			t.Errorf("first run lacks %q:\n%s", want, h.calls())
		}
	}
	if verified != 1 || !strings.Contains(h.file("/etc/fail2ban/jail.d/heyearth-sshd.local"), "port = 2222") {
		t.Errorf("verify-path calls %d, jail %q", verified, h.file("/etc/fail2ban/jail.d/heyearth-sshd.local"))
	}
	// Review Focus 2: a repeated run (job resumed after a break) reinstalls and restarts nothing.
	h.resetCalls()
	if err := runRelay(h, relayRecipe(o, h.layout())); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	for _, banned := range []string{"apt-get", "nft -f", "nft -c", "daemon-reload", "systemctl start", "systemctl restart", "systemctl reload"} {
		if strings.Contains(h.calls(), banned) {
			t.Errorf("second run called %q:\n%s", banned, h.calls())
		}
	}
	// The table vanished ("flush ruleset" by someone): the next run loads it again.
	_ = os.Remove(h.dir + "/state/live.nft")
	h.resetCalls()
	if err := runRelay(h, relayRecipe(o, h.layout())); err != nil || h.file("/state/live.nft") != rules {
		t.Fatalf("lost table not restored: %v\n%s", err, h.calls())
	}
}

func TestRelayPreflightRefuses(t *testing.T) {
	cases := []struct {
		name string
		env  map[string]string
		want string
	}{
		{"порт 443 занят", map[string]string{"SS_LINES": "tcp LISTEN 0 511 0.0.0.0:443 0.0.0.0:*"}, "заняты порты: tcp/443"},
		{"порт Бамбука занят", map[string]string{"SS_LINES": "udp UNCONN 0 0 [::]:50443 [::]:*"}, "udp/50443"},
		{"FORWARD DROP без ufw", map[string]string{"FORWARD_POLICY": "DROP"}, "FORWARD = DROP"},
		{"Docker", map[string]string{"DOCKER": "1"}, "Docker"},
		{"Hub недоступен", map[string]string{"HUB_DOWN": "1"}, "недоступен с этого сервера"},
		{"CentOS", map[string]string{"OS_ID": "centos"}, "не поддерживается"},
		{"armv7", map[string]string{"UNAME_M": "armv7l"}, "архитектура"},
	}
	for _, c := range cases {
		t.Run(c.name, func(t *testing.T) {
			h := newRelayHost(t, c.env)
			err := relayStep(t, relayRecipe(relayOpts(), h.layout()), "Предпроверка").Apply(context.Background(), h, nil)
			if err == nil || !strings.Contains(err.Error(), c.want) {
				t.Fatalf("got %v, want %q", err, c.want)
			}
			if strings.Contains(h.calls(), "nft") || strings.Contains(h.calls(), "apt-get") {
				t.Errorf("preflight changed the host:\n%s", h.calls())
			}
		})
	}
	// Not a reason to refuse: FORWARD DROP behind an active ufw, a client socket in the hop range.
	h := newRelayHost(t, map[string]string{"FORWARD_POLICY": "DROP", "UFW_ACTIVE": "1", "SS_LINES": "udp UNCONN 0 0 0.0.0.0:41000 0.0.0.0:*"})
	if err := relayStep(t, relayRecipe(relayOpts(), h.layout()), "Предпроверка").Apply(context.Background(), h, nil); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	// A bad Hub address stops the recipe before anything runs on the host.
	o := relayOpts()
	o.HubIP = "10.0.0.1"
	h.resetCalls()
	if err := relayRecipe(o, h.layout())[0].Apply(context.Background(), h, nil); err == nil || h.calls() != "" {
		t.Fatalf("private Hub address: err %v, calls %q", err, h.calls())
	}
}

func TestRelayFirewallOnlyIfActiveAndRemovable(t *testing.T) {
	off := newRelayHost(t, nil)
	fw := relayStep(t, relayRecipe(relayOpts(), off.layout()), "Фаервол")
	if err := fw.Apply(context.Background(), off, nil); err != nil || strings.Contains(off.calls(), "ufw allow") || strings.Contains(off.calls(), "ufw route") {
		t.Fatalf("inactive ufw touched: %v\n%s", err, off.calls())
	}
	on := newRelayHost(t, map[string]string{"UFW_ACTIVE": "1"})
	fw = relayStep(t, relayRecipe(relayOpts(), on.layout()), "Фаервол")
	for i := 0; i < 2; i++ {
		if err := fw.Apply(context.Background(), on, nil); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
	}
	if err := fw.Verify(context.Background(), on, nil); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	want := "2222/tcp ALLOW Anywhere\n198.51.100.2 443,2443/tcp ALLOW FWD Anywhere # heyearth-relay\n" +
		"198.51.100.2 30000:65000/udp ALLOW FWD Anywhere # heyearth-relay\n"
	if got := on.file("/state/ufw"); got != want {
		t.Fatalf("ufw rules:\n%s\nwant:\n%s", got, want)
	}
	if err := fw.Rollback(context.Background(), on, nil); err != nil || on.file("/state/ufw") != "2222/tcp ALLOW Anywhere\n" {
		t.Fatalf("rollback: %v, left %q (SSH must stay)", err, on.file("/state/ufw"))
	}
}

func TestRelayNftRollback(t *testing.T) {
	h := newRelayHost(t, nil)
	old := "table ip heyearth_relay {\n}\n# old\n"
	_ = os.MkdirAll(h.dir+"/etc/heyearth", 0o755)
	_ = os.WriteFile(h.layout().nft, []byte(old), 0o644)
	st := relayStep(t, relayRecipe(relayOpts(), h.layout()), "Правила nftables")
	if err := st.Apply(context.Background(), h, nil); err != nil || h.file("/state/live.nft") == old {
		t.Fatalf("apply: %v", err)
	}
	if err := st.Rollback(context.Background(), h, nil); err != nil || h.file("/etc/heyearth/relay.nft") != old || h.file("/state/live.nft") != old {
		t.Fatalf("rollback did not restore the previous rules: %v", err)
	}
	fresh := newRelayHost(t, nil)
	st = relayStep(t, relayRecipe(relayOpts(), fresh.layout()), "Правила nftables")
	_ = st.Apply(context.Background(), fresh, nil)
	if err := st.Rollback(context.Background(), fresh, nil); err != nil || fresh.file("/state/live.nft") != "" {
		t.Fatalf("rollback without a previous file must drop the table: %v", err)
	}
}

func TestRelayDeprovisionAndVerifyPath(t *testing.T) {
	h := newRelayHost(t, map[string]string{"UFW_ACTIVE": "1"})
	if err := runRelay(h, relayRecipe(relayOpts(), h.layout())); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	for i := 0; i < 2; i++ { // idempotent
		if err := runRelay(h, relayDeprovision(h.layout())); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
	}
	if h.file("/state/live.nft") != "" || h.file("/etc/systemd/system/heyearth-relay.service") != "" || strings.Contains(h.file("/state/ufw"), "heyearth-relay") {
		t.Fatal("forwarding left after deprovision")
	}
	o := relayOpts()
	o.VerifyPath = nil
	if err := relayStep(t, relayRecipe(o, h.layout()), "Проверка входа снаружи").Verify(context.Background(), h, nil); err == nil {
		t.Fatal("a relay must never pass unchecked")
	}
	o.VerifyPath = func(context.Context) error { return errors.New("TLS: i/o timeout") }
	if err := relayStep(t, relayRecipe(o, h.layout()), "Проверка входа снаружи").Verify(context.Background(), h, nil); err == nil {
		t.Fatal("failed check accepted")
	}
}
```

```go
package provision

import (
	"context"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"net"
	"net/netip"
	"strings"

	"github.com/heyearth/backend/internal/config"
)

// Reserve entry in RU (role 'relay', spec 2026-10-12 section 4): preflight → packages →
// ip_forward + conntrack → nft rules (atomic) → unit that restores them after a reboot → firewall
// (only if ufw is already on: SSH + forwarded ports) → fail2ban on SSH → check from outside.
// Every step is idempotent: a resumed job re-runs from the start without duplicates or restarts.

type RelayOptions struct {
	RelayIP string // servers.ip_address of the relay
	HubIP   string // public IPv4 of the Hub: the DNAT target
	SSHPort int    // the relay's real SSH port: stays open in ufw, watched by fail2ban
	// VerifyPath checks the relay from outside (Hub → foreign exit → relay → Hub). nil fails the
	// last step: a relay never becomes online unchecked.
	VerifyPath func(ctx context.Context) error
}

// RelayPathVerifier is cmd/api's verifyRelayPath, injected at start (like biz.XraySyncFn).
var RelayPathVerifier func(ctx context.Context, relayIP string) error

func DefaultHubLookup(ctx context.Context, host string) ([]netip.Addr, error) {
	return net.DefaultResolver.LookupNetIP(ctx, "ip", host)
}

// RelayOptionsFor builds the options for a relay row. hubHost is main_server_host: an IPv4
// literal or a name the Hub resolves (phase 4 may move it to a domain).
func RelayOptionsFor(ctx context.Context, relayIP string, sshPort int, hubHost string,
	lookup func(ctx context.Context, host string) ([]netip.Addr, error)) (RelayOptions, error) {
	hub := strings.TrimSpace(hubHost)
	if _, err := netip.ParseAddr(hub); err != nil {
		addrs, lerr := lookup(ctx, hub)
		if lerr != nil {
			return RelayOptions{}, fmt.Errorf("адрес Hub %q не разрешился: %w", hub, lerr)
		}
		hub = ""
		for _, a := range addrs {
			if a.Unmap().Is4() {
				hub = a.Unmap().String()
				break
			}
		}
	}
	ip, err := config.RelayHubIP(hub)
	if err != nil {
		return RelayOptions{}, err
	}
	relayIP = strings.TrimSpace(relayIP)
	if ip.String() == relayIP {
		return RelayOptions{}, errors.New("IP ретранслятора совпадает с адресом Hub")
	}
	if sshPort <= 0 || sshPort > 65535 {
		return RelayOptions{}, fmt.Errorf("SSH-порт %d вне диапазона", sshPort)
	}
	return RelayOptions{RelayIP: relayIP, HubIP: ip.String(), SSHPort: sshPort,
		VerifyPath: func(ctx context.Context) error {
			if RelayPathVerifier == nil {
				return errors.New("проверка снаружи недоступна: API не подключил проверку входа")
			}
			return RelayPathVerifier(ctx, relayIP)
		}}, nil
}

type relayLayout struct{ osRelease, nft, unit, sysctl, modules, jail string }

var defaultRelayLayout = relayLayout{
	osRelease: "/etc/os-release",
	nft:       config.RelayNftPath,
	unit:      "/etc/systemd/system/" + config.RelayUnitName,
	sysctl:    "/etc/sysctl.d/90-heyearth-relay.conf",
	modules:   "/etc/modules-load.d/heyearth-relay.conf",
	jail:      "/etc/fail2ban/jail.d/heyearth-sshd.local",
}

func RelayRecipe(o RelayOptions) Recipe { return relayRecipe(o, defaultRelayLayout) }
func RelayDeprovisionRecipe() Recipe    { return relayDeprovision(defaultRelayLayout) }

func relayQ(s string) string { return "'" + strings.ReplaceAll(s, "'", `'\''`) + "'" }

type relayFn = func(context.Context, Remote, *State) error

func (l relayLayout) env(o RelayOptions) string {
	return fmt.Sprintf("HUB=%s\nSSH_PORT=%d\nTABLE=%s\nUNIT_NAME=%s\nOS_RELEASE=%s\nNFT=%s\nUNIT=%s\nSYSCTL=%s\nMODULES=%s\nJAIL=%s\n",
		relayQ(o.HubIP), o.SSHPort, config.RelayNftTable, config.RelayUnitName, relayQ(l.osRelease), relayQ(l.nft),
		relayQ(l.unit), relayQ(l.sysctl), relayQ(l.modules), relayQ(l.jail))
}

// sh runs body on the relay with the layout variables; an error carries the output tail.
func (l relayLayout) sh(o RelayOptions, body string) relayFn {
	return func(ctx context.Context, r Remote, _ *State) error {
		out, err := r.Run(ctx, "set -euo pipefail\n"+l.env(o)+body)
		if err != nil {
			if len(out) > 600 {
				out = out[len(out)-600:]
			}
			return fmt.Errorf("%w: %s", err, strings.TrimSpace(out))
		}
		return nil
	}
}

// put writes path (parent created first), then runs body with CHANGED=1|0.
func (l relayLayout) put(o RelayOptions, path, content, body string) relayFn {
	return func(ctx context.Context, r Remote, st *State) error {
		if err := l.sh(o, `mkdir -p "$(dirname `+relayQ(path)+`)"`)(ctx, r, st); err != nil {
			return err
		}
		changed, err := r.PutFile(ctx, path, []byte(content), 0o644)
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		flag := "CHANGED=0\n"
		if changed {
			flag = "CHANGED=1\n"
		}
		return l.sh(o, flag+body)(ctx, r, st)
	}
}

const relayPreflightSh = `fail() { echo "ПРЕДПРОВЕРКА: $*"; exit 1; }
[ "$(id -u)" = 0 ] || fail "нужен root"
[ -r "$OS_RELEASE" ] || fail "нет $OS_RELEASE"
os=$(. "$OS_RELEASE"; echo "${ID:-}")
case "$os" in ubuntu|debian) ;; *) fail "ОС «$os» не поддерживается: нужна Ubuntu или Debian" ;; esac
case "$(uname -m)" in x86_64|aarch64) ;; *) fail "архитектура $(uname -m) не поддерживается" ;; esac
command -v systemctl >/dev/null || fail "нет systemd"
if systemctl is-active --quiet docker; then fail "работает Docker: ретранслятор ставится на чистый сервер"; fi
busy=$(ss -Hlntu | awk '{n=split($5,a,":"); p=a[n]; if (($1=="tcp" && (p==443 || p==2443)) || ($1=="udp" && p==50443)) print $1"/"p}' | sort -u | tr '\n' ' ')
[ -z "$busy" ] || fail "заняты порты: ${busy}— их пересылает ретранслятор"
if command -v ufw >/dev/null && ufw status | grep -q '^Status: active'; then :
elif command -v iptables >/dev/null && iptables -S FORWARD 2>/dev/null | grep -q '^-P FORWARD DROP'; then
  fail "политика FORWARD = DROP без ufw: пересылка будет отброшена"
fi
timeout 5 bash -c "exec 3<>/dev/tcp/$HUB/443" 2>/dev/null || fail "Hub $HUB:443 недоступен с этого сервера"
echo "предпроверка пройдена"
`

const relayPackagesSh = `need=""
for p in nftables fail2ban python3-systemd; do dpkg -s "$p" >/dev/null 2>&1 || need="$need $p"; done
if [ -n "$need" ]; then export DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive; apt-get update -qq; apt-get install -y -qq $need; fi
`

const relaySysctlSh = `mkdir -p "$(dirname "$MODULES")"; echo nf_conntrack > "$MODULES"
modprobe nf_conntrack
sysctl -q -p "$SYSCTL"
`

// The new file is checked (nft -c) before it replaces the old one; an unchanged file is loaded
// again only when the table is gone (flush ruleset, manual nft delete).
const relayNftSh = `same() { [ -f "$2" ] && [ "$(sha256sum < "$1")" = "$(sha256sum < "$2")" ]; }
if ! same "$NFT.new" "$NFT"; then
  nft -c -f "$NFT.new"
  if [ -f "$NFT" ]; then cp -p "$NFT" "$NFT.bak"; else rm -f "$NFT.bak"; fi
  mv -f "$NFT.new" "$NFT"; nft -f "$NFT"; echo "правила загружены"
else
  rm -f "$NFT.new"
  nft list table ip "$TABLE" >/dev/null 2>&1 || { nft -f "$NFT"; echo "таблица пропала — загружена снова"; }
fi
`

const relayNftVerifySh = `live=$(nft list table ip "$TABLE") || { echo "таблицы $TABLE нет"; exit 1; }
[ "$(printf '%s\n' "$live" | grep -c "dnat to $HUB")" = 2 ] || { echo "в $TABLE не два DNAT на $HUB"; exit 1; }
printf '%s\n' "$live" | grep -q "ip daddr $HUB ct status dnat masquerade" || { echo "нет masquerade на $HUB"; exit 1; }
`

const relayNftRollbackSh = `if [ -f "$NFT.bak" ]; then mv -f "$NFT.bak" "$NFT"; nft -f "$NFT"
else nft delete table ip "$TABLE" 2>/dev/null || true; rm -f "$NFT"; fi
`

const relayUnitSh = `if [ "$CHANGED" = 1 ]; then systemctl daemon-reload; fi
systemctl enable "$UNIT_NAME" >/dev/null 2>&1
if ! systemctl is-active --quiet "$UNIT_NAME"; then systemctl start "$UNIT_NAME"
elif [ "$CHANGED" = 1 ]; then systemctl reload "$UNIT_NAME"; fi
`

const relayTeardownSh = `systemctl disable --now "$UNIT_NAME" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
nft delete table ip "$TABLE" 2>/dev/null || true
rm -f "$UNIT" "$NFT" "$NFT.bak" "$NFT.new" "$SYSCTL" "$MODULES"
systemctl daemon-reload
`

const relayUfwOn = `ufw_on() { command -v ufw >/dev/null && ufw status | grep -q '^Status: active'; }
`

const relayFirewallSh = relayUfwOn + `if ! ufw_on; then echo "ufw выключен — не трогаем"; exit 0; fi
ufw allow "$SSH_PORT/tcp" comment 'heyearth ssh' >/dev/null
ufw route allow proto tcp to "$HUB" port 443,2443 comment 'heyearth-relay' >/dev/null
ufw route allow proto udp to "$HUB" port 30000:65000 comment 'heyearth-relay' >/dev/null
`

const relayFirewallVerifySh = relayUfwOn + `ufw_on || exit 0
st=$(ufw status)
printf '%s\n' "$st" | grep -Eq "^$SSH_PORT/tcp +ALLOW" || { echo "ufw: SSH $SSH_PORT/tcp не открыт"; exit 1; }
printf '%s\n' "$st" | grep -F "$HUB 443,2443/tcp" | grep -q "ALLOW FWD" || { echo "ufw: нет пересылки TCP"; exit 1; }
printf '%s\n' "$st" | grep -F "$HUB 30000:65000/udp" | grep -q "ALLOW FWD" || { echo "ufw: нет пересылки UDP"; exit 1; }
`

// Removes only our forwarding rules (comment heyearth-relay); the SSH rule stays (lockout risk).
const relayUfwDeleteSh = relayUfwOn + `ufw_on || exit 0
for _ in 1 2 3 4 5 6 7 8; do
  n=$(ufw status numbered | grep -F 'heyearth-relay' | head -n1 | sed -E 's/^\[ *([0-9]+)\].*/\1/' || true)
  [ -n "$n" ] || exit 0
  ufw --force delete "$n" >/dev/null
done
echo "правила heyearth-relay не удаляются"; exit 1
`

const relayJailSh = `systemctl enable fail2ban >/dev/null 2>&1
if [ "$CHANGED" = 1 ] || ! systemctl is-active --quiet fail2ban; then systemctl restart fail2ban; fi
`

func relayRecipe(o RelayOptions, l relayLayout) Recipe {
	rules, rerr := config.RelayNftRuleset(o.HubIP)
	preflight := l.sh(o, relayPreflightSh)
	verifyPath := func(ctx context.Context, _ Remote, _ *State) error {
		if o.VerifyPath == nil {
			return errors.New("проверка входа снаружи не настроена")
		}
		return o.VerifyPath(ctx)
	}
	return Recipe{
		{Name: "Предпроверка", Verify: preflight, Apply: func(ctx context.Context, r Remote, st *State) error {
			if rerr != nil {
				return rerr // before anything runs on the host
			}
			return preflight(ctx, r, st)
		}},
		{Name: "Пакеты", Apply: l.sh(o, relayPackagesSh),
			Verify: l.sh(o, `dpkg -s nftables fail2ban python3-systemd >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "пакеты не установлены"; exit 1; }`)},
		{Name: "Пересылка и conntrack", Apply: l.put(o, l.sysctl, config.RelaySysctl(), relaySysctlSh),
			Verify: l.sh(o, `[ "$(sysctl -n net.ipv4.ip_forward)" = 1 ] || { echo "ip_forward выключен"; exit 1; }`)},
		{Name: "Правила nftables", Apply: l.put(o, l.nft+".new", rules, relayNftSh),
			Verify: l.sh(o, relayNftVerifySh), Rollback: l.sh(o, relayNftRollbackSh)},
		{Name: "Юнит heyearth-relay", Apply: l.put(o, l.unit, config.RelayUnit(l.nft), relayUnitSh),
			Verify:   l.sh(o, `systemctl is-enabled --quiet "$UNIT_NAME" && systemctl is-active --quiet "$UNIT_NAME" || { echo "$UNIT_NAME не включён"; exit 1; }`),
			Rollback: l.sh(o, `systemctl disable --now "$UNIT_NAME" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; rm -f "$UNIT"; systemctl daemon-reload`)},
		{Name: "Фаервол", Apply: l.sh(o, relayFirewallSh), Verify: l.sh(o, relayFirewallVerifySh), Rollback: l.sh(o, relayUfwDeleteSh)},
		{Name: "fail2ban для SSH", Apply: l.put(o, l.jail, config.RelayJail(o.SSHPort, o.HubIP), relayJailSh),
			Verify: l.sh(o, `for _ in 1 2 3 4 5; do fail2ban-client status sshd >/dev/null 2>&1 && exit 0; sleep 2; done; echo "fail2ban: нет jail sshd"; exit 1`)},
		{Name: "Проверка входа снаружи", Apply: func(context.Context, Remote, *State) error { return nil }, Verify: verifyPath},
	}
}

func relayDeprovision(l relayLayout) Recipe {
	var o RelayOptions
	return Recipe{
		{Name: "Снять пересылку", Apply: l.sh(o, relayTeardownSh),
			Verify: l.sh(o, `if nft list table ip "$TABLE" >/dev/null 2>&1 || [ -e "$UNIT" ]; then echo "пересылка осталась"; exit 1; fi`)},
		{Name: "Фаервол", Apply: l.sh(o, relayUfwDeleteSh),
			Verify: l.sh(o, relayUfwOn+`ufw_on || exit 0; if ufw status | grep -qF heyearth-relay; then echo "правила остались"; exit 1; fi`)},
	}
}
```

```go
// relaySetup: the lifecycle rules of recipeForSetup (exit.go) with the relay recipe. The relay goes
// online (Hooks.Activate, one write) only after the check from outside passed — the same activate
// step as an exit, so ListRelayEntries never sees an unchecked relay.
func relaySetup(kind string, n Node, st *State) (Recipe, error) {
	switch kind {
	case KindProvision:
		if n.Lifecycle == "online" || n.Lifecycle == "deprovisioning" {
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("нода в состоянии «%s»: для работающей — «Переустановить», для выводимой — дождитесь конца вывода", n.Lifecycle)
		}
		st.Begin = func(ctx context.Context) error {
			return st.Hooks.SetLifecycle(ctx, n.ID, []string{"pending", "failed", "offline", "provisioning"}, "provisioning")
		}
		st.Fail = func(ctx context.Context) { _ = st.Hooks.SetLifecycle(ctx, n.ID, []string{"provisioning"}, "failed") }
	case KindReprovision:
		if n.Lifecycle != "online" {
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("переустановка — только для работающей ноды, а она «%s»", n.Lifecycle)
		}
	case KindVerify:
	default:
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("неизвестный вид задачи %q", kind)
	}
	if st.Relay.RelayIP == "" {
		return nil, errors.New("параметры ретранслятора не заданы: API не вызвал RelayOptionsFor")
	}
	return append(RelayRecipe(st.Relay), Step{Name: "activate", Apply: activateApply, Verify: lifecycleIs("online")}), nil
}
```

```go
// The phase 2 dispatch: a relay ends online only through activate, and its teardown keeps the
// lifecycle steps of DeprovisionRecipe around the relay's own.
func TestRelayStitching(t *testing.T) {
	names := func(r Recipe) []string {
		var out []string
		for _, s := range r {
			out = append(out, s.Name)
		}
		return out
	}
	dep := names(DeprovisionRecipe("relay"))
	if dep[0] != "exclude" || dep[len(dep)-1] != "finalize" || len(dep) != 2+len(RelayDeprovisionRecipe()) {
		t.Fatalf("relay deprovision: %v", dep)
	}
	st := NewState(KindProvision, Node{ID: 7, Role: "relay", Lifecycle: "pending"}, nil, Hooks{})
	if _, err := RecipeFor(KindProvision, st.Node, st); err == nil {
		t.Fatal("a relay without RelayOptions must be refused")

	st.Relay = RelayOptions{RelayIP: "203.0.113.7", HubIP: "198.51.100.2", SSHPort: 22}
	rc, err := RecipeFor(KindProvision, st.Node, st)
	if err != nil || len(rc) != len(RelayRecipe(st.Relay))+1 || rc[len(rc)-1].Name != "activate" || st.Begin == nil {
		t.Fatalf("relay provision: %v %v", names(rc), err)
	}
}
```

Правила: резерв = `role relay`, `online`, `ext healthy`; Бамбук через резерв — только при `udp healthy`. Автоподмена (глобальная `entry_failover_active` или тестовый пользователь `entry_failover_test_user == userID`) → основные Берёза/Дуб/Бамбук на адрес цели (если цель здорова; иначе остаются на Hub); `host=` у Дуба **всегда** `main_server_host` (XHTTP-inbound проверяет Host); Облако не меняется. Интервал: 1 при активной аварии, иначе `subscription_update_interval_hours` (1…24, иначе 4). Приоритеты резерва: `20+10·k` (Берёза), `+1` (Дуб), `+2/+3` (Бамбук 1/2). gRPC/REST используют тот же `hubConnectionOptions`.

```go
package main

func relayRow(id int64, ip, ext, udp string) []driver.Value {
	return []driver.Value{id, fmt.Sprintf("Резерв %d", id), ip, "RU", "online", "ip", "", ext, nil, "", udp, nil, "", "unknown", nil, ""}
}

const (
	eHub = "hub.example.test"
	eR5  = "203.0.113.50"
	eR6  = "203.0.113.60"
	eR7  = "203.0.113.70"

// entriesScript is goldenScript with reserve entries and the failover state of a scenario.
func entriesScript(t *testing.T, scenario string) *scriptDB {
	t.Helper()
	s := goldenScript()
	var rows [][]driver.Value
	switch scenario {
	case "relay": // 5 healthy (UDP too), 6 unhealthy, 7 healthy TCP but UDP unconfirmed
		rows = [][]driver.Value{relayRow(5, eR5, "healthy", "healthy"), relayRow(6, eR6, "unhealthy", "healthy"), relayRow(7, eR7, "healthy", "unknown")}
	case "failover", "relay_unhealthy":
		ext := map[string]string{"failover": "healthy", "relay_unhealthy": "unhealthy"}[scenario]
		rows = [][]driver.Value{relayRow(5, eR5, ext, "healthy")}
		s.settings["entry_failover_active"], s.settings["entry_failover_target"] = "true", "5"
		s.settings["entry_failover_since"] = "2026-10-12T10:00:00Z"
	default:
		t.Fatalf("scenario %s", scenario)
	}
	for i := range s.queries {
		if s.queries[i].name == "relays" {
			s.queries[i].rows = rows
			return s
		}
	}
	t.Fatal("goldenScript has no relays query")
	return nil
}

type subLine struct{ host, port, hostParam string }

func subLines(t *testing.T, uris []string) map[string]subLine {
	t.Helper()
	out := map[string]subLine{}
	for _, raw := range uris {
		if !strings.HasPrefix(raw, "vless://") && !strings.HasPrefix(raw, "hysteria2://") {
			continue
		}
		u, err := url.Parse(raw)
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatalf("bad URI %q: %v", raw, err)
		}
		out[u.Fragment] = subLine{u.Hostname(), u.Port(), u.Query().Get("host")}
	}
	return out
}

func entriesRequest(t *testing.T, s *scriptDB, ua, query string) (string, http.Header) {
	t.Helper()
	useScriptDB(t, s)
	rec := subscriptionRequest(t, ua, query)
	if rec.Code != http.StatusOK || len(s.unknown) > 0 {
		t.Fatalf("status %d, unscripted %v, body %.200q", rec.Code, s.unknown, rec.Body.String())
	}
	return rec.Body.String(), rec.Header()
}

func wantLines(t *testing.T, got map[string]subLine, want map[string]string) {
	t.Helper()
	for label, hostPort := range want {
		if l, ok := got[label]; !ok || l.host+":"+l.port != hostPort {
			t.Errorf("%q: got %+v (present %v), want %s", label, l, ok, hostPort)
		}
	}
}

func TestEntriesSubscriptionLines(t *testing.T) {
	happ := func(t *testing.T, s *scriptDB) (map[string]subLine, http.Header) {

		return subLines(t, strings.Split(body, "\n")), h
	}
	t.Run("relay", func(t *testing.T) {
		lines, h := happ(t, entriesScript(t, "relay"))
		wantLines(t, lines, map[string]string{"🌳 Берёза 1": eHub + ":443", "🎋 Бамбук 1 only WiFi": eHub + ":50443",
			"🌳 Берёза · резерв": eR5 + ":443", "🌲 Дуб · резерв": eR5 + ":2443",
			"🎋 Бамбук 1 only WiFi · резерв": eR5 + ":50443", "🎋 Бамбук 2 only WiFi · резерв": eR5 + ":50443",
			"🌳 Берёза · резерв 2": eR7 + ":443", "🌲 Дуб · резерв 2": eR7 + ":2443"})
		if hp := lines["🌲 Дуб · резерв"].hostParam; hp != eHub {
			t.Errorf("XHTTP host= must stay %s (the Hub inbound checks it), got %q", eHub, hp)
		}
		if _, ok := lines["🎋 Бамбук 1 only WiFi · резерв 2"]; ok {
			t.Error("Bamboo through an entry whose UDP is not confirmed")
		}
		for label, l := range lines {
			if l.host == eR6 {
				t.Errorf("unhealthy relay in %q", label)
			}
		}

			"🎋 Бамбук 2 only WiFi": eR5 + ":50443", "☁️ Облако (CDN)": "cdn.example.test:443", "🌳 Берёза · резерв": eR5 + ":443"})

			t.Errorf("interval %q, want 1 during failover", got)
		}

	t.Run("failover target unhealthy", func(t *testing.T) {
		lines, h := happ(t, entriesScript(t, "relay_unhealthy"))
		wantLines(t, lines, map[string]string{"🌳 Берёза 1": eHub + ":443"})
		for label := range lines {
			if strings.Contains(label, "резерв") {
				t.Errorf("reserve line %q of an unhealthy relay", label)

		if got := h.Get("Profile-Update-Interval"); got != "1" {
			t.Errorf("interval %q, want 1 while the failover flag is on", got)
		}

	t.Run("test user sees the failover alone", func(t *testing.T) {
		s := entriesScript(t, "relay")
		s.settings["entry_failover_test_user"] = goldenUser
		lines, h := happ(t, s)
		wantLines(t, lines, map[string]string{"🌳 Берёза 1": eR5 + ":443"})
		if h.Get("Profile-Update-Interval") != "1" {
			t.Error("test user: interval must be 1")

		s = entriesScript(t, "relay")
		s.settings["entry_failover_test_user"] = "someone-else"
		lines, _ = happ(t, s)
		wantLines(t, lines, map[string]string{"🌳 Берёза 1": eHub + ":443"})
	})
	t.Run("interval setting", func(t *testing.T) {
		for raw, want := range map[string]string{"6": "6", "24": "24", "0": "4", "25": "4", "abc": "4"} {

		for _, want := range []string{"name: \"HeYearth-Home · резерв\"\n    type: vless\n    server: " + eR5,
			"name: \"HeYearth-XHTTP · резерв 2\"\n    type: vless\n    server: " + eR7,
			"name: \"HiEarth-Express · резерв\"\n    type: hysteria2\n    server: " + eR5, "      - \"HeYearth-Home · резерв\""} {

// V2Ray (base64) and the gRPC bundle carry exactly the Happ lines; then the byte-exact goldens.
func TestEntriesSubscriptionGolden(t *testing.T) {
	labels := func(m map[string]subLine) []string {
		var out []string
		for k := range m {
			out = append(out, k)
		}
		sort.Strings(out)
		return out
	}
	for _, sc := range []string{"relay", "failover", "relay_unhealthy"} {
		t.Run(sc, func(t *testing.T) {
			happBody, _ := entriesRequest(t, entriesScript(t, sc), "Happ/3.1 Android", "")
			want := fmt.Sprint(labels(subLines(t, strings.Split(happBody, "\n"))))
			v2, _ := entriesRequest(t, entriesScript(t, sc), "v2rayNG/1.9", "")
			dec, err := base64.StdEncoding.DecodeString(v2)
			if err != nil || fmt.Sprint(labels(subLines(t, strings.Split(string(dec), "\n")))) != want {
				t.Errorf("v2ray lines differ from happ (%v)", err)
			}
			s := entriesScript(t, sc)
			useScriptDB(t, s)
			resp, err := (&server{}).GetConnectionBundle(context.Background(), &heyearth_v1.GetConnectionBundleRequest{UserId: goldenUser})
			if err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			var uris []string
			for _, o := range resp.GetConnectionOptions() {
				uris = append(uris, o.GetUri())
			}

				checkGolden(t, "entries_"+sc+"_"+f.name+"_headers", goldenHeaders(rec))
			}
		})

}
```

```go
// admin preview). Defaults only for absent/blank keys, an error for a failed read.
func loadHubSettingInputs(in *hubConnectionInputs) error {
	var err error
	if in.mainServerHost, err = subscriptionSetting("main_server_host", ""); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	for _, r := range []struct {
		dst      *string
		key, def string
	}{
		{&in.realityPubKey, "reality_public_key", ""},
		{&in.realityShortID, "reality_short_id", ""},

		{&in.xhttpPort, "xhttp_port", "2443"},
	} {

			return err
		}
	}
	cdn, err := subscriptionSetting("cdn_enabled", "false")
	if err != nil {
		return err

	if in.cdnEnabled = cdn == "true"; in.cdnEnabled {
		if in.cdnHost, err = subscriptionSetting("cdn_host", "cdn.hiearth.ru"); err != nil {
			return err
		}
		if in.cdnPath, err = subscriptionSetting("cdn_xh_path", "/cdn-xh"); err != nil {
			return err
		}
	}
	return nil
}
```

(в) Новый код (рядом с `hubConnectionOptions`; импорты `sort`, `strconv`):
```go
// ── Entries (phase 3): reserve lines and the failover of the main address ──

const defaultUpdateIntervalHours = 4

type reserveEntry struct {
	id      int
	address string
	udp     bool // Bamboo answers through this entry
}

// entryPlan says where the lines point. main "" means mainServerHost.
type entryPlan struct {
	main     string
	failover bool
	reserves []reserveEntry
	interval int // Profile-Update-Interval, hours
}

// planEntries: reserves = online relays with a healthy external check, by id. During a failover
// (global, or forced for the test user) the main lines go to the target — only if it is healthy
// right now (a stale flag never points users at a dead relay) — and the interval drops to 1 h.
func planEntries(mainHost string, relays []biz.Entry, fo biz.EntryFailover, forced bool, intervalRaw string) entryPlan {
	p := entryPlan{main: mainHost, interval: defaultUpdateIntervalHours}
	if h, err := strconv.Atoi(strings.TrimSpace(intervalRaw)); err == nil && h >= 1 && h <= 24 {
		p.interval = h
	}
	for _, r := range relays {
		if r.Kind == biz.EntryKindRelay && r.Lifecycle == "online" && r.Health.External == biz.EntryHealthy && r.Address != "" {
			p.reserves = append(p.reserves, reserveEntry{id: r.ID, address: r.Address, udp: r.Health.UDP == biz.EntryHealthy})
		}
	}
	sort.Slice(p.reserves, func(i, j int) bool { return p.reserves[i].id < p.reserves[j].id })
	if !fo.Active && !forced {
		return p
	}
	p.interval = 1
	target := fo.Target
	if !fo.Active && len(p.reserves) > 0 {
		target = p.reserves[0].id
	}
	for _, r := range p.reserves {
		if r.id == target {
			p.main, p.failover = r.address, true
			break
		}
	}
	return p
}

func loadEntryPlan(userID, mainHost string) (entryPlan, error) {
	relays, err := withSyncTimeout(biz.ListRelayEntries)
	if err != nil {
		return entryPlan{}, err
	}
	fo, err := withSyncTimeout(biz.GetEntryFailover)
	if err != nil {
		return entryPlan{}, err
	}
	testUser, err := subscriptionSetting("entry_failover_test_user", "")
	if err != nil {
		return entryPlan{}, err
	}
	interval, err := subscriptionSetting("subscription_update_interval_hours", strconv.Itoa(defaultUpdateIntervalHours))
	if err != nil {
		return entryPlan{}, err
	}
	return planEntries(mainHost, relays, fo, userID != "" && testUser == userID, interval), nil
}

func reserveSuffix(k int) string {
	if k == 0 {
		return " · резерв"
	}
	return fmt.Sprintf(" · резерв %d", k+1)
}

// realityParams are the Reality values shared by every VLESS line of a user.
type realityParams struct{ uuid, sni, pbk, sid, flowParam string }

func (p realityParams) tcpURI(host, fp, label string) string {
	return fmt.Sprintf("vless://%s@%s:443?encryption=none&security=reality&sni=%s&fp=%s&pbk=%s&sid=%s&type=tcp&tcpKeepAliveInterval=15&tcpKeepAliveIdle=100%s#%s",
		p.uuid, host, p.sni, fp, p.pbk, p.sid, p.flowParam, url.PathEscape(label))
}

// xhttpURI: hostHeader is ALWAYS the Hub's main_server_host — the XHTTP inbound checks it.
func (p realityParams) xhttpURI(host, port, fp, hostHeader, label string) string {
	return fmt.Sprintf("vless://%s@%s:%s?encryption=none&security=reality&sni=%s&fp=%s&pbk=%s&sid=%s&type=xhttp&path=%%2F&host=%s&mode=auto&tcpKeepAliveInterval=15&tcpKeepAliveIdle=100#%s",
		p.uuid, host, port, p.sni, fp, p.pbk, p.sid, url.QueryEscape(hostHeader), url.PathEscape(label))
}

func bambooURI(password, host, obfs, sni, bwParams, label string) string {
	return fmt.Sprintf("hysteria2://%s@%s:50443/?obfs=salamander&obfs-password=%s&sni=%s&insecure=0&mport=30000-65000&hop_interval=15%s#%s",
		url.QueryEscape(password), host, url.QueryEscape(obfs), sni, bwParams, url.PathEscape(label))
}

// bambooVariants: BBR (no bandwidth) and Brutal (fixed bandwidth beats operator UDP QoS).
var bambooVariants = []struct {
	name, bwParams string
	priority       int32
}{{"Бамбук 1", "", 4}, {"Бамбук 2", "&upmbps=20&downmbps=80", 5}}

func vlessOption(uri, label string, prio int32) *heyearth_v1.ConnectionOption {
	return &heyearth_v1.ConnectionOption{Uri: uri, Protocol: "vless", Label: label,
		RecommendedNetworks: []string{"wifi", "cellular", "ethernet", "any"}, Priority: prio}
}

func bambooOption(uri, label string, prio int32) *heyearth_v1.ConnectionOption {
	return &heyearth_v1.ConnectionOption{Uri: uri, Protocol: "hysteria2", Label: label,
		RecommendedNetworks: []string{"wifi", "ethernet"}, Priority: prio}
}

// reserveOptions: per healthy reserve one Берёза and one Дуб (fp chrome) and, when Bamboo answers
// through it, both Бамбук variants; after every main line (priority 20 + 10·k).
func reserveOptions(in hubConnectionInputs, rp realityParams) []*heyearth_v1.ConnectionOption {
	if in.mainServerHost == "" {
		return nil
	}
	var opts []*heyearth_v1.ConnectionOption
	for k, r := range in.entries.reserves {
		sfx, base := reserveSuffix(k), int32(20+10*k)
		if rp.uuid != "" && rp.pbk != "" && in.canVLESS {
			label := "🌳 Берёза" + sfx
			opts = append(opts, vlessOption(rp.tcpURI(r.address, "chrome", label), label, base))
			label = "🌲 Дуб" + sfx
			opts = append(opts, vlessOption(rp.xhttpURI(r.address, in.xhttpPort, "chrome", in.mainServerHost, label), label, base+1))
		}
		if in.canHysteria2 && in.hy2Password != "" && in.obfsPassword != "" && r.udp {
			for i, v := range bambooVariants {
				label := fmt.Sprintf("🎋 %s only WiFi%s", v.name, sfx)
				opts = append(opts, bambooOption(bambooURI(in.hy2Password, r.address, in.obfsPassword, in.hysteria2SNI, v.bwParams, label), label, base+2+int32(i)))
			}
		}
	}
	return opts
}
```

Ключи алертов: `entry-failover-<relayID>` (critical: включение/смена цели; resolve — возврат/выключение/отказ резерва), `entry-failover-no-reserve` (warn «основной недоступен, резерва нет»; critical при отказе резерва во время аварии), `relay-<id>-unreachable-external` (warn), `relay-<id>-bamboo` (warn), `relay-<id>-unreachable-ru` (warn, check-host), `entries-probe-blind` (warn: час без вердикта). Hub-алерты `entry-unreachable-external/-ru` остаются за loop-пробой и check-host.

Правила (Review Focus 4): провал засчитывается, только если контроль выхода (`1.1.1.1:443` через тот же SOCKS) прошёл **до** проверки (выбор выхода) и **после** неё; иначе — пропуск, не трогающий счётчики.
```go
package main

import (
	"context"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"slices"
	"strings"
	"testing"
	"time"

	"github.com/heyearth/backend/internal/biz"
)

var errBlocked = errors.New("read tcp: i/o timeout")

const (
	tHub = "198.51.100.1"
	tR5  = "203.0.113.50"
	tR7  = "203.0.113.70"
)

type entryEnv struct {
	now        time.Time
	entries    []biz.Entry
	fo         biz.EntryFailover
	saveErr    error
	settings   map[string]string
	exits      []int
	exitsErr   error
	controlErr error
	controlSeq []error // consumed first, one per control call
	tcp, udp   map[string]error
	events     []string
	bumps      int
	m          *entryMonitor
}

func newEntryEnv() *entryEnv {
	e := &entryEnv{now: time.Date(2026, 10, 12, 12, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC), settings: map[string]string{},
		exits: []int{1090}, tcp: map[string]error{}, udp: map[string]error{},
		entries: []biz.Entry{
			{ID: 0, Name: "Hub", Kind: biz.EntryKindHub, Address: tHub, Lifecycle: "online"},
			{ID: 5, Name: "Резерв", Kind: biz.EntryKindRelay, Address: tR5, Lifecycle: "online",
				Health: biz.EntryHealth{External: biz.EntryHealthy, UDP: biz.EntryHealthy}},
		}}
	e.m = &entryMonitor{
		now:          func() time.Time { return e.now },
		list:         func(context.Context) ([]biz.Entry, error) { return e.entries, nil },
		readFailover: func(context.Context) (biz.EntryFailover, error) { return e.fo, nil },
		saveFailover: func(_ context.Context, st biz.EntryFailover) error {
			if e.saveErr != nil {
				return e.saveErr
			}
			e.fo = st
			return nil
		},
		saveCheck: func(context.Context, int, string, biz.EntryCheck) error { return nil },
		bump:      func(context.Context) error { e.bumps++; return nil },
		setting:   func(k string) (string, error) { return e.settings[k], nil },
		exits:     func() ([]int, error) { return e.exits, e.exitsErr },
		control: func(int) error {
			if len(e.controlSeq) > 0 {
				err := e.controlSeq[0]
				e.controlSeq = e.controlSeq[1:]
				return err
			}
			return e.controlErr
		},
		tlsCheck:   func(_ int, host string, _ int, _ string) error { return e.tcp[host] },
		udpCheck:   func(_ int, host string, _ []byte) error { return e.udp[host] },
		udpControl: func(int) error { return nil },
		raise:      func(k string, l AlertLevel, _, _ string) { e.events = append(e.events, "raise "+k+" "+string(l)) },
		resolve:    func(k, _ string) { e.events = append(e.events, "resolve "+k) },
		logf:       func(string, ...any) {},
	}
	return e
}

func (e *entryEnv) run()                { e.now = e.now.Add(time.Minute); e.m.run() }
func (e *entryEnv) step(hubErr error)   { e.tcp[tHub] = hubErr; e.run() }
func (e *entryEnv) has(ev string) bool  { return slices.Contains(e.events, ev) }

func TestFailoverActivatesOnThreeRealFailures(t *testing.T) {
	e := newEntryEnv()
	e.step(errBlocked)
	e.step(errBlocked)
	if e.fo.Active {
		t.Fatal("2 failures switched")
	}
	e.step(errBlocked)
	if !e.fo.Active || e.fo.Target != 5 || !e.fo.Since.Equal(e.now) || !e.has("raise entry-failover-5 critical") || e.bumps != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("fo %+v, events %v, bumps %d", e.fo, e.events, e.bumps)
	}
}

// Review Focus 4: a flapping probe never switches.
func TestFailoverFlappingProbeNeverSwaps(t *testing.T) {
	e := newEntryEnv()
	for i := 0; i < 20; i++ {
		e.step(errBlocked)
		e.step(errBlocked)
		e.step(nil)
	}
	if e.fo.Active || e.has("raise entry-failover-5 critical") {
		t.Fatalf("flapping switched: %+v %v", e.fo, e.events)
	}
}

// Review Focus 4: the probe's own failure — no exit, unreadable exit list, the exit's control
// failing, the exit dying in the middle of a check, a broken SOCKS — is not a block: not counted,
// and a short real streak survives it.
func TestFailoverProbeToolFailureIsNotABlock(t *testing.T) {
	tool := fmt.Errorf("%w: bad port", errEntryProbeTool)
	breakers := map[string]func(e *entryEnv){
		"нет выхода":                  func(e *entryEnv) { e.exits = nil },
		"список выходов не прочитан":  func(e *entryEnv) { e.exitsErr = errors.New("db down") },
		"контроль выхода не проходит": func(e *entryEnv) { e.controlErr = errors.New("socks: connection refused") },
		"выход умер посреди проверки": func(e *entryEnv) { e.controlSeq = []error{nil, errors.New("refused"), errors.New("refused")} },
		"SOCKS не создаётся":          func(e *entryEnv) { e.tcp[tHub], e.tcp[tR5] = tool, tool },
	}
	for name, breakProbe := range breakers {
		t.Run(name, func(t *testing.T) {
			e := newEntryEnv()
			e.step(errBlocked)
			e.step(errBlocked)
			e.events = nil
			for i := 0; i < 5; i++ {
				e.tcp[tHub], e.tcp[tR5] = errBlocked, errBlocked // both really fail…
				breakProbe(e)                                    // …but the probe cannot prove it
				e.run()
			}
			if e.fo.Active || len(e.events) > 0 || e.m.tcp[5].status != biz.EntryHealthy {
				t.Fatalf("tool failure acted: fo %+v, events %v, reserve %s", e.fo, e.events, e.m.tcp[5].status)
			}
			e.exits, e.exitsErr, e.controlErr, e.controlSeq, e.tcp[tR5] = []int{1090}, nil, nil, nil, nil
			e.step(errBlocked) // 2 old + 1 new within 10 min = 3 in a row
			if !e.fo.Active {
				t.Fatal("skips broke a real streak shorter than the stale window")
			}
		})
	}
	// Blind for an hour: the streak starts over and the blind alert is raised, then resolved.
	e := newEntryEnv()
	e.step(errBlocked)
	e.step(errBlocked)
	e.exits = nil
	for i := 0; i < 61; i++ {
		e.run()
	}
	e.exits = []int{1090}
	e.step(errBlocked)
	if e.fo.Active || !e.has("raise entries-probe-blind warn") || !e.has("resolve entries-probe-blind") {
		t.Fatalf("blind hour: fo %+v, events %v", e.fo, e.events)
	}
}

func TestFailoverNeedsHealthyReserve(t *testing.T) {
	e := newEntryEnv()
	e.entries[1].Health.External = biz.EntryUnhealthy // persisted state seeds the track
	e.tcp[tR5] = errBlocked
	for i := 0; i < 5; i++ {
		e.step(errBlocked)
	}
	if e.fo.Active || !e.has("raise entry-failover-no-reserve warn") {
		t.Fatalf("fo %+v, events %v", e.fo, e.events)
	}
	none := newEntryEnv() // no relays at all: no "no reserve" noise (the loop probe alerts already)
	none.entries = none.entries[:1]
	for i := 0; i < 5; i++ {
		none.step(errBlocked)
	}
	if none.fo.Active || len(none.events) != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("no relays: %+v %v", none.fo, none.events)
	}
}

func TestFailoverReturnNeedsThirtyStableMinutes(t *testing.T) {
	e := newEntryEnv()
	for i := 0; i < 3; i++ {
		e.step(errBlocked)
	}
	for i := 0; i < 29; i++ {
		if e.step(nil); !e.fo.Active {
			t.Fatalf("returned after %d stable minutes", i+1)
		}
	}
	e.step(errBlocked) // one failure restarts the 30 minutes
	for i := 0; i < 30; i++ {
		if e.step(nil); !e.fo.Active {
			t.Fatalf("returned %d min after the last failure", i+1)
		}
	}
	e.step(nil)
	if e.fo.Active || !e.has("resolve entry-failover-5") {
		t.Fatalf("30 stable minutes must return: %+v %v", e.fo, e.events)
	}
}

func TestFailoverRetargetsAndAbandons(t *testing.T) {
	e := newEntryEnv()
	e.entries = append(e.entries, biz.Entry{ID: 7, Name: "Резерв 2", Kind: biz.EntryKindRelay, Address: tR7, Lifecycle: "online",
		Health: biz.EntryHealth{External: biz.EntryHealthy}})
	for i := 0; i < 3; i++ {
		e.step(errBlocked)
	}
	since := e.fo.Since
	e.tcp[tR5] = errBlocked
	for i := 0; i < 3; i++ {
		e.step(errBlocked)
	}
	if e.fo.Target != 7 || !e.fo.Since.Equal(since) || !e.has("resolve entry-failover-5") || !e.has("raise entry-failover-7 critical") {
		t.Fatalf("retarget: %+v %v", e.fo, e.events)
	}
	e.tcp[tR7] = errBlocked
	for i := 0; i < 3; i++ {
		e.step(errBlocked)
	}
	if e.fo.Active || !e.has("resolve entry-failover-7") || !e.has("raise entry-failover-no-reserve critical") {
		t.Fatalf("abandon: %+v %v", e.fo, e.events)
	}
}

func TestFailoverSwitchOffAndUnsavedState(t *testing.T) {
	e := newEntryEnv()
	e.saveErr = errors.New("db down")
	for i := 0; i < 3; i++ {
		e.step(errBlocked)
	}
	if e.fo.Active || e.has("raise entry-failover-5 critical") || e.bumps != 0 {
		t.Fatal("alert or bump before the state was saved")
	}
	e.saveErr = nil
	if e.step(errBlocked); !e.fo.Active {
		t.Fatal("not retried a minute later")
	}
	e.settings["entry_failover_enabled"] = "false"
	if e.step(errBlocked); e.fo.Active || !e.has("resolve entry-failover-5") {
		t.Fatal("switch-off did not return the lines")
	}
	for i := 0; i < 3; i++ {
		e.step(errBlocked)
	}
	if e.fo.Active {
		t.Fatal("activated while switched off")
	}
}

func TestFailoverDrillExpires(t *testing.T) {
	e := newEntryEnv()
	e.settings["entry_probe_simulate_hub_fail_until"] = e.now.Add(3*time.Minute + 30*time.Second).Format(time.RFC3339)
	for i := 0; i < 3; i++ {
		e.step(nil) // the Hub answers, the drill says it does not
	}
	if !e.fo.Active {
		t.Fatal("the drill did not switch")
	}
	for i := 0; i < 31; i++ {
		e.step(nil)
	}
	if e.fo.Active {
		t.Fatal("the drill did not end")
	}
}

func TestEntryMonitorRestartAndReserveChanges(t *testing.T) {
	e := newEntryEnv() // restarted API during a failover: state kept, no bump for an unchanged reserve
	e.fo = biz.EntryFailover{Active: true, Target: 5, Since: e.now}
	e.step(nil)
	e.step(nil)
	if !e.fo.Active || e.bumps != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("restart: %+v bumps %d", e.fo, e.bumps)
	}
	e = newEntryEnv() // a reserve going down and up: warn alert, a bump on each change
	e.tcp[tR5] = errBlocked
	for i := 0; i < 3; i++ {
		e.step(nil)
	}
	if !e.has("raise relay-5-unreachable-external warn") || e.bumps != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("down: %v bumps %d", e.events, e.bumps)
	}
	e.tcp[tR5] = nil
	e.step(nil)
	e.step(nil)
	if !e.has("resolve relay-5-unreachable-external") || e.bumps != 2 {
		t.Fatalf("up: %v bumps %d", e.events, e.bumps)
	}
}

func TestEntryMonitorBambooThroughRelay(t *testing.T) {
	e := newEntryEnv()
	e.settings["hysteria2_obfs_password"] = "psk"
	e.udp[tR5] = fmt.Errorf("%w от %s:41000 за 5s", errBambooNoReply, tR5)

	}
	if !e.has("raise relay-5-bamboo warn") || e.m.udp[5].status != biz.EntryUnhealthy {

	lost.udp[tR5] = fmt.Errorf("%w от %s", errBambooNoReply, tR5)
	lost.m.udpControl = func(int) error { return errors.New("DNS через exit: нет ответа") }
	for i := 0; i < 3; i++ {
		lost.step(nil)
	}
	if lost.has("raise relay-5-bamboo warn") || lost.m.udp[5] != nil {
		t.Fatalf("exit without UDP counted as a Bamboo failure: %v", lost.events)
	}
}

func TestVerifyRelayPath(t *testing.T) {
	e := newEntryEnv()
	if err := e.m.verifyRelay(tR5); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("healthy relay: %v", err)
	}

	if err := e.m.verifyRelay(tR5); err == nil || !strings.Contains(err.Error(), "проверка невозможна") {

	}
	if err := e.m.verifyRelay(tR5); err == nil || !strings.Contains(err.Error(), ":2443") {
		t.Fatalf("XHTTP port not checked: %v", err)
	}
	e.m.tlsCheck = func(int, string, int, string) error { return nil }
	e.settings["hysteria2_obfs_password"] = "psk"
	e.udp[tR5] = fmt.Errorf("%w от %s", errBambooNoReply, tR5)
	if err := e.m.verifyRelay(tR5); err == nil {

	}
	e.m.udpControl = func(int) error { return errors.New("exit lost UDP") }
	if err := e.m.verifyRelay(tR5); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("UDP that cannot be checked is not the relay's fault: %v", err)
	}
}
```
