```go
package main

import (
	"context"
	"crypto/tls"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"log"
	"net"
	"slices"
	"strconv"
	"time"

	"github.com/heyearth/backend/internal/biz"
)

// ── Entries monitor (phase 3, spec 2026-10-12 section 4) ──
// Once a minute every entry (Hub = 0, each online relay) is checked from outside — TLS with the
// Reality SNI to <entry>:443 through a foreign exit, and for relays the Bamboo VN probe through
// their hop ports. While the main entry is blocked (3 consecutive REAL failures) and a reserve is
// healthy, the main subscription lines move to the reserve (entry_failover_*); they return after
// 2 successes and 30 min of stability. A probe that could not run (no exit, broken SOCKS, the
// exit's control failing before or right after the check, a DB read error) is a skip: never a
// failure, never a recovery (Review Focus 4).

const (
	entryCheckInterval  = time.Minute
	entryFailThreshold  = 3
	entryReturnStable   = 30 * time.Minute
	entryDBTimeout      = 5 * time.Second
	entryBlindAfter     = time.Hour
	entryControlAddr    = "1.1.1.1:443"
	entryNoReserveAlert = "entry-failover-no-reserve"
	entryBlindAlert     = "entries-probe-blind"
)

var errEntryProbeTool = errors.New("сбой инструмента проверки")

func entryFailoverAlertKey(target int) string { return "entry-failover-" + strconv.Itoa(target) }
func relayAlertKey(id int, what string) string { return fmt.Sprintf("relay-%d-%s", id, what) }

type entryVerdict int

const (
	entrySkip entryVerdict = iota
	entryFail
	entryOK
)

// decideEntry: a failed check counts only if the exit still passes its own control afterwards.
func decideEntry(checkErr error, control func() error) entryVerdict {
	switch {
	case checkErr == nil:
		return entryOK
	case errors.Is(checkErr, errEntryProbeTool), control() != nil:
		return entrySkip
	default:
		return entryFail
	}
}

// entryTrack: hysteresis of one check of one entry. status is what was published (persisted,
// survives restarts): unhealthy after entryFailThreshold failures, healthy after probeResolveOKs
// successes; verdicts more than loopProbeStaleAfter apart restart both streaks.
type entryTrack struct {
	streak  loopProbeStreak
	status  string
	okSince time.Time // start of the current run of successes; zero while failing
	dirty   bool      // status changed, not saved yet
}

func (t *entryTrack) record(now time.Time, ok bool) (changed bool) {
	if !t.streak.last.IsZero() && now.Sub(t.streak.last) > loopProbeStaleAfter {
		t.okSince = time.Time{}
	}
	t.streak.record(now, ok)
	switch {
	case !ok:
		t.okSince = time.Time{}
	case t.okSince.IsZero():
		t.okSince = now
	}
	prev := t.status
	if t.streak.fails >= entryFailThreshold {
		t.status = biz.EntryUnhealthy
	} else if t.streak.recovered() {
		t.status = biz.EntryHealthy
	}
	return t.status != prev
}

type failoverEvent string

const (
	foNone      failoverEvent = ""
	foActivate  failoverEvent = "activate"
	foRetarget  failoverEvent = "retarget"
	foReturn    failoverEvent = "return"
	foAbandon   failoverEvent = "abandon"
	foDisabled  failoverEvent = "disabled"
	foNoReserve failoverEvent = "no-reserve"
)

type failoverInput struct {
	now     time.Time
	enabled bool
	cur     biz.EntryFailover
	hub     entryTrack // the main entry's TCP track
	healthy []int      // relays with a healthy TCP track, ascending
	relays  int        // online relays
}

// decideFailover is the auto-swap state machine (pure).
func decideFailover(in failoverInput) (biz.EntryFailover, failoverEvent) {
	cur := in.cur
	if cur.Active {
		switch {
		case !in.enabled:
			return biz.EntryFailover{}, foDisabled
		case in.hub.streak.recovered() && !in.hub.okSince.IsZero() && in.now.Sub(in.hub.okSince) >= entryReturnStable:
			return biz.EntryFailover{}, foReturn
		case !slices.Contains(in.healthy, cur.Target):
			if len(in.healthy) == 0 {
				return biz.EntryFailover{}, foAbandon
			}
			cur.Target = in.healthy[0]
			return cur, foRetarget
		}
		return cur, foNone
	}
	if !in.enabled || in.hub.streak.fails < entryFailThreshold {
		return cur, foNone
	}
	if len(in.healthy) == 0 {
		if in.relays > 0 {
			return cur, foNoReserve
		}
		return cur, foNone
	}
	return biz.EntryFailover{Active: true, Target: in.healthy[0], Since: in.now}, foActivate
}

type entryConfig struct {
	enabled  bool
	sni, psk string
	simUntil time.Time
}

// entryMonitor: every side effect is a field (tests drive it). Used by one goroutine only.
type entryMonitor struct {
	now          func() time.Time
	list         func(ctx context.Context) ([]biz.Entry, error)
	readFailover func(ctx context.Context) (biz.EntryFailover, error)
	saveFailover func(ctx context.Context, st biz.EntryFailover) error
	saveCheck    func(ctx context.Context, id int, kind string, c biz.EntryCheck) error
	bump         func(ctx context.Context) error
	setting      func(key string) (string, error) // "" for absent; error = failed read
	exits        func() ([]int, error)
	control      func(socksPort int) error
	tlsCheck     func(socksPort int, host string, port int, sni string) error
	udpCheck     func(socksPort int, host string, psk []byte) error
	udpControl   func(socksPort int) error
	raise        func(key string, level AlertLevel, title, details string)
	resolve      func(key, message string)
	logf         func(format string, args ...any)

	tcp, udp   map[int]*entryTrack
	blindSince time.Time
	skipLog    logGate
}

var entryMon = &entryMonitor{
	now: time.Now, list: biz.ListEntries, readFailover: biz.GetEntryFailover, saveFailover: biz.SetEntryFailover,
	saveCheck: biz.SaveEntryCheck, bump: biz.BumpSubscriptionVersionContext,
	setting:  func(key string) (string, error) { return settingOrEmpty(biz.GetSetting, key) },
	exits:    func() ([]int, error) { return liveExitSocksPorts(bambooMaxExits) },
	control:  exitTCPControl,
	tlsCheck: entryTLSCheck,
	udpCheck: func(port int, host string, psk []byte) error { _, _, err := probeBamboo(port, host, psk); return err },
	udpControl: func(port int) error { return defaultBambooProber.control(port) },
	raise:      RaiseAlert, resolve: ResolveAlert, logf: log.Printf,
}

func runEntryMonitor() { entryMon.run() }

// verifyRelayPath is provision.RelayPathVerifier (the last step of the relay recipe).
func verifyRelayPath(_ context.Context, relayIP string) error { return entryMon.verifyRelay(relayIP) }

func exitTCPControl(socksPort int) error {
	d, err := exitSocksDialer(socksPort)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	return socksDialCheck(d, entryControlAddr)
}

func entryTLSCheck(socksPort int, host string, port int, sni string) error {
	d, err := exitSocksDialer(socksPort)
	if err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("%w: %v", errEntryProbeTool, err)
	}
	ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 15*time.Second)
	defer cancel()
	conn, err := d.DialContext(ctx, "tcp", net.JoinHostPort(host, strconv.Itoa(port)))
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	defer conn.Close()
	// Reality answers with the dest site's certificate: the path is tested, not the PKI.
	return tls.Client(conn, &tls.Config{ServerName: sni, InsecureSkipVerify: true}).HandshakeContext(ctx)
}

func (m *entryMonitor) readConfig() (entryConfig, error) {
	v := map[string]string{}
	for _, k := range []string{"entry_failover_enabled", "reality_sni_domain", "hysteria2_obfs_password", "entry_probe_simulate_hub_fail_until"} {
		s, err := m.setting(k)
		if err != nil {
			return entryConfig{}, fmt.Errorf("настройка %s не прочитана: %w", k, err)
		}
		v[k] = s
	}
	c := entryConfig{enabled: v["entry_failover_enabled"] != "false", sni: v["reality_sni_domain"], psk: v["hysteria2_obfs_password"]}
	if c.sni == "" {
		c.sni = biz.DefaultRealitySNI
	}
	c.simUntil, _ = time.Parse(time.RFC3339, v["entry_probe_simulate_hub_fail_until"])
	return c, nil
}

// pickExit: the first live exit whose own TCP path works (the "before" control).
func (m *entryMonitor) pickExit() (int, error) {
	ports, err := m.exits()
	if err != nil {
		return 0, err
	}
	for _, p := range ports {
		if m.control(p) == nil {
			return p, nil
		}
	}
	if len(ports) == 0 {
		return 0, errNoLiveExit
	}
	return 0, fmt.Errorf("ни один выход за рубежом не прошёл контроль %s (порты %v)", entryControlAddr, ports)
}

func (m *entryMonitor) track(tracks *map[int]*entryTrack, id int, persisted string) *entryTrack {
	if *tracks == nil {
		*tracks = map[int]*entryTrack{}
	}
	t := (*tracks)[id]
	if t == nil {
		if persisted == "" {
			persisted = biz.EntryUnknown
		}
		t = &entryTrack{status: persisted} // a restart keeps the published state
		(*tracks)[id] = t
	}
	return t
}

func (m *entryMonitor) run() {
	now := m.now()
	if m.blindSince.IsZero() {
		m.blindSince = now
	}
	ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), entryDBTimeout)
	entries, err := m.list(ctx)
	var cur biz.EntryFailover
	if err == nil {
		cur, err = m.readFailover(ctx)
	}
	cancel()
	if err != nil {
		m.skip(now, "входы или состояние автоподмены не прочитаны: "+err.Error())
		return
	}
	cfg, err := m.readConfig()
	if err != nil {
		m.skip(now, err.Error())
		return
	}
	port, err := m.pickExit()
	if err != nil {
		m.skip(now, err.Error())
		return
	}
	live := map[int]bool{}
	for _, e := range entries {
		live[e.ID] = true
		m.checkTCP(now, port, e, cfg)
		if e.Kind == biz.EntryKindRelay && cfg.psk != "" {
			m.checkUDP(now, port, e, cfg.psk)
		}
	}
	for id := range m.tcp {
		if !live[id] {
			delete(m.tcp, id)
			delete(m.udp, id)
		}
	}
	m.failover(now, cur, cfg.enabled, entries)
}

func (m *entryMonitor) checkTCP(now time.Time, port int, e biz.Entry, cfg entryConfig) {
	err := m.tlsCheck(port, e.Address, 443, cfg.sni)
	v := decideEntry(err, func() error { return m.control(port) })
	if e.ID == 0 && now.Before(cfg.simUntil) {
		v, err = entryFail, fmt.Errorf("учебная авария до %s (админка → Входы)", cfg.simUntil.In(mskZone).Format("15:04"))
	}
	if v == entrySkip {
		m.skip(now, fmt.Sprintf("вход %s не проверен через выход :%d: %v", e.Address, port, err))
		return
	}
	m.verdict(now)
	t := m.track(&m.tcp, e.ID, e.Health.External)
	m.publish(e, "ext", t, t.record(now, v == entryOK), now, err)
	if e.Kind != biz.EntryKindRelay {
		return // the Hub's own alerts come from the loop probe (entry-unreachable-external)
	}
	key := relayAlertKey(e.ID, "unreachable-external")
	switch {
	case t.streak.fails >= entryFailThreshold:
		m.raise(key, AlertWarn, "Резервный вход недоступен снаружи", fmt.Sprintf(
			"Резервный вход «%s» (%s): %d проверок подряд через выход за рубежом :%d не прошли, строки «· резерв» этого входа убраны из подписки.\nПоследняя ошибка: %v\nНа ретрансляторе: systemctl status heyearth-relay; nft list table ip heyearth_relay.",
			e.Name, e.Address, t.streak.fails, port, err))
	case t.streak.recovered():
		m.resolve(key, fmt.Sprintf("Резервный вход «%s» (%s) снова доступен снаружи.", e.Name, e.Address))
	}
}

func (m *entryMonitor) checkUDP(now time.Time, port int, e biz.Entry, psk string) {
	err := m.udpCheck(port, e.Address, []byte(psk))
	var cerr error
	if bambooNeedsControl(err) {
		cerr = m.udpControl(port)
	}
	verdict := decideBamboo(err, cerr)
	if verdict == bambooSkip {
		m.skip(now, fmt.Sprintf("Бамбук через вход %s не проверен: %v (контроль UDP: %v)", e.Address, err, cerr))
		return
	}
	t := m.track(&m.udp, e.ID, e.Health.UDP)
	m.publish(e, "udp", t, t.record(now, verdict == bambooOK), now, err)
	key := relayAlertKey(e.ID, "bamboo")
	switch {
	case t.streak.fails >= entryFailThreshold:
		m.raise(key, AlertWarn, "Бамбук через резервный вход не отвечает", fmt.Sprintf(
			"Резервный вход «%s» (%s): %d проверок подряд Бамбук (UDP %d-%d) не ответил, строки «🎋 … · резерв» убраны из подписки.\nПоследняя ошибка: %v",
			e.Name, e.Address, t.streak.fails, bambooHopPortMin, bambooHopPortMax, err))
	case t.streak.recovered():
		m.resolve(key, fmt.Sprintf("Бамбук через резервный вход «%s» снова отвечает.", e.Name))
	}
}

// publish persists the published status; a changed reserve bumps subscription_version (apps
// refetch their lines). A failed write is retried by the next verdict.
func (m *entryMonitor) publish(e biz.Entry, kind string, t *entryTrack, changed bool, now time.Time, cause error) {
	t.dirty = t.dirty || changed
	detail := ""
	if cause != nil {
		detail = cause.Error()
	}
	ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), entryDBTimeout)
	defer cancel()
	if err := m.saveCheck(ctx, e.ID, kind, biz.EntryCheck{Status: t.status, At: now, Detail: detail}); err != nil {
		m.logf("[entries] вход %d (%s): состояние не сохранено, повтор при следующей проверке: %v", e.ID, kind, err)
		return
	}
	if t.dirty && e.Kind == biz.EntryKindRelay {
		if err := m.bump(ctx); err != nil {
			m.logf("[entries] subscription_version не увеличена: %v", err)
		}
	}
	t.dirty = false
}

func (m *entryMonitor) failover(now time.Time, cur biz.EntryFailover, enabled bool, entries []biz.Entry) {
	hub := m.track(&m.tcp, 0, biz.EntryUnknown)
	in := failoverInput{now: now, enabled: enabled, cur: cur, hub: *hub}
	names := map[int]string{}
	for _, e := range entries {
		if e.Kind != biz.EntryKindRelay {
			continue
		}
		in.relays++
		names[e.ID] = fmt.Sprintf("«%s» (%s)", e.Name, e.Address)
		if t := m.tcp[e.ID]; t != nil && t.status == biz.EntryHealthy {
			in.healthy = append(in.healthy, e.ID)
		}
	}
	slices.Sort(in.healthy)
	name := func(id int) string {
		if n, ok := names[id]; ok {
			return n
		}
		return fmt.Sprintf("вход %d", id)
	}
	next, ev := decideFailover(in)
	switch ev {
	case foNone:
		if hub.status == biz.EntryHealthy {
			m.resolve(entryNoReserveAlert, "Основной вход снова доступен снаружи.")
		}
		return
	case foNoReserve:
		m.raise(entryNoReserveAlert, AlertWarn, "Основной вход недоступен, резерва нет", fmt.Sprintf(
			"Основной вход %d проверок подряд недоступен снаружи, но ни один резервный вход не здоров — автоподмена невозможна. Админка → Входы.", hub.streak.fails))
		return
	}
	ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), entryDBTimeout)
	defer cancel()
	if err := m.saveFailover(ctx, next); err != nil {
		m.logf("[entries] автоподмена (%s) не сохранена, повтор через минуту: %v", ev, err)
		return // no alert for a state nobody sees: the next run decides again
	}
	if err := m.bump(ctx); err != nil {
		m.logf("[entries] subscription_version не увеличена: %v", err)
	}
	m.logf("[entries] автоподмена: %s; было %+v, стало %+v", ev, cur, next)
	switch ev {
	case foActivate:
		m.resolve(entryNoReserveAlert, "Включена автоподмена на резервный вход.")
		m.raise(entryFailoverAlertKey(next.Target), AlertCritical, "Основной вход недоступен — включена автоподмена", fmt.Sprintf(
			"Основной вход %d проверок подряд недоступен снаружи. Основные строки подписки теперь ведут на резервный вход %s, подписка обновляется раз в час. Возврат — после 30 мин стабильной работы основного входа. Выключить: админка → Входы → «Автоподмена».",
			hub.streak.fails, name(next.Target)))
	case foRetarget:
		m.resolve(entryFailoverAlertKey(cur.Target), fmt.Sprintf("Резервный вход %s перестал отвечать — автоподмена переключена на %s.", name(cur.Target), name(next.Target)))
		m.raise(entryFailoverAlertKey(next.Target), AlertCritical, "Автоподмена переключена на другой резервный вход",
			fmt.Sprintf("Основные строки подписки теперь ведут на %s.", name(next.Target)))
	case foReturn:
		m.resolve(entryFailoverAlertKey(cur.Target), fmt.Sprintf("Основной вход стабильно доступен %v — основные строки подписки вернулись на него.",
			now.Sub(hub.okSince).Round(time.Minute)))
	case foAbandon:
		m.resolve(entryFailoverAlertKey(cur.Target), fmt.Sprintf("Резервный вход %s тоже перестал отвечать — основные строки вернулись на основной вход.", name(cur.Target)))
		m.raise(entryNoReserveAlert, AlertCritical, "Основной и резервные входы недоступны",
			"Основной вход недоступен снаружи, здоровых резервных входов нет. Работают только строки «☁️ Облако», если CDN включён.")
	case foDisabled:
		m.resolve(entryFailoverAlertKey(cur.Target), "Автоподмена выключена в админке — основные строки вернулись на основной вход.")
	}
}

// verdict: the probe really tested an entry; skip: it could not — after entryBlindAfter of only
// skips the owner is told that the entries are not checked (and no failover can happen).
func (m *entryMonitor) verdict(now time.Time) {
	m.blindSince = now
	m.resolve(entryBlindAlert, "Проверка входов снова даёт результат.")
}

func (m *entryMonitor) skip(now time.Time, reason string) {
	if m.skipLog.allow(now, time.Hour) {
		m.logf("[entries] проверка пропущена: %s (не чаще раза в час)", reason)
	}
	if blind := now.Sub(m.blindSince); blind > entryBlindAfter {
		m.raise(entryBlindAlert, AlertWarn, "Входы не проверяются", fmt.Sprintf(
			"Уже %v проверка входов снаружи не даёт результата: блокировка основного входа не будет замечена, автоподмена не сработает.\nПоследняя причина: %s",
			blind.Round(time.Minute), reason))
	}
}

// verifyRelay: the provisioning check — TLS to :443 and :2443, then Bamboo through a hop port
// (when deployed). No usable exit = error: the job fails and can be resumed later.
func (m *entryMonitor) verifyRelay(relayIP string) error {
	cfg, err := m.readConfig()
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	port, err := m.pickExit()
	if err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("проверка невозможна: %w", err)
	}
	for _, p := range []int{443, 2443} {
		if err := m.tlsCheck(port, relayIP, p, cfg.sni); err != nil {
			return fmt.Errorf("TLS к %s:%d (SNI %s) через выход :%d: %w", relayIP, p, cfg.sni, port, err)
		}
	}
	if cfg.psk == "" {
		return nil // Bamboo is not deployed on the Hub
	}
	uerr := m.udpCheck(port, relayIP, []byte(cfg.psk))
	var cerr error
	if bambooNeedsControl(uerr) {
		cerr = m.udpControl(port)
	}
	switch decideBamboo(uerr, cerr) {
	case bambooFail:
		return fmt.Errorf("Бамбук через %s не ответил: %w", relayIP, uerr)
	case bambooSkip:
		m.logf("[relay-verify] %s: UDP не проверен (выход не передаёт UDP): %v / %v", relayIP, uerr, cerr)
	}
	return nil
}
```

```go
func checkHostVerdict(st *loopProbeStreak, now time.Time, verdict, entry, link string, tally checkHostTally,
	raise func(key string, level AlertLevel, title, details string), resolve func(key, message string)) {
	checkHostVerdictFor(st, now, verdict, "entry-unreachable-ru", "Вход недоступен из РФ", entry, link, tally, raise, resolve)
}

var checkHostRelayStates = map[int]*loopProbeStreak{} // touched only by the check-host goroutine

// runCheckHostRelays: the same check-host TCP :443 from RU nodes for every online relay.
func runCheckHostRelays(nodes []string) {
	ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), entryDBTimeout)
	relays, err := biz.ListRelayEntries(ctx)
	cancel()
	if err != nil {
		log.Printf("[monitor] check-host: резервные входы не прочитаны: %v", err)
		return
	}
	live := map[int]bool{}
	for _, r := range relays {
		live[r.ID] = true
		tally, link, err := checkHostTCP(net.JoinHostPort(r.Address, "443"), nodes)
		if err != nil {
			log.Printf("[monitor] check-host недоступен для %s, не учитывается: %v", r.Address, err)
			continue
		}
		st := checkHostRelayStates[r.ID]
		if st == nil {
			st = &loopProbeStreak{}
			checkHostRelayStates[r.ID] = st
		}
		v := tally.verdict()
		checkHostVerdictFor(st, time.Now(), v, relayAlertKey(r.ID, "unreachable-ru"), "Резервный вход недоступен из РФ", r.Address, link, tally, RaiseAlert, ResolveAlert)
		saveRUCheck(r.ID, v, link)
	}
	for id := range checkHostRelayStates {
		if !live[id] {
			delete(checkHostRelayStates, id)
		}
	}
}

func saveRUCheck(id int, verdict, link string) {
	if verdict != "reachable" && verdict != "unreachable" {
		return
	}
	ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), entryDBTimeout)
	defer cancel()
	if err := biz.SaveEntryCheck(ctx, id, "ru", biz.EntryCheck{Status: verdict, At: time.Now(), Detail: link}); err != nil {
		log.Printf("[monitor] check-host: вход %d не сохранён: %v", id, err)
	}
}
```

```go
package admin

import (
	"context"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"strings"

	"github.com/heyearth/backend/internal/biz"
)

// validateRelayCreate normalizes the wizard's create request of a reserve entry (role 'relay'):
// it lives in Russia and has none of the exit-only options.
func validateRelayCreate(country string, planIDs []int, mtproxy bool, loadWeight int) (string, error) {
	if c := strings.ToUpper(strings.TrimSpace(country)); c != "" && c != "RU" {
		return "", errors.New("резервный вход ставится в РФ: страна должна быть RU")
	}
	if len(planIDs) > 0 || mtproxy || loadWeight > 1 {
		return "", errors.New("у резервного входа нет тарифов, MTProxy и приоритета — это опции выхода за рубежом")
	}
	return "RU", nil
}

var ErrRelayInUse = errors.New("этот резервный вход сейчас используется автоподменой: сначала выключите автоподмену в «Входах»")

var relayFailoverTarget = biz.EntryIsFailoverTarget

// relayDeprovisionGuard refuses to take away the relay the main subscription lines point at.
func relayDeprovisionGuard(ctx context.Context, id int) error {
	inUse, err := relayFailoverTarget(ctx, id)
	if err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("состояние автоподмены не прочитано: %w", err)
	}
	if inUse {
		return ErrRelayInUse
	}
	return nil
}
```

```go
func DeprovisionNodeHandler(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	id, ok := confirmedNode(w, r, "deprovision")
	if !ok {
		return
	}
	n, err := NodeJobs.LoadNode(r.Context(), id)
	if err != nil {
		writeAdminError(w, http.StatusNotFound, err.Error())
		return
	}
	if n.Role == "relay" {
		if err := relayDeprovisionGuard(r.Context(), id); err != nil {
			writeAdminError(w, http.StatusConflict, err.Error())
			return
		}
	}
	startJob(w, r, id, provision.KindDeprovision)
}
```

```go
func useEntriesFake(t *testing.T) *entriesFake {
	t.Helper()
	f := &entriesFake{settings: map[string]string{"subscription_update_interval_hours": "6"}, written: map[string]string{}}
	l, fo, s, ss, sm, b, h, a, n := entriesList, entriesFailover, entriesSetting, entriesSetSetting, entriesSetMode, entriesBump, entriesHistory, entriesAudit, entriesNow
	t.Cleanup(func() {
		entriesList, entriesFailover, entriesSetting, entriesSetSetting, entriesSetMode, entriesBump, entriesHistory, entriesAudit, entriesNow = l, fo, s, ss, sm, b, h, a, n
	})
	entriesList = func(context.Context) ([]biz.Entry, error) {
		return []biz.Entry{{ID: 0, Name: "Hub", Kind: biz.EntryKindHub, Address: "198.51.100.1"},
			{ID: 5, Name: "Резерв", Kind: biz.EntryKindRelay, Address: "203.0.113.50", Health: biz.EntryHealth{External: biz.EntryHealthy}}}, nil
	}
	entriesFailover = func(context.Context) (biz.EntryFailover, error) {
		return biz.EntryFailover{Active: true, Target: 5, Since: time.Date(2026, 10, 12, 10, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC)}, nil
	}
	entriesSetting = func(k string) (string, error) { return f.settings[k], nil }
	entriesSetSetting = func(_ context.Context, k, v string) error { f.written[k] = v; return nil }
	entriesSetMode = func(_ context.Context, id int, mode, domain string) error {
		f.modes = append(f.modes, fmt.Sprintf("%d %s %s", id, mode, domain))
		return nil
	}
	entriesBump = func(context.Context) error { f.bumps++; return nil }
	entriesHistory = func(int) ([]alertEvent, error) { return []alertEvent{{Key: "entry-failover-5", Kind: "raise"}}, nil }
	entriesAudit = func(_ *http.Request, action, _, _ string, _ any) { f.audits = append(f.audits, action) }
	entriesNow = func() time.Time { return time.Date(2026, 10, 12, 12, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC) }
	return f
}

func callEntries(h http.HandlerFunc, method, path, body string) *httptest.ResponseRecorder {
	rec := httptest.NewRecorder()
	h(rec, httptest.NewRequest(method, path, strings.NewReader(body)))
	return rec
}

	}

func TestAdminEntryUpdate(t *testing.T) {
	f := useEntriesFake(t)
	cases := []struct {
		path, body string
		want       int
	}{
		{"/api/admin/entries/5", `{"address_mode":"ip"}`, http.StatusOK},
		{"/api/admin/entries/0", `{"address_mode":"domain","domain":"entry.example.ru"}`, http.StatusConflict},
		{"/api/admin/entries/5", `{"address_mode":"domain","domain":"not a domain"}`, http.StatusBadRequest},
		{"/api/admin/entries/5", `{"address_mode":"dns"}`, http.StatusBadRequest},
		{"/api/admin/entries/9", `{"address_mode":"ip"}`, http.StatusNotFound},
		{"/api/admin/entries/abc", `{"address_mode":"ip"}`, http.StatusNotFound},
	}
	for _, c := range cases {
		if rec := callEntries(handleAdminEntryUpdate, http.MethodPut, c.path, c.body); rec.Code != c.want {
			t.Errorf("%s %s: %d %s, want %d", c.path, c.body, rec.Code, rec.Body.String(), c.want)
		}
	}
	if fmt.Sprint(f.modes) != "[5 ip ]" || f.bumps != 1 || fmt.Sprint(f.audits) != "[update_entry_address]" {
		t.Fatalf("modes %v bumps %d audits %v", f.modes, f.bumps, f.audits)
	}
}

func TestAdminEntrySettings(t *testing.T) {
	f := useEntriesFake(t)
	for _, bad := range []string{`{"update_interval_hours":0}`, `{"update_interval_hours":25}`, `{"simulate_hub_fail_minutes":121}`,
		`{"test_user":"a b"}`, `{}`, `nope`} {
		if rec := callEntries(handleAdminEntrySettings, http.MethodPut, "/api/admin/entries/settings", bad); rec.Code != http.StatusBadRequest {
			t.Errorf("%s: %d, want 400", bad, rec.Code)
		}
	}
	if len(f.written) != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("a rejected request wrote %v", f.written)
	}
	rec := callEntries(handleAdminEntrySettings, http.MethodPut, "/api/admin/entries/settings",
		`{"update_interval_hours":6,"failover_enabled":false,"test_user":"u-1","simulate_hub_fail_minutes":30}`)
	want := map[string]string{"subscription_update_interval_hours": "6", "entry_failover_enabled": "false",
		"entry_failover_test_user": "u-1", "entry_probe_simulate_hub_fail_until": "2026-10-12T12:30:00Z"}
	if rec.Code != http.StatusOK || fmt.Sprint(f.written) != fmt.Sprint(want) || f.bumps != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("%d written %v bumps %d", rec.Code, f.written, f.bumps)
	}
	callEntries(handleAdminEntrySettings, http.MethodPut, "/api/admin/entries/settings", `{"simulate_hub_fail_minutes":0}`)
	if f.written["entry_probe_simulate_hub_fail_until"] != "" {
		t.Fatal("0 minutes must stop the drill")
	}
}
```

```go
package main

import (

)

// Admin «Входы» (phase 3). Side effects are variables (tests swap them).
var (
	entriesList       = biz.ListEntries
	entriesFailover   = biz.GetEntryFailover
	entriesSetting    = func(key string) (string, error) { return settingOrEmpty(biz.GetSetting, key) }
	entriesSetSetting = biz.SetSettingContext
	entriesSetMode    = biz.SetEntryAddressMode
	entriesBump       = biz.BumpSubscriptionVersionContext
	entriesHistory    = listEntryAlertEvents
	entriesPreview    = buildEntriesPreview
	entriesAudit      = admin.WriteAuditLog
	entriesNow        = time.Now
)

var (
	entryDomainRe   = regexp.MustCompile(`^([a-z0-9]([a-z0-9-]{0,61}[a-z0-9])?\.)+[a-z]{2,63}$`)
	entryTestUserRe = regexp.MustCompile(`^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,64}$`)
)

const previewUUID = "00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000000"

func registerEntryAdminRoutes() {
	http.HandleFunc("/api/admin/entries", admin.RequirePermission("servers.read", handleAdminEntries))
	http.HandleFunc("/api/admin/entries/", func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
		switch strings.TrimPrefix(r.URL.Path, "/api/admin/entries/") {
		case "preview":
			admin.RequirePermission("servers.read", handleAdminEntriesPreview)(w, r)
		case "settings": // writes of «Входы» need the nodes permission (the page itself is servers.read)
			admin.RequirePermission("nodes.provision", handleAdminEntrySettings)(w, r)
		default:
			admin.RequirePermission("nodes.provision", handleAdminEntryUpdate)(w, r)
		}
	})
}

type entriesFailoverView struct {
	Enabled       bool       `json:"enabled"`
	Active        bool       `json:"active"`
	Target        int        `json:"target"`
	Since         *time.Time `json:"since"`
	TestUser      string     `json:"test_user"`
	SimulateUntil *time.Time `json:"simulate_until"`
}

func entriesUnavailable(w http.ResponseWriter, err error) {
	log.Printf("[entries-admin] %v", err)
	writeJSON(w, http.StatusServiceUnavailable, map[string]string{"error": "БД недоступна: не удалось прочитать входы"})
}

func handleAdminEntries(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	setCORS(w, r)
	if r.Method != http.MethodGet {
		writeJSON(w, http.StatusMethodNotAllowed, map[string]string{"error": "GET only"})
		return
	}
	ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(r.Context(), 10*time.Second)
	defer cancel()
	entries, err := entriesList(ctx)
	var fo biz.EntryFailover
	if err == nil {
		fo, err = entriesFailover(ctx)
	}
	vals := map[string]string{}
	for _, k := range []string{"entry_failover_enabled", "entry_failover_test_user", "entry_probe_simulate_hub_fail_until", "subscription_update_interval_hours"} {
		if err == nil {
			vals[k], err = entriesSetting(k)
		}
	}
	var history []alertEvent
	if err == nil {
		history, err = entriesHistory(50)
	}
	if err != nil {
		entriesUnavailable(w, err)
		return
	}
	view := entriesFailoverView{Enabled: vals["entry_failover_enabled"] != "false", Active: fo.Active, Target: fo.Target,
		TestUser: vals["entry_failover_test_user"]}
	if fo.Active && !fo.Since.IsZero() {
		view.Since = &fo.Since
	}
	if t, perr := time.Parse(time.RFC3339, vals["entry_probe_simulate_hub_fail_until"]); perr == nil && t.After(entriesNow()) {
		view.SimulateUntil = &t
	}
	writeJSON(w, http.StatusOK, map[string]any{
		"entries": entries, "failover": view, "history": history,
		"update_interval_hours": planEntries("", nil, biz.EntryFailover{}, false, vals["subscription_update_interval_hours"]).interval,
		"domain_mode_available": biz.EntryDomainModeAvailable(),
	})
}

type entryUpdateRequest struct {
	AddressMode string `json:"address_mode"`
	Domain      string `json:"domain"`
}

func handleAdminEntryUpdate(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	setCORS(w, r)
	if r.Method != http.MethodPut {
		writeJSON(w, http.StatusMethodNotAllowed, map[string]string{"error": "PUT only"})
		return
	}
	id, err := strconv.Atoi(strings.TrimPrefix(r.URL.Path, "/api/admin/entries/"))
	if err != nil || id < 0 {
		writeJSON(w, http.StatusNotFound, map[string]string{"error": "вход не найден"})
		return
	}
	var req entryUpdateRequest
	if err := parseJSON(r, &req); err != nil {
		writeJSON(w, http.StatusBadRequest, map[string]string{"error": "invalid JSON"})
		return
	}
	ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(r.Context(), 10*time.Second)
	defer cancel()
	entries, err := entriesList(ctx)
	if err != nil {
		entriesUnavailable(w, err)
		return
	}
	if !slices.ContainsFunc(entries, func(e biz.Entry) bool { return e.ID == id }) {
		writeJSON(w, http.StatusNotFound, map[string]string{"error": "вход не найден"})
		return
	}
	domain := strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(req.Domain))
	switch req.AddressMode {
	case biz.EntryAddressIP:
		domain = ""
	case biz.EntryAddressDomain:
		// The domain is optional: from phase 4 the entry's domain comes from the registry («Домены»).
		if domain != "" && !entryDomainRe.MatchString(domain) {
			writeJSON(w, http.StatusBadRequest, map[string]string{"error": "неверное доменное имя"})
			return
		}
		if err := biz.EntryDomainCheck(ctx, id, domain); err != nil {
			// A precondition (no checked registry domain yet, or the registry not set up): 409.
			writeJSON(w, http.StatusConflict, map[string]string{"error": err.Error()})
			return
		}
	default:
		writeJSON(w, http.StatusBadRequest, map[string]string{"error": "address_mode: ip или domain"})
		return
	}
	if err := entriesSetMode(ctx, id, req.AddressMode, domain); err != nil {
		log.Printf("[entries-admin] вход %d: %v", id, err)
		writeJSON(w, http.StatusInternalServerError, map[string]string{"error": "не удалось сохранить адрес входа"})
		return
	}
	if err := entriesBump(ctx); err != nil {
		log.Printf("[entries-admin] subscription_version: %v", err)
	}
	entriesAudit(r, "update_entry_address", "entry", strconv.Itoa(id), map[string]any{"address_mode": req.AddressMode, "domain": domain})
	writeJSON(w, http.StatusOK, map[string]string{"message": "saved"})
}

type entrySettingsRequest struct {
	UpdateIntervalHours *int    `json:"update_interval_hours"`
	FailoverEnabled     *bool   `json:"failover_enabled"`
	TestUser            *string `json:"test_user"`
	SimulateMinutes     *int    `json:"simulate_hub_fail_minutes"`
}

// writes returns the app_settings to write, or a user-facing error message.
func (req entrySettingsRequest) writes(now time.Time) (map[string]string, string) {
	out := map[string]string{}
	if v := req.UpdateIntervalHours; v != nil {
		if *v < 1 || *v > 24 {
			return nil, "интервал обновления подписки: от 1 до 24 часов"
		}
		out["subscription_update_interval_hours"] = strconv.Itoa(*v)
	}
	if v := req.FailoverEnabled; v != nil {
		out["entry_failover_enabled"] = strconv.FormatBool(*v)
	}
	if v := req.TestUser; v != nil {
		u := strings.TrimSpace(*v)
		if u != "" && !entryTestUserRe.MatchString(u) {
			return nil, "тестовый пользователь: ID из раздела «Пользователи»"
		}
		out["entry_failover_test_user"] = u
	}
	if v := req.SimulateMinutes; v != nil {
		switch {
		case *v == 0:
			out["entry_probe_simulate_hub_fail_until"] = ""
		case *v < 0 || *v > 120:
			return nil, "учебная авария: от 1 до 120 минут (0 — остановить)"
		default:
			out["entry_probe_simulate_hub_fail_until"] = now.Add(time.Duration(*v) * time.Minute).UTC().Format(time.RFC3339)
		}
	}
	if len(out) == 0 {
		return nil, "нечего сохранять"
	}
	return out, ""
}

func handleAdminEntrySettings(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	setCORS(w, r)
	if r.Method != http.MethodPut {
		writeJSON(w, http.StatusMethodNotAllowed, map[string]string{"error": "PUT only"})
		return
	}
	var req entrySettingsRequest
	if err := parseJSON(r, &req); err != nil {
		writeJSON(w, http.StatusBadRequest, map[string]string{"error": "invalid JSON"})
		return
	}
	writes, msg := req.writes(entriesNow())
	if msg != "" {
		writeJSON(w, http.StatusBadRequest, map[string]string{"error": msg})
		return
	}
	ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(r.Context(), 10*time.Second)
	defer cancel()
	keys := make([]string, 0, len(writes))
	for k := range writes {
		keys = append(keys, k)
	}
	sort.Strings(keys)
	for _, k := range keys {
		if err := entriesSetSetting(ctx, k, writes[k]); err != nil {
			log.Printf("[entries-admin] %s: %v", k, err)
			writeJSON(w, http.StatusInternalServerError, map[string]string{"error": "не удалось сохранить " + k})
			return
		}
	}
	_, interval := writes["subscription_update_interval_hours"]
	_, testUser := writes["entry_failover_test_user"]
	if interval || testUser { // the subscription content changed
		if err := entriesBump(ctx); err != nil {
			log.Printf("[entries-admin] subscription_version: %v", err)
		}
	}
	entriesAudit(r, "update_entry_settings", "setting", "entries", writes)
	writeJSON(w, http.StatusOK, map[string]string{"message": "saved"})
}

type previewLine struct {
	Label    string   `json:"label"`
	Protocol string   `json:"protocol"`
	Address  string   `json:"address"`
	Port     string   `json:"port"`
	Networks []string `json:"networks"`
}

// buildEntriesPreview renders the lines of a sample user on a plan with every protocol — now and
// as during a failover. Inputs are synthetic (no real user, no obfs password read) and only
// label/protocol/host:port leave the server.
func buildEntriesPreview() (now, failover []previewLine, err error) {
	var in hubConnectionInputs
	if err = loadHubSettingInputs(&in); err != nil {
		return nil, nil, err
	}
	if in.hysteria2SNI, err = subscriptionSetting("hub_main_server_host", "hiearth.ru"); err != nil {
		return nil, nil, err
	}
	in.vlessUUID, in.canVLESS, in.canHysteria2, in.hy2Password, in.obfsPassword = previewUUID, true, true, "preview", "preview"
	relays, err := withSyncTimeout(biz.ListRelayEntries)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, nil, err
	}
	fo, err := withSyncTimeout(biz.GetEntryFailover)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, nil, err
	}
	interval, err := subscriptionSetting("subscription_update_interval_hours", "4")
	if err != nil {
		return nil, nil, err
	}
	in.entries = planEntries(in.mainServerHost, relays, fo, false, interval)
	now = previewLines(hubConnectionOptions(in))
	in.entries = planEntries(in.mainServerHost, relays, fo, true, interval)
	return now, previewLines(hubConnectionOptions(in)), nil
}

func previewLines(opts []*heyearth_v1.ConnectionOption) []previewLine {
	out := make([]previewLine, 0, len(opts))
	for _, o := range opts {
		if u, err := url.Parse(o.GetUri()); err == nil {
			out = append(out, previewLine{Label: o.GetLabel(), Protocol: o.GetProtocol(), Address: u.Hostname(), Port: u.Port(), Networks: o.GetRecommendedNetworks()})
		}
	}
	return out
}

func handleAdminEntriesPreview(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	setCORS(w, r)
	if r.Method != http.MethodGet {
		writeJSON(w, http.StatusMethodNotAllowed, map[string]string{"error": "GET only"})
		return
	}
	now, failover, err := entriesPreview()
	if err != nil {
		entriesUnavailable(w, err)
		return
	}
	writeJSON(w, http.StatusOK, map[string]any{"now": now, "failover": failover})
}

// listEntryAlertEvents: the failover and entry history for «Входы» (raise/resolve only).
func listEntryAlertEvents(limit int) ([]alertEvent, error) {
	if db.DB == nil {
		return nil, errAlertsNoDB
	}
	ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), alertDBTimeout)
	defer cancel()
	return scanAlertEvents(db.DB.QueryContext(ctx, `SELECT `+alertEventColumns+` FROM alert_events
		WHERE kind IN ('raise', 'resolve') AND (alert_key LIKE 'entry-%' OR alert_key LIKE 'relay-%' OR alert_key = 'entries-probe-blind')
		ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT $1`, limit))
}
```

```js
  return apiFetch(`/entries/${id}`, { method: 'PUT', body: payload })
}
export function saveEntrySettings(patch) {
  return apiFetch('/entries/settings', { method: 'PUT', body: patch })
}
export function fetchEntriesPreview() {
  return apiFetch('/entries/preview')
}
```

```jsx
}

        : <span className="text-[11px] font-mono tabular-nums text-tertiary">{when}</span>}
    </div>
  )
}
```

## Фаза 4 — Реестр доменов (подписка и API, адрес входа, сертификат Бамбука)

**Цель:** владелец добавляет купленный домен в «Домены», видит инструкцию по A-записи, проверяет DNS (в т.ч. резолвером Яндекса), выпускает сертификат на Hub и переключает на домен ссылки подписки, адрес входа и сертификат Бамбука — без SSH. nginx (vhost + строки map :443) генерируется из реестра и сохраняет живой режим PROXY.

**Зависит от:** фаза 1 (`auth/access.js`: новая страница регистрируется в `PAGE_PERMS`/`TENANT_HIDDEN`), фаза 2 (`servers.role`, `components/ui/CopyButton.jsx` — `<CopyButton text label? />`, `components/ui/ConfirmDanger.jsx` — `<ConfirmDanger open onClose title consequences confirmText actionLabel onConfirm />`, право `nodes.provision`), фаза 3 (`biz.Entry` в `internal/biz/entries.go`, `biz.ListEntries`, хуки `biz.EntryDomainModeAvailable`/`biz.EntryDomainCheck`, `GET/PUT /api/admin/entries` в `cmd/api/entries_admin.go`, `fetchEntries()` → `{entries: [...]}`). Права: список доменов и пункт меню — `servers.read`, любые изменения — `domains.manage`. Пути — от `server/backend/`, если не указано иное.

**Решения фазы:**
- Статус выпуска сертификата — в строке `domains` (`cert_status none|issuing|valid|failed`, `cert_log`, `cert_error`), не в `provision_jobs` (там `server_id` с FK на `servers`). Рестарт API посреди выпуска → `failed` с причиной.
- certbot — `--webroot /var/www/letsencrypt` (плагин `--nginx` правит наши конфиги). Перед certbot — самопроверка: nginx на :80 отдаёт файл из `/.well-known/acme-challenge/` для каждого имени (лимит неудачных проверок Let's Encrypt не тратится).
- Сертификат Бамбука выпускается на **два имени**: новый домен + текущий SNI (`hub_main_server_host`, сейчас `hiearth.ru`), если тот указывает на Hub. Тогда смена SNI не ломает Бамбук у старых профилей; без второго имени переключение — только с подтверждением.
- Строки реестра в map `$backend` — между маркерами `# BEGIN heyearth-domains…`/`# END heyearth-domains`; vhost — отдельный `/etc/nginx/conf.d/heyearth-domains.conf`; `deploy --nginx` переносит строки map. Разбор nginx переезжает из `cmd/deploy/stream_proxy.go` в `internal/nginxconf` (один код для деплоя и API).
- Host Дуба (XHTTP) отвязан от адреса входа: ключ `xhttp_host` (миграция фиксирует текущий `main_server_host`).

```go
package db

import (
	"os"
	"strings"
	"testing"

// 000062: the registry's invariants live in SQL too; xhttp_host pins today's XHTTP Host.
func TestMigration000062(t *testing.T) {
	read := func(n string) string {
		b, err := os.ReadFile("../../migrations/" + n)
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		return string(b)
	}
	up, down := read("000062_domains.up.sql"), read("000062_domains.down.sql")
	for _, w := range []string{"CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS domains", "purposes <@ ARRAY['subscription','entry','bamboo_cert']::text[]",
		"CONSTRAINT domains_hub_only_purposes", "ON domains ((true)) WHERE 'bamboo_cert' = ANY(purposes)",
		"ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS happ_crypt_url TEXT", "('domains.manage',", "r.role_key = 'super_admin'",
		"SELECT 'xhttp_host', value FROM app_settings WHERE key = 'main_server_host'"} {
		if !strings.Contains(up, w) {
			t.Errorf("up lacks %q", w)

	}
	for _, w := range []string{"DROP TABLE IF EXISTS domains", "DROP COLUMN IF EXISTS happ_crypt_url", "permission_key = 'domains.manage'"} {

			t.Errorf("down lacks %q", w)
		}
	}
	if strings.Contains(strings.ToUpper(up), "BEGIN;") {
		t.Error("golang-migrate runs the file as one Exec: no explicit transaction")
	}
}
```

```sql
-- Subproject 2, phase 4: the domain registry (spec 2026-10-12 §5).
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS domains (
    id              SERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
    name            TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE CHECK (name ~ '^([a-z0-9]([a-z0-9-]{0,61}[a-z0-9])?\.)+[a-z][a-z0-9-]{0,61}[a-z0-9]$'),
    purposes        TEXT[] NOT NULL CHECK (cardinality(purposes) > 0 AND purposes <@ ARRAY['subscription','entry','bamboo_cert']::text[]),
    expected_target TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'hub' CHECK (expected_target = 'hub' OR expected_target ~ '^relay:[1-9][0-9]*$'),
    dns_status      TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'unknown' CHECK (dns_status IN ('unknown','ok','partial','mismatch','missing','error')),
    dns_checked_at  TIMESTAMPTZ,
    dns_details     JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb,
    cert_status     TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'none' CHECK (cert_status IN ('none','issuing','valid','failed')),
    cert_expires_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
    cert_names      TEXT[] NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',
    cert_error      TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    cert_log        TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    cert_started_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
    created_at      TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),
    updated_at      TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),
    -- certificates are issued on the Hub (HTTP-01 on its :80)
    CONSTRAINT domains_hub_only_purposes CHECK (expected_target = 'hub' OR NOT (purposes && ARRAY['subscription','bamboo_cert']::text[]))
);
-- Bamboo (Hysteria2) has one certificate.
```

```go
func TestNormalizeDomainName(t *testing.T) {
	ok := map[string]string{"Sub.Example.NET.": "sub.example.net", " edge-1.example.org ": "edge-1.example.org", "xn--80ak6aa92e.xn--p1ai": "xn--80ak6aa92e.xn--p1ai"}

		}

	for _, bad := range []string{"example", "*.example.net", "138.16.181.225", "-bad.example.net", "a..example.net", "sub.example.1",
		"sub.example.n", "пример.рф", "sub.example.net;", "sub.example.net\nserver_name x"} {
		var rule DomainRuleError
		if _, err := NormalizeDomainName(bad); !errors.As(err, &rule) {
```

```go
package biz

// domains.go — the domain registry (spec 2026-10-12 §5, phase 4). The rules are enforced here
// (Russian messages for the admin) and as CHECK constraints in migration 000062.

import (
	"context"
	"database/sql"
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"net"
	"regexp"
	"slices"
	"strconv"
	"strings"
	"time"

	"github.com/heyearth/backend/internal/db"
	"github.com/lib/pq"
)

const (
	PurposeSubscription = "subscription" // subscription links + API (vhost, :443 map line)
	PurposeEntry        = "entry"        // address of an entry in the profiles
	PurposeBambooCert   = "bamboo_cert"  // certificate and SNI of Bamboo
	TargetHub           = "hub"
)

// DomainRuleError is a rejected input or an unmet precondition; the text is shown to the owner.
type DomainRuleError string

func (e DomainRuleError) Error() string { return string(e) }

var (
	ErrDomainNotFound   = errors.New("домен не найден")
	ErrDomainExists     = errors.New("такой домен уже есть в реестре")
	ErrBambooTaken      = errors.New("сертификат Бамбука уже назначен другому домену — у Бамбука один сертификат")
	ErrDomainBusy       = errors.New("для домена уже идёт выпуск сертификата")
	ErrDomainNeedsForce = errors.New("нужно подтверждение")
	purposeOrder        = []string{PurposeSubscription, PurposeEntry, PurposeBambooCert}
	reDomainLabel       = regexp.MustCompile(`^[a-z0-9]([a-z0-9-]{0,61}[a-z0-9])?$`)
)

type Domain struct {
	ID             int             `json:"id"`
	Name           string          `json:"name"`
	Purposes       []string        `json:"purposes"`
	ExpectedTarget string          `json:"expected_target"`
	DNSStatus      string          `json:"dns_status"`
	DNSCheckedAt   *time.Time      `json:"dns_checked_at"`
	DNSDetails     json.RawMessage `json:"dns_details"`
	CertStatus     string          `json:"cert_status"`
	CertExpiresAt  *time.Time      `json:"cert_expires_at"`
	CertNames      []string        `json:"cert_names"`
	CertError      string          `json:"cert_error"`
	CertLog        string          `json:"cert_log"`
	CertStartedAt  *time.Time      `json:"cert_started_at"`
	CreatedAt      time.Time       `json:"created_at"`
}

func (d Domain) Has(purpose string) bool { return slices.Contains(d.Purposes, purpose) }

func (d Domain) CertReady(now time.Time) bool {
	return d.CertStatus == "valid" && d.CertExpiresAt != nil && d.CertExpiresAt.After(now)
}

// NormalizeDomainName: an ASCII (punycode) FQDN, ≥ 2 labels, no wildcard, not an IP. The result is
// safe for nginx lines and certbot arguments.
func NormalizeDomainName(raw string) (string, error) {
	n := strings.TrimSuffix(strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(raw)), ".")
	if n == "" || len(n) > 253 || net.ParseIP(n) != nil {
		return "", DomainRuleError("укажите домен (не IP), например sub.example.com")
	}
	labels := strings.Split(n, ".")
	if len(labels) < 2 {
		return "", DomainRuleError("домен должен содержать точку, например sub.example.com")
	}
	for _, l := range labels {
		if !reDomainLabel.MatchString(l) {
			return "", DomainRuleError(fmt.Sprintf("недопустимая часть домена %q: латиница, цифры, дефис (кириллицу — в punycode xn--…)", l))
		}
	}
	if tld := labels[len(labels)-1]; len(tld) < 2 || tld[0] < 'a' || tld[0] > 'z' {
		return "", DomainRuleError(fmt.Sprintf("недопустимая зона домена %q", tld))
	}
	return n, nil
}

// ParseTarget: "hub" → 0, "relay:<id>" → id.
func ParseTarget(t string) (int, error) {
	if t == TargetHub {
		return 0, nil
	}
	if s, ok := strings.CutPrefix(t, "relay:"); ok {
		if id, err := strconv.Atoi(s); err == nil && id > 0 && strconv.Itoa(id) == s {
			return id, nil
		}
	}
	return 0, DomainRuleError(fmt.Sprintf("куда указывает домен: %q — ожидается hub или relay:<id>", t))
}

// EntryTarget is the expected_target of an entry (biz.Entry.ID, 0 = Hub).
func EntryTarget(entryID int) string {
	if entryID == 0 {
		return TargetHub
	}
	return "relay:" + strconv.Itoa(entryID)
}

// ValidateDomain normalizes d in place. reserved: names managed elsewhere (site, CDN, MTProxy).
func ValidateDomain(d *Domain, reserved []string) error {
	name, err := NormalizeDomainName(d.Name)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	d.Name = name
	for _, r := range reserved {
		if strings.EqualFold(strings.TrimSpace(r), name) {
			return DomainRuleError(name + " уже используется сайтом, CDN или MTProxy и настраивается не здесь")
		}
	}
	seen := map[string]bool{}
	for _, p := range d.Purposes {
		if !slices.Contains(purposeOrder, p) {
			return DomainRuleError(fmt.Sprintf("неизвестное назначение %q", p))
		}
		seen[p] = true
	}
	d.Purposes = nil
	for _, p := range purposeOrder {
		if seen[p] {
			d.Purposes = append(d.Purposes, p)
		}
	}
	if len(d.Purposes) == 0 {
		return DomainRuleError("выберите хотя бы одно назначение")
	}
	if d.ExpectedTarget == "" {
		d.ExpectedTarget = TargetHub
	}
	if _, err := ParseTarget(d.ExpectedTarget); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if d.ExpectedTarget != TargetHub && (d.Has(PurposeSubscription) || d.Has(PurposeBambooCert)) {
		return DomainRuleError("подписка и сертификат Бамбука работают только на Hub: сертификат выпускается там")
	}
	return nil
}

// CRUD (domainColumns, scanDomain, ListDomains … UpdateDomainCertInfo) — по таблице после блока.

// EntryDomainFor: the domain an entry uses in domain mode — purpose entry, its target, DNS ok.
func EntryDomainFor(doms []Domain, target string) (string, bool) {
	for _, d := range doms {
		if d.Has(PurposeEntry) && d.ExpectedTarget == target && d.DNSStatus == "ok" {
			return d.Name, true
		}
	}
	return "", false
}

// ApplyEntryDomains: entries in domain mode get their checked registry domain; without one they
// keep the IP (never an unchecked name).
func ApplyEntryDomains(entries []Entry, doms []Domain) []Entry {
	out := slices.Clone(entries)
	for i, e := range out {
		if name, ok := EntryDomainFor(doms, EntryTarget(e.ID)); ok && e.AddressMode == "domain" {
			out[i].Address = name
		}
	}
	return out
}

// CheckEntryDomainMode: switching an entry to domain mode needs a checked registry domain.
func CheckEntryDomainMode(ctx context.Context, entryID int) error {
	doms, err := ListDomains(ctx)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if _, ok := EntryDomainFor(doms, EntryTarget(entryID)); !ok {
		return DomainRuleError("для адреса «домен» добавьте в «Домены» домен с назначением «Адрес входа», указывающий на этот вход, и проверьте DNS (все резолверы — «верно»)")
	}
	return nil
}
```
CRUD в том же файле: `db.DB.*Context`; `const domainColumns = "id, name, purposes, expected_target, dns_status, dns_checked_at, dns_details, cert_status, cert_expires_at, cert_names, cert_error, cert_log, cert_started_at, created_at"`; `scanDomain(row interface{ Scan(...any) error })` — `pq.Array` для массивов, `&d.DNSCheckedAt`/`&d.CertExpiresAt`/`&d.CertStartedAt` (NULL → nil), пустой `dns_details` → `{}`.

| Функция | SQL / поведение |
|---|---|
| `ListDomains(ctx) ([]Domain, error)` | `SELECT <cols> FROM domains ORDER BY name`; пусто → `[]Domain{}` |
| `GetDomain(ctx, id)` | `… WHERE id = $1`; `sql.ErrNoRows` → `ErrDomainNotFound` |
| `CreateDomain(ctx, d, reserved)` | `ValidateDomain`; `relay:<id>` → `SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM servers WHERE id = $1 AND role = 'relay')`, нет → `DomainRuleError("резервного входа с id N нет")`; `INSERT INTO domains (name, purposes, expected_target) VALUES ($1, $2, $3) RETURNING <cols>`; `*pq.Error` с кодом `23505`: constraint `domains_one_bamboo_cert` → `ErrBambooTaken`, иначе `ErrDomainExists` |
| `DeleteDomain(ctx, id)` | `DELETE FROM domains WHERE id = $1`; 0 строк → `ErrDomainNotFound` |
| `SaveDomainDNS(ctx, id, status, details []byte)` | `SET dns_status = $2, dns_details = $3, dns_checked_at = NOW(), updated_at = NOW()` |
| `StartDomainCert(ctx, id) (bool, error)` | `SET cert_status = 'issuing', cert_error = '', cert_log = '', cert_started_at = NOW() WHERE id = $1 AND cert_status <> 'issuing'`; `true` ⇔ изменена 1 строка |
| `FinishDomainCert(ctx, id, valid bool, expires *time.Time, names []string, errText, logTail string)` | `cert_status` = `valid`/`failed`, `cert_expires_at`, `cert_names` (nil → `{}`), `cert_error`, `cert_log` |

| `UpdateDomainCertInfo(ctx, id, expires time.Time, names)` | `SET cert_expires_at = $2, cert_names = $3` |

- [ ] **Step 3: Реализация** — `cmd/api/domains_dns.go`:
```go
package main

// domains_dns.go — «Проверить DNS»: the A records of a name as several public resolvers see it
// (Яндекс among them: Russian resolvers have answered with other addresses), compared with where
// the name must point (the Hub or a relay).

import (
	"context"
	"database/sql"
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"net"
	"slices"
	"sort"
	"strings"
	"sync"
	"time"

	"github.com/heyearth/backend/internal/biz"
	"github.com/heyearth/backend/internal/db"
)

type dnsResolverSpec struct{ Name, Addr string }

var publicDNSResolvers = []dnsResolverSpec{{"Cloudflare", "1.1.1.1"}, {"Google", "8.8.8.8"}, {"Яндекс", "77.88.8.8"}, {"Quad9", "9.9.9.9"}}

// acmeResolvers must see the right address before Let's Encrypt is asked (it validates from abroad).
var acmeResolvers = []string{"1.1.1.1", "8.8.8.8"}

const dnsResolverTimeout = 4 * time.Second

type dnsLookupFunc func(ctx context.Context, resolverAddr, name string) ([]string, error)

type dnsResolverResult struct {
	Name    string   `json:"name"`
	Addr    string   `json:"addr"`
	IPs     []string `json:"ips"`
	Verdict string   `json:"verdict"`
	Error   string   `json:"error,omitempty"`
}

type dnsCheckResult struct {
	Status    string              `json:"status"`
	Expected  []string            `json:"expected"`
	Resolvers []dnsResolverResult `json:"resolvers"`
}

func checkDomainDNS(ctx context.Context, name string, expected []string, resolvers []dnsResolverSpec, lookup dnsLookupFunc) dnsCheckResult {
	res := dnsCheckResult{Expected: expected, Resolvers: make([]dnsResolverResult, len(resolvers))}
	var wg sync.WaitGroup
	for i, r := range resolvers {
		wg.Add(1)
		go func() {
			defer wg.Done()
			cctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(ctx, dnsResolverTimeout)
			defer cancel()
			ips, err := lookup(cctx, r.Addr, name)
			out := dnsResolverResult{Name: r.Name, Addr: r.Addr, IPs: append([]string{}, ips...), Verdict: "ok"}
			var de *net.DNSError
			switch {
			case err != nil && errors.As(err, &de) && de.IsNotFound, err == nil && len(ips) == 0:
				out.Verdict, out.Error = "missing", "записи A нет"
			case err != nil:
				out.Verdict, out.Error = "error", err.Error()
			default:
				for _, ip := range ips {
					if !slices.Contains(expected, ip) {
						out.Verdict = "mismatch"
					}
				}
			}
			res.Resolvers[i] = out
		}()
	}
	wg.Wait()
	n := map[string]int{}
	for _, r := range res.Resolvers {
		n[r.Verdict]++
	}
	// An error (timeout, SERVFAIL) says nothing about the record and does not spoil ok.
	switch {
	case len(expected) == 0:
		res.Status = "error"
	case n["ok"] > 0 && n["mismatch"]+n["missing"] > 0:
		res.Status = "partial"
	case n["ok"] > 0:
		res.Status = "ok"
	case n["mismatch"] > 0:
		res.Status = "mismatch"
	case n["missing"] > 0:
		res.Status = "missing"
	default:
		res.Status = "error"
	}
	return res
}

func dnsReadyForACME(res dnsCheckResult) bool {
	ok := 0
	for _, r := range res.Resolvers {
		if slices.Contains(acmeResolvers, r.Addr) && r.Verdict == "ok" {
			ok++
		}
	}
	return ok == len(acmeResolvers)
}

// publicLookupA, hubExpectedIPv4s, domainExpectedIPs, storeDomainDNS, checkAndStoreDomainDNS — по списку ниже.
```
В том же файле:
- `publicLookupA(ctx, resolverAddr, name)`: `net.Resolver{PreferGo: true, Dial: (&net.Dialer{Timeout: dnsResolverTimeout}).DialContext(ctx, network, net.JoinHostPort(resolverAddr, "53"))}` (без системного резолвера и кэша), `LookupIP(ctx, "ip4", name)`, адреса строками, `sort.Strings`.
- `hubExpectedIPv4s()`: `collectHubIPs(net.InterfaceAddrs(), []string{h}, lookupIPsTimeout)`, где `h` = `main_server_host`, только если это IP-литерал (NAT-Hub), иначе `""` — домен там не резолвится (круг); только IPv4, `sort.Strings`.
- `domainExpectedIPs(ctx, target)`: `biz.ParseTarget`; `hub` → `hubExpectedIPv4s()`; `relay:<id>` → `SELECT ip_address FROM servers WHERE id = $1 AND role = 'relay'` (`sql.ErrNoRows` → `biz.DomainRuleError("резервный вход, на который указывает домен, удалён")`).
- `storeDomainDNS(ctx, id, res)`: `json.Marshal(res)` → `biz.SaveDomainDNS(ctx, id, res.Status, b)`; `checkAndStoreDomainDNS(ctx, d)`: `domainExpectedIPs` → `checkDomainDNS(ctx, d.Name, expected, publicDNSResolvers, publicLookupA)` → `storeDomainDNS` → `biz.GetDomain(ctx, d.ID)`.

```go
package nginxconf

import (
	"flag"
	"os"
	"slices"

	"testing"

var update = flag.Bool("update", false, "rewrite testdata/*.golden")

func fixture(t *testing.T, name string) string {
	t.Helper()
	b, err := os.ReadFile("testdata/" + name)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	return string(b)
}

func golden(t *testing.T, name, got string) {
	t.Helper()
	if *update {
		_ = os.WriteFile("testdata/"+name, []byte(got), 0o644)
	}
	if got != fixture(t, name) {
		t.Errorf("testdata/%s differs (check, then -update):\n%s", name, got)
	}
}

// Both PROXY modes: lines go into deploy's router without changing the mode, idempotently;
// no names give deploy's file back byte for byte.

		again, _ := SetManagedMapEntries(got, names)
		back, _ := SetManagedMapEntries(got, nil)
		if m, _ := DetectStreamMode(got); m != mode || again != got || back != router ||
			!slices.Equal(ManagedMapEntries(got), []string{"api.example.org", "sub.example.net"}) {
			t.Errorf("%s: mode %q, idempotent %v, restores %v", mode, m, again == got, back == router)
		}
		for _, bad := range []string{"admin.hiearth.ru", "evil.example.net;", "x.example.net nginx_https; default"} {
```

- [ ] **Step 3: Реализация** — `internal/nginxconf/domains.go`:
```go
package nginxconf

// domains.go — the domain registry's part of nginx: lines in the :443 SNI map and DomainsVhostFile.
// Written by heyearth-api (cmd/api/domains_nginx.go); deploy --nginx carries the map lines over.

import (
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"regexp"
	"slices"
	"sort"
	"strings"
)

const (
	ManagedMapBegin  = "# BEGIN heyearth-domains: generated by heyearth-api from the domain registry, do not edit"
	ManagedMapEnd    = "# END heyearth-domains"
	AcmeWebroot      = "/var/www/letsencrypt"
	DomainsVhostFile = "/etc/nginx/conf.d/heyearth-domains.conf"
)

var (
	reSafeName     = regexp.MustCompile(`^[a-z0-9]([a-z0-9.-]*[a-z0-9])?\.[a-z0-9-]+$`)
	reManagedEntry = regexp.MustCompile(`^(\S+)\s+nginx_https;$`)
)

// managedRegion: the markers inside the $backend map, (-1, -1) without them; a marker outside the
// map, repeated or unbalanced is an error (nothing is guessed).
func managedRegion(router string) (lines []string, mapBlock, begin, end int, err error) {
	stmts, blocks := scanNginx(router)
	lines, mapBlock, begin, end = strings.Split(router, "\n"), -1, -1, -1
	for i, b := range blocks {
		if b.kind == "map" && isBackendMap(b.head) {
			mapBlock = i
			break
		}
	}
	if mapBlock < 0 {
		return nil, 0, 0, 0, errors.New("no `map ... $backend` block")
	}
	for i, l := range lines {
		switch t := strings.TrimSpace(l); {
		case t == ManagedMapBegin && begin < 0 && stmts[i].block == mapBlock:
			begin = i
		case t == ManagedMapEnd && begin >= 0 && end < 0 && stmts[i].block == mapBlock:
			end = i
		case t == ManagedMapBegin || t == ManagedMapEnd:
			return nil, 0, 0, 0, fmt.Errorf("line %d: unexpected registry marker", i+1)
		}
	}
	if begin >= 0 && end < 0 {
		return nil, 0, 0, 0, errors.New("registry begin marker without the end marker")
	}
	return lines, mapBlock, begin, end, nil
}

func ManagedMapEntries(router string) []string {
	lines, _, begin, end, err := managedRegion(router)
	if err != nil || begin < 0 {
		return nil
	}
	var out []string
	for _, l := range lines[begin+1 : end] {
		if m := reManagedEntry.FindStringSubmatch(strings.TrimSpace(l)); m != nil && reSafeName.MatchString(m[1]) {
			out = append(out, m[1])
		}
	}
	return out
}

func SetManagedMapEntries(router string, names []string) (string, error) {
	lines, mapBlock, begin, end, err := managedRegion(router)
	if err != nil {
		return "", err
	}
	if begin >= 0 {
		lines = append(lines[:begin:begin], lines[end+1:]...)
	}
	base := strings.Join(lines, "\n")
	mode, err := detectStreamMode(base)
	if err != nil {
		return "", err
	}
	r, stmts, err := parseStreamRouter(base)
	if err != nil {
		return "", err
	}
	if _, ok := r.upstreams["nginx_https"]; !ok {
		return "", errors.New("the $backend map does not name the nginx_https upstream")
	}
	want := slices.Compact(slices.Sorted(slices.Values(names)))
	for _, n := range want {
		if !reSafeName.MatchString(n) || slices.ContainsFunc(r.mapEntries, func(e [2]string) bool { return e[0] == n }) {
			return "", fmt.Errorf("%q: unsafe name or already routed by the deploy-managed part of the map", n)
		}
	}
	if len(want) == 0 {
		return base, nil
	}
	at, indent := -1, "    "
	for i, s := range stmts {
		if m := reMapEntry.FindStringSubmatch(s.code); s.block == mapBlock && (m != nil && m[1] == "default" || s.code == "}") {
			at, indent = i, leadingSpace(lines[i])
			break
		}
	}
	if at < 0 {
		return "", errors.New("cannot find the end of the $backend map")
	}
	region := []string{indent + ManagedMapBegin}
	for _, n := range want {
		region = append(region, indent+n+" nginx_https;")
	}
	out := strings.Join(slices.Concat(lines[:at], region, []string{indent + ManagedMapEnd}, lines[at:]), "\n")
	if got, err := detectStreamMode(out); err != nil || got != mode {
		return "", fmt.Errorf("the registry lines would change the router mode (%s -> %q, %v)", mode, got, err)
	}
	return out, nil
}

// DomainVhost: a registry domain pointing at the Hub; HTTPS = purpose subscription with a ready certificate.
type DomainVhost struct {
	Name  string
	HTTPS bool
}

const domainsVhostHeader = `# Generated by heyearth-api from the domain registry (admin «Домены»). DO NOT EDIT: every
# registry change rewrites this file. Subscription + API only; anything else gets 444.
`

const domainHTTPTemplate = `
# ── %[1]s ──
server {
    listen 80;
    listen [::]:80;
    server_name %[1]s;
    location ^~ /.well-known/acme-challenge/ { root %[2]s; default_type text/plain; }
    location / { return 444; }
}
`

// Both listeners always (plain 8443 and the PROXY one), as deploy's generator: right in either mode.
const domainHTTPSTemplate = `server {
    listen 8443 ssl http2;
    listen [::]:8443 ssl http2;
%[2]s    server_name %[1]s;

    ssl_certificate /etc/letsencrypt/live/%[1]s/fullchain.pem;
    ssl_certificate_key /etc/letsencrypt/live/%[1]s/privkey.pem;
    include /etc/letsencrypt/options-ssl-nginx.conf;
    ssl_dhparam /etc/letsencrypt/ssl-dhparams.pem;

    location /heyearth.v1.ConfigApi/ { grpc_pass 127.0.0.1:50051; grpc_set_header Host $host; }
    location /heyearth.v1.ClientApi/ { grpc_pass 127.0.0.1:50051; grpc_set_header Host $host; }
    location /api/v1/ {
        proxy_pass http://127.0.0.1:8000;
        proxy_http_version 1.1;
        proxy_set_header Host $host;
        proxy_set_header X-Real-IP $remote_addr;
        proxy_set_header X-Forwarded-For $proxy_add_x_forwarded_for;
        proxy_set_header X-Forwarded-Proto $scheme;
        client_max_body_size 1m;
    }
    location = /static/geoip.dat { alias /etc/hysteria/geoip.dat; default_type application/octet-stream; add_header Cache-Control "public, max-age=86400" always; }
    location = /robots.txt { default_type text/plain; return 200 "User-agent: *\nDisallow: /\n"; }
    location / { return 444; }
}
`

func RenderDomainVhosts(ds []DomainVhost) (string, error) {
	sorted := slices.Clone(ds)
	sort.Slice(sorted, func(i, j int) bool { return sorted[i].Name < sorted[j].Name })
	var b strings.Builder
	b.WriteString(domainsVhostHeader)
	for i, d := range sorted {
		if !reSafeName.MatchString(d.Name) || i > 0 && sorted[i-1].Name == d.Name {
			return "", fmt.Errorf("unsafe or duplicate domain name %q", d.Name)
		}
		fmt.Fprintf(&b, domainHTTPTemplate, d.Name, AcmeWebroot)
		if d.HTTPS {
			fmt.Fprintf(&b, domainHTTPSTemplate, d.Name, ProxyProtocolListen)
		}
	}
	return b.String(), nil
}
```

```go
// streamRegistryForDeploy: the domain registry's names in the live router (streamRouterReadCmd

func streamRegistryForDeploy(out string) []string {
	b, err := base64.StdEncoding.DecodeString(strings.TrimSpace(out))

	}
	return nginxconf.ManagedMapEntries(string(b))
}

func buildNginxStreamConfWithDomains(domain string, proxyProtocol bool, registry []string) (string, error) {
	return nginxconf.SetManagedMapEntries(buildNginxStreamConf(domain, proxyProtocol), registry)
}
```

```go
package main

import (
	"context"
	"errors"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"strings"
	"testing"
	"time"

	"github.com/heyearth/backend/internal/biz"
	"github.com/heyearth/backend/internal/nginxconf"
)

type fakeNginx struct {
	calls     []string
	failOn    string
	verifyErr error
}

func testDomainsNginx(t *testing.T, mode string, f *fakeNginx) *domainsNginx {
	t.Helper()
	dir := t.TempDir()
	for src, dst := range map[string]string{"router_" + mode + ".conf": "router.conf", "site_ssl.conf": "site.conf"} {
		b, err := os.ReadFile("../../internal/nginxconf/testdata/" + src)
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		_ = os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(dir, dst), b, 0o644)
	}
	return &domainsNginx{routerPath: filepath.Join(dir, "router.conf"), sitePath: filepath.Join(dir, "site.conf"),
		vhostPath: filepath.Join(dir, "domains.conf"), backupDir: filepath.Join(dir, "bk"),
		run: func(_ context.Context, name string, args ...string) (string, error) {
			c := name + " " + strings.Join(args, " ")
			f.calls = append(f.calls, c)
			if c == f.failOn {
				return "nginx: [emerg] test", errors.New("exit status 1")
			}
			return "", nil
		},
		verify: func(context.Context, []string) error { return f.verifyErr },
		now:    func() time.Time { return time.Date(2026, 10, 12, 12, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC) }}
}

var testVhosts = []nginxconf.DomainVhost{{Name: "sub.example.net", HTTPS: true}, {Name: "edge.example.net"}}

func TestDomainsNginxApply(t *testing.T) {
	ctx := context.Background()
	for _, mode := range []string{"off", "on"} {
		f := &fakeNginx{}
		n := testDomainsNginx(t, mode, f)
		changed, err := n.apply(ctx, testVhosts, []string{"sub.example.net"})
		router, _ := os.ReadFile(n.routerPath)
		vh, _ := os.ReadFile(n.vhostPath)
		bk, _ := filepath.Glob(filepath.Join(n.backupDir, "router.conf.*.domains"))
		m, _ := nginxconf.DetectStreamMode(string(router))
		if err != nil || !changed || strings.Join(f.calls, "|") != "nginx -t|systemctl reload nginx" || m != mode || len(bk) != 1 ||
			!strings.Contains(string(router), "sub.example.net nginx_https;") || strings.Contains(string(router), "edge.example.net") ||
			!strings.Contains(string(vh), "server_name edge.example.net;") {
			t.Fatalf("%s: changed=%v err=%v calls=%v mode=%q backups=%v", mode, changed, err, f.calls, m, bk)
		}
		f.calls = nil
		if changed, err := n.apply(ctx, testVhosts, []string{"sub.example.net"}); err != nil || changed || len(f.calls) != 0 {
			t.Errorf("%s: a second apply must be a no-op", mode)
		}
	}
}
```

```go
package main

// domains_nginx.go — applies the domain registry to nginx on the Hub (the API runs there as root).
// Fail closed like deploy --stream-proxy-protocol: the live router must parse and keeps its PROXY
// mode (mode on: every map name needs a vhost on 127.0.0.1:8446); files are backed up, nginx -t
// gates the reload, and after the reload the site and every subscription domain must answer
// through :443 — otherwise the previous files come back.

import (
	"context"
	"crypto/tls"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"io/fs"
	"log"
	"net"
	"net/http"
	"os"
	"os/exec"
	"path"
	"path/filepath"
	"runtime"
	"strconv"
	"sync"
	"time"

	"github.com/heyearth/backend/internal/biz"
	"github.com/heyearth/backend/internal/nginxconf"
)

const letsencryptLive = "/etc/letsencrypt/live"

type domainsNginx struct {
	routerPath, sitePath, vhostPath, backupDir string
	run                                        func(ctx context.Context, name string, args ...string) (string, error)
	verify                                     func(ctx context.Context, subscription []string) error
	now                                        func() time.Time
}

var (
	domainsNginxMu, domainsNginxDebounceMu sync.Mutex
	domainsNginxDebounce                   *time.Timer
	hubDomainsNginx                        = &domainsNginx{routerPath: "/etc/nginx/stream.d/heyearth.conf", sitePath: "/etc/nginx/conf.d/heyearth.conf",
		vhostPath: nginxconf.DomainsVhostFile, backupDir: "/var/backups/heyearth-nginx", verify: verifyDomainsThrough443, now: time.Now,
		run: func(ctx context.Context, name string, args ...string) (string, error) {
			out, err := exec.CommandContext(ctx, name, args...).CombinedOutput()
			return string(out), err
		}}
)

func lineageCert(name string) string { return path.Join(letsencryptLive, name, "fullchain.pem") }

func certFilesExist(name string) bool {
	_, e1 := os.Stat(lineageCert(name))
	_, e2 := os.Stat(path.Join(letsencryptLive, name, "privkey.pem"))
	return e1 == nil && e2 == nil
}

// registryVhosts: every domain pointing at the Hub gets the :80 ACME vhost; a subscription domain
// with a ready certificate (files on disk) also the HTTPS vhost and a map line.
func registryVhosts(doms []biz.Domain, now time.Time, certFiles func(string) bool) (vhosts []nginxconf.DomainVhost, subscription []string) {
	for _, d := range doms {
		if d.ExpectedTarget != biz.TargetHub {
			continue
		}
		https := d.Has(biz.PurposeSubscription) && d.CertReady(now) && certFiles(d.Name)
		vhosts = append(vhosts, nginxconf.DomainVhost{Name: d.Name, HTTPS: https})
		if https {
			subscription = append(subscription, d.Name)
		}
	}
	return vhosts, subscription
}

func writeNginxFile(p string, data []byte) error {
	if err := os.WriteFile(p+".heyearth-tmp", data, 0o644); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	return os.Rename(p+".heyearth-tmp", p)
}

func (n *domainsNginx) apply(ctx context.Context, vhosts []nginxconf.DomainVhost, subscription []string) (bool, error) {
	router, err := os.ReadFile(n.routerPath)
	if err != nil {
		return false, fmt.Errorf("SNI-роутер nginx не прочитан (%v): домены подписки работают только за 443-роутером — nginx не трогаю", err)
	}
	mode, err := nginxconf.DetectStreamMode(string(router))
	if err != nil {
		return false, fmt.Errorf("режим PROXY в %s не определяется: %v — nginx не трогаю", n.routerPath, err)
	}
	newRouter, err := nginxconf.SetManagedMapEntries(string(router), subscription)
	if err != nil {
		return false, fmt.Errorf("%s: %v — nginx не трогаю", n.routerPath, err)
	}
	newVhosts, err := nginxconf.RenderDomainVhosts(vhosts)
	if err != nil {
		return false, err
	}
	if mode == "on" {
		site, err := os.ReadFile(n.sitePath)
		if err == nil {
			err = nginxconf.CheckPPCoverage(newRouter, []string{string(site), newVhosts})
		}
		if err != nil {
			return false, fmt.Errorf("режим PROXY включён: %v — nginx не трогаю", err)
		}
	}
	oldVhosts, err := os.ReadFile(n.vhostPath)
	if err != nil && !errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) {
		return false, err
	}
	vhostSame := newVhosts == string(oldVhosts) || (len(vhosts) == 0 && oldVhosts == nil)
	if newRouter == string(router) && vhostSame {
		return false, nil
	}
	stamp := n.now().Format("20060102-150405")
	if err := os.MkdirAll(n.backupDir, 0o700); err != nil {
		return false, err
	}
	for p, c := range map[string][]byte{n.routerPath: router, n.vhostPath: oldVhosts} {
		if c != nil {
			if err := os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(n.backupDir, filepath.Base(p)+"."+stamp+".domains"), c, 0o600); err != nil {
				return false, fmt.Errorf("бэкап %s: %v — nginx не трогаю", p, err)
			}
		}
	}
	restore := func() {
		_ = writeNginxFile(n.routerPath, router)
		if oldVhosts != nil {
			_ = writeNginxFile(n.vhostPath, oldVhosts)
		} else {
			_ = os.Remove(n.vhostPath)
		}
	}
	if err := writeNginxFile(n.routerPath, []byte(newRouter)); err != nil {
		restore()
		return false, err
	}
	if !vhostSame {
		if err := writeNginxFile(n.vhostPath, []byte(newVhosts)); err != nil {
			restore()
			return false, err
		}
	}
	if out, err := n.run(ctx, "nginx", "-t"); err != nil {
		restore()
		return false, fmt.Errorf("nginx -t отклонил конфиг реестра (прежние файлы возвращены, reload не было): %s", tailString(out, 600))
	}
	if out, err := n.run(ctx, "systemctl", "reload", "nginx"); err != nil {
		restore()
		_, _ = n.run(ctx, "systemctl", "reload", "nginx")
		return false, fmt.Errorf("reload nginx: %v %s (прежние файлы возвращены)", err, tailString(out, 300))
	}
	if err := n.verify(ctx, subscription); err != nil {
		restore()
		if _, terr := n.run(ctx, "nginx", "-t"); terr == nil {
			_, _ = n.run(ctx, "systemctl", "reload", "nginx")
		}
		return false, fmt.Errorf("после reload проверка через :443 не прошла: %v — прежние файлы возвращены", err)
	}
	return true, nil
}
```

В том же файле:
- `probeVia443(ctx, host, path) (int, error)`: `http.Client{Timeout: 10s}` с `Transport{TLSClientConfig: &tls.Config{ServerName: host}, DisableKeepAlives: true, DialContext → 127.0.0.1:443}` (через свой stream, как клиенты; сертификат проверяется), `GET https://host<path>`, код ответа.
- `verifyDomainsThrough443(ctx, subscription)`: до 3 попыток с паузой 1 с (воркеры nginx подхватывают reload асинхронно): сайт `monitorSiteHost()` `/api/v1/health` → 200; каждый домен подписки `/api/v1/health` → 200, а `/` — **не** 200 (444 рвёт соединение); иначе ошибка с именем и кодом.
- `RequestDomainsNginxApply()`: только `runtime.GOOS == "linux"`; debounce 2 с (`time.AfterFunc`, как `RequestXraySync`) → `applyDomainsNginxNow(context.Background())`.

```go
package main

// domains_cert.go — «Выпустить сертификат»: Let's Encrypt HTTP-01 through the Hub's :80 (certbot
// --webroot; the nginx plugin would edit our configs), in the background, the state in the domain's
// row. Before certbot: DNS as Cloudflare and Google see it, the registry's :80 vhost applied, and a
// self-probe of the challenge directory — LE's failed-validation limit is never spent in vain.

import (
	"context"
	"crypto/rand"
	"crypto/x509"
	"encoding/hex"
	"encoding/pem"
	"fmt"
	"io"
	"log"
	"net"
	"net/http"
	"os"
	"os/exec"
	"path"
	"path/filepath"
	"runtime"
	"slices"
	"sort"
	"strings"
	"sync"
	"time"

	"github.com/heyearth/backend/internal/biz"
	"github.com/heyearth/backend/internal/nginxconf"
)

const (
	defaultBambooSNI = "hiearth.ru" // Bamboo's SNI (the site's certificate) until a registry domain is activated
	certbotTimeout   = 4 * time.Minute
	certMinValidity  = 14 * 24 * time.Hour
	heyearthCertHook = "/etc/letsencrypt/renewal-hooks/deploy/50-heyearth.sh"
)

// heyearthCertHookScript runs after every renewal (renewal-hooks/deploy) and once after each issue
// from the admin (RENEWED_LINEAGE set by issueDomainCert).
const heyearthCertHookScript = `#!/bin/sh
# Installed by heyearth-api (cmd/api/domains_cert.go). Do not edit: the API rewrites it.
HY_CONF="${HEYEARTH_HYSTERIA_CONFIG:-/etc/hysteria/server.yaml}"
# nginx and hysteria read certificates through the ssl-cert group (as cmd/deploy hysteria2_hub.go).
chgrp -R ssl-cert /etc/letsencrypt/archive /etc/letsencrypt/live 2>/dev/null || true
chmod -R g+rX /etc/letsencrypt/archive /etc/letsencrypt/live 2>/dev/null || true
# certbot does not reload webroot certificates into nginx.
if nginx -t >/dev/null 2>&1; then systemctl reload nginx || true; fi
[ -n "${RENEWED_LINEAGE:-}" ] || exit 0
# Bamboo: hysteria2-server reads its certificate only at start.
if grep -qF "cert: ${RENEWED_LINEAGE}/fullchain.pem" "$HY_CONF" 2>/dev/null; then
  systemctl restart hysteria2-server || true
fi
exit 0
`

var certJobMu sync.Mutex // one certbot at a time

func currentBambooSNI(ctx context.Context) string {
	if v, err := biz.GetSettingContext(ctx, "hub_main_server_host"); err == nil && strings.TrimSpace(v) != "" {
		return strings.TrimSpace(v)
	}
	return defaultBambooSNI
}

// certbotArgs: every name must already be normalized — no option or shell text gets in.
func certbotArgs(name string, extra []string) ([]string, error) {
	args := []string{"certonly", "--non-interactive", "--agree-tos", "--register-unsafely-without-email",
		"--webroot", "-w", nginxconf.AcmeWebroot, "--cert-name", name, "--keep-until-expiring"}
	for _, d := range append([]string{name}, extra...) {
		if n, err := biz.NormalizeDomainName(d); err != nil || n != d {
			return nil, biz.DomainRuleError(fmt.Sprintf("имя %q не годится для certbot", d))
		}
		args = append(args, "-d", d)
	}
	return args, nil
}

type certInfo struct {
	NotAfter time.Time
	Names    []string
}

// readCertInfo reads the leaf (first PEM block) of a fullchain.pem.
func readCertInfo(p string) (certInfo, error) {
	b, err := os.ReadFile(p)
	if err != nil {
		return certInfo{}, err
	}
	block, _ := pem.Decode(b)
	if block == nil || block.Type != "CERTIFICATE" {
		return certInfo{}, fmt.Errorf("%s: нет PEM-сертификата", p)
	}
	c, err := x509.ParseCertificate(block.Bytes)
	if err != nil {
		return certInfo{}, fmt.Errorf("%s: %w", p, err)
	}
	names := slices.Clone(c.DNSNames)
	sort.Strings(names)
	return certInfo{NotAfter: c.NotAfter, Names: names}, nil
}

// acmeSelfProbe: every host must serve a random file of the challenge directory on :80 (via get).
func acmeSelfProbe(ctx context.Context, webroot string, hosts []string, get func(ctx context.Context, host, p string) (int, string, error)) error {
	dir := filepath.Join(webroot, ".well-known", "acme-challenge")
	rb := make([]byte, 16)
	if _, err := rand.Read(rb); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	token, body := "heyearth-probe-"+hex.EncodeToString(rb[:6]), hex.EncodeToString(rb)
	if err := os.MkdirAll(dir, 0o755); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if err := os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(dir, token), []byte(body), 0o644); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	defer os.Remove(filepath.Join(dir, token))
	for _, h := range hosts {
		if code, got, err := get(ctx, h, "/.well-known/acme-challenge/"+token); err != nil || code != http.StatusOK || strings.TrimSpace(got) != body {
			return biz.DomainRuleError(fmt.Sprintf("nginx не отдаёт /.well-known/acme-challenge/ для %s на :80 (HTTP %d, %v) — Let's Encrypt не проверит имя; для имён сайта сначала go run ./cmd/deploy --nginx", h, code, err))
		}
	}
	return nil
}

// httpGetVia80, startDomainCertJob, runDomainCertJob, issueDomainCert — по списку ниже.
```
В том же файле:
- `httpGetVia80(ctx, host, path) (int, string, error)`: HTTP-клиент с `DialContext → 127.0.0.1:80`, `CheckRedirect: http.ErrUseLastResponse`, тело до 4 КБ.
- `startDomainCertJob(ctx, id) error`: не Linux → `DomainRuleError("сертификаты выпускаются только на Hub")`; `biz.GetDomain`; без `subscription`/`bamboo_cert` → `DomainRuleError("сертификат нужен только для «Подписки и API» и «Сертификата Бамбука»")`; не `hub` → `DomainRuleError("сертификат выпускается на Hub: домен должен указывать на Hub")`; `d.CertReady(now+30 дн.)` → `DomainRuleError("сертификат действует ещё больше 30 дней — продлит certbot сам")`; `biz.StartDomainCert` (`false` → `biz.ErrDomainBusy`); `go runDomainCertJob(d)`.
- `runDomainCertJob(d)`: таймаут 8 мин; журнал `strings.Builder`, строки `HH:MM:SS (МСК) текст`; `issueDomainCert(ctx, d, logf)` (ошибка → `errText` + строка «ОШИБКА: …»); затем **итог по диску**: `readCertInfo(lineageCert(d.Name))` — `valid` ⇔ читается, `NotAfter` в будущем, имена содержат домен (неудачное продление ещё действующего сертификата оставляет `valid`); `biz.FinishDomainCert(ctx, d.ID, valid, &NotAfter|nil, names, errText, tailString(журнал, 8 КБ))`; при `valid && errText == ""` — `applyDomainsNginxNow` (HTTPS-vhost и строка map).
- `issueDomainCert(ctx, d, logf) error` под `certJobMu`: (1) `domainExpectedIPs` → `checkDomainDNS` → `storeDomainDNS`; не `dnsReadyForACME` → `DomainRuleError("DNS: Cloudflare и Google должны видеть <имя> → <IP> (сейчас «<статус>»); дождитесь обновления записи")`; (2) у домена `bamboo_cert` и `prev := currentBambooSNI(ctx)` ≠ имени: если `dnsReadyForACME(checkDomainDNS(ctx, prev, expected, …))` — `extra = [prev]`, в журнал «в сертификат добавлено прежнее имя Бамбука <prev> — старые профили продолжат подключаться», иначе «ВНИМАНИЕ: прежнее имя Бамбука <prev> не указывает на Hub — в сертификат не включено; после переключения старые профили не подключатся к Бамбуку до обновления подписки»; (3) `applyDomainsNginxNow` (:80-vhost домена); (4) `acmeSelfProbe(ctx, nginxconf.AcmeWebroot, [имя]+extra, httpGetVia80)`; (5) если файл `heyearthCertHook` ≠ `heyearthCertHookScript` — `MkdirAll(path.Dir(...), 0755)` и запись с правами `0755`; (6) `certbotArgs` → `exec.CommandContext(ctx с таймаутом certbotTimeout, "certbot", args...)`, вывод (хвост 4 КБ) в журнал, ошибка → «certbot: … (подробности — в журнале выпуска)»; (7) `/bin/sh heyearthCertHook` с `RENEWED_LINEAGE=/etc/letsencrypt/live/<имя>` (ошибка — только в журнал).

`cmd/api/main.go`, перед `	StartMonitor()`:
