```go
// Seams for tests (SendTest).
var (
	loadSMTP = loadSettings
	sendWith = doSend
)

// SendTest sends a short letter synchronously so the owner sees the SMTP error at once
// (admin «Отправить тестовое письмо»), and records it in email_log as admin_test.
func SendTest(to string) error {
	cfg, err := loadSMTP()
	if err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("настройки SMTP не прочитаны: %w", err)
	}
	if !cfg.Enabled {
		return errors.New("отправка писем выключена (включите «Отправка включена» и сохраните)")
	}
	if cfg.Host == "" || cfg.FromEmail == "" {
		return errors.New("не заполнены SMTP host или From email")
	}
	m := Message{To: to, Subject: "HiEarth: тестовое письмо", Template: "admin_test",
		TextBody: "Это тестовое письмо из админки HiEarth. Если вы его читаете — почта настроена верно.",
		HTMLBody: "<p>Это тестовое письмо из админки HiEarth.</p><p>Если вы его читаете — почта настроена верно.</p>"}
	logID := logEmail(m, "pending", nil)
	if err := sendWith(cfg, m); err != nil {
		markEmailStatus(logID, "failed", err.Error())
		return err
	}
	markEmailStatus(logID, "sent", "")
	return nil
}
```

```go
package admin

import (

	"github.com/heyearth/backend/internal/yookassa"

var (
	yookassaCheck = func() (*yookassa.ShopInfo, bool, error) {
		c, err := yookassa.NewClientFromSettings()
		if err != nil {
			return nil, false, err
		}
		info, err := c.Me()
		return info, c.IsTestMode(), err
	}
	sendTestEmail = email.SendTest
)

// CheckYookassaHandler — POST /api/admin/settings/check-yookassa. Never 401/403: admin_web
// would treat a rejected shop key as an expired admin session.
func CheckYookassaHandler(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	info, testMode, err := yookassaCheck()
	if err != nil {
		msg := "ЮKassa не ответила: " + err.Error()
		var apiErr *yookassa.APIError
		if errors.As(err, &apiErr) && (apiErr.HTTPStatus == http.StatusUnauthorized || apiErr.HTTPStatus == http.StatusForbidden) {
			msg = "ЮKassa отклонила ключи: неверный shopId или секретный ключ"
		}
		settingsAudit(r, "check_yookassa", "setting", "yookassa", map[string]any{"ok": false})
		writeAdminError(w, http.StatusBadGateway, msg)
		return
	}
	settingsAudit(r, "check_yookassa", "setting", "yookassa", map[string]any{"ok": true, "test": info.Test})
	writeAdminJSON(w, http.StatusOK, map[string]any{
		"ok": true, "account_id": info.AccountID, "test": info.Test, "test_mode_setting": testMode,
		"mismatch": info.Test != testMode, "fiscalization": info.FiscalizationEnabled, "status": info.Status,
	})
}

// TestEmailHandler — POST /api/admin/settings/test-email {"to": "..."}.
func TestEmailHandler(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	var body struct {
		To string `json:"to"`
	}
	if err := json.NewDecoder(r.Body).Decode(&body); err != nil {
		writeAdminError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "Invalid request body")
		return
	}
	to := strings.TrimSpace(body.To)
	if !reEmail.MatchString(to) || len(to) > 254 {
		writeAdminError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "неверный адрес получателя")
		return
	}
	err := sendTestEmail(to)
	settingsAudit(r, "send_test_email", "setting", "smtp", map[string]any{"to": to, "ok": err == nil})
	if err != nil {
		writeAdminError(w, http.StatusBadGateway, "Письмо не отправлено: "+err.Error())
		return
	}
	writeAdminJSON(w, http.StatusOK, map[string]string{"message": "Письмо отправлено на " + to})
}
```

```go
package main

import (
	"net/http"
	"sort"
	"time"

	"github.com/heyearth/backend/internal/admin"
	"github.com/heyearth/backend/internal/biz"
)

const quotaPreviewNote = "Квота считается за текущий цикл подписки: месяц от даты её начала (если даты нет — последние 30 дней). " +
	"Отключённые по квоте вернутся сами, когда у них начнётся новый цикл или вы увеличите квоту тарифа."

var quotaPreviewList = func() (map[string]struct{}, error) {
	return dbBounded(5*time.Second, biz.ListQuotaExceededUserIDsContext)
}

func registerQuotaAdminRoutes() {
	http.HandleFunc("/api/admin/quota/preview", admin.RequirePermission("settings.read", handleAdminQuotaPreview))
}

// handleAdminQuotaPreview answers «сейчас отключит N пользователей» before the owner arms the cutoff.
func handleAdminQuotaPreview(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	setCORS(w, r)
	if r.Method != http.MethodGet {
		writeJSON(w, http.StatusMethodNotAllowed, map[string]string{"error": "GET only"})
		return
	}
	enabled, err := readQuotaCutoffFlag()
	if err != nil {
		writeJSON(w, http.StatusServiceUnavailable, map[string]string{"error": "Не удалось прочитать настройку: " + err.Error()})
		return
	}
	over, err := quotaPreviewList()
	if err != nil {
		writeJSON(w, http.StatusServiceUnavailable, map[string]string{"error": "Не удалось посчитать превысивших квоту: " + err.Error()})
		return
	}
	ids := make([]string, 0, len(over))
	for id := range over {
		ids = append(ids, id)
	}
	sort.Strings(ids)
	if len(ids) > 10 {
		ids = ids[:10]
	}
	writeJSON(w, http.StatusOK, map[string]any{"enabled": enabled, "over_quota": len(over), "sample": ids, "note": quotaPreviewNote})
}
```

```go
package main

import (
	"net/http"
	"net/http/httptest"
	"strings"
	"testing"
)

type protoFakes struct {
	set    map[string]string
	bumps  int
	syncs  int
	audits []string
}

func withProtoFakes(t *testing.T, stored map[string]string) *protoFakes {
	t.Helper()
	f := &protoFakes{set: map[string]string{}}
	oldGet, oldSet, oldBump, oldSync, oldAudit := protoGet, protoSet, protoBump, protoSync, protoAudit
	t.Cleanup(func() {
		protoGet, protoSet, protoBump, protoSync, protoAudit = oldGet, oldSet, oldBump, oldSync, oldAudit
	})
	protoGet = func(k string) (string, error) { return stored[k], nil }
	protoSet = func(k, v string) error { f.set[k] = v; return nil }
	protoBump = func() { f.bumps++; stored["config_version"] = "13" }
	protoSync = func() { f.syncs++ }
	protoAudit = func(r *http.Request, action, targetType, targetID string, details any) {
		f.audits = append(f.audits, action)
	}
	return f
}

func postProtocols(body string) *httptest.ResponseRecorder {
	rec := httptest.NewRecorder()
	handleAdminProtocols(rec, httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodPost, "/api/admin/protocols", strings.NewReader(body)))
	return rec
}

func TestProtocolsPostRequiresAcknowledgement(t *testing.T) {
	f := withProtoFakes(t, map[string]string{"config_version": "12"})
	for _, body := range []string{
		`{"changes":{"reality_fingerprint":"firefox"}}`,
		`{"changes":{"reality_transport":"ws"},"acknowledge_resubscribe":true}`,
		`{"changes":{"reality_fingerprint":"netscape"},"acknowledge_resubscribe":true}`,
		`{"changes":{"reality_sni_domain":"apple.com"},"acknowledge_resubscribe":true}`,
		`{"changes":{"dns_servers":"8.8.8.8,not-an-ip"},"acknowledge_resubscribe":true}`,
		`{"changes":{"mux_concurrency":"0"},"acknowledge_resubscribe":true}`,
		`{"changes":{},"acknowledge_resubscribe":true}`,
		`{"changes":{"mux_concurrency":"4","reality_transport":"ws"},"acknowledge_resubscribe":true}`,
	} {
		if rec := postProtocols(body); rec.Code != http.StatusBadRequest {
			t.Errorf("%s: %d %s", body, rec.Code, rec.Body.String())
		}
	}
	if len(f.set) != 0 || f.bumps != 0 || f.syncs != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("rejected requests must not write anything: %+v", f)
	}
}

func TestProtocolsPostAppliesOnce(t *testing.T) {
	f := withProtoFakes(t, map[string]string{"config_version": "12"})
	rec := postProtocols(`{"changes":{"reality_fingerprint":"Firefox","dns_servers":" 1.1.1.1 , 9.9.9.9 "},"acknowledge_resubscribe":true}`)
	if rec.Code != http.StatusOK || !strings.Contains(rec.Body.String(), `"config_version":"13"`) {
		t.Fatalf("%d %s", rec.Code, rec.Body.String())
	}
	if f.set["reality_fingerprint"] != "firefox" || f.set["dns_servers"] != "1.1.1.1,9.9.9.9" || f.bumps != 1 || f.syncs != 1 || len(f.audits) != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("applied: %+v", f)
	}
}

func TestProtocolsGetDefaultsAndNoSecrets(t *testing.T) {
	withProtoFakes(t, map[string]string{"awg_server_private_key": "PRIVATE", "awg_peer_count": "3", "hysteria2_obfs_password": "OBFS"})
	rec := httptest.NewRecorder()
```

- [ ] **Step 3: Реализация** — `server/backend/cmd/api/protocols_admin.go`:

```go
package main

import (
	"fmt"
	"net"
	"net/http"
	"regexp"
	"sort"
	"strconv"
	"strings"

	"github.com/heyearth/backend/internal/admin"
	"github.com/heyearth/backend/internal/biz"
)

var (
	protoGet   = func(key string) (string, error) { return settingOrEmpty(biz.GetSetting, key) }
	protoSet   = biz.SetSetting
	protoBump  = incrementConfigVersion
	protoSync  = RequestXraySync
	protoAudit = admin.WriteAuditLog

	protoHostRe       = regexp.MustCompile(`^[a-z0-9]([a-z0-9-]*[a-z0-9])?(\.[a-z0-9]([a-z0-9-]*[a-z0-9])?)+$`)
	protoFingerprints = map[string]bool{"chrome": true, "firefox": true, "safari": true, "edge": true, "ios": true, "android": true}
)

// protocolDefaults mirror xraySyncReads.load (xray_sync.go): what is in effect when a key is unset.
var protocolDefaults = map[string]string{
	"reality_sni_domain": biz.DefaultRealitySNI, "reality_fingerprint": defaultFingerprint,
	"dns_servers": defaultDNSServers, "mux_concurrency": strconv.Itoa(defaultMuxConcurrency),
	"cdn_enabled": "false", "cdn_host": defaultCDNHost,
	"reality_transport": "tcp", "reality_flow": "xtls-rprx-vision",
	// No balancer_strategy: phase 1 removed the setting (and defaultBalancerStrategy) — exits are
	// chosen by leastLoad + costs from each exit's priority (load_weight) on the node card.
}

// protocolValidators: the only keys POST accepts. Transport and flow of Берёза are fixed
// (Reality needs tcp + xtls-rprx-vision), exit priorities live on the node card (phase 2),
// the CDN host moves to «Домены» (phase 4).
var protocolValidators = map[string]func(string) (string, string){
	"reality_sni_domain": func(v string) (string, string) {
		v = strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(v))
		if !protoHostRe.MatchString(v) || len(v) > 253 {
			return "", "SNI — доменное имя, например yandex.ru"
		}
		if v == "apple.com" || strings.HasSuffix(v, ".apple.com") {
			return "", "apple.com не годится: адрес Hub не принадлежит Apple, DPI это видит"
		}
		return v, ""
	},
	"reality_fingerprint": func(v string) (string, string) {
		v = strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(v))
		if !protoFingerprints[v] {
			return "", "отпечаток: chrome, firefox, safari, edge, ios или android"
		}
		return v, ""
	},
	"dns_servers": func(v string) (string, string) {
		var ips []string
		for _, p := range strings.Split(v, ",") {
			if p = strings.TrimSpace(p); p != "" {
				if net.ParseIP(p) == nil {
					return "", "DNS — IP-адреса через запятую: " + p
				}
				ips = append(ips, p)
			}
		}
		if len(ips) == 0 || len(ips) > 4 {
			return "", "от 1 до 4 DNS-серверов"
		}
		return strings.Join(ips, ","), ""
	},
	"mux_concurrency": func(v string) (string, string) {
		n, err := strconv.Atoi(strings.TrimSpace(v))
		if err != nil || n < 1 || n > 64 {
			return "", "mux — целое число 1…64"
		}
		return strconv.Itoa(n), ""
	},
	"cdn_enabled": func(v string) (string, string) {
		if l := strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(v)); l == "true" || l == "false" {
			return l, ""
		}
		return "", "true или false"
	},
}

func registerProtocolsAdminRoutes() {
	http.HandleFunc("/api/admin/protocols", func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
		perm := "settings.write"
		if r.Method == http.MethodGet {
			perm = "settings.read"
		}
		admin.RequirePermission(perm, handleAdminProtocols)(w, r)
	})
}

func handleAdminProtocols(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	setCORS(w, r)
	switch r.Method {
	case http.MethodGet:
		writeJSON(w, http.StatusOK, protocolsView())
	case http.MethodPost:
		updateProtocols(w, r)
	default:
		writeJSON(w, http.StatusMethodNotAllowed, map[string]string{"error": "GET or POST"})
	}
}

func protocolsView() map[string]any {
	values := map[string]string{}
	for k, def := range protocolDefaults {
		values[k] = def
		if v, err := protoGet(k); err == nil && v != "" {
			values[k] = v
		}
	}
	get := func(k string) string {
		v, _ := protoGet(k)
		return v
	}
	editable := make([]string, 0, len(protocolValidators))
	for k := range protocolValidators {
		editable = append(editable, k)
	}
	sort.Strings(editable)
	return map[string]any{
		"values": values, "editable": editable,
		"config_version": get("config_version"), "config_version_updated_at": get("config_version_updated_at"),
		"auto_tuner_enabled": get("auto_tuner_enabled") == "true",
		"awg": map[string]string{"peer_count": get("awg_peer_count"), "last_sync_at": get("awg_last_sync_at"),
			"last_error": get("awg_last_error"), "config_version": get("awg_config_version")},
	}
}

func updateProtocols(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	var req struct {
		Changes     map[string]string `json:"changes"`
		Acknowledge bool              `json:"acknowledge_resubscribe"`
	}
	if err := parseJSON(r, &req); err != nil {
		writeJSON(w, http.StatusBadRequest, map[string]string{"error": "invalid JSON"})
		return
	}
	if !req.Acknowledge {
		writeJSON(w, http.StatusBadRequest, map[string]string{"error": "Подтвердите, что пользователям придётся обновить подписку"})
		return
	}
	if len(req.Changes) == 0 {
		writeJSON(w, http.StatusBadRequest, map[string]string{"error": "нет изменений"})
		return
	}
	clean := map[string]string{}
	for k, v := range req.Changes {
		validate, ok := protocolValidators[k]
		if !ok {
			writeJSON(w, http.StatusBadRequest, map[string]string{"error": fmt.Sprintf("%s здесь только для чтения", k)})
			return
		}
		nv, msg := validate(v)
		if msg != "" {
			writeJSON(w, http.StatusBadRequest, map[string]string{"error": k + ": " + msg})
			return
		}
		clean[k] = nv
	}
	for k, v := range clean { // validated as a whole first: a bad key never leaves half the change applied
		if err := protoSet(k, v); err != nil {
			writeJSON(w, http.StatusInternalServerError, map[string]string{"error": "не удалось сохранить " + k})
			return
		}
	}
	protoBump()
	protoSync()
	protoAudit(r, "update_protocols", "setting", "protocols", map[string]any{"changes": clean})
	ver, _ := protoGet("config_version")
	writeJSON(w, http.StatusOK, map[string]string{"message": "Сохранено. Пользователи увидят «обновите подписку» в приложении.", "config_version": ver})
}
```

```go
var userIDRe = regexp.MustCompile(`^[A-Za-z0-9-]{8,64}$`)

// resolveNewUserID: an empty user_id gets a fresh UUIDv4 — the admin form does not invent one.
func resolveNewUserID(in string) (string, string) {
	in = strings.TrimSpace(in)
	if in == "" {
		var b [16]byte
		if _, err := rand.Read(b[:]); err != nil {
			return "", "не удалось сгенерировать user_id"
		}
		b[6], b[8] = b[6]&0x0f|0x40, b[8]&0x3f|0x80
		return fmt.Sprintf("%x-%x-%x-%x-%x", b[0:4], b[4:6], b[6:8], b[8:10], b[10:]), ""
	}
	if !userIDRe.MatchString(in) {
		return "", "user_id: 8–64 символа — латиница, цифры, дефис"
	}
	return in, ""
}
```

```go
// RenameSshKey changes only the name; the private key stays as stored.
func RenameSshKey(id int, name string) (*SshKey, error) {
	var k SshKey
	err := db.DB.QueryRow(`
		UPDATE ssh_keys SET name = $1, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = $2
		RETURNING id, name, public_key, fingerprint, created_at, updated_at
	`, strings.TrimSpace(name), id).Scan(&k.ID, &k.Name, &k.PublicKey, &k.Fingerprint, &k.CreatedAt, &k.UpdatedAt)

		return nil, err
	}
	return &k, nil
}
```

```go
// mtprotoUpdateRequest: absent fields keep their stored value. Host and port are not here on
// purpose: the balancer picks them, and the old form wiped mtproto_port with "".
type mtprotoUpdateRequest struct {
	Enabled        *bool   `json:"enabled"`
	Secret         *string `json:"secret"`
	FrontingDomain *string `json:"fronting_domain"`
	SponsorChannel *string `json:"sponsor_channel"`
	AutoInstall    *bool   `json:"auto_install"`
}

var mtprotoSecretRe = regexp.MustCompile(`^ee[0-9a-f]{34,}$`)

func mtprotoUpdates(req mtprotoUpdateRequest) (map[string]string, string) {
	out := map[string]string{}
	if req.Enabled != nil {
		out["mtproto_enabled"] = strconv.FormatBool(*req.Enabled)
	}
	if req.AutoInstall != nil {
		out["mtproto_auto_install"] = strconv.FormatBool(*req.AutoInstall)
	}
	if req.Secret != nil {
		s := strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(*req.Secret))
		if s != "" && !mtprotoSecretRe.MatchString(s) {
			return nil, "секрет в формате mtg: ee + 32 hex + hex домена — нажмите «Сгенерировать»"
		}
		out["mtproto_secret"] = s
	}
	if req.FrontingDomain != nil {
		out["mtproto_fronting_domain"] = strings.TrimSpace(*req.FrontingDomain)
	}
	if req.SponsorChannel != nil {
		out["mtproto_sponsor_channel"] = strings.TrimSpace(*req.SponsorChannel)
	}
	return out, ""
}
```

```go
package admin

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"net/http"
	"strconv"
	"strings"
	"unicode/utf8"

	"golang.org/x/crypto/bcrypt"

	"github.com/heyearth/backend/internal/db"
)

var (
	adminPasswordHash = func(id int) (string, error) {
		var h string
		err := db.DB.QueryRow(`SELECT password_hash FROM admin_users WHERE id = $1`, id).Scan(&h)
		return h, err
	}
	adminSetPassword = func(id int, hash string) error {
		_, err := db.DB.Exec(`UPDATE admin_users SET password_hash = $1, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = $2`, hash, id)
		return err
	}
	adminSelfAudit = WriteAuditLog
)

func validateNewAdminPassword(current, next string) string {
	n := utf8.RuneCountInString(next)
	switch {
	case n < 10:
		return "новый пароль — не короче 10 символов"
	case n > 128:
		return "новый пароль — не длиннее 128 символов"
	case next == current:
		return "новый пароль совпадает с текущим"
	case strings.Count(next, string([]rune(next)[0])) == n:
		return "пароль из одного повторяющегося символа"
	}
	return ""
}

// ChangeOwnPasswordHandler — POST /api/admin/me/password. A wrong current password is 400, never
// 401/403: admin_web treats those as an ended session. Other sessions stay valid until their JWT
// expires (24 h).
func ChangeOwnPasswordHandler(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	claims, ok := ClaimsFromContext(r.Context())
	if !ok || claims.AdminID == 0 {
		writeAdminError(w, http.StatusUnauthorized, "Missing admin session")
		return
	}
	var body struct {
		Current string `json:"current_password"`
		New     string `json:"new_password"`
	}
	if err := json.NewDecoder(r.Body).Decode(&body); err != nil {
		writeAdminError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "Invalid request body")
		return
	}
	if msg := validateNewAdminPassword(body.Current, body.New); msg != "" {
		writeAdminError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, msg)
		return
	}
	id := strconv.Itoa(claims.AdminID)
	hash, err := adminPasswordHash(claims.AdminID)
	if err != nil {
		writeAdminError(w, http.StatusInternalServerError, "Failed to load admin")
		return
	}
	if bcrypt.CompareHashAndPassword([]byte(hash), []byte(body.Current)) != nil {
		adminSelfAudit(r, "change_own_password", "admin", id, map[string]any{"ok": false})
		writeAdminError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "текущий пароль неверный")
		return
	}
	newHash, err := bcrypt.GenerateFromPassword([]byte(body.New), bcrypt.DefaultCost)
	if err != nil || adminSetPassword(claims.AdminID, string(newHash)) != nil {
		writeAdminError(w, http.StatusInternalServerError, "Failed to save password")
		return
	}
	adminSelfAudit(r, "change_own_password", "admin", id, map[string]any{"ok": true})
	writeAdminJSON(w, http.StatusOK, map[string]string{"message": "Пароль изменён"})
}
```

- [ ] **Step 3: Построители фильтров** — в конец `common.go` (импорты `fmt`, `net/url`, `time`):

```go
var mskLocation = time.FixedZone("MSK", 3*60*60)

// addDateRange appends col >= from and col < to + 1 day (dates YYYY-MM-DD in Moscow time,
// both inclusive for the owner), numbering placeholders after args. Empty bounds are skipped.
func addDateRange(where string, args []any, col, from, to string) (string, []any, string) {
	for i, v := range []string{from, to} {
		if v = strings.TrimSpace(v); v == "" {
			continue
		}
		d, err := time.ParseInLocation("2006-01-02", v, mskLocation)
		if err != nil {
			return where, args, "дата в формате ГГГГ-ММ-ДД: " + v
		}
		op := ">="
		if i == 1 {
			d, op = d.AddDate(0, 0, 1), "<"
		}
		args = append(args, d)
		where += fmt.Sprintf(" AND %s %s $%d", col, op, len(args))
	}
	return where, args, ""
}

// subscriptionFilters: plan_id, status (active|expired|cancelled|pending_renewal),
// expiring_days 1..90, with_promo=1. Unknown values are ignored.
func subscriptionFilters(q url.Values, where string, args []any) (string, []any) {
	if id, err := strconv.Atoi(q.Get("plan_id")); err == nil && id > 0 {
		args = append(args, id)
		where += fmt.Sprintf(" AND us.plan_id = $%d", len(args))
	}
	switch q.Get("status") {
	case "active":
		where += " AND us.valid_until > NOW() AND COALESCE(us.status, 'active') NOT IN ('cancelled', 'canceled')"
	case "expired":
		where += " AND us.valid_until <= NOW()"
	case "cancelled":
		where += " AND us.status IN ('cancelled', 'canceled')"
	case "pending_renewal":
		where += " AND us.status = 'pending_renewal'"
	}
	if d, err := strconv.Atoi(q.Get("expiring_days")); err == nil && d >= 1 && d <= 90 {
		args = append(args, d)
		where += fmt.Sprintf(" AND us.valid_until > NOW() AND us.valid_until <= NOW() + make_interval(days => $%d)", len(args))
	}
	if q.Get("with_promo") == "1" {
		where += " AND COALESCE(us.promocode_used, '') <> ''"
	}
	return where, args
}

// auditFilters builds the WHERE of the audit log: search, action and admin are substrings.
func auditFilters(q url.Values) (string, []any, string) {
	where, args := "1=1", []any{}
	if s := strings.TrimSpace(q.Get("search")); s != "" {
		args = append(args, "%"+s+"%")
		n := len(args)
		where += fmt.Sprintf(" AND (a.admin_username ILIKE $%d OR a.target_id ILIKE $%d OR a.action ILIKE $%d)", n, n, n)
	}
	for _, f := range []struct{ param, col string }{{"action", "a.action"}, {"admin", "a.admin_username"}} {
		if v := strings.TrimSpace(q.Get(f.param)); v != "" {
			args = append(args, "%"+v+"%")
			where += fmt.Sprintf(" AND %s ILIKE $%d", f.col, len(args))
		}
	}
	if v := strings.TrimSpace(q.Get("target_type")); v != "" {
		args = append(args, v)
		where += fmt.Sprintf(" AND a.target_type = $%d", len(args))
	}
	return addDateRange(where, args, "a.created_at", q.Get("from"), q.Get("to"))
}
```

```go
// PlanUsage counts what still refers to a plan; shown before a delete (user_subscriptions.plan_id
// is ON DELETE SET NULL, so deleting a plan in use silently leaves its subscribers plan-less).
type PlanUsage struct {
	ActiveSubscriptions int `json:"active_subscriptions"`
	AllSubscriptions    int `json:"all_subscriptions"`
	PendingRetries      int `json:"pending_retries"`
	Promocodes          int `json:"promocodes"`
}

func GetPlanUsage(id int) (PlanUsage, error) {
	var u PlanUsage
	err := db.DB.QueryRow(`SELECT
		(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user_subscriptions WHERE plan_id = $1 AND valid_until > NOW()),
		(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user_subscriptions WHERE plan_id = $1),
		(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM payment_retry_queue WHERE plan_id = $1 AND status IN ('pending', 'in_progress')),
		(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM promocodes WHERE plan_id_granted = $1)`, id).
		Scan(&u.ActiveSubscriptions, &u.AllSubscriptions, &u.PendingRetries, &u.Promocodes)
	return u, err
}
```

`plans_handlers.go` — добавить и переписать `DeletePlanHandler`:
```go
// planDeleteDecision: a plan with active subscribers is deleted only with its slug typed in.
func planDeleteDecision(u biz.PlanUsage, slug, confirm string) (int, string) {
	if u.ActiveSubscriptions > 0 && strings.TrimSpace(confirm) != slug {
		return http.StatusConflict, fmt.Sprintf("У тарифа %d активных подписчиков: после удаления они останутся без тарифа. "+
			"Лучше снимите галочку «Активен». Чтобы всё же удалить, введите slug тарифа.", u.ActiveSubscriptions)
	}
	return 0, ""
}

func PlanUsageHandler(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	planID, ok := parseLastPathInt(strings.TrimSuffix(strings.TrimSuffix(r.URL.Path, "/"), "/usage"))
	if !ok {
		writeAdminError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "Invalid plan id")
		return
	}
	u, err := biz.GetPlanUsage(planID)
	if err != nil {
		writeAdminError(w, http.StatusInternalServerError, "Failed to count plan usage")
		return
	}
	writeAdminJSON(w, http.StatusOK, u)
}

func DeletePlanHandler(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	planID, ok := parseLastPathInt(r.URL.Path)
	if !ok {
		writeAdminError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "Invalid plan id")
		return
	}
	var body struct {
		ConfirmSlug string `json:"confirm_slug"`
	}
	_ = json.NewDecoder(r.Body).Decode(&body) // the body is optional
	plan, err := biz.GetPlanByID(planID)
	if err != nil {
		writeAdminError(w, http.StatusNotFound, "Plan not found")
		return
	}
	usage, err := biz.GetPlanUsage(planID)
	if err != nil {
		writeAdminError(w, http.StatusInternalServerError, "Failed to count plan usage")
		return
	}
	if code, msg := planDeleteDecision(usage, plan.Slug, body.ConfirmSlug); code != 0 {
		writeAdminJSON(w, code, map[string]any{"error": msg, "active_subscriptions": usage.ActiveSubscriptions})
		return
	}
	if err := biz.DeletePlan(planID); err != nil {
		writeAdminError(w, http.StatusInternalServerError, "Failed to delete plan")
		return
	}
	WriteAuditLog(r, "delete_plan", "plan", strconv.Itoa(planID), map[string]any{"slug": plan.Slug, "usage": usage})
	go biz.NotifySubscriptionChange()
	writeAdminJSON(w, http.StatusOK, map[string]string{"message": "Plan deleted"})
}
```

```js
#!/usr/bin/env node
// Asserts that the built admin CSS really contains the theme-token utilities the code uses
// (they silently did not exist before: --color-text-primary only generates text-text-primary).
import { readdirSync, readFileSync } from 'node:fs'
import { join, resolve } from 'node:path'
import { fileURLToPath } from 'node:url'

const assets = resolve(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url), '../../dist/assets')
const file = readdirSync(assets).find(f => f.endsWith('.css'))
const css = readFileSync(join(assets, file), 'utf8')
const must = {
  'text-primary': /\.text-primary\{[^}]*color:var\(--color-text-primary\)/,
  'text-secondary': /\.text-secondary\{[^}]*color:var\(--color-text-secondary\)/,
  'text-tertiary': /\.text-tertiary\{[^}]*color:var\(--color-text-tertiary\)/,
  'border-default': /\.border-default\{[^}]*border-color:var\(--color-border-default\)/,
  'border-strong': /\.border-strong\{[^}]*border-color:var\(--color-border-strong\)/,
  'divide-default': /\.divide-default[^{]*\{[^}]*border-color:var\(--color-border-default\)/,
}
const mustNot = { 'cyan accent': /#22d3ee/i, 'Inter font': /Inter/, 'light/brutalist themes': /data-theme=/, 'border-default as width': /\.border-default\{[^}]*border-width/ }
const fails = [
  ...Object.entries(must).filter(([, re]) => !re.test(css)).map(([k]) => `нет утилиты ${k}`),
  ...Object.entries(mustNot).filter(([, re]) => re.test(css)).map(([k]) => `в CSS осталось: ${k}`),
]
fails.forEach(f => console.log('css-check:', f))
console.log(fails.length ? `css-check: ${fails.length} проблем в ${file}` : `css-check: OK (${file})`)
process.exit(fails.length ? 1 : 0)
```
`package.json` → `"css-check": "node scripts/css-tokens-check.mjs"`.

```jsx
import { createContext, useContext, useEffect, useState } from 'react'
import { accents, DEFAULT_ACCENT } from './accents.js'

// One theme only (dark Linear, repo CLAUDE.md theme lock); the owner may pick an accent.
const ACCENT_KEY = 'hiearth-accent-v2' // v1 defaulted to blue and offered light themes
const LEGACY_KEYS = ['hiearth-theme', 'hiearth-accent', 'admin_theme_mode']
const ThemeContext = createContext({ accent: DEFAULT_ACCENT, setAccent: () => {} })

function storedAccent() {
  try {
    const v = localStorage.getItem(ACCENT_KEY)
    return accents.some(a => a.id === v) ? v : DEFAULT_ACCENT
  } catch {
    return DEFAULT_ACCENT
  }
}

export function ThemeProvider({ children }) {
  const [accent, setAccent] = useState(storedAccent)
  useEffect(() => {
    const root = document.documentElement
    root.removeAttribute('data-theme')
    root.classList.remove('light')
    root.setAttribute('data-accent', accent)
    try {
      localStorage.setItem(ACCENT_KEY, accent)
      LEGACY_KEYS.forEach(k => localStorage.removeItem(k))
    } catch { /* storage blocked: the default accent still applies */ }
  }, [accent])
  return <ThemeContext.Provider value={{ accent, setAccent }}>{children}</ThemeContext.Provider>
}

export const useTheme = () => useContext(ThemeContext)
```

```js
import { readFileSync, writeFileSync } from 'node:fs'
import { resolve } from 'node:path'
import { fileURLToPath } from 'node:url'

const groups = {
  'text-primary': 'text-slate-100 text-slate-200 text-gray-100 text-text-primary',
  'text-secondary': 'text-slate-300 text-gray-300 text-text-secondary',
  'text-tertiary': 'text-slate-400 text-slate-500 text-gray-400 text-gray-500',
  'bg-canvas': 'bg-slate-900 bg-surface bg-surface-bg',
  'bg-elevated': 'bg-slate-800 bg-surface-alt',
  'bg-overlay': 'bg-surface-card bg-bg-surface',
  'bg-elevated/60': 'bg-slate-800/40 bg-slate-800/60',
  'bg-hover': 'bg-slate-700 bg-slate-600 bg-slate-500 bg-slate-500/15 bg-gray-500/15 bg-gray-500/20 bg-white/5 bg-white/10 bg-white/20',
  'border-default': 'border-slate-700 border-slate-800 border-white/10 border-white/5 border-border',
  'border-strong': 'border-slate-600 border-brand/50',
  'text-danger': 'text-red-300 text-red-400', 'bg-danger/10': 'bg-red-500/10', 'bg-danger/15': 'bg-red-500/15 bg-red-500/20',
  'bg-danger': 'bg-red-600 bg-red-700', 'border-danger/30': 'border-red-500/30',
  'text-success': 'text-green-400 text-emerald-300 text-emerald-400', 'bg-success/15': 'bg-green-500/20 bg-emerald-500/15',
  'bg-success/10': 'bg-emerald-900/20', 'bg-success': 'bg-green-600 bg-emerald-600 bg-emerald-500', 'border-success': 'border-emerald-500',
  'text-warning': 'text-yellow-400 text-amber-200 text-amber-300 text-amber-400 text-orange-400',
  'bg-warning/15': 'bg-yellow-500/20 bg-amber-500/15 bg-amber-500/20 bg-orange-500/20', 'bg-warning': 'bg-yellow-500',
  'text-info': 'text-blue-300 text-blue-400 text-cyan-400 text-sky-300', 'bg-info/15': 'bg-blue-500/15 bg-blue-500/20 bg-cyan-500/20', 'bg-info': 'bg-blue-600',
  'text-accent': 'text-purple-400 text-brand', 'bg-accent/15': 'bg-purple-500/20 bg-brand/20', 'bg-accent': 'bg-purple-600 bg-brand',
  'bg-accent-hover': 'bg-purple-500 bg-brand-dark bg-brand/80', 'border-accent': 'border-purple-400 border-brand', 'ring-accent/40': 'ring-brand',
  'placeholder:text-tertiary': 'placeholder-text-secondary', 'rounded-md': 'rounded-xl rounded-2xl', 'bg-black/60': 'bg-black/50',
  '': 'shadow-sm shadow-md shadow-lg shadow-xl shadow-2xl',
}
export const MAP = Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(groups).flatMap(([to, from]) => from.split(' ').map(f => [f, to])))

export function transform(src) {
  return src.replace(/(?<=^|[\s"'`{])((?:[a-z0-9-]+:)*)([a-z][a-z0-9-]*(?:\/\d+)?)(?=$|[\s"'`}])/gm,
    (m, variants, cls) => (cls in MAP ? (MAP[cls] === '' ? '' : variants + MAP[cls]) : m))
}

if (process.argv[1] && resolve(process.argv[1]) === fileURLToPath(import.meta.url)) {
  for (const f of process.argv.slice(2)) {
    const before = readFileSync(f, 'utf8')
    const after = transform(before)
    if (after !== before) writeFileSync(f, after)
    console.log(`${after === before ? '·' : '✎'} ${f}`)
  }
}
```

```js
// Pure rules of the confirm dialog (unit-tested with node --test).
import { confirmMatches } from './ui/confirm.js'

export function confirmLocked(req, text) {
  if (req?.typeToConfirm) return !confirmMatches(text, req.typeToConfirm)
  if (req?.input) return text.trim() === ''
  return false
}
export function confirmValue(req, text, accepted) {
  if (req?.input) return accepted ? text.trim() : null
  return accepted
}
```

```jsx
import { createContext, useCallback, useContext, useRef, useState } from 'react'
import { Button, Dialog, Input } from './ui/index.js'
import { confirmLocked, confirmValue } from './confirmLogic.js'

const ConfirmContext = createContext(null)

export function ConfirmProvider({ children }) {
  const [req, setReq] = useState(null)
  const [text, setText] = useState('')
  const resolver = useRef(null)
  const confirm = useCallback(opts => new Promise(resolve => {
    resolver.current = resolve
    setText(opts.input?.defaultValue ?? '')
    setReq(opts)
  }), [])
  const finish = accepted => {
    resolver.current?.(confirmValue(req, text, accepted))
    resolver.current = null
    setReq(null)
  }
  const locked = confirmLocked(req, text)
  return (
    <ConfirmContext.Provider value={confirm}>
      {children}
      <Dialog open={!!req} onClose={() => finish(false)} title={req?.title} maxWidth="max-w-md">
        {req && (
          <form onSubmit={e => { e.preventDefault(); if (!locked) finish(true) }} className="space-y-4">
            {req.message && <p className="text-sm text-secondary whitespace-pre-line">{req.message}</p>}
            {(req.typeToConfirm || req.input) && (
              <div>
                <label htmlFor="confirm-input" className="block text-xs text-tertiary mb-1">
                  {req.input?.label || <>Для подтверждения введите <span className="font-mono text-primary">{req.typeToConfirm}</span></>}
                </label>
                <Input id="confirm-input" autoFocus autoComplete="off" value={text} onChange={e => setText(e.target.value)}
                  className={req.typeToConfirm ? 'font-mono' : ''} />
              </div>
            )}
            <div className="flex flex-col-reverse sm:flex-row sm:justify-end gap-2">
              <Button type="button" variant="ghost" onClick={() => finish(false)}>Отмена</Button>
              <Button type="submit" variant={req.danger ? 'danger' : 'primary'} disabled={locked}>{req.confirmLabel || 'Подтвердить'}</Button>
            </div>
          </form>
        )}
      </Dialog>
    </ConfirmContext.Provider>
  )
}

export function useConfirm() {
  const confirm = useContext(ConfirmContext)
  if (!confirm) throw new Error('useConfirm() outside <ConfirmProvider>')
  return confirm
}
```

```jsx
      <label className="block text-xs text-tertiary mb-1">{label}</label>
      {children}
      {hint && <p className="text-xs text-tertiary mt-1">{hint}</p>}
    </div>

export function TextInput({ value, onChange, ...props }) {
  return <Input value={value ?? ''} onChange={e => onChange(e.target.value)} {...props} />
}

export function TextArea({ value, onChange, rows = 3, ...props }) {
  return <Textarea value={value ?? ''} rows={rows} onChange={e => onChange(e.target.value)} {...props} />
}

export function Checkbox({ label, checked, onChange, disabled }) {
  return (
    <label className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 cursor-pointer select-none text-sm text-primary">
      <input type="checkbox" className="h-3.5 w-3.5 accent-accent" checked={!!checked} disabled={disabled} onChange={e => onChange(e.target.checked)} />
      {label}
    </label>
  )
}

export function SelectInput({ value, onChange, options, placeholder }) {
  return (
    <Select value={value ?? ''} onChange={e => onChange(e.target.value)}>
      {placeholder && <option value="">{placeholder}</option>}
      {options.map(o => <option key={o.value} value={o.value}>{o.label}</option>)}
    </Select>
  )
}
```

### Task 5.13: `useHotkey` не глотает ввод

**Files:** Create: `admin_web/src/hooks/hotkeyMatch.js`, `admin_web/scripts/test/hotkey.test.mjs`. Modify: `admin_web/src/hooks/useHotkey.js`.

**Interfaces:** `matchesHotkey(event, { key, meta?, ctrl?, shift? }): boolean`. Простые клавиши (`j`, `k`, `Enter`) не срабатывают в `input/textarea/select/button/a/contenteditable`, с любым модификатором и не вызывают `preventDefault` при несовпадении; `⌘K/Ctrl+K` работают и в полях ввода.

- [ ] **Step 1: Тест (RED)** — `scripts/test/hotkey.test.mjs`:
```js
import { test } from 'node:test'
import assert from 'node:assert/strict'
import { matchesHotkey } from '../../src/hooks/hotkeyMatch.js'

const ev = (key, extra = {}) => ({ key, metaKey: false, ctrlKey: false, shiftKey: false, altKey: false, target: { tagName: 'BODY' }, ...extra })

test('plain keys ignore typing, controls and modifiers', () => {
  assert.equal(matchesHotkey(ev('j'), { key: 'j' }), true)
  assert.equal(matchesHotkey(ev('j', { target: { tagName: 'INPUT' } }), { key: 'j' }), false)
  assert.equal(matchesHotkey(ev('j', { target: { tagName: 'TEXTAREA' } }), { key: 'j' }), false)
  assert.equal(matchesHotkey(ev('j', { target: { tagName: 'DIV', isContentEditable: true } }), { key: 'j' }), false)
  assert.equal(matchesHotkey(ev('Enter', { target: { tagName: 'BUTTON' } }), { key: 'Enter' }), false)
  assert.equal(matchesHotkey(ev('k', { ctrlKey: true }), { key: 'k' }), false)
  assert.equal(matchesHotkey(ev('k', { metaKey: true }), { key: 'k' }), false)
  assert.equal(matchesHotkey(ev('j', { altKey: true }), { key: 'j' }), false)
  assert.equal(matchesHotkey(ev('x'), { key: 'j' }), false)
})

test('Cmd/Ctrl+K works even while typing', () => {
  assert.equal(matchesHotkey(ev('k', { metaKey: true, target: { tagName: 'INPUT' } }), { key: 'k', meta: true }), true)
  assert.equal(matchesHotkey(ev('K', { ctrlKey: true }), { key: 'k', meta: true }), true)
  assert.equal(matchesHotkey(ev('k'), { key: 'k', meta: true }), false)
})
```

- [ ] **Step 2: Запустить** — `cd admin_web && npm test` → FAIL: `Cannot find module …/hotkeyMatch.js`.

- [ ] **Step 3: Реализация.** `src/hooks/hotkeyMatch.js`:
```js
const INTERACTIVE = new Set(['INPUT', 'TEXTAREA', 'SELECT', 'BUTTON', 'A'])

// matchesHotkey: plain keys (j, k, Enter) never fire while the user types or works a control or
// holds a modifier; Cmd/Ctrl combos (meta: true) work anywhere.
export function matchesHotkey(e, { key, meta = false, ctrl = false, shift = false }) {
  if (!e.key || e.key.toLowerCase() !== key.toLowerCase()) return false
  if (meta ? !(e.metaKey || e.ctrlKey) : e.metaKey) return false
  if (ctrl ? !e.ctrlKey : !meta && e.ctrlKey) return false
  if (shift !== !!e.shiftKey || e.altKey) return false
  if (meta || ctrl) return true
  const t = e.target
  return !(t && (INTERACTIVE.has(t.tagName) || t.isContentEditable))
}
```
`src/hooks/useHotkey.js` — целиком:
```js
import { useEffect, useRef } from 'react'
import { matchesHotkey } from './hotkeyMatch.js'

/** useHotkey({ key, meta, ctrl, shift }, handler) — preventDefault only when the hotkey matches. */
export function useHotkey({ key, meta = false, ctrl = false, shift = false }, handler) {
  const ref = useRef(handler)
  ref.current = handler
  useEffect(() => {
    const onKey = e => {
      if (!matchesHotkey(e, { key, meta, ctrl, shift })) return
      e.preventDefault()
      ref.current(e)
    }
    window.addEventListener('keydown', onKey)
    return () => window.removeEventListener('keydown', onKey)
  }, [key, meta, ctrl, shift])
}
```

```js
export const STATUS_META = {
  critical: { label: 'Не работает', variant: 'danger', dot: 'bg-danger' },
  warn: { label: 'Внимание', variant: 'warning', dot: 'bg-warning' },
  unknown: { label: 'Нет данных', variant: 'default', dot: 'bg-tertiary' },
  ok: { label: 'Работает', variant: 'success', dot: 'bg-success' },
  off: { label: 'Не настроено', variant: 'default', dot: 'bg-disabled' },
}
const RANK = { off: 0, ok: 1, unknown: 2, warn: 3, critical: 4 }

export const worstStatus = list => list.reduce((w, s) => ((RANK[s] ?? 0) > RANK[w] ? s : w), 'ok')

export function groupChecks(checks) {
  const groups = new Map()
  for (const c of checks) {
    if (!groups.has(c.group)) groups.set(c.group, [])
    groups.get(c.group).push(c)
  }
  return [...groups].map(([group, list]) => {
    const sorted = [...list].sort((a, b) => (RANK[b.status] ?? 0) - (RANK[a.status] ?? 0)) // stable: server order within a status
    return { group, checks: sorted, worst: worstStatus(list.map(c => c.status)) }
  })
}
```

```jsx
import { useCallback, useEffect, useMemo, useState } from 'react'
import { Link } from 'react-router-dom'
import { CheckCircle2, ChevronDown, RefreshCw } from 'lucide-react'
import { fetchHealth } from '../api/admin.js'
import { formatDate, formatRelativeRu } from '../utils/format.js'
import { groupChecks, STATUS_META } from '../utils/health.js'
import { Badge, Button, Card, CardBody, CardHeader, PageHeader, Skeleton } from '../components/ui/index.js'

function Explain({ meaning, action, link }) {
  return (
    <div className="space-y-1 text-xs">
      {meaning && <p className="text-secondary"><span className="text-tertiary">Что это значит: </span>{meaning}</p>}
      {action && <p className="text-secondary"><span className="text-tertiary">Что делать: </span>{action}</p>}
      {link && <Link to={link} className="inline-block text-accent hover:underline">Открыть раздел →</Link>}
    </div>
  )
}

function Incident({ i }) {
  const m = STATUS_META[i.level === 'critical' ? 'critical' : 'warn']
  return (
    <div role="alert" className={`rounded-md border px-3 py-2 ${i.level === 'critical' ? 'border-danger/40 bg-danger/10' : 'border-warning/40 bg-warning/10'}`}>
      <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center gap-1 sm:gap-3">
        <Badge variant={m.variant}>{m.label}</Badge>
        <span className="text-sm font-medium text-primary flex-1 min-w-0">{i.title}</span>
        <span className="text-xs text-tertiary font-mono tabular-nums" title={formatDate(i.since)}>с {formatRelativeRu(i.since)}</span>
      </div>
      {i.details && <p className="mt-1 text-xs text-secondary font-mono break-words">{i.details}</p>}
      <div className="mt-2"><Explain meaning={i.meaning} action={i.action} link={i.link} /></div>
      {!i.delivered && <p className="mt-1 text-xs text-warning">В Telegram ещё не доставлено — см. «Алерты».</p>}
    </div>
  )
}

function CheckRow({ c }) {
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false)
  const m = STATUS_META[c.status] || STATUS_META.unknown
  return (
    <li className="border-b border-default last:border-b-0">
      <button type="button" onClick={() => setOpen(v => !v)} aria-expanded={open}
        className="w-full min-h-9 px-3 py-1.5 flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center gap-1 sm:gap-3 text-left hover:bg-hover">
        <span className="flex items-center gap-2 sm:w-72 shrink-0">
          <span className={`h-2 w-2 rounded-full shrink-0 ${m.dot}`} aria-hidden="true" />
          <span className="text-sm text-primary">{c.title}</span>
          <span className="sr-only">{m.label}</span>
        </span>
        <span className="flex-1 min-w-0 text-xs text-secondary truncate" title={c.detail}>{c.detail || m.label}</span>
        <span className="text-xs text-tertiary font-mono tabular-nums shrink-0">{c.checked_at && !c.checked_at.startsWith('0001') ? formatRelativeRu(c.checked_at) : '—'}</span>
        <ChevronDown className={`hidden sm:block w-3.5 h-3.5 text-tertiary transition-transform ${open ? 'rotate-180' : ''}`} aria-hidden="true" />
      </button>
      {open && <div className="px-3 pb-3 pl-7"><Explain meaning={c.meaning} action={c.action} link={c.link} /></div>}
    </li>
  )
}

export default function HealthPage() {
  const [data, setData] = useState(null)
  const [error, setError] = useState('')
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true)

  const load = useCallback(() => {
    fetchHealth().then(d => { setData(d); setError('') }).catch(e => setError(e.message)).finally(() => setLoading(false))
  }, [])
  useEffect(() => {
    load()
    const id = setInterval(() => { if (document.visibilityState === 'visible') load() }, 30000)
    return () => clearInterval(id)
  }, [load])

  const groups = useMemo(() => groupChecks(data?.checks || []), [data])
  const overall = STATUS_META[data?.overall] || STATUS_META.unknown

  return (
    <div className="max-w-5xl space-y-6">
      <PageHeader
        title="Состояние"
        subtitle="Проверки идут сами каждые 1–15 минут. Красное — делать сразу, жёлтое — посмотреть сегодня. Нажмите на строку, чтобы узнать, что она значит."
        actions={<>
          {data && <Badge variant={overall.variant}>{overall.label}</Badge>}
          {data && <span className="text-xs text-tertiary font-mono tabular-nums">обновлено {formatDate(data.generated_at)}</span>}
          <Button variant="ghost" size="sm" icon={<RefreshCw className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />} onClick={load}>Обновить</Button>
        </>}
      />
      {error && <div role="alert" className="rounded-md border border-danger/30 bg-danger/10 px-3 py-2 text-sm text-danger">Не удалось получить состояние: {error}</div>}
      {loading ? <Skeleton className="h-64" /> : data && (
        <>
          <section className="space-y-2" aria-label="Активные проблемы">
            <h2 className="text-sm font-semibold text-primary">Сейчас</h2>
            {data.incidents.length === 0
              ? <div className="flex items-center gap-2 rounded-md border border-success/30 bg-success/10 px-3 py-2 text-sm text-success"><CheckCircle2 className="w-4 h-4" aria-hidden="true" />Активных проблем нет</div>
              : data.incidents.map(i => <Incident key={i.key} i={i} />)}
          </section>
          <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-2 gap-4">
            {groups.map(g => (
              <Card key={g.group}>
                <CardHeader className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2">
                  <h3 className="text-sm font-semibold text-primary">{g.group}</h3>
                  <Badge variant={STATUS_META[g.worst].variant}>{STATUS_META[g.worst].label}</Badge>
                </CardHeader>
                <CardBody className="p-0"><ul>{g.checks.map(c => <CheckRow key={c.key} c={c} />)}</ul></CardBody>
              </Card>
            ))}
          </div>
        </>
      )}
    </div>
  )
}
```

```jsx
import { useCallback, useEffect, useState } from 'react'
import { Archive, RefreshCw, TriangleAlert } from 'lucide-react'
import { fetchMaintenance, runBackupNow } from '../api/admin.js'
import { useAuth } from '../auth/AuthContext.jsx'
import { useToast } from '../components/Toast.jsx'
import { useConfirm } from '../components/ConfirmProvider.jsx'
import { formatDate, formatRelativeRu } from '../utils/format.js'
import { Badge, Button, Card, CardBody, CardHeader, PageHeader, Skeleton, Table, Thead, Tbody, Tr, Th, Td } from '../components/ui/index.js'

const SERVICE = { active: ['success', 'работает'], activating: ['warning', 'запускается'], failed: ['danger', 'упал'],
  inactive: ['default', 'остановлен'], 'not-installed': ['default', 'не установлен'], unknown: ['default', 'неизвестно'] }
const GUARD = { B: ['success', 'итоговая'], A: ['warning', 'переходная'], 'not-installed': ['danger', 'не установлена'], unknown: ['default', 'неизвестно'] }
const MODE = { on: ['accent', 'включены'], off: ['default', 'выключены'], unknown: ['danger', 'не определяется'] }
const when = t => (t && !t.startsWith('0001') ? `${formatRelativeRu(t)} · ${formatDate(t)}` : '—')

function Fact({ label, children }) {
  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-baseline gap-0.5 sm:gap-3 py-1.5 border-b border-default last:border-b-0">
      <span className="text-xs text-tertiary sm:w-44 shrink-0">{label}</span>
      <span className="text-sm text-primary min-w-0 break-words">{children}</span>
    </div>
  )
}

export default function MaintenancePage() {
  const { can } = useAuth()
  const toast = useToast()
  const confirm = useConfirm()
  const [data, setData] = useState(null)
  const [error, setError] = useState('')
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false)

  const load = useCallback(() => {
    fetchMaintenance().then(d => { setData(d); setError('') }).catch(e => setError(e.message))
  }, [])
  useEffect(() => { load() }, [load])

  async function backupNow() {
    const ok = await confirm({ title: 'Сделать бэкап сейчас?', confirmLabel: 'Запустить',
      message: 'Сохранятся база и настройки Hub; если настроена копия вне Hub — она уйдёт на выход за рубежом. Работа пользователей не прерывается, обычно 1–5 минут.' })
    if (!ok) return
    setBusy(true)
    try {
      const r = await runBackupNow()
      toast.success(r.message)
      setTimeout(load, 10000)
    } catch (e) { toast.error(e.message) } finally { setBusy(false) }
  }

  if (error && !data) return <div role="alert" className="rounded-md border border-danger/30 bg-danger/10 px-3 py-2 text-sm text-danger">Не удалось прочитать состояние Hub: {error}</div>
  if (!data) return <Skeleton className="h-96" />
  const { services, versions: v, backups: b, egress_guard: g, proxy_mode: p, certs, disk, api_log: log } = data
  const hyMismatch = v.hysteria.installed && v.hysteria.installed !== v.hysteria.pinned

  return (
    <div className="max-w-6xl space-y-4">
      <PageHeader title="Обслуживание" subtitle="Что сейчас на Hub: сервисы, версии, бэкапы, защита и режим входа 443. Только чтение — кроме «Бэкап сейчас»."
        actions={<Button variant="ghost" size="sm" icon={<RefreshCw className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />} onClick={load}>Обновить</Button>} />

      {(p.warnings || []).map((w, i) => (
        <div key={i} role="alert" className={`flex items-start gap-2 rounded-md border px-3 py-2 text-sm ${i === 0 ? 'border-warning/40 bg-warning/10 text-warning' : 'border-danger/40 bg-danger/10 text-danger'}`}>
          <TriangleAlert className="w-4 h-4 mt-0.5 shrink-0" aria-hidden="true" /><span>{w}</span>
        </div>
      ))}

      <Card>
        <CardHeader><h3 className="text-sm font-semibold text-primary">Сервисы Hub</h3></CardHeader>
        <Table>
          <Thead><Tr><Th>Сервис</Th><Th>Состояние</Th><Th align="right">Перезапусков</Th><Th>Работает с</Th></Tr></Thead>
          <Tbody>
            {services.map(s => {
              const [variant, label] = SERVICE[s.active] || SERVICE.unknown
              return (
                <Tr key={s.unit}>
                  <Td><span className="text-primary">{s.title}</span> <span className="text-xs text-tertiary font-mono">{s.unit}</span></Td>
                  <Td><Badge variant={variant}>{label}</Badge></Td>
                  <Td align="right" mono className={s.n_restarts > 0 ? 'text-warning' : ''}>{s.n_restarts}</Td>
                  <Td mono className="text-secondary">{s.since || s.error || '—'}</Td>
                </Tr>
              )
            })}
          </Tbody>
        </Table>
      </Card>

      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-2 gap-4">
        <Card>
          <CardHeader className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2">
            <h3 className="text-sm font-semibold text-primary">Бэкапы</h3>
            {can('server_ops.execute') && <Button size="sm" icon={<Archive className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />} onClick={backupNow} loading={busy} disabled={b.running}>{b.running ? 'Идёт бэкап…' : 'Бэкап сейчас'}</Button>}
          </CardHeader>
          <CardBody>
            <Fact label="Последний на Hub">{when(b.last_local)} <span className="text-tertiary">· хранится <span className="font-mono tabular-nums">{b.local_count}</span></span></Fact>
            <Fact label="Копия вне Hub">{b.offsite_target ? <><span className="font-mono">{b.offsite_target}</span> · {when(b.last_offsite)}</> : <span className="text-tertiary">не настроена (deploy --setup-ops)</span>}</Fact>
            <Fact label="Следующий запуск"><span className="font-mono">{b.next_run || '—'}</span></Fact>
            {b.last_error && <Fact label="Последняя ошибка"><span className="text-danger font-mono text-xs">{b.last_error}</span></Fact>}
          </CardBody>
        </Card>

        <Card>
          <CardHeader><h3 className="text-sm font-semibold text-primary">Версии</h3></CardHeader>
          <CardBody>
            <Fact label="Xray"><span className="font-mono">{v.xray.installed || v.xray.error}</span></Fact>
            <Fact label="Бамбук (Hysteria)">
              <span className="font-mono">{v.hysteria.installed || v.hysteria.error}</span>
              {' '}{hyMismatch ? <Badge variant="warning">закреплена {v.hysteria.pinned}</Badge> : <Badge variant="success">совпадает с закреплённой</Badge>}
            </Fact>
            <Fact label="Сборка API">
              <span className="font-mono">{(v.api.revision || 'неизвестно').slice(0, 12)}</span>
              {v.api.time && <span className="text-tertiary"> · {formatDate(v.api.time)}</span>}
              {v.api.modified && <> <Badge variant="warning">собрана с незакоммиченными правками</Badge></>}
            </Fact>
          </CardBody>
        </Card>

        <Card>
          <CardHeader><h3 className="text-sm font-semibold text-primary">Защита и вход 443</h3></CardHeader>
          <CardBody>
            <Fact label="Защита исходящих"><Badge variant={(GUARD[g.phase] || GUARD.unknown)[0]}>{(GUARD[g.phase] || GUARD.unknown)[1]}</Badge> <span className="text-secondary text-xs">{g.detail}</span></Fact>
            <Fact label="Реальные IP клиентов"><Badge variant={(MODE[p.mode] || MODE.unknown)[0]}>{(MODE[p.mode] || MODE.unknown)[1]}</Badge> <span className="text-secondary text-xs">{p.detail}</span></Fact>
            <Fact label="Слушают порты">
              <span className="flex flex-wrap gap-1.5">
                {Object.entries(p.listening || {}).map(([port, up]) => <Badge key={port} variant={up ? 'success' : 'default'}><span className="font-mono">{port}</span></Badge>)}
              </span>
            </Fact>
          </CardBody>
        </Card>

        <Card>
          <CardHeader><h3 className="text-sm font-semibold text-primary">Сертификаты и диск</h3></CardHeader>
          <CardBody>
            {certs.map(c => (
              <Fact key={c.name} label={c.name}>
                {c.error ? <span className="text-tertiary">{c.error}</span> : <>
                  <span className="font-mono text-xs">{c.subject}</span> · до {formatDate(c.not_after)}{' '}
                  <Badge variant={c.days_left < 0 ? 'danger' : c.days_left < 14 ? 'warning' : 'success'}><span className="font-mono tabular-nums">{c.days_left}</span> дн.</Badge>
                </>}
              </Fact>
            ))}
            <Fact label="Диск /">
              {disk.error ? <span className="text-tertiary">{disk.error}</span> : <span className="flex items-center gap-2">
                <span className="font-mono tabular-nums">{disk.used_percent}%</span>
                <span className="h-1.5 w-32 rounded bg-hover overflow-hidden" aria-hidden="true">
                  <span className={`block h-full ${disk.used_percent > 85 ? 'bg-danger' : disk.used_percent > 70 ? 'bg-warning' : 'bg-success'}`} style={{ width: `${Math.min(100, disk.used_percent)}%` }} />
                </span>
              </span>}
            </Fact>
          </CardBody>
        </Card>
      </div>

      <Card>
        <CardHeader><h3 className="text-sm font-semibold text-primary">Журнал API — последние строки</h3></CardHeader>
        <pre className="max-h-80 overflow-auto p-3 text-xs font-mono text-secondary whitespace-pre-wrap break-all bg-canvas">{(log || []).join('\n') || 'Журнал пуст или недоступен'}</pre>
      </Card>

      <p className="text-xs text-tertiary">Остаются в командной строке: включение/выключение реальных IP, восстановление из бэкапа, <span className="font-mono">deploy --setup-ops</span>, деплой API и админки.</p>
    </div>
  )
}
```

- [ ] **Step 4: Поле** — `src/components/settings/SettingField.jsx`:
```jsx
import { useEffect, useState } from 'react'
import { Button, Input, Switch, Textarea } from '../ui/index.js' // Switch — primitive of phase 2 (Task 2.12)

export default function SettingField({ field, value, secretSet, disabled, onSave, onClear }) {
  const id = `setting-${field.key}`
  const secret = field.kind === 'secret'
  const [input, setInput] = useState(secret ? '' : value ?? '')
  const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false)
  useEffect(() => { if (!secret) setInput(value ?? '') }, [value, secret])

  async function save(v) {
    setSaving(true)
    try { if ((await onSave(field, v)) !== false && secret) setInput('') } finally { setSaving(false) }
  }

  const label = <label htmlFor={id} className="text-sm text-primary">{field.label}</label>
  const hint = field.hint && <p className="text-xs text-tertiary mt-0.5">{field.hint}</p>
  if (field.kind === 'bool') {
    return (
      <div className="py-3">
        <Switch id={id} checked={value === 'true'} disabled={disabled || saving} label={field.label} description={field.hint}
          onChange={(next) => save(next ? 'true' : 'false')} />
      </div>
    )
  }
  const Field = field.kind === 'textarea' ? Textarea : Input
  const changed = secret ? input !== '' : input !== (value ?? '')
  return (
    <div className="py-3">
      {label}{hint}
      <div className="mt-1.5 flex flex-col sm:flex-row gap-2">
        <Field id={id} value={input} onChange={e => setInput(e.target.value)} disabled={disabled}
          type={secret ? 'password' : field.kind === 'int' ? 'number' : field.kind === 'email' ? 'email' : 'text'}
          min={field.min} max={field.max} autoComplete={secret ? 'new-password' : 'off'}
          placeholder={secret && secretSet ? 'Сохранён — введите новый, чтобы заменить' : field.placeholder}
          className={`sm:flex-1 ${secret || field.kind === 'int' ? 'font-mono' : ''}`} />
        <div className="flex gap-2">
          <Button size="md" onClick={() => save(input)} disabled={disabled || !changed} loading={saving}>Сохранить</Button>
          {secret && secretSet && <Button size="md" variant="ghost" onClick={() => onClear(field)} disabled={disabled || saving}>Удалить</Button>}
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  )
}
```

- [ ] **Step 6: Страница** — `src/pages/SettingsPage.jsx` — целиком:
```jsx
import { useEffect, useState } from 'react'
import { Link } from 'react-router-dom'
import { RefreshCw } from 'lucide-react'
import { useAuth } from '../auth/AuthContext.jsx'
import { useToast } from '../components/Toast.jsx'
import { useConfirm } from '../components/ConfirmProvider.jsx'
import SettingField from '../components/settings/SettingField.jsx'
import { SETTINGS_BLOCKS } from '../components/settings/settingsBlocks.js'
import { checkYookassa, fetchEditableSettings, fetchQuotaPreview, getSettings, sendTestEmail, updateSetting } from '../api/admin.js'
import { Button, Card, CardBody, CardHeader, Input, PageHeader, Skeleton } from '../components/ui/index.js'

const ADDRESS_KEYS = [['main_server_host', 'Адрес входа (в подписках)'], ['site_url', 'Адрес сайта'], ['hub_main_server_host', 'Домен сертификата Бамбука']]

export default function SettingsPage() {
  const { can } = useAuth()
  const toast = useToast()
  const confirm = useConfirm()
  const canWrite = can('settings.write')
  const [values, setValues] = useState(null)
  const [secrets, setSecrets] = useState({})
  const [addresses, setAddresses] = useState({})
  const [error, setError] = useState('')
  const [ykResult, setYkResult] = useState(null)
  const [testTo, setTestTo] = useState('')
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState('')

  function load() {
    Promise.all([fetchEditableSettings(), getSettings().catch(() => ({}))])
      .then(([e, all]) => { setValues(e.values); setSecrets(e.secrets_set); setAddresses(all.settings || all); setError('') })
      .catch(e => setError(e.message))
  }
  useEffect(load, [])

  // Extra confirmations before a write; false cancels it.
  async function confirmChange(key, v) {
    if (key === 'yookassa_test_mode') {
      return v === 'false'
        ? confirm({ title: 'Включить боевой режим ЮKassa?', danger: true, typeToConfirm: 'БОЕВОЙ', confirmLabel: 'Включить',
            message: 'С этой минуты оплаты списывают настоящие деньги. Сначала нажмите «Проверить подключение»: ключ должен быть боевым (live_…).' })
        : confirm({ title: 'Включить тестовый режим?', danger: true, confirmLabel: 'Включить тестовый',
            message: 'Пока режим включён, настоящие оплаты не проходят — покупатели не смогут продлить подписку.' })
    }
    if (key === 'quota_cutoff_enabled' && v === 'true') {
      const p = await fetchQuotaPreview()
      return confirm({ title: 'Включить отключение по квоте?', danger: p.over_quota > 0, confirmLabel: 'Включить',
        typeToConfirm: p.over_quota > 0 ? 'ОТКЛЮЧИТЬ' : undefined,
        message: `Сейчас превысили квоту: ${p.over_quota} польз. — они потеряют доступ в течение 5 минут.\n\n${p.note}` })
    }
    if (key === 'quota_cutoff_enabled') {
      return confirm({ title: 'Выключить отключение по квоте?', confirmLabel: 'Выключить', message: 'Превысившие квоту снова получат доступ при следующей синхронизации.' })
    }
    return true
  }

  async function save(field, v, clear = false) {
    try {
      if (!(await confirmChange(field.key, v))) return false
      const r = await updateSetting(field.key, v, clear)
      if (field.kind === 'secret') setSecrets(s => ({ ...s, [field.key]: !clear }))
      else setValues(s => ({ ...s, [field.key]: r.value ?? v }))
      toast.success(`${field.label}: сохранено`)
    } catch (e) { toast.error(e.message); return false }
  }

  async function clearSecret(field) {
    if (await confirm({ title: `Удалить «${field.label}»?`, danger: true, confirmLabel: 'Удалить', message: 'Пока значение не задано заново, эта функция работать не будет.' })) save(field, '', true)
  }

  async function runCheck(kind) {
    setBusy(kind)
    try {
      if (kind === 'yk') setYkResult(await checkYookassa())
      else toast.success((await sendTestEmail(testTo)).message)
    } catch (e) { kind === 'yk' ? setYkResult({ error: e.message }) : toast.error(e.message) } finally { setBusy('') }
  }

  if (error) return (
    <div role="alert" className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center justify-between gap-3 rounded-md border border-danger/30 bg-danger/10 px-3 py-2">
      <span className="text-sm text-danger">Не удалось загрузить настройки: {error}. Форма скрыта, чтобы не затереть сохранённое.</span>
      <Button variant="secondary" size="sm" icon={<RefreshCw className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />} onClick={load}>Повторить</Button>
    </div>
  )
  if (!values) return <Skeleton className="h-96 max-w-3xl" />

  return (
    <div className="max-w-3xl space-y-4">
      <PageHeader title="Настройки" subtitle="Платежи, почта, юридические данные и правила подписок. Протоколы — в «Протоколах и маскировке», адреса — в «Доменах»." />
      {SETTINGS_BLOCKS.map(block => (
        <Card key={block.id}>
          <CardHeader>
            <h3 className="text-sm font-semibold text-primary">{block.title}</h3>
            {block.hint && <p className="text-xs text-tertiary mt-0.5">{block.hint}</p>}
          </CardHeader>
          <CardBody className="py-0 divide-y divide-default">
            {block.fields.map(f => (
              <SettingField key={f.key} field={f} value={values[f.key]} secretSet={secrets[f.key]} disabled={!canWrite} onSave={save} onClear={clearSecret} />
            ))}
            {block.id === 'payments' && canWrite && (
              <div className="py-3 space-y-2">
                <Button variant="secondary" onClick={() => runCheck('yk')} loading={busy === 'yk'}>Проверить подключение</Button>
                {ykResult?.error && <p className="text-xs text-danger">{ykResult.error}</p>}
                {ykResult?.ok && <p className="text-xs text-success">Магазин <span className="font-mono">{ykResult.account_id}</span> отвечает: {ykResult.test ? 'тестовый' : 'боевой'}, фискализация {ykResult.fiscalization ? 'включена' : 'выключена'}.</p>}
                {ykResult?.mismatch && <p className="text-xs text-warning">Ключи от {ykResult.test ? 'тестового' : 'боевого'} магазина, а «Тестовый режим» {ykResult.test_mode_setting ? 'включён' : 'выключен'} — приведите в соответствие.</p>}
              </div>
            )}
            {block.id === 'mail' && canWrite && (
              <div className="py-3 flex flex-col sm:flex-row gap-2">
                <Input type="email" value={testTo} onChange={e => setTestTo(e.target.value)} placeholder="куда отправить тестовое письмо" className="sm:flex-1" aria-label="Адрес для тестового письма" />
                <Button variant="secondary" onClick={() => runCheck('mail')} loading={busy === 'mail'} disabled={!testTo}>Отправить тестовое письмо</Button>
              </div>
            )}
          </CardBody>
        </Card>
      ))}
      <Card>
        <CardHeader><h3 className="text-sm font-semibold text-primary">Адреса сервиса</h3><p className="text-xs text-tertiary mt-0.5">Только просмотр — меняются в разделе <Link to="/domains" className="text-accent hover:underline">«Домены»</Link>.</p></CardHeader>
        <CardBody className="py-0 divide-y divide-default">
          {ADDRESS_KEYS.map(([k, label]) => (
```

```js
export function diffProtocolChanges(values, form, editable) {
  const out = {}
  for (const k of editable) {
    const v = String(form[k] ?? '').trim()
    if (v !== String(values[k] ?? '').trim()) out[k] = v
  }
  return out
}
export const FINGERPRINTS = ['chrome', 'firefox', 'safari', 'edge', 'ios', 'android']
```

```jsx
function Row({ label, children, note }) {
  return (
    <div className="py-1.5 border-b border-default last:border-b-0 flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-baseline gap-0.5 sm:gap-3">
      <span className="text-xs text-tertiary sm:w-48 shrink-0">{label}</span>

export default function ProtocolsPage() {
  const { can } = useAuth()

  const [data, setData] = useState(null)
  const [error, setError] = useState('')
  const [form, setForm] = useState(null)
  const [ack, setAck] = useState(false)
  const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false)

  const load = () => fetchProtocols().then(d => { setData(d); setError('') }).catch(e => setError(e.message))
  useEffect(() => { load() }, [])

  async function save() {
    const changes = diffProtocolChanges(data.values, form, data.editable)
    if (Object.keys(changes).length === 0) { setForm(null); return }
    setSaving(true)
    try {
      const r = await saveProtocols(changes)
      toast.success(`${r.message} Версия конфигурации: ${r.config_version}`)
      setForm(null)
      load()
    } catch (e) { toast.error(e.message) } finally { setSaving(false) }
  }

  if (error) return <div role="alert" className="rounded-md border border-danger/30 bg-danger/10 px-3 py-2 text-sm text-danger">Не удалось загрузить: {error}</div>
  if (!data) return <Skeleton className="h-96" />
  const v = data.values
  const set = (k, val) => setForm(f => ({ ...f, [k]: val }))

  return (
    <div className="max-w-5xl space-y-4">
      <PageHeader title="Протоколы и маскировка"
        subtitle={<>Как выглядит трафик пользователей для провайдера. Версия конфигурации <span className="font-mono tabular-nums">{data.config_version || '1'}</span>{data.config_version_updated_at && <> · изменена {formatRelativeRu(data.config_version_updated_at)}</>}.</>}
        actions={can('settings.write') && <Button icon={<Pencil className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />} onClick={() => { setAck(false); setForm({ ...v }) }}>Изменить</Button>} />

      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-2 gap-4">
        <Card>
          <CardHeader><h3 className="text-sm font-semibold text-primary">Берёза — основной протокол</h3></CardHeader>
          <CardBody>
            <Row label="Маскировка под сайт (SNI)" note="Провайдер видит соединение с этим сайтом."><span className="font-mono">{v.reality_sni_domain}</span></Row>
            <Row label="Отпечаток браузера"><span className="font-mono">{v.reality_fingerprint}</span></Row>
            <Row label="Транспорт" note="tcp + xtls-rprx-vision — обязательны для Берёзы, не меняются."><span className="font-mono">{v.reality_transport} · {v.reality_flow}</span></Row>
          </CardBody>
        </Card>
        <Card>
          <CardHeader><h3 className="text-sm font-semibold text-primary">Дуб — запасной, через CDN</h3></CardHeader>
          <CardBody>
            <Row label="Дуб через CDN"><Badge variant={v.cdn_enabled === 'true' ? 'success' : 'default'}>{v.cdn_enabled === 'true' ? 'включён' : 'выключен'}</Badge></Row>
            <Row label="Домен CDN" note={<>Меняется в <Link to="/domains" className="text-accent hover:underline">«Доменах»</Link>.</>}><span className="font-mono">{v.cdn_host}</span></Row>
          </CardBody>
        </Card>
        <Card>
          <CardHeader><h3 className="text-sm font-semibold text-primary">Связь Hub ↔ выходы за рубежом</h3></CardHeader>
          <CardBody>
            <Row label="DNS-серверы"><span className="font-mono">{v.dns_servers}</span></Row>
            <Row label="Мультиплексирование (mux)"><span className="font-mono tabular-nums">{v.mux_concurrency}</span></Row>
            <Row label="Выбор выхода" note={<>Приоритет каждого выхода задаётся в карточке ноды («<Link to="/nodes" className="text-accent hover:underline">Ноды</Link>»).</>}>по приоритету: трафик идёт на живой выход с более высоким приоритетом (с учётом задержки), остальные — резерв</Row>
          </CardBody>
        </Card>
        <Card>
          <CardHeader><h3 className="text-sm font-semibold text-primary">Пальма (AmneziaWG)</h3></CardHeader>
          <CardBody>
            <Row label="Подключено устройств"><span className="font-mono tabular-nums">{data.awg.peer_count || '0'}</span></Row>
            <Row label="Последняя синхронизация">{data.awg.last_sync_at ? formatDate(data.awg.last_sync_at) : '—'}</Row>
            <Row label="Версия конфигурации"><span className="font-mono tabular-nums">{data.awg.config_version || '—'}</span></Row>
            {data.awg.last_error && <Row label="Последняя ошибка"><span className="text-danger text-xs font-mono">{data.awg.last_error}</span></Row>}
          </CardBody>
        </Card>
        <BambooCard />
        <Card>
          <CardHeader><h3 className="text-sm font-semibold text-primary">Автотюнер</h3></CardHeader>
          <CardBody>

            <Link to="/auto-tuner" className="inline-block mt-2 text-sm text-accent hover:underline">Открыть автотюнер →</Link>
          </CardBody>
        </Card>
      </div>

      <Dialog open={!!form} onClose={() => setForm(null)} title="Изменить протоколы" maxWidth="max-w-lg">
        {form && (

            <div>
              <label htmlFor="p-sni" className="block text-xs text-tertiary mb-1">Маскировка под сайт (SNI)</label>
              <Input id="p-sni" className="font-mono" value={form.reality_sni_domain} onChange={e => set('reality_sni_domain', e.target.value)} />
              <p className="text-xs text-tertiary mt-1">Российский сайт для входа в РФ (yandex.ru, vk.com). apple.com не подходит.</p>

            <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-3">
              <div>
                <label htmlFor="p-fp" className="block text-xs text-tertiary mb-1">Отпечаток браузера</label>
                <Select id="p-fp" value={form.reality_fingerprint} onChange={e => set('reality_fingerprint', e.target.value)}>
                  {FINGERPRINTS.map(f => <option key={f} value={f}>{f}</option>)}
                </Select>
              </div>
              <div>
                <label htmlFor="p-mux" className="block text-xs text-tertiary mb-1">Mux (1–64)</label>
                <Input id="p-mux" type="number" min="1" max="64" className="font-mono" value={form.mux_concurrency} onChange={e => set('mux_concurrency', e.target.value)} />
              </div>
            </div>
            <div>
              <label htmlFor="p-dns" className="block text-xs text-tertiary mb-1">DNS-серверы (через запятую, до 4)</label>
              <Input id="p-dns" className="font-mono" value={form.dns_servers} onChange={e => set('dns_servers', e.target.value)} />
            </div>
            <label className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 text-sm text-primary cursor-pointer">
              <input type="checkbox" className="h-3.5 w-3.5 accent-accent" checked={form.cdn_enabled === 'true'} onChange={e => set('cdn_enabled', String(e.target.checked))} />
              Дуб через CDN
            </label>
            <div role="alert" className="rounded-md border border-warning/40 bg-warning/10 px-3 py-2 text-xs text-warning flex gap-2">
              <TriangleAlert className="w-4 h-4 shrink-0" aria-hidden="true" />
              <span>После сохранения версия конфигурации вырастет до <span className="font-mono">{Number(data.config_version || 1) + 1}</span>: пользователям придётся обновить подписку в приложении (Happ покажет баннер). Пока они не обновят, часть подключений может не работать.</span>
            </div>
            <label className="inline-flex items-start gap-2 text-sm text-primary cursor-pointer">
              <input type="checkbox" className="h-3.5 w-3.5 mt-0.5 accent-accent" checked={ack} onChange={e => setAck(e.target.checked)} />

            <div className="flex flex-col-reverse sm:flex-row sm:justify-end gap-2">
              <Button type="button" variant="ghost" onClick={() => setForm(null)}>Отмена</Button>

      </Dialog>
```

    ```js
        typeToConfirm: used ? plan.slug : undefined,
        message: `Активных подписок: ${u.active_subscriptions}, всего подписок: ${u.all_subscriptions}, повторов оплаты в очереди: ${u.pending_retries}, промокодов с этим тарифом: ${u.promocodes}.\n\n` +
          (used ? 'Подписчики останутся без тарифа: пропадут протоколы и привязка к выходам. Обычно лучше снять галочку «Активен» — новые покупки прекратятся, текущие доработают.' : 'Тариф не используется — удаление безопасно.'),
      })
      if (!ok) return
      try { await deletePlan(plan.id, used ? plan.slug : ''); toast.success('Тариф удалён'); reload() } catch (e) { toast.error(e.message) }
    }
    ```

```js
// Request bodies exactly as internal/admin expects them (role_keys, role_key, permission_keys, user_id).
export function adminUserPayload({ username, displayName = '', password = '', roleKeys = [], isActive = true }) {
  const p = { username: username.trim(), display_name: displayName.trim(), role_keys: roleKeys, is_active: isActive }
  if (password) p.password = password
  return p
}
export function adminRolePayload({ roleKey, name, description = '', permissionKeys = [] }) {
  return { role_key: roleKey.trim(), name: name.trim(), description: description.trim(), permission_keys: permissionKeys }
}
export const permissionKey = p => (typeof p === 'object' ? p.Key || p.key : p)
export function newUserPayload({ userId = '', telegramId = '', role = 'user', blocked = false }) {
  const p = { role, is_blocked: blocked }
  if (userId.trim()) p.user_id = userId.trim()
  if (String(telegramId).trim()) p.telegram_id = Number(telegramId)
  return p
}
```

```js
    { to: '/mtproto', label: 'Telegram-прокси', icon: 'Send', perm: 'settings.read' },
  ] },
  { id: 'system', label: 'СИСТЕМА', ownerOnly: true, items: [
    { to: '/alerts', label: 'Алерты', icon: 'Bell', perm: 'settings.read' },
    { to: '/maintenance', label: 'Обслуживание', icon: 'Wrench', perm: 'settings.read' },

    { to: '/ssh-keys', label: 'SSH-ключи', icon: 'Key', perm: 'servers.read' },
    { to: '/releases', label: 'Релизы', icon: 'Rocket', perm: 'releases.read' },
  ] },
  { id: 'b2b', label: 'B2B', ownerOnly: true, defaultCollapsed: true, items: [
    { to: '/tenants', label: 'Компании', icon: 'Building2', perm: 'tenants.read' },
    { to: '/b2b-analytics', label: 'Аналитика', icon: 'TrendingUp', perm: 'tenants.read' },
  ] },
]

export function visibleNav(groups, { can, isTenantAdmin, hasRoute = () => true }) {
  return groups
    .map(g => ({
      ...g,
      items: g.items.filter(i =>
        (!i.perm || can(i.perm)) && !(isTenantAdmin && (g.ownerOnly || i.ownerOnly)) && hasRoute(i.to)),
    }))
    .filter(g => g.items.length > 0)
}

export function firstAllowedPath(groups, ctx) {
  return visibleNav(groups, ctx)[0]?.items[0]?.to || '/dashboard'
}
```

```jsx
import { useState } from 'react'
import { NavLink } from 'react-router-dom'
import { ChevronDown, PanelLeftClose, PanelLeftOpen, Search, X } from 'lucide-react'
import { useAuth } from '../auth/AuthContext.jsx'
import { NAV_GROUPS, visibleNav } from '../nav/navigation.js'
import { NAV_ICONS } from '../nav/icons.js'
import { availablePaths } from '../routes.jsx'
import { Kbd } from './ui/index.js'
import ProfileMenu from './ProfileMenu.jsx'

const GROUPS_KEY = 'hiearth-sidebar-groups-v2'
const readGroups = () => { try { return JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(GROUPS_KEY) || '{}') } catch { return {} } }

export default function Sidebar({ collapsed, onToggleCollapse, onCmdK, onChangePassword, mobile = false, onMobileNav }) {
  const { can, isTenantAdmin } = useAuth()
  const [openGroups, setOpenGroups] = useState(readGroups)
  const groups = visibleNav(NAV_GROUPS, { can, isTenantAdmin, hasRoute: p => availablePaths.has(p) })
  const isOpen = g => openGroups[g.id] ?? !g.defaultCollapsed
  const toggle = g => {
    const next = { ...openGroups, [g.id]: !isOpen(g) }
    setOpenGroups(next)
    try { localStorage.setItem(GROUPS_KEY, JSON.stringify(next)) } catch { /* per-viewer convenience only */ }
  }

  return (
    <aside className={`shrink-0 h-screen bg-elevated border-r border-default flex flex-col ${mobile ? '' : 'sticky top-0'}`}
      style={mobile ? { width: '280px' } : { width: collapsed ? '60px' : '240px', transition: 'width 150ms ease' }}>
      <div className="h-12 px-3 flex items-center justify-between border-b border-default">
        {!collapsed && <div className="font-semibold text-primary tracking-tight truncate">HiEarth</div>}
        <button type="button" onClick={onToggleCollapse}
          aria-label={mobile ? 'Закрыть меню' : collapsed ? 'Развернуть боковую панель' : 'Свернуть боковую панель'}
          className={`p-1.5 rounded text-tertiary hover:text-primary hover:bg-hover ${!mobile && collapsed ? 'mx-auto' : ''}`}>
          {mobile ? <X className="w-4 h-4" /> : collapsed ? <PanelLeftOpen className="w-4 h-4" /> : <PanelLeftClose className="w-4 h-4" />}
        </button>
      </div>
      <button type="button" onClick={onCmdK} aria-label="Поиск (⌘K)"
        className={collapsed ? 'mx-auto mt-3 mb-1 w-9 h-9 flex items-center justify-center rounded text-tertiary hover:text-primary hover:bg-hover'
          : 'mx-2 mt-3 mb-1 flex items-center gap-2 h-8 px-2.5 rounded border border-default bg-canvas hover:bg-hover text-sm text-tertiary hover:text-primary'}>
        <Search className={collapsed ? 'w-4 h-4' : 'w-3.5 h-3.5'} />
        {!collapsed && <><span className="flex-1 text-left">Поиск…</span><span className="flex gap-0.5"><Kbd>⌘</Kbd><Kbd>K</Kbd></span></>}
      </button>
      <nav className="flex-1 overflow-y-auto px-2 pb-3 space-y-0.5" aria-label="Разделы админки">
        {groups.map(g => (
          <div key={g.id}>
            {collapsed ? <div className="my-2 mx-2 border-t border-default" /> : (
              <button type="button" onClick={() => toggle(g)} aria-expanded={isOpen(g)}
                className="w-full flex items-center justify-between px-3 mt-4 mb-1 text-[10px] uppercase tracking-wider text-tertiary hover:text-secondary">
                <span>{g.label}</span><ChevronDown className={`w-3 h-3 transition-transform ${isOpen(g) ? '' : '-rotate-90'}`} />
              </button>
            )}
            {(collapsed || isOpen(g)) && g.items.map(item => <SidebarItem key={item.to} item={item} collapsed={collapsed} onMobileNav={onMobileNav} />)}
          </div>
        ))}
      </nav>
      <div className="border-t border-default p-2">
        <ProfileMenu collapsed={collapsed} onChangePassword={onChangePassword} />
      </div>
    </aside>
  )
}

function SidebarItem({ item, collapsed, onMobileNav }) {
  const Icon = NAV_ICONS[item.icon]
  return (
    <NavLink to={item.to} title={collapsed ? item.label : undefined} aria-label={collapsed ? item.label : undefined}
      onClick={() => onMobileNav && onMobileNav()}
      className={({ isActive }) => `flex items-center gap-2 h-8 rounded text-sm transition-colors ${collapsed ? 'justify-center w-9 mx-auto px-0' : 'px-3'} ${
        isActive ? `bg-accent/10 text-primary border-l-2 border-accent ${collapsed ? '' : 'pl-[10px]'}` : 'text-secondary hover:bg-hover hover:text-primary'}`}>
      {Icon && <Icon className="w-4 h-4 shrink-0" />}
      {!collapsed && <span className="flex-1 truncate">{item.label}</span>}
    </NavLink>
  )
}
```
